jobs.excerpt: The Senior Attorney will manage and lead an active caseload of state and federal plaintiff's-side wage-and-hour, class, and representative action litigation against regional, national, and Fortune 500 companies, while also providing guidance and oversight to associate attorneys.
jobs.description:
The Senior Attorney will manage and lead an active caseload of state and federal plaintiff's-side wage-and-hour, class, and representative action litigation against regional, national, and Fortune 500 companies, while also providing guidance and oversight to associate attorneys. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, developing case strategy; conducting and responding to complex discovery; taking and defending depositions; drafting and arguing dispositive and class certification motions; leading settlement negotiations; appearing in court for hearings and trial; and mentoring junior attorneys on litigation best practices. Our agenda is growing and the ideal candidate for this position is a licensed, highly experienced litigator with a strong track record in complex or class action litigation who is organized, professional, and committed to achieving strong outcomes for our clients.

Qualifications

  • Candidates must be either (a) licensed to practice law in Illinois or (b) already licensed in another U.S. jurisdiction and pending admission to the Illinois Bar.
  • The ideal candidate will be licensed to practice law in Illinois and have minimum of 8+ years of experience in civil litigation, including experience with discovery in the civil litigation context, oral advocacy and appearing in Court, motion practice and taking/defending depositions.
  • Prior experience with class actions, complex litigation, and wage and hour litigation is a plus.
  • Candidates must be able to travel on occasion.
License/Certification:
  • Must be licensed to practice law in the state of Chicago

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance
  • Opportunity for Performance Based Discretionary Bonus & Merit Increases

jobs.title: Account Executive TikTok Shop (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Du willst keinen Job.  Du willst ein Spielfeld.  Du weißt, was es für einen Abschluss braucht, denkst in Umsatz statt in Arbeitsstunden und wirst unruhig, wenn's zu langsam vorangeht?
jobs.description:
Du willst keinen Job. Du willst ein Spielfeld.

Du weißt, was es für einen Abschluss braucht, denkst in Umsatz statt in Arbeitsstunden und wirst unruhig, wenn's zu langsam vorangeht?

Dann lies weiter.

Wir sind RealStudio, Social Performance Partner für Brands wie AG1, AirUp, TOOM Baumarkt & Smilodox. Im Agentur-Ranking von TikTok Shop sind wir aktuell auf Platz 4 in Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist Platz 1, und dafür brauchen wir dich in unserem Account Management Team.

Aufgaben

Du bist das Gesicht für unsere TikTok Shop-Kunden und damit für unseren Backend-Umsatz verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Brands bei uns bleiben, mehr buchen und andere Brands an uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Kunden ownen, nicht nur betreuen: Du übernimmst die komplette Kommunikation, Strategie-Calls und Reviews. Du weißt vor dem Kunden, was er als Nächstes braucht.

  • Upsells, Cross-Sells, Verlängerungen: Du erkennst Potenziale, schnürst Angebote und bringst sie selbst zum Abschluss.

  • KPIs: NPS, Verlängerungsquote, Churn, Pipeline im CRM. Hier bist du verantwortlich und hast es selbst in der Hand.

  • Squad Lead: Du arbeitest eng mit 2–3 Creator Managern zusammen, die an dich berichten. Du gibst die Richtung vor und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Build the Machine: Du baust Account-Pläne, Review-Rhythmen und Prozesse auf. Wenn das Team wächst, kann daraus eine Lead Position werden.

Qualifikation

  • Sales im Blut: Du hast nachweislich verkauft und abgeschlossen. Wir bringen dir TikTok Shop bei, aber nicht, wie man verkauft.

  • Background: Aus E-Commerce, Agentur oder Selbstständigkeit, zum Beispiel TikTok Shop, Amazon, eBay, Account Management in einer Agentur oder ein eigenes E-Com-Business mit eigenem Vertrieb.

  • Brain & Speed: Du verstehst Dinge schnell, bist street smart und musst nicht alles dreimal erklärt bekommen.

  • People Skills: Kunden arbeiten gern mit dir, weil du ehrlich, schnell und angenehm bist. It's a people game.

  • Performance-Mindset: Du hast Bock zu arbeiten und Geld zu verdienen. Eine Deadline steht an und du klappst den Laptop zu? Dann passt es nicht.

  • Remote: Wenn du remote arbeiten willst, hast du schon mindestens 1 Jahr remote gearbeitet und weißt, wie man sich selbst organisiert.

Benefits

Quasi selbstständig, aber ohne den ganzen Stress
Viele von uns ticken wie Unternehmer. Bei RealStudio bekommst du das, was die Selbstständigkeit gut macht: Ownership, keine Hierarchien und ein Einkommen, das nach oben offen ist.

Was du dir dabei sparst: Buchhaltung, Rechnungen schreiben, Kunden akquirieren und die Unsicherheit, ob nächsten Monat genug reinkommt. Die Leads bringt unser Sales-Team, die Delivery macht das Backend. Du konzentrierst dich darauf, Kunden groß zu machen.

Was dich sonst noch erwartet:

  • Fixum plus Provision auf den Umsatz deiner Brands plus Boni für Verlängerungen, Upsells und Cross-Sells. Monatlich ausgezahlt, nach oben offen.

  • Vertrauen ab Tag 1: Du hast eine Idee? Dann let's go! Wir arbeiten ohne starre Vorgaben und Politik, direkt mit den Foundern.

  • Eine Lernkurve wie sonst kaum wo: TikTok Shop ist der am schnellsten wachsende Commerce-Kanal, und wir sind mittendrin. Wir hinterfragen Prozesse und Ergebnisse jede Woche.

  • Remote oder Berlin: Du entscheidest. Unser Office in der Eberswalder Straße hat 300 m², zwei Dachterrassen und Klimaanlage.

  • Ein Team, das sich wie Freunde anfühlt: ca. 30 Leute, die gern zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam Gas geben.

  • Die Basics: unbefristeter Vertrag, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Sport-Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge ab dem 2. Jahr.

Klingt genau nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager - East
jobs.excerpt: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter.
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows and build solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

The Sr. Customer Success Manager builds high-value, strategic relationships with a focused portfolio of large, complex enterprise customers. The role requires extensive experience in SaaS Customer Success, strong business acumen and exceptional communication skills.

The Sr. Customer Success Manager is expected to provide thought leadership and mentorship to CSMs, as well as lead and/or contribute to special programs and projects. For the right candidate, this is a career-defining opportunity to join the market leader in Smartsheet, the AI powered enterprise work management platform and help influence the future of Customer Success as a vocation.

This role reports to a Manager of Customer Success.

You Will:

Lead AI-First Transformation & Value Creation

  • Act as a trusted advisor, partnering with customers to unlock the full potential of Smartsheet's platform from core workflows through to AI-powered capabilities that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Design and maintain AI Adoption Roadmaps and Customer Success Plans that connect Smartsheet's AI capabilities (agents, Smart Assist, and MCP connections to the AI tools customers already use), with adoption and usage as the measure of progress to each customer's strategic priorities and goals.

Executive Relationship Management

  • Be the single thread to the customer. Orchestrate Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product and Training so the customer has one owner, one cadence and one plan.
  • Build and sustain trusted, multi-threaded relationships at the VP and C-Suite level, owning and leading high-impact QBRs and Executive Business Reviews.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures to develop a robust stakeholder map, ensuring relationships are resilient to executive turnover and aligned to evolving business strategy.

Value Engineering

  • Onboarding and value realization: Lead onboarding for strategic customers, from planning through rollout and training. You understand each customer’s deployment and how it fits their broader business goals, partner hands-on with their teams to model best practices, and keep executive stakeholders informed as customers realize measurable value early and over time.
  • Define, track, and measure KPIs, mapping Smartsheet solution adoption directly to financial outcomes.
  • Transform standard Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) into executive briefings focused on realized value (efficiency gains, reduced operational risk, and tool consolidation savings).
  • Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.
  • Own the path to resolution, diagnosing the issue and bringing in Support, SEs, Product or Engineering at the right moment for complex technical challenges raised by the Customer, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.
  • Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. Establish trust with customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.

Commercial Growth & Renewal Strategy

  • Co-own Account Plans and Value Realization frameworks with Sales, driving renewal confidence, expansion, and measurable customer ROI.
  • Influence renewals in close partnership with internal teams, forming a cohesive approach to mitigate churn and identify expansion opportunities.
  • Positively impact revenue by coaching customers to develop and enhance solutions that translate directly into upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

Data-Driven

  • Use data to gain insights, provide guidance, increase customer adoption and proactively identify opportunities for expansion and risk mitigation.
  • Create and execute territory engagement plans and joint customer enablement plans grounded in customer-specific data, with a focus on value realization and tailored strategy.

Advocacy

  • Serve as a thought leader, advising customers on industry best practices and how to solve complex business problems using the Smartsheet platform.
  • Provide customer insight to internal teams, Product, Marketing, and Sales, to inform innovation, roadmap prioritization, and go-to-market strategy.

Risk Management

  • Identify risk the week it appears, with an owner, a plan and a loss range, and maintain an accurate renewal forecast. across your book of business, deploying targeted mitigation strategies to protect retention and customer health.
  • Understand each customer's business model, go-to-market strategy, and organizational structure to anticipate risk and build proactive, customer-specific engagement plans.

Smartsheet Platform SME

  • Manage a focused portfolio of large, complex accounts, with a focus on engagement, enablement and adoption across the full Smartsheet platform.
  • Maintain strong fluency of Smartsheets Core Product, enough to diagnose customer needs and bring in the right specialist and Premium Application SME, mastering best practices and enablement strategies to accelerate product adoption across your customer base.
  • Effectively partner with cross-functional teams - Sales, Training, Product, Professional Services - to deliver a unified, cohesive, and elite customer experience.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, or solutions architecture , with a strong background in SaaS and enterprise customers.
  • Strategic mindset that anticipates where the market, the customer, and the business are heading, connecting long-term trends to near-term account strategy before others see the need.
  • Deeply attuned to the goals, pressures, and success metrics of the customer's business, treating their outcomes as the primary measure of success.
  • Actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to evolve how value is delivered, problems are solved, and customer relationships are scaled.
  • Operates with autonomy across complex, strategically important accounts, managing escalations with minimal oversight.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with measurable outcomes tied to retention, expansion, and strategic alignment.
  • Established VP and C-suite relationships within large enterprise organizations, engaging as a trusted advisor who influences adoption and investment decisions.
  • Good understanding of core business finance metrics, including ROI, TCO, labor costing, and operational expenditure (OpEx) reduction.
  • Comfortable presenting financial data and strategic roadmaps directly to economic buyers and VP/C-level executives.
  • Expert in outcome-based account strategy at enterprise scale, linking platform adoption to measurable ROI and multi-year value realization.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in Customer Success strategy, actively mentoring peers and contributing to product feedback loops.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for customer meetings and QBRs, if required.

Nice to Haves

  • Up-to-date Smartsheet Certifications (Core Product, System Administrator, Project Management, Control Center Lead, Control Center Blueprint Builder) or the ability to obtain within 6 months.
  • Deep understanding of Project Management Offices (PMO), Agile methodologies, resource management, and strategic portfolio execution. Knowledge of Smartsheet architectural capabilities is highly preferred.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$112,500—$142,500 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Altery, we're building products that make finance feel seamless in a fragmented world.
jobs.description:
At Altery, we're building products that make finance feel seamless in a fragmented world. We build the technology that helps businesses and people move money across borders, currencies and digital assets, without the friction.
Behind every simple payment is a complex system, and a team that makes it work. We look for people who enjoy solving difficult problems, challenge each other with respect and care about doing great work.
We're now looking for an Application Security Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team. You'll make security part of how we build: finding real vulnerabilities in our web, API and mobile products and helping our engineers fix them before they reach customers.

What you'll be doing at Altery

  • Own security findings end to end: triage results from scanners and our Bug Bounty programme, validate them manually, assess exploitability and build proofs of concept.
  • Work with development teams to explain vulnerabilities clearly and help them fix the root cause, not just the symptom.
  • Help build and improve our Secure SDLC, embedding SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container image scanning and security gates into our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Review application architectures and new features through threat modelling, and turn the results into clear security requirements for our products.
  • Test our web, API and mobile applications dynamically, with a focus on the business logic flaws that scanners miss.
  • Strengthen our software supply chain and secrets management, from dependency control to secrets detection and rotation.
  • Report monthly on our application security posture, so the team can see what's improving and where to focus next.

What you'll bring to us

Must-haves
  • 2+ years as an Application Security Engineer, with a strong understanding of modern web and mobile architecture, including microservices, containers, CI/CD and Secure SDLC principles.
  • Hands-on experience building security checks into CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container image scanning and security gates.
  • Experience triaging findings from scanners and Bug Bounty, including manual validation, exploitability assessment, PoCs and communicating fixes to developers.
  • Solid web and API security testing skills beyond the OWASP Top 10, covering CSP and security headers, cookies and business logic flaws, and confidence with common proxy and testing tools.
  • Mobile application security testing based on OWASP MASVS/MASTG, including root and emulator detection, SSL pinning and anti-tampering.
  • Experience in threat modelling and security review of architecture decisions and new features.
  • Practical knowledge of software supply chain security and secrets management.
  • Fluent English for technical reading, writing and communication.
Nice to have
  • A fintech or payments background, including PSD2/SCA, cardholder data and PIN protection, and awareness of PCI DSS.
  • Experience running or supporting a Bug Bounty programme, or taking part in one as a researcher.
  • Experience using AI and LLM tools in AppSec, such as AI-assisted triage or AI pentest frameworks, and an understanding of AI integration risks.
  • Cloud security basics, ideally on AWS.
  • Experience with ELK, including security dashboards and metrics and detecting sensitive data in logs.
  • Experience with Security Champions programmes, secure coding checklists or developer training.
  • Scripting skills for automation and data analysis, and a good understanding of TCP/IP and core network and web protocols.
How you work
  • You take ownership: you follow a finding through to a real fix rather than just raising a ticket.
  • You collaborate: you work with engineers as partners, share early and help them build security into their own work.
  • You're curious: you like to learn, experiment and use AI and automation thoughtfully.

How we value you

Here's what you can expect when you join Altery:
  • Competitive compensation that rewards your contribution.
  • Flexible working. Wherever you are, you work your local hours with flexibility, and we all come together during core hours, 9am-2pm UK time. Near a hub? We'd love to see you from time to time, but we care more about outcomes than office hours.
  • Wellbeing support, including additional sick leave when you need it.
  • Opportunities to grow your career by taking ownership, expanding your skills and making a real impact.
Why join us
  • A team that has your back: we're team players, not solo stars. People here are quick to help and ready to collaborate.
  • Ownership from day one: you're trusted to make decisions, try new things and lead from wherever you are.
  • Built by a global team: our team spans countries, cultures and time zones, and those different perspectives help us build for customers around the world.
  • High standards, continuous growth: you'll be encouraged to learn, challenge assumptions and help raise the bar.
  • Resilient by design: we're a startup, so we don't expect easy days, we expect progress. When challenges come, you'll never face them alone.
Sound like you? Apply now and help us create financial experiences that work seamlessly across borders, currencies and technologies.
We celebrate our diversity: its power strengthens our team. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever your background, and we hire based on skills, experience and the difference you can make.
We treat your personal data with care and use it only for recruitment. Applications are processed through our hiring platform, HiBob. To find out how your data is handled, read the Bob Hiring privacy notice.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud / VMware Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier.
jobs.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

Senior Cloud Engineer / VMWare – Azure & GCP

Location: Remote – Mexico
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time. Occasional weekend availability is required for emergencies.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and management of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This is a hands-on cloud engineering position focused on cloud infrastructure, architecture, migration, automation, and operational support. It is not a role focused exclusively on DevOps or CI/CD.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and GCP.
  • Lead and support cloud migration initiatives while applying architecture and security best practices.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
  • Support containerized workloads using Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and engineering support for VMware environments as needed.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, and Application teams to support cloud-native development and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, security, and cost optimization.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers.
  • Participate in occasional weekend emergency support as business needs require.

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 5 years of relevant cloud engineering or infrastructure experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Working knowledge of VMware at a Level 3 support or engineering level, including advanced troubleshooting and technical escalations.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed technical teams.
  • Professional English proficiency, including the ability to participate in technical meetings, communicate with U.S.-based stakeholders, and prepare technical documentation in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Senior Windows Engineer or Windows Administrator.
  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, or similar container technologies.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM templates, Deployment Manager, or similar tools.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or comparable languages.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and working with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud environments and multi-cloud strategies.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification.
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration or a related certification.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded cloud infrastructure engineer with strong, hands-on experience in both Azure and GCP, along with sufficient VMware knowledge to provide Level 3 support and engineering assistance.

Candidates whose backgrounds are primarily focused on DevOps pipelines or CI/CD tooling without direct cloud infrastructure ownership may not meet the core requirements of this position.

Teammate Benefits

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

Our benefits program includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision care coverage

  • Paid time off plan

  • 401(k) Plan

  • Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Basic life insurance

  • Short-and long-term disability coverage

  • Accident insurance

  • Teammate Assistance Program

  • Paid parental leave

  • Domestic partner benefits

  • Mental, physical, and financial well-being programs

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.

Accendra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.excerpt: Über uns Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer.  Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen.
jobs.description:
Über uns

Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer. Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen. Wir organisieren Extremwanderungen in Deutschland und Europa, bei denen Menschen über sich hinauswachsen. Hinter unseren Events steht ein starkes Team aus Festangestellten und Event-HelferInnen. Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos läuft, suchen wir dich als LohnbuchhalterIn in Teilzeit (15 Std./Woche, 100 % remote) - jemanden, der die Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung eigenverantwortlich im Griff hat und Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld hat.

Dein Impact

Du sorgst dafür, dass unser gesamtes Team – vom Office-Mitarbeitenden bis zu den HelferInnen auf der Strecke - pünktlich, korrekt und reibungslos abgerechnet wird. Damit schaffst du Vertrauen, hältst dem Team den Rücken frei und bist der verlässliche Anker für alle Themen rund um Gehalt, Sozialversicherung und Meldewesen.

So arbeiten wir

Remote-first, unkompliziert und verbindlich. Wir schätzen kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und Menschen, die ihr Fachgebiet souverän im Griff haben. Bei uns arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich und im engen Austausch mit HR, Accounting und unserem Steuerbüro.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Monatliche Entgeltabrechnung: Du führst die laufenden Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen für unsere Mitarbeitenden durch - inklusive Arbeitszeiten, Überstunden, Urlaub, Krankheit und Auslagen.

  • Event- & Beschäftigungsarten: Du prüfst und rechnest neben Festangestellten und Minijobbern auch unsere Event-Helfer:innen („Edelhelfer“) rechtssicher ab.

  • Melde- & Bescheinigungswesen: Du übernimmst An- und Abmeldungen, pflegst laufende Stammdatenänderungen und kümmerst dich um Sozialversicherungs-, Lohnsteuer- und Krankenkassenmeldungen sowie Erstattungsanträge.

  • Systempflege & Zahlungen: Du verwaltest und pflegst unser Abrechnungssystem und kontrollierst bzw. veranlasst die monatlichen Gehaltszahlungen.

  • Ansprechperson & Schnittstelle: Du stehst Mitarbeitenden, Krankenkassen, Finanzämtern und unserem Steuerbüro kompetent bei lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen zur Seite.

Was du mitbringst

  • Spezialisiertes Know-how: Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung in der eigenständigen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung.

  • Sicherheit im Lohnsteuer- & SV-Recht: Du kennst dich bestens mit verschiedenen Beschäftigungsarten (Voll-/Teilzeit, Minijobs, kurzfristige Beschäftigungen/Event-Aushilfen) aus.

  • System-Erfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Abrechnungssoftware; idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Sage HR & Payroll mit.

  • Sorgfalt & Verlässlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, diskrete und termintreue Arbeitsweise, auf die sich das gesamte Team verlassen kann.

  • Sprache: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Versprechen an dich

  • 100 % Remote & maximale Flexibilität: Arbeite komplett ortsunabhängig in Deutschland und teile dir deine 15 Stunden pro Woche - außerhalb der festen Abrechnungsstichtage - flexibel ein.

  • Planbarer Rahmen: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und direktem Kontakt zu HR und Geschäftsführung.

  • Das Mammutmarsch-Gemeinschaftsgefühl: Ein wertschätzendes Team, das zusammenhält und deine Arbeit im Hintergrund genauso feiert wie den Zieleinlauf auf der Strecke.

  • Kurze Wege: Pragmatische Lösungen statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Deine Bewerbung

Klingt nach dir? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Anschreiben genügt) und 2–3 Sätze, warum du Lust auf Lohnbuchhaltung beim Mammutmarsch hast. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von fünf Tagen bei dir zurück.

jobs.title: Sales Setter - Vertrieb (w/m/d) mit Aufstieg zum Closer – Freelance | 100 % Remo
jobs.excerpt: Kennst du das?  Du bist ein guter Setter.  Du greifst zum Hörer, ohne zu zögern.
jobs.description:
Kennst du das?

Du bist ein guter Setter. Du greifst zum Hörer, ohne zu zögern. Aber deine Provision ist gedeckelt, das Angebot überzeugt dich selbst nicht ganz, und der Weg ins Closing ist seit Monaten „in Planung".

Du arbeitest mehr als die anderen und willst, dass sich das endlich auch im Einkommen zeigt? Bei uns ist das so.

NETSHAKE ist TÜV-zertifizierter Shopify Premier Partner – Top 1 % weltweit. 26 Jahre am Markt, über 1.700 Projekte. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Intersport und Junglück, die wir als Shopify-Partner von 3 auf 38 Millionen Euro Umsatz begleitet haben. Du verkaufst kein Versprechen. Du verkaufst Ergebnisse, die man nachprüfen kann.

Worum es geht

Du startest dort, wo sich Hunter beweisen. Du rufst E-Commerce-Entscheider an, holst sie ins Gespräch und setzt deine Termine selbst.

Der Deal ist einfach: Du zeigst, dass du am Telefon lieferst. Dann füllen unsere Opener deinen Kalender, und du konzentrierst dich voll auf Qualifizierungsgespräche mit hochwertigen Leads. Wer dort konstant performt, übernimmt eigene Closing-Gespräche.

Kein „irgendwann vielleicht". Der Weg zum Closer ist bei uns der Plan, nicht die Ausnahme.

Aufgaben

  • Du rufst AI-vorqualifizierte Leads an, Power Dialer, klarer Leitfaden

  • Du holst Entscheider ins Gespräch und weckst Interesse in den ersten Sekunden

  • Du qualifizierst: Bedarf, Potenzial, Entscheidungsbefugnis

  • Du setzt Termine, die stattfinden und sich schließen lassen

  • Du fasst nach, bis eine Entscheidung steht

  • Du führst deine Pipeline in Close CRM wie ein Unternehmer

  • Du übernimmst bei konstanter Performance eigene Strategie- und Closing-Gespräche

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im telefonischen Outbound-Vertrieb, zum Beispiel als Setter, Opener, im Telesales oder in der Terminierung

  • Du kennst deine Zahlen und legst sie auf den Tisch: Calls, gesetzte Termine, Show-up-Rate

  • Ein „Nein" spornt dich an, und beim ersten Widerstand legst du nicht auf

  • Du bleibst souverän, wenn ein Geschäftsführer dich testet

  • Du willst ins Closing und bist bereit, dir den Platz zu verdienen

  • Du nimmst Feedback an und setzt es am nächsten Tag um

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, Headset

Benefits

  • Verdienst: Festes Monatshonorar ab 2.500 € plus Provision, ohne künstlichen Deckel. Wer mehr leistet, verdient mehr. Als Closer steigt dein Einkommenspotenzial deutlich.

  • Volle Kalender: Wer in der Akquise liefert, bekommt die Termine von unseren Openern geliefert.

  • Klarer Karrierepfad: Setter mit eigener Akquise → Setter mit vollem Kalender → Closer mit Umsatzverantwortung.

  • Training auf Closer-Niveau: Dein Vertriebsleiter ist der CEO selbst und trainiert dich täglich in der Verkaufspsychologie und Einwandbehandlung.

  • Vertrieb mit System: AI-vorqualifizierte Leads, Close CRM, Power Dialer.

  • Freelance, Vollzeit, 100 % remote: Weltweit. Das Office in Dubai steht dir offen.

  • Schneller Prozess: Vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung vergehen ein bis zwei Wochen.

Dieser Job ist kein Nebenjob. Du arbeitest viel, telefonierst viel und wirst an deinen Zahlen gemessen. Dafür bekommst du ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt bezahlt wird und der Weg zum Closer offen ist.

So läuft es ab

Kurzes Erstgespräch, Videocall, Schnuppertag am Telefon. Wir schauen auf Output, nicht auf Lebensläufe. Wir nehmen nicht jeden – und genau deshalb ist das Team stark.

Wenn du heute gut bist und außergewöhnlich werden willst: Bewirb dich mit deinen Zahlen.

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.

jobs.title: Channel Manager
jobs.excerpt: Description Location: remote within Europe Reports to Head of Partnerships About Driivz Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV charging and energy management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers.
jobs.description:
Description

Location: remote within Europe

Reports to Head of Partnerships

About Driivz

Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV charging and energy management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers. We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that ensures a seamless charging experience and drives high driver retention for leading EV charging networks such as EVgo, Shell, Circle K, Mer, and Volvo Group. Driivz facilitates the global transition to a forward-looking EV charging ecosystem by powering networks in more than 35 countries across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, with its platform supporting over 3 million charging ports and more than 6 million EV drivers worldwide.

Join our team and work alongside brilliant, disruptive minds focused on leading the e-mobility industry and building a greener world.

The role

We are looking for a Channel Manager to build and scale our partner channel across Europe. Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you will help take Driivz from ad-hoc partnerships to a structured, scalable partner program. You will recruit and develop partners such as charger manufacturers, technology partners, system integrators, energy companies, payment and roaming providers, resellers and consultancies, and own channel revenue for the region.

Success means a growing, profitable partner network that brings in new customers and expands existing accounts, and uses partner capabilities to unlock complex solutions and resolve blockers in customer deals.

What you'll do

Build the channel

  • Define the European channel strategy: target partner profiles, priority countries and partnership models.
  • Identify and qualify potential partners and channels based on real customer needs, strategic value, product and technical fit, commercial potential and risk.
  • Build and manage a solid channel pipeline, from first contact through discovery, agreement and onboarding.

Structure and launch partnerships

  • Build the business case for each partner and structure agreements, including the commercial model, territories and rules of engagement.
  • Take each partnership through review with Finance, Product, Delivery and Legal, up to executive approval.
  • Make sure partners are launch-ready: pricing, sales training, go-to-market plan, target accounts and a first pilot customer.

Drive revenue and build relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with partner leadership, and run regular pipeline reviews and QBRs.
  • Build joint business plans with key partners and hold them accountable to targets.
  • Own the channel pipeline and forecast, winning new customers and growing existing accounts through partners.
  • Bring partner capabilities into complex deals and RFPs to resolve blockers and deliver complete solutions.

Enable partners and work across Driivz

  • Train partners on the Driivz platform, and certify internal Sales, Pre-Sales and Delivery teams on partner offerings.
  • Run joint marketing, PR and events, and represent Driivz at industry conferences.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market, integrations and partner requirements.

Measure and improve

  • Track partner KPIs such as partner-sourced pipeline, revenue and validated integrations, and keep improving how we manage partners.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 5+ years in B2B channel or partner sales, including building a channel or partner program from an early stage.
  • A proven record of selling complex SaaS or technology solutions through partners in Europe, and of meeting revenue targets.
  • A strong network across the European [EV / energy / mobility] ecosystem.
  • Strong commercial skills: building business cases, negotiating partner agreements and managing channel conflict.
  • A strategic mindset with hands-on execution, and strong relationship skills with senior stakeholders.
  • Fluent English; German / French / other is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe (approximately 20–30% of the time).

Nice to have

  • Experience in EV charging, e-mobility, energy or utilities, and with Salesforce.
  • Knowledge of OCPP, OCPI or ISO 15118 (Plug & Charge), or of eRoaming, EV payments or charging cybersecurity.

Why Driivz

  • A high-impact role shaping our growth in Europe, with direct visibility to leadership.
  • A mission-driven, international team at the heart of the energy transition, with hybrid working.
  • Competitive packag, commission plan and benefits.

Driivz is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Marketing Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.excerpt: About OpenSesame OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Marketing Team

The Marketing team blends creativity and data to craft innovative strategies that drive brand recognition, boost lead generation, and deepen customer engagement. Working cross-functionally, the team aligns marketing initiatives with OpenSesame’s mission while ensuring campaigns deliver measurable, high-impact results.

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame’s core marketing ecosystem, tools, and HubSpot workflows spanning growth, product, and customer marketing.
  • Partner with product marketing on launch planning, competitive analysis, and preliminary collateral development.
  • Begin contributing to customer marketing programs like customer interviews and case studies.
  • Document marketing processes to support team scalability and efficiency.

By 30 Days

  • Partner with growth and product teams on core initiatives, including webinar program execution, optimization, and lead generation strategies.
  • Drive engagement by creating social media campaigns and experimenting with AI tools for creativity and reach.
  • Build HubSpot assets, support customer marketing collateral, and help ensure website user experience is top-notch.
  • Contribute to early-stage content distribution flywheels and ongoing competitive positioning research.

By 60 Days

  • Become an essential partner to the marketing team, offering insights and creative solutions that help drive our projects forward.
  • Take ownership of a project that will enhance a key aspect of OpenSesame’s marketing efforts, this is your chance to shine.
  • Develop a plan to optimize our marketing campaigns using data-driven insights, making sure we’re always one step ahead.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts.
jobs.description:
At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build and own machine learning models that power core prediction problems across the FourKites platform — including ETA/ATA forecasting and message-based status extraction. You will work end-to-end, from data pipeline to production deployment and monitoring, turning noisy real-world logistics data into models that run at scale and directly move the needle on customer outcomes. You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams, hands-on building and shipping models yourself while also guiding the technical direction of other data scientists on the team.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and productionize ML models for problems like ETA/ATA prediction, using regression, classification, and time-series forecasting techniques
  • Develop NLP/LLM-based extraction pipelines for message-based ETA and status updates (text extraction, entity recognition)
  • Own models end-to-end: data pipeline → training → deployment → monitoring → retraining
  • Work with noisy, real-world logistics and supply chain data (GPS pings, check calls, carrier data) rather than clean, pre-processed datasets
  • Diagnose gaps between offline evaluation performance and live production accuracy, and drive fixes
  • Build and maintain automated training/retraining pipelines using orchestration tools such as Airflow
  • Set up and maintain model monitoring and observability (e.g., Grafana) to catch drift and degradation proactively
  • Replace manual or rule-based processes with ML-driven automation (e.g., automating manual check calls)
  • Translate model performance improvements into business impact — operational savings, efficiency gains, and deal-relevant outcomes
  • Mentor and guide other data scientists/engineers on technical approach and best practices
  • Make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoff decisions independently

About the team:

Our product and engineering teams are dedicated to providing the industry's best-in-class end-to-end supply chain visibility platform. We are committed to building a high-performing, ML-driven team that turns supply chain data into automated, proactive action — and we want you to help lead that effort.

Who you are:

  • Strong ML fundamentals across regression, classification, and time-series forecasting
  • NLP experience — text extraction, entity recognition, or LLM-based extraction
  • Production ML experience — you've shipped models serving real traffic, not just built POCs or notebooks
  • Strong Python and SQL skills — pandas, scikit-learn, and comfort querying large datasets (Redshift/Snowflake a plus)
  • Experience with cloud and data infrastructure — AWS (S3, EC2), and orchestration tools like Airflow for training/retraining pipelines
  • Experience setting up or working with model monitoring and observability tooling (Grafana or similar)
  • Comfortable working with noisy, real-world data rather than clean, curated datasets
  • Experience diagnosing and closing the gap between offline evaluation results and live production performance
  • A track record of replacing manual/rule-based processes with ML solutions
  • Ability to translate model output into business value and communicate that impact to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations teams
  • Experience mentoring or guiding other data scientists or engineers
  • Ability to make build-vs-buy and architecture tradeoffs independently
  • A track record of reducing manual intervention or turnaround time through automation
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming data (Kafka)
  • Exposure to LLM/GenAI applications in production

Who we are:

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit.

FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.

Benefits:

  • Medical benefits start on first day of employment
  • 36 PTO days (Sick, Casual and Earned), 5 recharge days, 2 volunteer days
  • Home Office set ups and Technology reimbursement
  • Lifestyle & Family benefits
  • Mental Wellness support and guidance
  • Ongoing learning & development opportunities (Professional development program, Toast Master club, etc.)

FourKites is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
jobs.excerpt: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is one of its first engineering hires. The Enterprise Platform team is brand new. You will not be inheriting a mature system or a long backlog: you will own core domains of the platform that turns the internal systems enabling Discordians into self-service software.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Senior engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
  • Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
  • Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.
  • Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
  • Own your domain end to end: Take core components of the platform from design through production with no code boundaries, writing the RFCs and documentation for the areas you own.

What You Should Have

  • 3+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning projects end to end.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Go, Python, and TypeScript), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.
  • Hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and working fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.
  • Experience treating endpoint or infrastructure configuration as an API-driven engineering surface rather than console work.
  • A platform-as-a-product mindset. You care whether people actually adopt what you build, not just whether it ships.
  • Comfort owning complex, multi-milestone projects through ambiguity, and energy for building in a greenfield environment.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
  • Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
  • Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$196,000—$245,000 USD

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us redefine and grow our suite of data pipelines in support of the company's mission of powering hospital and pharmacy operations. Our customers rely on us to keep their patients safe and their pharmacies running smoothly while delighting them with every release. Through our pharmacy management and controlled substance tracking platforms, we're committed to improving medication management and compliance for our nation's healthcare providers; and our data operations form the backbone of that mission.

Data at Bluesight is a team sport. The pipelines you build will carry data from hospital systems, third-party sources, and our own applications into products that pharmacy directors and compliance teams use every day. That only works when engineers, product owners, analysts, and security partners design together—so this role is as much about how you work with people as it is about how you work with data. You'll own medium to large initiatives spanning several pipelines, and part of how we'll measure you is how much easier you make everyone else's work.

You Can Expect To

  • Work with product owners and application engineering teams to gather and understand business requirements, plan work, and own delivery of projects
  • Negotiate data contracts with our partner teams
  • Design pipelines that are idempotent and recoverable, able to handle backfills, replays, and late-arriving data, establishing and documenting patterns that are usable across the team
  • Build data quality checks and observability into your work, with useful and actionable alerts
  • Champion good data stewardship and governance across the company, and work closely with DevOps and Security on access controls, PHI minimization, and customer assurance
  • Mentor data engineers earlier in their careers
  • Work alongside our partners in data science, implementation, support, and analytics, treating their needs as requirements on the platform rather than requests to triage later
  • Actively reduce technical debt in our data systems so the next engineer inherits something better than you found

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a quantitative or data-intensive field
  • 4+ years of data engineering experience, or comparable depth gained alongside backend engineering work
  • Ability to communicate clearly with varied audiences about data architecture and implementations, with minimal preparation, including non-technical audiences
  • Strong written and analytical skills
  • Strong command of data modeling
  • Experience with both SQL-style and distributed querying (e.g. MapReduce, Spark), and deep understanding when each approach is appropriate
  • Solid programming skills and the engineering discipline to test, review, and version your data code like any other software
  • Experience owning production pipelines end to end, including their orchestration, deployment, and monitoring
  • Experience working in a major cloud environment, with infrastructure managed as code
  • Proven ability to debug complex data issues across the stack and to explain what went wrong afterward
  • A collaborative, consensus-building approach to technical decisions
  • Comfort working through ambiguity with open communication and autonomy
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with PHI, HIPAA-regulated systems, or another compliance-driven domain
  • Knowledge of hospital data systems (e.g. EHR, FHIR, automated dispensing systems, purchasing reports) or the pharmaceutical supply chain
  • Experience supporting analysts and data scientists as internal customers
  • Experience with change data capture or event-driven ingestion in addition to batch
  • Experience introducing a data catalog, documentation practice, or quality framework that outlasted your involvement in it

The Tools We Use

    The Data Products team works primarily in Python, on AWS. We orchestrate using Lambda and Glue, use Docker for machine images, and manage our infrastructure using Terraform.

    We work with data in a variety of input file formats, pulled from third-party APIs, extracted from RDS databases, and numerous other sources. We deliver data as the teams using it need, and build Athena databases backed by parquet files.

    We value knowledge, judgment, and collaboration more than specific tool experience. However, with this Senior role, we also expect experience in at least some parts of our technology stack.

This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.

Why Bluesight?

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!

jobs.title: Delivery Lead KI-Programme (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Bei Neurawork bauen Data Scientists, Engineers und Mathematiker:innen KI-Lösungen, die bei Konzernkunden in den Betrieb gehen – von KI-Governance über Plattformen bis zum Sales Generator.
jobs.description:
Bei Neurawork bauen Data Scientists, Engineers und Mathematiker:innen KI-Lösungen, die bei Konzernkunden in den Betrieb gehen – von KI-Governance über Plattformen bis zum Sales Generator. Unsere Programme laufen über mehrere Workpackages, mehrere Teams und mehrere Monate. Wir suchen die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass am Ende abgenommen wird, was versprochen wurde. Anderswo hieße die Rolle Technical Program Manager:in oder Projektleitung – bei uns heißt sie Delivery Lead, weil es ums Liefern geht.

Du bist keine Projektverwalter:in. Status, Gantt und Folien erledigt bei uns eine agentische Projektsteuerung. Du steuerst über Ergebnisse – und entwickelst dieses System mit weiter.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Delivery von 2–3 parallelen KI-Programmen: Scope, Zeitplan, Lieferpflichten und Abnahmen

  • Steuerung der Workpackage-Teams über Definition of Done, Zeitboxen für Exploration und Demos statt Statusberichte

  • Vorbereitung und Moderation von Lenkungskreisen – mit klaren Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Senior Management

  • Change Requests: Scope Creep früh erkennen, sauber formulieren, mit dem Kunden verhandeln

  • Belastbarer Forecast zu Aufwand, Budget und Terminen

  • Schnittstelle zu Fachbereich, IT, Datenschutz und Mitbestimmung beim Kunden; Change als Teil der Lieferung

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer agentischen Projektsteuerung (Git, YAML, Claude)

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Engagement Partner zusammen, der Kundenbeziehung, Vertrag und Strategie verantwortet. Du verantwortest, dass geliefert wird.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst

  • 8–12 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon 3–5 Jahre mit Lieferverantwortung für Daten-, KI- oder Softwareprojekte bei Konzernkunden (z. B. als Delivery Lead, Technical Program Manager:in oder technische Projektleitung)

  • Eigene technische Praxis mit Daten, ML oder Software – idealerweise als Data Scientist oder Data Engineer, bevor du in die Delivery oder technische Beratung gewechselt bist

  • Du liest Code und Notebooks und erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Demo, Prototyp und abnahmefähiger Lösung

  • Du führst Expert:innen, die fachlich tiefer sind als Du – über Klarheit, nicht über Weisung – und sprichst Konflikte früh an

  • Kaufmännisches Urteil: Du weißt, was ein Angebot hergibt, und wann ein Kundenwunsch ein Change Request ist

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git, YAML, Kommandozeile und KI-Assistenten wie Claude – du baust Werkzeuge aus, statt sie nur zu bedienen

  • Zertifikate wie PMP oder PRINCE2 sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Kategorie, die gerade entsteht: KI, deren Ergebnisse man verantworten kann. Du prägst mit, wie wir solche Programme liefern

  • Echte Kundenprogramme statt Demos: Die Wirkung beim Kunden wird gemessen, die Abnahme ist das Ziel.

  • Jedes Programm zählt doppelt: Es hinterlässt Bausteine und Vorgehen, die das nächste schneller machen.

  • Ein starkes Team auf Augenhöhe: Data Scientists, Engineers und Mathematiker:innen, die ihr Handwerk verstehen – mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung statt Hierarchie.

  • Aktuelle KI-Tools als Standard: Neueste Modelle, Coding Agents und Raum zum Experimentieren, dazu voller Zugang zu unseren Coachinginhalten.

  • Weiterbildung und Coaching: Wir investieren in Deine Entwicklung; unsere Führungskräfte werden professionell von externen Coaches begleitet.

  • 100 % remote und flexibel: Kernarbeitszeit 9–15 Uhr, Arbeiten aus dem Ausland nach Absprache zeitweise möglich. Lenkungskreise und Kundenworkshops vor Ort; ein- bis zweimal im Jahr Teamtreffen.

  • Beste Ausstattung: Die Tools und Geräte, die Du für gute Arbeit brauchst.

  • 28 Tage Urlaub: plus Heiligabend und Silvester frei.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Projekt, das Du in die Abnahme gebracht hast – und was beinahe schiefgegangen wäre.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Muttdata has been helping companies turn their data into better decisions. We build AI and Machine Learning tools that solve real business problems, from predicting demand to getting more out of every marketing dollar. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're a team of data nerds who love building things, working together and learning something new every day.
We are looking for a curious, organized and driven Sales Development Representative Semi Senior to help us bring Mixilo, our AI-powered Paid Media Optimizer, to more brands across Latin America 🐶🚀
You'll be the engine at the top of our funnel: researching accounts, starting conversations with marketing teams and booking meetings for our sales team. We'll teach you the product, the paid media world and how we sell. You bring the energy, the curiosity and the discipline to follow up.

🚀 What We Do

We built Mixilo to crack one of marketing's toughest questions: where should every dollar of paid media budget go? Then we kept listening to the marketers using it every day. Side by side with them, Mixilo has grown into planning, forecasting, target setting, performance monitoring and measurement, and it's fast becoming the end-to-end operating system for modern marketing teams.
Teams like Tec de Monterrey, Ripley and Social Learning already use it. We're starting with LATAM, with Mexico as our first big push, and the US on the horizon.

🌟 Our Partnerships

  • Amazon Web Services
  • Astronomer
  • Databricks

🌟 Our Values

  • 📊 We are Data Nerds
  • 🤗 We are Open Team Players
  • 🚀 We Take Ownership
  • 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset
🔍 Curious about what we're up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we're working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓

  • Research and build target account lists of retail, e-commerce and consumer brands in Mexico and the rest of LATAM, and identify the right contacts in their marketing, growth and media teams.
  • Run outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn and phone, writing messages that are personal and relevant, not copy-paste.
  • Book qualified meetings for our Mexico-based sales team and hand them over with clear notes on the prospect's channels, budget and pain points.
  • Keep the CRM clean and up to date, and track your own activity and conversion numbers week by week.
  • Help create and test outreach templates, prospect lists and short follow-up materials together with Marketing.
  • Learn Mixilo and the paid media basics (ROAS, CPA, attribution, budget allocation) well enough to start a credible conversation.

Required Skills 💻

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, SDR/BDR, customer-facing roles, recruiting, account management or similar.
  • Completed university degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.
  • Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken.
  • Very organized: you can manage a long list of conversations, follow up consistently and keep track of everything.
  • Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce or similar.
  • Experience with prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar.
  • Curiosity about AI, digital marketing and how companies spend on ads.

Nice to have ✨

  • Some exposure to digital marketing or paid media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads), from a job, a course or your own project.
  • Experience at an agency, startup or tech company.
  • Portuguese, to help us expand into Brazil.

🎁 Perks

  • 🌍 Remote-first culture – work from anywhere!
  • 🚀 In-Company English Lessons.
  • 💪 Wellhub or sports club stipend to stay active
  • 🚀 AWS, DBT, Google Cloud, Azure & Databricks certifications fully covered
  • 🍕 Food credits via Pedidos Ya – because great work deserves great food.
  • 🎂 Birthday off + an extra vacation week (Mutt Week! 🏖️)
  • 🤝 Referral bonuses – help us grow the team & get rewarded!
  • ✈️🏝️ Annual Mutters' Trip – an unforgettable getaway with the team!

Overview

Ogletree Deakins, one of the largest labor and employment law firms representing management, has an opportunity for an experienced litigator seeking a role with increased flexibility with a focus on legal writing without giving up the challenge of a full-cycle litigation practice. This highly flexible role will allow the right candidate to work remotely without the administrative and client-development demands of a shareholder/partner track position. This role will focus on efficient, effective legal work with a lower billable hours target than our full-time shareholder track attorneys.

Working with a dedicated client team servicing one of the firm’s largest clients, this attorney will focus on defending employers in employment litigation, primarily single/multi-plaintiff arbitrations. Core responsibilities will regularly include, but will not be limited to, providing input on defense strategy, performing legal research, and drafting dispositive motions and briefs. This attorney will provide support for a dedicated team within the firm, providing briefing on a regular and ad-hoc basis. The ideal candidate should be comfortable both working from initial drafts designed by the team and creating briefing from start to finish. From time-to-time, the attorney may need to appear at virtual arbitration conferences and hearings.

While this role will not be required to work in the office, the attorney will be included in the firm’s annual all-attorney retreat and will have access to the firm’s extensive learning and development resources.

This position may be remote, but the successful candidate must reside in a state where the firm has a physical office

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in the manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position in accordance with the Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Candidates must have 2+ years of litigation experience, either in-house or for a law firm, government agency, or nonprofit. Prior employment law experience is not required. We are open to candidates with strong general litigation backgrounds, including attorneys coming from insurance defense or criminal litigation backgrounds (both prosecution and defense), provided they have transferable litigation skills and an interest in employment litigation.

  • Due to the remote nature of the position, this job requires a high level of self-motivation, accountability for work product, and responsiveness.
