jobs.excerpt: Accounting Manager | Remote We’re looking for an Accounting Manager / Lead Accountant who goes beyond reviewing numbers—they understand what the numbers are telling them.
jobs.description:
Accounting Manager | Remote

We’re looking for an Accounting Manager / Lead Accountant who goes beyond reviewing numbers—they understand what the numbers are telling them.

The ideal candidate is naturally analytical and curious. When a recurring expense suddenly changes, a balance disappears, or an account doesn’t reconcile as expected, you don’t simply accept the report—you ask questions, investigate the underlying activity, and validate that the financials are accurate.

This is a hands-on accounting leadership role for someone who enjoys financial statement review, quality control, problem-solving, and developing accounting teams and processes.

About the Role

As the Accounting Manager / Lead Accountant, you will serve as the primary accounting resource for our bookkeeping department and help ensure that client financials are accurate, complete, and ready for delivery.

We currently support approximately 35 bookkeeping clients and continue to grow. You will initially manage a portfolio of approximately 10–15 clients while performing limited production work. As the team grows, the role will transition toward technical accounting oversight, quality control, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review client financial statements before delivery
  • Analyze balance sheet accounts for discrepancies, unusual activity, and unsupported balances
  • Identify trends, inconsistencies, and accounting issues that require follow-up
  • Review bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries, schedules, and supporting documentation
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate, complete, and client-ready
  • Own the month-end close review process for bookkeeping clients
  • Investigate unusual or unexpected changes in financial activity
  • Escalate significant accounting issues to management when appropriate
  • Supervise, support, and provide technical guidance to bookkeeping staff
  • Train and mentor team members on accounting practices and quality standards
  • Serve as the primary accounting resource for the bookkeeping department
  • Maintain and improve quality control standards and review procedures
  • Assist with cleanup and catch-up projects as needed
  • Initially manage approximately 10–15 clients, with production responsibilities decreasing as the team grows
  • Help develop, document, and improve accounting processes and best practices

Organizational Structure

Reports to: VP of Firm Operations

Operations Leadership Handles

  • Client communication and relationships
  • Scheduling and workflow management
  • Capacity planning
  • Escalations
  • Payroll, sales tax, withholding, and compliance

Bookkeeping Team Handles

  • Transaction categorization
  • Bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Daily bookkeeping production
  • Cleanup and catch-up work
  • Preparing books for management review

The Accounting Manager provides the technical accounting oversight and quality control that connects these functions and ensures the final financials meet our standards.

Your Impact

As the Accounting Manager, you will become the primary accounting authority within the bookkeeping department, helping reduce reliance on senior leadership for technical accounting review.

Your work will help ensure that:

  • Financial statements are accurate and client-ready
  • Accounting issues are identified before they become client concerns
  • Financials are reviewed with a critical and analytical mindset
  • Bookkeeping staff have a reliable accounting resource for guidance
  • Accounting processes can scale as the department grows

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means more than completing reviews on time.

You will:

  • Deliver timely and accurate financial reporting
  • Identify accounting issues before they reach the client
  • Ask the right questions when the numbers don’t make sense
  • Understand the story behind the financial statements
  • Provide technical accounting guidance to the team
  • Support and mentor bookkeeping staff
  • Strengthen quality control and review processes
  • Help build scalable accounting systems and best practices

The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:

  • Naturally notices inconsistencies and unusual financial patterns
  • Doesn’t accept numbers at face value
  • Enjoys investigating the “why” behind a balance or transaction
  • Can independently review financial statements without extensive direction
  • Has strong technical accounting judgment
  • Communicates clearly when explaining accounting issues
  • Enjoys mentoring and developing other accountants
  • Is comfortable working in a growing, changing environment

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, CAS, outsourced accounting, or public accounting
  • 2+ years in a reviewing, supervisory, or accounting leadership role
  • Strong QuickBooks Online (QBO) experience
  • Strong financial statement and balance sheet review skills
  • Experience reviewing reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules
  • Ability to independently identify accounting issues and discrepancies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients
  • CAS, outsourced accounting, or public accounting experience
  • Experience managing multiple clients
  • Experience improving accounting processes and internal controls
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent certification
  • Experience supporting or leading team growth

Schedule

  • Fully remote
  • Full-time
  • Initial onboarding requires availability during U.S. Eastern Time hours
  • Ongoing collaboration during Eastern Time business hours is required
  • Additional flexibility may be available once fully onboarded

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: Open and based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit

$2000/$3000/m

Benefits:

  • Work from home
  • Fully remote work environment

Work Location: Remote

Interested?

If you’re an experienced accounting professional who enjoys reviewing financials, solving accounting problems, asking the right questions, and helping a team grow, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary: $2000 - $3000/m

jobs.description:
Wir bei Insurgo sind nicht nur ein Technologie-Unternehmen. Wir sind Innovatoren, die den Weg für digitale Lösungen in der Versicherungswirtschaft ebnen. Hunderte Maklerbüros arbeiten bereits mit unserer Software, unser Postfach Plus nimmt ihnen bis zu 80 Prozent ihres Verwaltungsaufwands ab, und unsere Kunden bewerten uns über 900 Mal.

Immer mehr Makler kommen von sich aus auf uns zu. Deshalb bauen wir unseren Vertrieb aus und suchen dich: jemanden, der Makler versteht, gerne mit ihnen spricht und Abschlüsse macht.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zum zufriedenen Kunden. Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Product Management und Support zusammen und berichtest direkt an den Geschäftsführer.

Neukunden gewinnen: Du nimmst Anfragen von unserer Website und aus unseren Kampagnen auf, qualifizierst sie, führst Demos durch und bringst sie zum Abschluss.

Bestandskunden entwickeln: Du sprichst aktiv auf unsere Kunden zu und zeigst ihnen, wie Zusatzprodukte wie Postfach Plus und der Insurgo Agent ihren Alltag weiter entlasten.

Wert verkaufen: Du machst für jedes Maklerbüro greifbar, welche Tools Insurgo ersetzt und wie viel Zeit es spart. Du argumentierst über Nutzen, nicht über Rabatt.

Prozess mitgestalten: Du steigst in unseren Vertriebsprozess ein und baust ihn mit uns weiter aus. Pipeline, CRM und Forecast hast du im Griff.

Präsenz zeigen: Du vertrittst Insurgo auf Messen wie der DKM und bei Branchenveranstaltungen und knüpfst dort Kontakte.

Feedback weitergeben: Was Makler dir erzählen, landet bei uns im Produkt. Du bist das Ohr am Markt.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst die Versicherungsbranche und den Alltag von Maklern aus eigener Erfahrung, zum Beispiel aus einem Maklerbüro, einem Pool, einem Versicherer oder einem Softwareanbieter für Makler.

  • Vertriebserfahrung: Du hast bereits erste Jahre im Vertrieb gearbeitet, idealerweise im B2B oder mit einem erklärungsbedürftigen Produkt.

  • Abschlussstärke: Du gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu, fasst nach und bringst Gespräche zu einer Entscheidung.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht auf Leads, sondern suchst dir Chancen selbst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Zahlen.

  • Kommunikation: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, am Telefon, im Video-Call und per Mail.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Messen und gelegentliche Kundentermine vor Ort gehören für dich dazu.

  • Pluspunkt: Erfahrung mit einem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm oder einem CRM.

Benefits

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team aus A-Playern

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit Top-Ausstattung

  • Fixgehalt plus attraktive, leistungsbezogene Provision

  • Offene Kommunikation und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten

  • 100€ Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung

  • 50€ Gutscheinkarte jeden Monat, steuerfrei zur freien Verfügung

  • Teamevents, die in Erinnerung bleiben

  • Sicherer und unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

Voraussetzung für diese Position ist ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland sowie eine bestehende Arbeitserlaubnis.

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is growing its channel sales team to capitalize on rapidly growing demand from channel partners, leveraging their expertise and connections to bring open source technology to organizations across a multitude of industries.

The role requires a mix of both farming and hunting capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned annual growth quotas.

They should be able to identify, prospect, and engage reseller and distributor partners to build and maintain relationships and grow Canonical’s business within the assigned territory.

The successful candidate must be comfortable owning and leading initiatives in an unstructured, startup-like environment. This individual must be able to sell open source, cloud, virtualization, and technical software solutions.

Although the role is focused primarily on reseller and distributor channel partners, the successful candidate must be capable of and comfortable with initial customer discovery calls and presentations as appropriate.

The Role Entails

  • Develop and execute channel strategy for distributors and resellers within the assigned territory
  • Increase awareness of Canonical as a lead player in Open Source and Cloud (Private, Hybrid, Multi, and Public models)
  • Identify and recruit new potential partners in assigned territory
  • Leverage personal network and prospecting skills to engage new partners and build on Canonical’s already-successful relationships
  • Guide partners through onboarding and enablement
  • Develop mutually beneficial go-to-market plans and commitments with partners
  • Arrange and execute sales and pre sales trainings to these resellers
  • Drive and manage channel pipeline through recurring partner interactions
  • Support partner’s satisfaction and act as trusted advisor and point of contact
  • Maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with priority resellers and distributors.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in a technology field
  • Experience in software or technology sales from the specified market
  • Fluency in English
  • An understanding of open source, Linux and Ubuntu
  • A self starter with a proven track record of achieving sales targets
  • Detail oriented with strong follow-up skills
  • Effective negotiating skills with ability to close sales
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills (written and verbal)
  • Productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation
  • Mature approach to long-term relationship development with customers
  • The ability to represent the company at external events
  • Start-up experience would be an advantage

What we offer colleagues

  • We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

    • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
    • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
    • Annual compensation review
    • Recognition rewards
    • Annual holiday leave
    • Maternity and paternity leave
    • Employee Assistance Programme
    • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
    • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

    About Canonical

    Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

    Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

    We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.description:
Job Description – SAP SuccessFactors Learning (LMS) Consultant

Job Title: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Consultant
Module: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS)
Experience: Relevant hands-on experience in SuccessFactors Learning
Employment Type: Contract
Location: Germany, EU Only

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Learning (LMS) Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in LMS configuration, implementation, integrations, and support. The ideal candidate should have experience managing end-to-end learning management solutions, configuring training programs, integrating third-party content providers, and supporting learning and compliance processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs for learning, training, and compliance programs.

  • Configure SAP SuccessFactors Learning, including catalogs, curricula, learning plans, assignments, workflows, and assignment profiles.

  • Manage LMS security, roles, permissions, domains, and role-based access.

  • Configure and manage learning content using SCORM, AICC, xAPI, and cmi5 standards.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Events
jobs.excerpt: Everyone's racing to build AI.  Workera by Pearson exists for the 8 billion people who have to work alongside it.
jobs.description:
Everyone's racing to build AI. Workera by Pearson exists for the 8 billion people who have to work alongside it.

While the world's attention is on creating new tools, someone has to solve the other side of the equation: the humans. The workforce is going through the biggest transformation in a generation, and most organizations are navigating it blind, without the data to understand what their people can actually do, where the gaps are, or how to close them fast enough.

Workera is the category leader in skills intelligence, now part of Pearson, the world's lifelong learning company. Our platform is the critical infrastructure for the AI era. It's the layer that lets organizations understand, mobilize, manage and develop their talent with precision. Trusted by the Fortune 500, powered by proprietary AI agents and backed by Pearson's global reach, we're helping the world's largest organizations not just survive the transition to AI, but lead it.

You'll own Workera's field channel: the strategy, the plan against pipeline goals, and the executive experiences, conferences and virtual events that bring senior leaders together. You won't be handed a calendar to execute. You'll set the agenda, run the room, and build the program with AI agents so it scales as it grows.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
Enterprise buyers are making some of the biggest workforce decisions of their careers, and they make them with people they trust. Field events are where Workera builds that trust: in the room, face to face, building relationships with senior leaders that last well beyond one evening. This role owns the channel end to end, from strategy through the follow-up that turns a great evening into business impact.

YOUR TEAM
You'll sit on the Growth Marketing team and report to the VP of Marketing. You'll work day to day with Sales in every region, with GTM engineering and Marketing Ops on the agents behind lists, registration and reporting, and with Product Marketing on virtual events. You'll be in the room where go-to-market decisions are made.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
This isn't a list of tasks. These are the outcomes you're accountable for:

  • Build the annual and quarterly field plan, tied to pipeline goals by region, segment and target account
  • Own executive experiences end to end, from concept and audience through run-of-show and follow-up
  • Drive conference strategy: which events earn investment, speaking, meetings, and the campaigns before and after
  • Partner with Sales to get the right titles in the room for the right conversations, and use events to reach the executives in our target accounts
  • Own the follow-up motion that turns every event into first meetings and opportunities, measured through to cost per opportunity
  • Own the field budget and the venues, platforms and partners behind it

HOW YOU'LL RAMP
We don't expect you to figure it out alone. Here's what great looks like at each stage:

  • First 30 days, learn the machine: immerse yourself in Workera's platform, customers and the problems we're solving. Meet every sales partner, learn our field event playbooks, formats and follow-up process, and co-run an upcoming event.
  • By 90 days, ship something real: own your first meaningful deliverable end to end. Run a field program start to finish, whether an executive dinner series, a conference or our user conference, and track it through to first meetings and opportunities.
  • By 6 months, multiply your impact: operate with full autonomy in your domain, and have built at least one AI-assisted workflow the team adopts. Help run Workera's first user conference, and be a strategic voice in the room deciding what Workera's in-person experience looks like for prospects and customers, from planning through execution.

We're a fast-moving company. The scope and shape of this role will evolve as we do.

WHAT YOU BRING
We're looking for signal, not checkboxes:

  • Executive events you planned and ran yourself, end to end, at a B2B company selling to large enterprises
  • Field programs and integrated campaigns you can tie to meetings, opportunities and pipeline
  • Programs built alongside account executives, with shared goals
  • A proven track record of impact on revenue/deals won
  • A systems thinker who uses AI tools to drive the right attendance and follow-up
  • 4+ years in B2B marketing, with Salesforce and HubSpot campaign and reporting experience
  • Comfort with senior leaders and curiosity about what HR and learning leaders face; able to travel up to 30%

HOW WE WORK: AI IS THE DEFAULT
At Workera, AI isn't a feature we sell. It's how we operate. Every team member is expected to:

  • Use AI daily. AI assistants, copilots and automation tools are part of your stack, not optional extras.
  • Think in systems, not tasks. We value people who build repeatable, scalable solutions over people who grind through one-off work. Stay curious and keep learning about how AI can impact your role and the way you support Workera.

AI fluency is a cultural expectation, not a line item on a job description.

This role is remote, but needs to be US based. We are not able to offer sponsorship for this role.

About WorkeraWe're a Silicon Valley company backed by NEA, Jump Capital, and Owl Ventures. Our founder is Kian Katanforoosh, an award-winning Stanford Computer Science Lecturer who has taught AI to over 1 million people. Our Chairman is Dr. Andrew Ng, co-founder of Coursera, CEO of DeepLearning.AI, and founding lead of the Google Brain project.

Our clients include Accenture, Siemens Energy, Samsung, and the United States Air Force.

Named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list alongside Microsoft and Canva. Recognized by the World Economic Forum's Tech Pioneers, Inc 5000, and Josh Bersin's HR Tech AI Trailblazers. In a world where every company claims to 'do AI', at Workera, it's actually in our DNA.

We're learners, builders, and dreamers. Join us.Workera is committed to providing an inclusive and respectful environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit, mindset, and business need.

Grounded in experience and supported by the integrated research expertise of Wake Forest University School of Medicine, the Advocate Health National Center for Clinical Trials is a first-of-its-kind, fully integrated solution designed to make participation in clinical trials part of the standard of care for patients. Our technology ecosystem supports clinical trials across all stages of planning and execution, from recruitment and retention to management and virtual care, delivering efficient processes and high-quality results. This role is responsible for understanding current-state operations, defining future-state workflows, documenting requirements, and ensuring business needs are clearly translated into actionable solution designs. The NCCT Business Process Analyst Sr serves as a critical link between strategy and execution by ensuring that business objectives, process requirements, data needs, and system capabilities are fully understood, traceable, and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

You own the books, the close and the compliance for Sprinto across its entities — India (parent) and the US today, with a European entity next — and lead the controllership and reporting team. You are the company’s authority on accounting and compliance, and you run the two biggest finance projects ahead of us: moving the India entity to Ind AS, and moving from entity-level accounting systems to a consolidation-capable ERP.

This role reports directly to the Head of Finance and works closely with: Founders, FinOps, legal, and our statutory auditors and tax advisors in India and the US.

Where you'll leave your mark?

    Close, consolidation and reporting

  • Run the monthly close across entities (Zoho Books in India, QuickBooks Online in the US) on a fixed calendar, and own the consolidated financials: intercompany eliminations, FX translation, reconciled balance sheets.

  • Own the monthly reporting pack and the numbers behind board and investor reporting; FinOps owns forecasts and budgets.

  • Set and defend technical accounting positions: SaaS revenue recognition (ASC 606 / Ind AS 115, including commission capitalisation), ESOP expense, leases, investments and intercompany arrangements.

  • Keep CRM, billing and books tied out — DealHub and HubSpot to invoicing to revenue.

Job Title: Spécialiste Principal(e) en Gestion de Bases de Données, Senior Database

Job Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

French:


Concepteur(trice) de bases de données (Database Designer)


Notre équipe dédiée aux commanditaires est à la recherche d’un(e) Concepteur(trice) de bases de données expérimenté(e) pour se joindre à nous!


Aperçu du poste

Le ou la Concepteur(trice) de bases de données est responsable des activités de développement EDC et est en mesure d’interpréter les protocoles d’études cliniques ainsi que d’exécuter les tâches de configuration des études. Ce rôle exige une solide compréhension de l’architecture Medidata Rave et du processus de conception d’études cliniques. Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède une expérience pratique en développement de spécifications de contrôles de validation (edit checks) et en programmation de fonctions personnalisées (Custom Functions - CF).Le ou la titulaire du poste possède également de l’expérience dans la gestion des modifications post-production (PPC) et dans la configuration de différents modules Rave, notamment Coding, Local Lab, l’intégration IWRS/IRT, CTMS, Safety Gateway et TSDV.

Responsabilités principales

  • Concevoir ou modifier des modèles de données afin de répondre à des exigences complexes en matière de bases de données tout en tenant compte des besoins d’affaires et applicatifs. Organiser les métadonnées pour leur utilisation par différentes équipes.
  • Planifier, réaliser et coordonner la conception de modèles de données avancés et de solutions de gestion des métadonnées de pointe.
  • Fournir un soutien en modélisation de données au niveau applicatif aux équipes de développement de projets.
  • Participer à la création et au maintien des normes de données à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
  • Contribuer aux activités de modélisation logique des données à l’échelle organisationnelle et diriger les initiatives dans les domaines de données qui lui sont attribués.
  • Participer à l’implantation d’outils de gestion des métadonnées.
  • Animer des discussions formelles et informelles afin de soutenir les initiatives de conception de bases de données.
  • Participer à la mise en œuvre et à la gestion du référentiel mondial de métadonnées.
  • Identifier les sources de métadonnées, développer les capacités de gestion des métadonnées, surveiller la qualité des métadonnées et établir des définitions de données communes.
  • Coordonner les activités de tests et de documentation du référentiel mondial de métadonnées, ainsi que mener des entrevues auprès des utilisateurs afin de recueillir les exigences relatives aux métadonnées et de s’assurer que les besoins d’affaires sont satisfaits.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe; le diplôme doit être complété.
  • Excellente connaissance des systèmes de bases de données, avec un minimum de cinq (5) années d’expérience pertinente, dont au moins deux (2) années en administration de données.
  • Expérience pratique avec Medidata Rave et les activités de développement EDC.
  • Maîtrise avancée de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit; les compétences linguistiques seront évaluées au cours du processus d’entrevue.
  • Doit résider au Canada. Il s’agit d’un poste entièrement en télétravail.

Lieu de travail : Télétravail à temps plein, partout au Canada.


English:


Our sponsor-dedicated team is looking for an experienced Database Designer to join!


Job Overview

The Database Designer is responsible for EDC build activities and is able to interpret study protocols and perform study build tasks. This role requires a strong understanding of Medidata Rave architecture and the study design process. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with edit check specification development and custom function (CF) programming.

The Database Designer has experience working on post-production change (PPC) activities and configuring various Rave modules, including Coding, Local Lab, IWRS/IRT integration, CTMS, Safety Gateway, and TSDV.


Essential Functions

  • Designs or modifies data models to address complex database requirements while considering business and application needs. Organizes metadata for use across teams.
  • Plans, conducts, and coordinates the design of state-of-the-art data models and metadata management solutions.
  • Provides application-level data modeling support for project development teams.
  • Assists in creating and maintaining enterprise-wide data standards.
  • Participates in enterprise-wide logical data modeling and leads efforts within assigned data subject areas.
  • Assists with the implementation of metadata management tools.
  • Facilitates formal and informal discussions to support database design initiatives.
  • Participates in the implementation and management of the global metadata repository.
  • Identifies metadata sources, develops metadata management capabilities, monitors metadata quality, and establishes common data definitions.
  • Coordinates testing and documentation of the global metadata repository and conducts user interviews to gather metadata requirements, ensuring business needs are met.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; completion of the degree is required.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems with a minimum of five (5) years of experience and at least two (2) years of experience in data administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave and EDC build activities.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken; language skills will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Must be based in Canada. This is a fully home-based position.

jobs.title: Certificate Authority Program Steward
jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
  • Analytical judgment and program management: Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration: Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Who We're Looking For At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter.
jobs.description:
Who We're Looking For

At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.

We don't bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them. In this role, you'll do that by redefining how MSPs go from first login to real results with ScalePad, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That's what we call our customers.)

What is ScalePad

At ScalePad, we're building more than software; we're building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.

Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients' most valuable partner). Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion. Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.

But our purpose goes beyond our software. We're creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we're creating a future where MSPs don't just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.

With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset, ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We've been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.

About The Role

As an Onboarding Specialist, you will guide MSP partners from their first login to real, measurable results with ScalePad's products. This role is about more than delivering training. It is about connecting with partners, understanding the outcomes they bought ScalePad to achieve, and creating learning experiences that stick. You'll be the partner's trusted product expert through onboarding and adoption, building the confidence and habits that keep them with us for the long run.

You'll work closely with Customer Success, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product, and the partner feedback you gather will directly shape how our products evolve.

AI Fluency: We expect you to use AI as a daily part of how you work. That includes preparing for sessions by researching a partner's business and goals ahead of time; tailoring examples, agendas, and follow-up recaps to each partner; drafting personalized outreach; spotting adoption gaps and at-risk signals across your book of partners; and helping build and refresh the playbooks and learning content the team relies on. AI helps you prepare and scale, but the rapport, judgment, and energy you bring to each partner conversation is what makes onboarding stick.

What You'll Own

Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:

  • Deliver engaging, high-energy onboarding sessions through both group workshops and 1-on-1 interactions over Zoom that go beyond showing how to click buttons, making the learning experience memorable and actionable.
  • Walk partners through setup, configuration, and best practices for the ScalePad products you support, translating features into clear outcomes for the MSP and the clients they serve.
  • Proactively engage partners during onboarding by asking questions, uncovering their goals and challenges, and tailoring examples so the product feels immediately relevant.
  • Conduct consistent outreach by email and phone to partners who have not yet booked onboarding sessions to encourage participation. Stay highly organized in tracking outreach activities and follow-ups.
  • Support existing partners who need help with adoption, especially for features they have not yet activated or are underutilizing.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product to manage handoffs, flag at-risk partners early, and share partner feedback that shapes the product.
  • Contribute to the playbooks, workshops, and learning content that help the whole team deliver a consistent partner experience.
  • Maintain flexible scheduling to accommodate partners in other time zones, including the UK and Australia.

What We're Looking For

We care about what you can do more than where you've done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role such as onboarding, customer success, training, or technical account management.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication ability (fluent and highly proficient in English).
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to create sessions that are memorable, actionable, and build confidence.
  • Dedicated to great customer service and passionate about partner success.
  • Adaptive and eager to constantly learn about changing technical products, even when it is a little out of your depth.
  • Creative, collaborative, optimistic, communicative, intellectually curious, and clever.
  • Able to quickly iterate and improve as a perpetual learner and teacher.
  • Strong sense of time management, with the ability to balance preparation, delivery, follow-up, and consistent outreach.
  • Incredible attention to detail, with a proven ability to multitask, stay organized, and work rapidly in time-critical situations.
  • Natural ability to build rapport with partners and inspire confidence in product adoption.
  • Open to feedback and committed to continuous improvement, while also able to provide constructive input that enhances the partner experience and internal processes.
  • Strong desire for continued professional growth.
  • Previous experience working at a SaaS company or within a Customer Success or Partner Enablement team is a strong asset.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Hands-on experience helping an IT team complete an IT audit or assessment, or delivering compliance as a service (gap assessments, policy development, evidence collection, and ongoing control monitoring). Early-career IT auditors or risk consultants from Big Four or similar consulting firms are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience contributing to an IT audit and earning, or actively pursuing, a relevant security or compliance certification.
  • Experience in a consultative IT role (especially in an MSP) such as vCIO, vCISO, Technology Alignment Manager (TAM), IT auditor, or IT consultant, where you guided technology roadmaps, budgets, and risk. An understanding of how IT compliance fits into MSP service delivery is an asset.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or CMMC, including how controls map to policies, procedures, and evidence.
  • Familiarity with the MSP tool stack, including PSA, RMM, documentation platforms, and Microsoft 365.
  • A clear passion for building a career in security and compliance, demonstrated through relevant work, certifications, or ongoing learning.

Perks

ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.

  • Everyone's an owner. Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and RRSP matching.
  • Support for growing families. Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.
  • Structured mentorship with builders. Join opt-in mentorship programs and learn directly from founders and senior leaders who've scaled multiple SaaS ventures and spent decades in the MSP industry.
  • Invest in your growth every year. Access an annual professional development budget to level up your skills, your career, and your impact.
  • Set yourself up with great tools. Work with brand new, top-of-the-line hardware and equipment so you can do your best work, whether you're at home or in one of our hubs.
  • Modern ways of working. Roles at ScalePad are structured as remote or hybrid, with hub locations in Vancouver, Toronto, and Phoenix.
  • Support for hybrid life. Receive a monthly stipend to help you create an effective hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Well-being and time to recharge. Take care of yourself with 100% employer-paid benefits.

Before You Apply

This is a full-time role for those who are eligible to work in Canada. We thank all applicants for taking the time to apply, but only candidates who make it to the next stage will be contacted.

Note on AI Use: ScalePad uses AI technology to support certain administrative aspects of our hiring process, such as transcription, note-taking, and interview documentation. These tools are strictly used to assist our team and have no influence on candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

No recruiters, please.

Salary: $70,000–$80,000

Who We Are

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.


United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).


The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

Who You Are

Are you ready to play a critical role in strengthening United Therapeutics’ global pharmacovigilance partnership framework by ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely safety data exchange across global business partners, affiliates, alliances, and QPPVs. This role provides expert operational governance of partner-related case management, reconciliation, reporting quality, and compliance activities to support accurate processing and submission of post-marketing adverse events in alignment with UT procedures and applicable global requirements.

Serving as a key escalation point and strategic advisor, this role will evaluate complex ICSR, governance, regulatory, and inspection-readiness issues; recommend risk-based solutions; and lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance partnership oversight, improve process efficiency, and help protect

patient safety through complete, consistent, and reliable safety reporting.


  • Oversee day-to-day quality, compliance, case-management, data exchange, and reconciliation activities for UT global business partners to ensure discrepancies are resolved and post-marketing adverse events are processed and submitted in accordance with UT procedures and applicable requirements
  • Maintain unified safety data exchange procedures and monitoring controls that support complete, accurate, timely, and consistent partner reporting activities
  • Monitor global regulations, guidelines, and industry practices related to safety data collection, end-to-end case management, and data exchange, and provide expert guidance regarding operational implementation
  • Evaluate complex ICSR compliance, governance, quality, safety-reporting, inspection, and regulatory issues, and recommend risk-based solutions that consider patient safety, regulatory obligations, business objectives, and operational feasibility
  • Serve as the primary functional escalation point for partner-related compliance, governance, quality, reconciliation, and safety-reporting issues involving UT business partners, GPS affiliates, partner alliances, and QPPVs
  • Recommend improvements to partnership oversight programs, functional practices, governance processes, quality systems, and operating procedures based on identified risks, performance trends, and business needs
  • Initiate and lead projects and cross-functional initiatives that improve partner oversight, process efficiency, reporting quality, compliance, and inspection readiness
  • Contribute to departmental planning and implementation of goals for the GPS Partnership Program Oversight function within established functional objectives
  • Develop and deliver procedures, training, and supporting materials for adverse event, product complaint, and special reporting situation collection and reporting in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements
  • Act as a functional subject matter expert and point of contact during inspections and audits involving partner safety data exchange and GVP case-management processes
  • Conduct root-cause analyses and support the timely development, implementation, and closure of corrective and preventive actions arising from partner-related inspection findings, audit observations, deviations, or compliance issues
  • Review and approve partner-related deviations and corrective and preventive actions within assigned authority
  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a bachelor's degree, or
  • 8+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance in end-to-end case processing of ICSRs with a master's degree, or

Minimum Requirements

  • Prior pharmacovigilance experience with demonstrated expertise in safety data exchange, adverse event reporting, compliance oversight, and partnership management activities supporting global pharmacovigilance operations
  • Advanced knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations, guidance, and industry best practices related to safety data exchange, adverse event reporting, reconciliation, and end-to-end case management for drugs, biologics, devices, and combination products
  • Advanced knowledge of drug development, post-marketing safety surveillance, and regulatory frameworks supporting product development, registration, safety monitoring, and reporting obligations
  • Working knowledge of pharmacovigilance agreements, quality agreements, inspection readiness practices, quality systems, and corrective and preventive action processes supporting global safety compliance activities

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your MissionEngine’s Product-Led Growth (PLG) team has a clear goal: team makes sure every new customer feels taken care of from day one, so booking the next trip is never a second thought and we're looking for a Staff Data Analyst to be the data partner who steers towards it. You'll own PLG's measurement end to end, define the metrics PLG and Growth run on, build the self-service analytics partners rely on, and bring a clear point of view on where to invest and what to stop.   • Own PLG's metrics. Define, build, and own the trusted metrics behind the self-serve journey, from sign-up through first booking to a second trip, tied to booking value and margin, not just volume.

  • Shape strategy. Represent data in PLG leadership, flag trends and risks early, and recommend where to invest and what to stop.
  • Set the measurement standard. Strengthen the foundation for A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and monitoring across PLG and Growth, and make sure major launches are measured against it.
  • Find new opportunities. Dig into the data to find where customers stall, which segments are under-served, and where the next growth bets should be.
  • Run analytics prioritization. Prioritize PLG's analytics work by business impact alongside your manager and product leads, and say no where needed.
  • Raise the bar. Improve how the wider team measures impact through reviews, shared playbooks, and mentoring.
  • Work across Growth. Partner with PLG product, engineering, design, and data engineering, and bring the same measurement approach to lifecycle, referrals, personalization, acquisition, and expansion.
  • Work AI-first. Use tools like Claude, Grok Bot and Cursor every day to query, build, and document faster, and help shape how the team works.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in product analytics, growth analytics, or a related role, with a track record of owning metrics for a product or growth area.

  • Strong product and business sense. You turn ambiguous questions into recommendations leaders act on, tied to revenue and margin.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building self-service analytics (Hex, Amplitude, or similar) that partners actually adopt.
  • Travel, hospitality, or T&E domain knowledge.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your analytics work.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Python, and Salesforce.

Why Join Us

  • Own the measurement behind how Engine grows its self-serve business, and directly shape the roadmap.
  • Take on a hard, interesting problem in repeat booking for business travel.
  • Build the foundation for how PLG measured, self-serve, and test, instead of inheriting a rigid process.
  • Contribute across the broader Growth team on referrals, lifecycle, personalization, acquisition, and expansion.
  • Join an AI-forward data team at a growing, profitable, and cash flow positive company.

jobs.description:
Cos'è Blox Space?

Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia Bitcoin, in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo del fintech, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro. Aiutiamo a connettere i talenti con l'ecosistema Bitcoin, operando come Talent Bridge tra le ambizioni di crescita dei professionisti e le opportunità offerte dal nostro network. In questo momento stiamo supportando una delle nostre partner companies nella ricerca di un Backend Developer, e se pensi di essere il profilo giusto, ci piacerebbe conoscerti.

L'azienda e il ruolo

L'azienda è uno dei nomi storici del Bitcoin applicato ai pagamenti, attiva da oltre dieci anni, con più di un milione di clienti in oltre 180 paesi e un team distribuito su più di 30 paesi. Cerchiamo un Backend Developer, da mid a senior, che costruisca le soluzioni di pagamento crypto, integri i supplier e migliori i servizi backend, puntando ad alta disponibilità, bassa latenza e scalabilità per una base di oltre un milione di persone. Non cerchiamo il curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo la testa giusta. Cerchiamo chi è forte su backend e pagamenti, prende decisioni tecniche e fa crescere i più junior. Le responsabilità di un Backend Developer in questo contesto possono spaziare dallo sviluppo e dalla manutenzione dei sistemi backend di pagamento crypto in Node.js e TypeScript, al tenere in piedi il servizio esistente migliorando sistemi e processi, dall'implementazione di nuove integrazioni con supplier e terze parti alla collaborazione con i team cross-funzionali di backend, frontend e design.

Le skill che fanno la differenza

  • 5+ anni di esperienza backend, principalmente in Node.js e TypeScript e/o Python, con MongoDB e Typesense.
  • Esperienza su piattaforme e-commerce o sistemi simili: sai cosa vuol dire reggere volumi e criticità reali.
  • Capacità di prendere decisioni tecniche e di fare mentoring agli sviluppatori più junior.
  • Ottimo inglese: il team è internazionale e distribuito.
  • Interesse per come l'AI sta cambiando il modo di programmare e apertura ai workflow AI-augmented.
  • Sono VERY Nice to Have: esperienza con tecnologie di search come Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Lucene o Solr, per la ricerca interna della piattaforma e-commerce e dei tool interni.

Ti manca qualcosa rispetto a quello che hai letto? Candidati comunque: siamo a caccia di game-changer, non di checklist da spuntare!

Work arrangements

Il ruolo ha come sede preferenziale l'hub di Blox Space a Torino, ma è aperto anche a candidature in remoto. L'azienda è remote-first dal primo giorno, con un team distribuito su più di 30 paesi e ritrovi periodici di persona. Se lo desideri puoi essere pagato in crypto.

Unisciti all'ecosistema con Blox Space!

Se vuoi costruire l'infrastruttura di pagamento che fa girare un prodotto Bitcoin usato da oltre un milione di persone, questa è l'opportunità che stavi aspettando: lavorare con una delle nostre partner companies significa entrare in un team innovativo e in forte crescita, al centro di un ecosistema dove circolano idee, competenze e progetti ad alta intensità tecnica. È un ambiente dove si costruisce, si testa, si discute e si migliora ogni giorno.

jobs.excerpt: Meet True Vet At True Vet Solutions, we believe no veteran should have to fight alone for what they already earned.
jobs.description:
Meet True Vet
At True Vet Solutions, we believe no veteran should have to fight alone for what they already earned.
Every day in America, veterans walk away from disability benefits they qualify for, not because they don't deserve them, but because the system meant to serve them is slow, confusing, and built to wear people down. We exist to change that. We stand between the veteran and the system, and we do not stop until they receive every benefit they earned.
We are a team of high-empathy, high-standards people doing work that actually matters. We answer the call when someone who served is at the end of their rope, and we turn it into an outcome that changes their life. The proof is in what our clients live:
  • Tens of thousands of veterans represented
  • $350M+ in lifetime benefits secured for the people who served
  • 4.9-star client rating across 634 reviews
Where we're going. We are not building a small shop that helps a few hundred veterans a year. There are millions of veterans in this country leaving earned benefits on the table, and we intend to reach them. We are building the most trusted veteran advocacy organization in America, and we are building it fast. If you are looking for a ceiling, this is the wrong place. If you are looking for a mission big enough to spend a career on, and a company moving fast enough for you to grow into the leader you're capable of becoming, keep reading.
The mission of this role
As an Intake Specialist, hours of work would be either 9am - 5pm or 12pm - 8pm eastern standard time, you will be responsible for supporting and assisting veterans in navigating the world of VA Disabilities Claims. You will work directly with veterans to assess their needs, strategize the most beneficial route to take for their claim, and assist them in initiating the claim-building process. Your role will be crucial in ensuring our veterans receive the support and care they deserve.
What you'll own
  • Conduct intake assessments with veterans to determine their needs and goals
  • Develop personalized strategy plans for each veteran based on their unique circumstances
  • Provide advocacy and support to veterans in accessing necessary documents for their claim
  • Assist veterans in completing necessary paperwork and applications for benefits
  • Collaborate with other organizations and agencies to ensure veterans receive
comprehensive support
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of services provided to veterans

Requirements
  • Prior experience working with Veterans or familiarity with Veterans preferred.
  • Previous sales experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of Veteran benefits and resources preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills using metrics to make sound decisions.
  • Process improvement mindset. Strong Communication skills (both written and verbal)
What we offer you
  • Daily coaching and real skill development, you will be sharper in six months than you have ever been
  • A clear path to grow; we promote from within and invest in the people who invest in the mission
  • A team that has your back, and a standard worth being held to
  • Work that lets you end the day knowing you changed the life of someone who served
Benefits
  • Remote-first work, from anywhere in the USA
  • Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and company-wide holidays
  • Hospitality experiences and team gatherings that make remote feel connected
Our Core Values
Our values are the heart of this company. The right person for any role here recognizes themselves in each of them.
Empathy, Without Exception. Every veteran is a person who served, not a case number. We lead with understanding and we hold that standard on the hardest days, in the longest calls, with the most frustrated client. Empathy is the one thing we will never trade away.
Remarkable Character. We do right by veterans when no one is watching. We tell each other hard truths with care, accept them with humility, and keep our words and our actions pointed at the same goal.
Relentless Advocacy. We fight for every benefit a veteran earned, and we do not quit when the system pushes back. It is us against the issue, never us against the veteran, and never each other.
Competitive Greatness. We hold ourselves to an elite standard because the people who served deserve elite representation. We compound small improvements into outsized results, and we build each other into leaders along the way.
How to apply
If this is the mission you've been looking for, apply now. Tell us why this work matters to you, we read every one.
True Vet Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for character and capability, and we welcome applicants of every background. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de ShareGate ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.
jobs.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. Il aide à mettre en place la fondation pour déployer avec confiance l’assistant d'IA de Microsoft.

ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

ShareGate évolue vers des expériences plus modernes, intuitives et fiables, et tu vas aider à mener ce virage. Tu vas bâtir et faire évoluer notre frontend React et TypeScript, influencer l'architecture et l'orientation technique, et travailler avec les équipes produit et design pour régler des problèmes complexes qui comptent pour les client.e.s. Tu vas aussi élever la barre technique par ton jugement, des pratiques modernes et le développement assisté par l'IA au quotidien.

Ton impact :

  • Livrer des fonctionnalités de grande qualité en React et TypeScript qui offrent aux client.e.s de ShareGate des expériences intuitives, rapides et fiables.
  • Façonner l'architecture frontend (composants réutilisables, structure du code, tests, performance) pour que le produit reste facile à maintenir et que chaque nouvelle fonctionnalité sorte plus vite que la précédente.
  • Prendre en charge des initiatives, de la conception technique à la livraison, avec le produit et le design, pour régler de vrais problèmes client.
  • Améliorer en continu la qualité, l'accessibilité, la performance et l'expérience utilisateur, et réduire la dette technique pour que le produit évolue de façon durable.
  • Utiliser chaque jour des outils de développement assisté par l'IA, comme Claude Code, pour livrer plus vite, rehausser la qualité du code et faire progresser les pratiques d'IA de l'équipe.
  • Élever la barre technique de l'équipe par du mentorat, du partage de connaissances et des revues de code qui font grandir les autres.

Ton équipe

Tu vas faire partie de l'équipe ShareGate Migrate, aux côtés de développeur.euse.s d'expérience, d'un.e gestionnaire de produit et d'un.e designer de produit. Tu peux aussi compter sur des expert.e.s de niveau staff et d'autres équipes pour le soutien technique. Dans les 6 à 12 prochains mois, on va améliorer et étendre notre frontend React, peaufiner l'expérience utilisateur et poser les bases techniques de la prochaine étape de ShareGate. On valorise l'autonomie, le sens des responsabilités et la communication ouverte : les décisions techniques se prennent ensemble, les connaissances se partagent et le développement assisté par l'IA fait partie de notre façon de livrer. Notre stack : React et TypeScript, C#/.NET, Azure, API Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, GitHub, tests automatisés et CI/CD.

Ce que tu apportes

  • 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en développement logiciel, idéalement dans un environnement orienté produit ;
  • Une solide expertise en React et TypeScript, avec une bonne maîtrise de l'architecture frontend, de la conception de composants, de la performance et des tests automatisés ;
  • Un jugement technique solide et l'envie de bâtir : tu prends les choses en main, tu décides avec l'information que tu as et tu continues d'élever la barre, côté produit comme côté pratiques d'ingénierie ;
  • Une utilisation quotidienne d'outils d'IA (p. ex. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) en développement logiciel, bien ancrée dans tes habitudes ;
  • Une communication claire et directe, y compris la capacité de remettre en question des décisions produit de façon constructive ;
  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français ;
  • Atout : expérience en développement backend C#/.NET et avec des API Microsoft comme Microsoft Graph, Entra ID et MSAL.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 125 000 $ – 160 000 $. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région de la personne candidate pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

On construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

Warum diese Rolle

Du prägst das Kundenerlebnis: Jede Anfrage, jede Reklamation und jede Bewertung läuft über dein Team. Du entscheidest, wie NEOLYMP sich für Kund:innen nach dem Kauf anfühlt.
Führung mit echtem Hebel: Du leitest unser Support-Team, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Menschen darin weiter.
Prozesse statt Feuerwehr: Du baust Strukturen, Wissensdatenbanken und Automatisierungen auf, damit dein Team weniger manuell arbeitet und mehr löst.
Dein Feedback wirkt im ganzen Unternehmen: Was im Support ankommt, fließt bei uns direkt in Produktentwicklung, Shop, Marketing und Logistik zurück.
Wachstum mitgestalten: Wir wollen in den nächsten Jahren deutlich wachsen. Du baust den Kundenservice so auf, dass er diesen Weg trägt.

Deine Aufgaben

Teamführung

Du führst unser Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, planst Kapazitäten und Erreichbarkeit und gibst klares Feedback.

Du arbeitest neue Teammitglieder ein und entwickelst dein Team gezielt weiter.

Du packst selbst mit an, wenn das Anfragevolumen steigt, etwa rund um Sales-Events wie Black Friday.

Operatives Support-Management

Du verantwortest den Kundenservice über alle Kanäle: E-Mail, Telefon, Onlineshop und Marktplätze wie Amazon oder Otto.

Du steuerst Reklamationen, Retouren, Ersatzteil- und Lieferanfragen und löst Eskalationen.

Du stellst sicher, dass die Kundenkommunikation die Richtlinien der Marktplätze, insbesondere von Amazon, einhält.

Prozesse & Qualität

Du definierst Support-KPIs wie Antwortzeit, Lösungsquote und Kundenzufriedenheit und machst sie transparent.

Du baust Textbausteine, Wissensdatenbank und Self-Service-Angebote (FAQs, Anleitungen) auf und aus.

Du treibst Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI im Support voran: Workflows, Trigger, KI-gestützte Erstantworten und Ticket-Klassifizierung.

Schnittstellen

Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Support strukturiert an Produktentwicklung, Shop, Marketing und Marktplatz-Team weiter, etwa zu wiederkehrenden Produktfragen oder Lieferverzögerungen.

Du stimmst dich mit Logistik und Fulfillment ab, wenn Bestellungen hängen oder Retourenprozesse angepasst werden.

Du unterstützt Operations punktuell, etwa bei der Wareneingangskontrolle, der Qualitätsprüfung von Retouren und der Ersatzteil-Bestandsplanung – so fließen Reklamationsmuster direkt in Einkauf und Produktentwicklung zurück.

Was du mitbringst

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise im E-Commerce und D2C.

Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Support-Team oder Teile davon fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet.

Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Ticketsystemen und Helpdesk-Tools: Routing, SLAs, Makros und Tagging kennst du nicht nur als Nutzer, sondern konfigurierst sie selbst.

Du hast Support-Prozesse bereits automatisiert – Workflows, Trigger, Schnittstellen zu Shop- und Logistiksystemen – und weißt, wo Automatisierung hilft und wo sie Kund:innen nervt.

Du setzt KI-Tools im Support praktisch ein, etwa für Erstantworten, Ticket-Klassifizierung oder den Aufbau der Wissensdatenbank, und entwickelst das für dein Team weiter.

Erfahrung im Marktplatz-Support, insbesondere mit Amazon Seller Central und dessen Kommunikations- und Reaktionszeit-Regeln.

Du arbeitest datengetrieben: Antwortzeit, Lösungsquote, Kundenzufriedenheit und Ticketvolumen sind für dich Steuerungsgrößen, aus denen du Maßnahmen ableitest.

Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

Du behältst auch bei hohem Anfragevolumen den Überblick und setzt klare Prioritäten.

Du denkst in Prozessen: Du löst nicht nur den Einzelfall, sondern die Ursache dahinter.

Du kommunizierst klar und freundlich, mit Kund:innen genauso wie mit Kolleg:innen.

Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung – auch im Remote-Setup arbeitest du strukturiert und selbstständig.

Erfahrung mit Shop-Backends wie Shopify.

Erfahrung im Aufbau von Help-Center- und Self-Service-Angeboten.

Erfahrung in Operations, Logistik oder Retourenmanagement.

Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
