About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at . Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We are hiring a Community Manager to build and grow HeyGen's in-person community across the US East region. This is a long-term, part-time contract (15-25 hours per week) with frequent travel. You will lead workshops for creators and small businesses, run HeyGen's presence at tradeshows and conferences, and recruit and activate local ambassadors and partners. This is an independent, builder role. You will own the region end to end: set the plan, open doors, and do the hands-on work yourself, whether that is leading a room of small business owners, staffing a booth, or coaching an ambassador through their first event. Within 12 months, success looks like US tradeshows that run smoothly, on time, and on budget, an active group of ambassadors and partners hosting their own events, a regular cadence of workshops across key East Coast cities, and measurable pipeline and user activation coming out of all of it. Over time, you will build a community engine that grows beyond what you can run alone.

What You'll Do

Lead hands-on workshops and meetups - You will run HeyGen workshops and meetups for creators, partners' audiences, and small businesses, co-host events with partners, and support ambassador-led events. You will keep content current as HeyGen ships and follow up with attendees to drive activation.

Own tradeshow and conference logistics - You will manage assigned tradeshows and conferences end to end, from booth registration and shipping to vendors, staffing, and teardown. Tradeshow support may span the entire US, not only the East Coast.

Staff the booth - You will run demos, capture leads, and route attendees to the right team.

Organize side events - You will plan dinners, happy hours, and pop-up workshops around major events, and report on results.

Build and run the regional community plan - You will set a community plan for the US East region that aligns with HeyGen's global direction.

Recruit and activate ambassadors - You will find, enable, and support local ambassadors who educate users, host events, and represent HeyGen.

Open local partnerships - You will build relationships with business associations, accelerators, agencies, and AI communities across the region.

Feed insights back to the team - You will track community activity and share what you are seeing with the global community and marketing team.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a community builder, creator, or ecosystem operator, with a track record of working independently.
  • Hands-on conference or tradeshow experience, such as planning logistics, staffing booths, or running activations.
  • Comfort leading workshops, trainings, meetups, or community gatherings, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and build new skills.
  • You drive outcomes through relationships rather than headcount, and you are comfortable reaching out to new people.
  • Organized and proactive in outreach, follow-up, and event logistics.
  • Tech-savvy and curious about AI. You enjoy showing others how to use new tools.
  • Based near a major East Coast hub such as New York, DC, Atlanta, or Miami.
  • Able to travel frequently (often 25-50%), including some evenings and weekends, and to transport event materials.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with partners to co-host events, workshops, or conference activations.
  • Experience as a trainer or teacher.
  • Experience working with creators, small businesses, or SaaS products.
  • Existing relationships with East Coast business associations, accelerators, agencies, or creator networks.

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Wants to own a whole region, not run someone else's playbook.
  • Is as comfortable leading a room of small business owners as breaking down a booth at the end of the day.
  • Gets energy from meeting new people and turning them into partners and ambassadors.
  • Thinks about building something that keeps growing without them in every room.
  • Likes a flexible schedule where event-heavy weeks trade off with prep and outreach weeks.

Logistics

  • Engagement: Long-term contract, part-time.
  • Hours: 15-25 hours per week, varying between event-heavy weeks and weeks focused on workshop prep and outreach.
  • Location: Remote, US East, based near a major East Coast hub such as New York, DC, Atlanta, or Miami.
  • Travel: Frequent travel across the US East Coast plus occasional national conferences, with expenses covered.
  • Be the face of HeyGen across the East Coast and shape how creators and businesses adopt AI video.
  • Real ownership and autonomy over a whole region.
  • Work with a fast-moving, creative community and marketing team that values ambition, clarity, and curiosity.

A note on the application questions: please answer concisely and in your own words. Applications with long AI-written answers lacking substance will not be reviewed.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Join Syndio to sell mission‑driven, category‑defining tech. We help companies get pay right. For almost a decade, we have led in pay equity software and now, with Decisions, we are delivering instant, explainable guidance for offers, promotions, and adjustments right where work happens. Decisions embeds fairness with policy‑aligned recommendations and auditable guardrails, helping customers hire faster, reduce attrition, strengthen compliance (such as navigating the EU Pay Transparency Directive), mitigate enterprise risk, and improve performance.

You'll help the world's largest employers move from fixing pay once a year to getting it right every time by partnering with C-suite executives—including CHROs, CFOs, General Counsels, and Heads of Total Rewards—framing pay governance and AI decision intelligence around enterprise risk, regulatory compliance, and measurable financial ROI. Because we're creating a category, we need a strategic AE comfortable with ambiguity: testing new approaches, learning fast, and folding what works into your talk track. Expect high impact, true enterprise rigor, and a product you can be proud to sell.

Why this job is exciting

  • Own the full sales cycle, from self-sourcing high-value enterprise pipeline to close. You'll partner with our ADRs and Marketing, executing proactive territory strategies to build a self-directed pipeline.
  • Execute rigorous territory planning and target account strategies to drive self-sourced enterprise pipeline creation and consistently exceed your quota goals.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals ($200k target ACV, 6–12 month sales cycles), navigating buying committees of 10–15 people across HR, Legal, Finance, and Procurement.
  • Act as a true strategic quarterback: orchestrate core demos, coordinate internal subject matter experts (Solutions Engineers, labor economists, data scientists, legal experts, executive sponsors), and tailor distinct value narratives for each stakeholder.
  • Participate in the RFP process for prospects, including qualifying leads to ensure a good fit and providing a final review of all responses.
  • Operate with the mentality that sales is a team sport, and bring in Syndio SMEs (e.g. lawyer, labor economist, data scientist, testifying expert, CEO) to help you win and exceed your goals.
  • Get in front of customers: drive active field-based selling by regularly traveling for key customer onsites, flying out to meet senior stakeholders, and hosting in-person executive meetings and events.
  • Operate as a self-directed owner of your territory in a fully remote, distributed team. You'll build your own structure and cadence rather than wait to be told what to do next.

About you

  • You have more than 7+ years experience in sales, and 5 years as a closer
  • Proven track record of closing complex enterprise deals ($150k+ ACV) across 6–12 month cycles while multi-threading with C-suite executives (CHROs, CFOs, General Counsels).
  • You've sold somewhere scrappy. When something wasn't built yet, or a client asked a question you couldn't answer, you figured it out instead of waiting for a team to do it for you
  • You forecast accurately because you know your deals: you spot what's missing and work with your manager to close the gap
  • You can run a confident product demo and tell the story behind it, and you know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer
  • You are proficient in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach (or equivalent), and Gong. You use AI tools (e.g. Claude/ChatGPT, Gong AI, Clay) as a normal part of how you research accounts, prep for calls, and personalize outbound, not as a novelty, and you bring ideas for where technology can help the team
  • You have a highly disciplined approach to selling, with the ability to solve complex deal puzzles and strategically navigate non-traditional enterprise hurdles beyond relying solely on standard framework steps like MEDDPICC
  • You are savvy, capable of curating a thoughtful approach to pay equity, diversity and inclusion, and workplace fairness for each individual client
  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, building your own playbook when one doesn't fully exist yet, rather than waiting for one
  • You bring a positive attitude, hustle, and persistence to your role
  • You are an excellent communicator, able to build relationships quickly with your colleagues, clients, and prospects
  • You're consultative, not scripted. You're curious, a great listener who knows where to poke and prod with prospects to inspire them to take action and drive organizational change
  • You know how to drive a deal and proactively lead prospects and customers (rather than reacting to their requests)
  • You are proficient with spreadsheets, presentation, and project management business applications
  • You are committed to our mission of workplace equity and passionate about Syndio products

Extra credit

  • Experience selling to compensation and total rewards professionals
  • Overall understanding of the HR technology landscape
  • Background selling compensation, HR, Business Intelligence/Analytics solutions
  • Experience selling an AI-native or AI-augmented product, where the pitch itself has to explain how the AI works, not just what it does
  • A track record of in-person, field-based selling: onsites, coffees, and events that build relationships beyond Zoom

Role progression

We're rebuilding onboarding with AI built in across every function, so new AEs ramp faster, with a ramped quota through your first year.

  • Within 2 months, you'll know the core of Syndi, understand Essentials and Decisions, the pay equity and compensation space, and the vocabulary our buyers use. You'll be leading discovery calls and core demos, and you'll have a territory plan.
  • Within 3–6 months, you'll be building pipeline across your territory through outbound, events, and in-person meetings, and leading sales efforts at large enterprise accounts with SE support.
  • Within 6 months, you'll be confident in your role and will provide input into other areas of the business (e.g. marketing & product) based on what you're hearing from prospects. For reference, our most recent AE hire closed their first deal within 6 months and exceeded quota the first year.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our base salary is targeted at $155,000- $160,000 base per year with a $310,000 - $320,000 at target earnings, with no cap. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future.
  • 📍Remote-first working model, with travel about 2-3 times per quarter

The Interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Strategic Account Executive position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  2. 45 minute zoom interview with the Hiring Manager
  3. Two 30 minute zoom interviews with the team - RevOps & an AE
  4. Zoom interview with a member of our executive team
  5. Mock Sales Presentation to panel - 60 minutes
  6. In person meet & greet

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

jobs.description:
About FixiHouse

FixiHouse builds lead products and software for the home improvement industry. We generate qualified homeowner leads and deliver each one to a single contractor within a minute of it being created: one contractor, one quote. Every lead is TCPA-compliant and carries a TrustedForm certificate. We are AI-powered, and our workflows, lead qualification and operating discipline are designed around speed and quality. National home-improvement brands and regional remodelers already buy from us. The company is new; the people are not. Our team has spent their careers in home improvement and lead generation.

Job Summary

The Account Executive, Contractor Sales is responsible for winning new contractor partners for FixiHouse. The role takes first meetings booked by Business Development Representatives (BDRs), runs discovery and demo calls, and manages each deal through to a signed partnership, while also generating additional pipeline through its own outreach. Buyers are owners, marketing leaders and operations leaders at regional home-improvement firms, typically with $10–50M in annual revenue, many of them multi-location and private-equity backed. The Account Executive partners with BDRs, Partnership Management and the go-to-market (GTM) team to grow FixiHouse’s contractor network and revenue.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Conducts discovery and demo calls with owners, marketing leaders and operations leaders at home-improvement firms, using meetings booked by BDRs.
  • Leads discovery in unit-economics terms, including current lead sources, cost per lead (CPL), set rate, close rate, average contract value and target cost of marketing.
  • Presents how FixiHouse works and how much exclusive lead volume is available in the prospect’s service area, using the buyer’s own numbers to show the impact on net sales per lead.
  • Responds to objections with facts on exclusivity, speed to lead, TCPA compliance and lead allocation.
  • Generates additional pipeline through self-sourced outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn, and follows up on stalled deals.
  • Manages deals through each pipeline stage to a signed partnership, involving leadership on pricing and contract terms as needed.
  • Hands closed contractors to Partnership Management with complete notes so onboarding starts quickly, and works with Partnership Management to deliver each new partner’s first lead within 14 days of signing.
  • Records all activities, deals, ZIP code lists and lead caps in HubSpot before signing.
  • Provides feedback to BDRs on meeting quality and helps refine prospect targeting.
  • Shares market and customer feedback with the GTM and product teams.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None.

Success Measures

Goals are set quarterly. In a typical month, a fully ramped Account Executive is expected to:

  • Sign approximately 10 new valid contractors. A valid contractor operates where FixiHouse has lead volume, covers enough ZIP codes for its size, and buys at least 5 leads after signing.
  • Keep at least 85% of signed contractors valid (measured by partners who buy, not contracts signed).
  • Get new partners to their first lead within 14 days of signing, together with Partnership Management.
  • Build a balanced book: at least 1 in 10 signings is a large multi-metro installer and at least 4 in 10 are mid-size firms.
  • Enter every deal, ZIP code list and lead cap in HubSpot before signing.

Education and Experience Required

  • [Confirm education requirement, e.g., High school diploma or equivalent; bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience]
  • 3+ years of B2B closing experience as an Account Executive or in a similar role, with a record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience selling to home-improvement or home-services contractors, or selling lead generation, performance marketing or media to small-business and mid-market buyers.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.

Education and Experience Preferred

  • Experience at a lead marketplace, aggregator or pay-per-lead business.
  • Experience working in a BDR-to-Account Executive handoff model.
  • Knowledge of the bathroom, roofing, windows or home security trades.
  • Familiarity with bid-based or market-based lead pricing.
  • Working knowledge of TCPA and consent documentation such as TrustedForm.
  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Fluency in lead economics: CPL, cost per acquisition (CPA), set rate, close rate and cost of marketing as a percentage of revenue.
  • Strong discovery and demo skills; able to run a structured, consultative sales conversation rather than a scripted pitch.
  • Ability to communicate as a peer with business owners and private-equity-backed marketing leaders.
  • Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to manage a pipeline by the numbers, including conversion rates at each stage.
  • Daily use of AI tools to research accounts, prepare for calls, draft follow-ups, summarize notes and keep the CRM current.
  • Ability to take ownership of outcomes, work with limited supervision and handle ambiguity in a fast-growing company.
  • Honest, accurate communication with customers about current product capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive).
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication in English.
  • Commitment to compliance and to protecting confidential company, partner and consumer information.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Work is performed remotely from a home office within the United States.
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and frequently operate a computer, phone and video-conferencing tools.
  • Spends a large part of the workday on phone and video calls with prospects; must be able to communicate clearly by phone and video.
  • Must be able to read and interpret information on a computer screen.
  • Must maintain a quiet, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet during working hours.
  • Must be available during US business hours; occasional early-morning or evening meetings may be needed to work with colleagues in other time zones.
  • [Confirm travel, e.g., “Occasional travel to industry events or contractor meetings” or remove]

This job description lists the essential functions and other duties considered necessary for this job. It is not a complete list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications, and duties may change at any time with or without notice. This job description is a guide only and does not create an employment contract. Employment with FixiHouse is at will.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Commission Ceiling: Uncapped. Earnings depend on actual sales and client retention.
Primary Market: U.S. med spas, aesthetic practices, and plastic surgery businesses

About the Company

Our client is an established advertising and creative agency launching a new growth-focused marketing vertical. The new offering helps med spas and other aesthetics businesses attract new customers while building a differentiated brand and stronger long-term customer relationships.

The Opportunity

This is the first dedicated sales hire for a growing business, and it is not an order-taking role. You will own inbound opportunities from first contact and qualification through discovery, presentation, objection handling, follow-up, and close.

You will work directly with the founder, help shape the sales process from the ground up, and have the opportunity to grow into a Sales Manager or Head of Sales role as the business scales.

The initial offer is a $3,000 monthly marketing retainer. Higher-tier packages in the $6,000–$10,000 range are planned as the offer matures. Leads will initially come from Meta Ads. The founder will run the early sales calls to set lead-quality and conversion benchmarks, and then you take over.

What You’ll Do

Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Quickly contact and qualify inbound prospects generated through Meta Ads and associated lead forms.
  • Schedule and confirm sales appointments, run discovery calls, present the offer, handle objections, and close new recurring-revenue clients.
  • Build trust with med spa owners, practice leaders, and other sophisticated buyers through consultative, confident conversations.
  • Follow up persistently and professionally with qualified opportunities to reduce no-shows and lost deals.
  • Identify relevant additional services and personally close upsell opportunities when appropriate.

Pipeline Ownership & Sales Operations

Inbound First

The initial focus is on inbound leads. Outbound prospecting is not a defined requirement at launch. This is a high-accountability, entrepreneurial environment that values professional communication and measurable sales outcomes.

Earning Potential

  • $4,000 USD per month, paid in addition to commissions until your monthly residual commissions reach $4,000. At that point the base is removed.

Initial Sale Commissions

Recurring Residuals (on clients you personally close)

  • Year 3: 2.5% of monthly recurring payments

Upsells

jobs.excerpt: We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark.
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.

What you'll do

Profile and map

  • Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.

  • Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.

  • Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.

Migrate and prove

  • Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.

  • Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.

  • Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.

Integrations and commercial data

  • Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and their migration status.

  • Map products, price books and contract terms, and help Finance reconcile billing between each acquired platform and Veremark.

Report

  • Own the migration dashboards for every integration in progress and contribute to the Programme Director's weekly update.

  • Give Customer Success and Sales the client data they need to plan each move.

  • Use AI to work faster: query data with prompts, draft and review SQL, generate first-pass mappings and documentation, and automate routine checks, always verifying results against the source.

Make each integration faster

  • Build a reusable library of profiling and reconciliation SQL, mapping templates and sign-off checklists.

  • Feed what you learn back into the integration playbook after each deal.

  • Where needed, review a target company's data before a deal closes, so we know what we're taking on.

Must have

    • 3+ years as a data analyst, with hands-on work on at least one data migration, platform consolidation or system implementation. Tell us what you moved, how much, and what went wrong.

    • Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregation, used to profile unfamiliar data and reconcile a source against a target.

    • Confident with AI and new tools: you already use AI in your daily work, for example querying data with prompts, drafting and reviewing SQL with an LLM, or using AI features in your BI tool. You know where it saves time, and you check what it produces against the data.

    • Data mapping and validation: you've written field-level mappings, tested migrated data against them and investigated the differences.

    • Reporting: dashboards in Looker, Metabase or similar that non-technical people use.

    • Enough BA craft to work with the product team: documenting current and future state, writing clear requirements, and supporting UAT.

    • Clear communication: you can explain a data problem to a client success manager and a finance lead.

    • Comfortable working to a playbook: you follow an agreed process and flag what doesn't fit, rather than reinventing it, and help improve it after each deal.

Nice to have

    • Python for data cleansing and profiling

    • Experience with billing, pricing or contract data, or with systems like NetSuite or a CRM

    • Background in HR tech, background screening, fintech or another regulated industry

    • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse or Bullhorn, and with APIs and webhooks

    • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit evidence

    • Previous post-acquisition or post-merger integration work

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
  • Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
  • Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
  • Remote work
  • A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

jobs.title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead
jobs.excerpt: REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.
jobs.description:
REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.

Tasks

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.

This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.

We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.

You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.

You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.

Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.

You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.

You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Build and Grow Our Supply Ecosystem

You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.

You will:

  • Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
  • Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
  • Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
  • Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
  • Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.

Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.

Own Commercial Partnerships

You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.

This includes:

  • Managing and developing existing partner relationships.
  • Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
  • Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
  • Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
  • Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.

You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.

Connect Supply With Performance

Supply has value only when it delivers results.

You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:

  • Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
  • Support campaign launches and supply activation.
  • Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
  • Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
  • Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
  • Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.

You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.

Protect Quality

Scaling poor-quality inventory isn’t growth.

You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.

You’ll monitor and challenge partners around:

  • Traffic quality.
  • Fraud and suspicious activity.
  • Attribution anomalies.
  • Delivery consistency.
  • KPI performance.
  • Scalability.
  • Communication and operational reliability.

When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.

Help Build REPLUG’s Own Performance Infrastructure

The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.

You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:

  • Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
  • Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
  • Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
  • Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.

This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.

You should have:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
  • A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
  • Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
  • Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
  • The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
  • Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
  • Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
  • Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
  • Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
  • Additional languages.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thinks commercially.
  • Is comfortable negotiating.
  • Follows through.
  • Makes decisions based on evidence.
  • Can operate independently.
  • Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
  • Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.

Benefits

Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
  • Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
  • Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
  • Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
  • Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
  • Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.
  • Access monthly health and fitness benefits
  • Access yearly educational budget

At the heart of Incubeta is our people. We operate with an entrepreneurial mindset where individuals are trusted to take ownership, bring forward ideas and challenge conventional thinking. Rather than relying on rigid structures, we value accountability, initiative and collaboration. We believe our strength comes from the diverse perspectives, skills and experiences of our team, and we encourage everyone to contribute their unique expertise to make our collective work stronger.

The Role

Incubeta is seeking an exceptional, Senior Creative Project Manager to lead complex, multi-track creative engagements across our growing US client portfolio.

This is not a generalist IT or administrative project management position. The role requires a seasoned creative production leader, blending the tactical discipline of a senior agency producer with the design fluency and strategic acumen of an operational director. Partnering with Client Services and Creative Directors, you will serve as both an authoritative client-facing delivery lead and an uncompromising operational champion for our creative talent.

You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery governance, rigorous brief intake, scope protection, and seamless delivery workflows, ensuring all creative outputs meet world-class design standards while safeguarding team capacity and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Project Leadership & Delivery Governance

  • End-to-End Creative Ownership: Oversee the scoping, planning, execution, and delivery of complex digital marketing, brand, performance creative, display, social, motion/video, and AI generated creative campaigns.
  • Design Literacy & Asset Quality Control: Review briefs, technical requirements, and production milestones through a dedicated design lens. Evaluate whether creative requests or updates are feasible within allotted hours and all specifications are documented before work is assigned to the resources.
  • Creative Workforce Orchestration: Partner daily with Creative Directors and delivery resources to align program deadlines with resource capacity across multiple time zones.
  • Milestone & Sprint Management: Establish and manage project timelines, sprint backlogs, resource allocations, and dependencies using enterprise project management systems (e.g., Monday.com).

Stakeholder Management & Scope Discipline

  • Executive Client Services Partnership: Act as the authoritative delivery counterpart to Client Directors, balancing commercial urgency with realistic operational capacity.
  • Feedback Consolidation & Scope Enforcement: Partner with Clients and Client Services to ensure that feedback is in scope, fully consolidated, actionable, and aligned with project guidelines before reaching production. Manage out-of-scope requests in close coordination with Client Services, authoring change orders and protecting agency standards diplomatically.
  • Client-Facing Composure: Interface directly with senior client stakeholders during kickoff, status, and delivery reviews with high emotional intelligence, transparency, and strategic composure.

Operational Integration & Process Adherence

  • Intake & Brief Gatekeeping: Enforce strict group intake protocols. Return vague briefs that lack core creative direction, mandatory assets, clear deliverables, or target KPIs.
  • Continuous Operational Refinement: Identify systemic production friction points, bottlenecks, and cross-team disconnects, proactively proposing and implementing process optimizations and tooling automations.

Financial & Commercial Accountability

  • Estimate & SOW Formulation: Partner with Client Services, Creative Directors, and PMO to forecast resourcing for the portfolio, building accurate, profitable resource estimates, statements of work (SOWs), and delivery burn forecasts.
  • Budget Tracking & Utilization: Actively monitor project burn rates, allocated vs. actual designer hours, and change requests, preventing margin erosion through real-time commercial governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Level: 6+ years of progressive project management / creative production experience within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, or high-velocity brand studio, including at least 3+ years in a senior or lead delivery role (Senior PM, Executive Producer, or Project Director).
  • Creative & Design Background (Mandatory): Demonstrated background in design, visual arts, creative technology, or rich media production. Must possess working fluency in digital design vocabulary, asset formats, Figma, and Google ecosystems, digital ad specs, and motion/video pipelines.
  • Technical & Digital Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of performance creative, paid media assets, digital display, and analytics-driven asset scaling.
  • Tooling Proficiency: Deep hands-on expertise with enterprise project tracking tools (Monday.com preferred, Asana, Jira), resource management platforms, and collaborative design review tools.
  • Cross-Border Delivery Experience: Proven track record collaborating across distributed, multi-timezone delivery teams.

Core Competencies

  • Authoritative Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills. Able to manage difficult conversations, push back constructively against client and internal pressures, and build trust across diverse teams.
  • Workload Prioritization: Ability to thrive under high-volume delivery cycles without losing composure or compromising quality standards.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Forward-looking mindset that anticipates production bottlenecks, resourcing deficits, and scope creep before they impact delivery timelines.
  • Operational Integrity: High attention to detail with an insistence on structured workflows, thorough documentation, and process consistency.

Fort Worth Heat and Air is hiring a phone-based Sales Representative to handle inbound and warm outbound calls from homeowners and small businesses. This role is focused on converting interested leads into booked jobs and sold estimates, not cold-calling a random list.

You’ll spend most of your day on the phone: answering inquiries, following up on open quotes, explaining options, and asking for the business.

Responsibilities

- Handle inbound calls and web leads from prospective customers
- Make outbound follow-up calls on open estimates, missed calls, and past-due recommendations
- Ask structured discovery questions to understand the customer’s situation and needs
- Present clear options, pricing, and next steps (service visit, maintenance plan, replacement estimate, etc.)
- Confidently ask for the sale and secure verbal commitment
- Coordinate with dispatch/office to get jobs scheduled and information handed off cleanly
- Document all calls, outcomes, and next steps in the system
- Hit daily/weekly activity and sales targets

Qualifications

- Prior phone-based sales or customer service experience required
- Comfortable spending most of the day on the phone and asking for the close
- Clear, professional communication and strong listening skills
- Organized and consistent with follow-up and note-taking
- Willing to work an 8–5 schedule with some flexibility for peak call times
- Able to pass a standard background check

Compensation – Commission Structure

1. How Your Commission Works

You are commission-only. This plan is the entire structure.

A) New Residential System Installs

- Base commission: 10% of gross profit on each residential install.

- Gross profit = Selling price

– equipment cost (condenser, air handler/furnace, accessories)
– materials & parts
– install labor (fully loaded)
– permits & fees
– financing / dealer fees
– sales tax
- FieldPulse will calculate gross profit per job so your 10% is visible on each ticket.
- When you get paid: after the job is completed and all customer payments are received / financing funds and clears.
- If a job is refunded / written off, your commission on that job is reduced in the same proportion (up to full chargeback).

2. Install & Service Upsell Spiffs

You earn these whether the item is sold on an install or on a later visit, as long as it is on your ticket and paid.

Flat spiffs (paid after customer payment clears):

- 5-Year Labor Warranty: $135

- 10-Year Labor Warranty: $270

- IAQ Testing (basic): $25
- IAQ Testing – Registered Professional: $100
- Whole-Home Air Purification system: $350
- Honeywell Elite Pro 1200 thermostat: $50

Memberships (Comfort Club & Breakdown Shield)
- Comfort Club – Pay Now: $50 per prepaid year, capped at 3 years per system on a single sale.
- Breakdown Shield – Pay Now: $25 per prepaid year, capped at 3 years per system on a single sale.
- If a customer prepays more than 3 years, commission is still capped at 3 years for that sale.

- Comfort Club – Pay Later (billed every 4 weeks):
- You earn the same $50 per year, paid as a one-time lump sum after 12 consecutive months of on-time payments.
- If they cancel or go delinquent before 12 months, no Comfort Club spiff is paid.

  • Breakdown Shield – Pay Later (only with Comfort Club Pay Later):
    - You earn $25 one-time after 12 consecutive months of on-time payments.
    - If they cancel or go delinquent before 12 months, no Shield spiff is paid.

3. Discounts, Changes, and Rules

A) No unauthorized discounting

- You do not control pricing. Any discount must be manager-approved.
- If an approved discount reduces the price by X%, your commission and spiffs on that job are reduced by the same X%.

B) Paid on cash in, not promises

- You are paid only on collected cash / funded financing.
- If a customer signs and later cancels or never pays, that commission is not earned or is charged back.

C) One-page plan

- This document is the entire commission plan.
- Any changes must be made in writing, signed by both you and management.
- Verbal promises are not part of this plan.

D) Install vs. Non-Install

- 10% gross-profit commission applies to new residential system installs you sell.
- The upsell spiffs above apply on any qualifying ticket (install or service) where you are the salesperson of record.

If you’re coachable, hungry, and like turning conversations into closed deals, we’d like to talk to you.

jobs.excerpt: Über NETSHAKE Deutschlands E-Commerce-Incubator Nr.
jobs.description:
Über NETSHAKE

Deutschlands E-Commerce-Incubator Nr. 1 und TÜV-zertifizierter Shopify Premier Partner – Top 1 % weltweit. 26 Jahre am Markt, über 1.600 Projekte, Standorte in Stuttgart und Dubai. Wir sind AI-First: Unsere Leads sind KI-vorqualifiziert, unser Vertrieb läuft über Close CRM mit Power Dialer. Du telefonierst nicht ins Blaue – du telefonierst mit System.

Worum es geht

Du hast schon am Telefon gearbeitet, im Kundenservice, im Callcenter oder in der Beratung. Jetzt willst du raus aus dem Großraumbüro, rein in einen Job, in dem deine Gespräche wirklich etwas bewegen.

Du bist die erste Stimme, die unsere Wunschkunden von NETSHAKE hören. Vier Stunden am Tag führst du Gespräche mit E-Commerce-Händlern und legst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter.

Der Unterschied zum Callcenter: Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführern, nicht mit Endkunden. Deine Leads sind KI-vorqualifiziert, und du wirst für gute Termine bezahlt. Nicht irgendwelche Termine. Termine, bei denen der Händler weiß, warum er im Gespräch sitzt, was NETSHAKE macht und warum es sich lohnt. Qualität bringt dich hier weiter.

Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest täglich 4 Stunden KI-vorqualifizierte Leads über unseren Power Dialer und stellst den ersten persönlichen Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden her.

  • Du führst jedes Gespräch entlang unseres Gesprächsleitfadens: souveräner Einstieg, Interesse wecken und qualifizieren, ob eine Zusammenarbeit infrage kommt.

  • Du gehst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Gesprächssituationen um und weißt, wie du auf Einwände wie „Keine Zeit“, „kein Bedarf“ oder „Schick mal was“ professionell reagierst.

  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jeder Termin, der von dir kommt, auch stattfindet

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens erste Erfahrung am Telefon: Kundenservice, Callcenter, Telesales, Terminierung oder Kundenberatung

  • Du willst dich vom Kundenservice in Richtung Vertrieb entwickeln und bist bereit, dafür Gas zu geben

  • Du gehst ans Telefon, um zu gewinnen. Ein „Nein“ spornt dich an, statt dich zu bremsen

  • Du bist ergebnisgetrieben und zählst am Abend, was du erreicht hast

  • Du führst Gespräche selbstbewusst und direkt, übernimmst die Führung und bringst den Gesprächspartner zur Entscheidung

  • Du hast einen Qualitätsanspruch: Lieber drei Termine, die halten, als zehn, die platzen

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und diszipliniert und bist 4 Stunden täglich fest am Telefon

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, Headset

Benefits

  • Stundenhonorar + Performance-Boni: Du bekommst ein festes Stundenhonorar – und zusätzlich Boni für jeden Termin. Der Bonus richtet sich nach der Qualität des Termins, nicht nur nach der Anzahl. Wer gute Termine legt, verdient deutlich mehr.

  • Homeoffice statt Großraumbüro: Kein Pendeln. Du brauchst einen ruhigen Platz, stabiles Internet und ein Headset.

  • Keine Kaltakquise ins Leere sondern gezielt: KI-vorqualifizierte Leads, Power Dialer, fertige Gesprächsleitfäden. Du telefonierst, das System macht den Rest.

  • Training auf Vertriebsniveau: Du bekommst Skripte, Einwandbehandlung und Coaching. Damit machst du aus deiner Telefonerfahrung echte Vertriebskompetenz.

  • Vom Kundenservice in den Vertrieb: Opener, Setter, Closer. Wer liefert, bekommt mehr Stunden, mehr Verantwortung und mehr Einkommen.

  • Bei guter Zusammenarbeit sprechen wir gern über eine Festanstellung – in deutschen oder internationalen Strukturen, je nachdem, wo du lebst und wohin du willst.

  • Ein Produkt, das man gern verkauft: Shopify-Händler, die wachsen wollen – und eine Agentur, die das nachweislich liefert.

Passt das?

Wenn du am Telefon zu Hause bist und den Schritt vom Kundenservice in den Vertrieb machen willst: bewirb dich.

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.

Job Description


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives everything we do. As we build our presence in obesity and related conditions, we have an opportunity to create connected, patient-centered experiences and meaningful engagement at scale.


What you will do

Activations are large-scale, culturally relevant brand experiences brought to life through media, live events, OOH, and partnerships. The Senior Manager, Activation & GEO will alongside the Associate Director, own activation delivery and cross-channel execution. The role also owns the media team’s GEO strategy, working with Corporate Affairs and external content partners to identify and develop opportunities that strengthen the brand’s visibility and content presence beyond owned digital properties.

What sets this role apart

• Pair activation execution leadership with a distinct media-side GEO strategy remit.

• Turn activation plans into coordinated cross-channel delivery with clear partner ownership.

• Connect external content opportunities with Corporate Affairs and the owned GEO work led by Digital Engagement.


Key responsibilities

Activation Execution and Cross-Channel Delivery

• Co-lead brand activation identification and development with the Associate Director, translating plans into coordinated workstreams, timelines, and partner deliverables.

• Own cross-channel execution coordination so activation content and experiences are delivered consistently across relevant touchpoints.

• Manage day-to-day activation logistics, dependencies, partner communication, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with Consumer, HCP Promotion, Corporate Affairs, Patient Experience, agencies, and external partners as needed for delivery.

• Track decisions, milestones, risks, and open actions, escalating issues that affect timing, cost, or strategic intent.

Media GEO Strategy

• Own GEO strategy for the consumer team, identifying how external content and media-related opportunities can improve discoverability in generative search environments.

• Coordinate with Corporate Affairs and external content partners to identify, shape, and activate credible content opportunities.

• Partner with Digital Engagement, which owns GEO strategy for brand-owned properties, to align external opportunities with the owned web and technical approach.

Partner and Process Leadership

• Experience with GEO, search strategy, digital content discoverability, or emerging content environments preferred.

• Strong project management, partner coordination, and communication skills.

• Ability to work across media, Corporate Affairs, agencies, and matrixed teams.

• Pharmaceutical, healthcare, consumer health, or other regulated-industry experience preferred.

  • Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
  • Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations

  • Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
  • Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
  • Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests

  • Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates

  • Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
  • QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
  • AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable:

What’s in it for you?

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel, Go-to-Market
jobs.excerpt: Why should you consider joining Auvik?  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.
jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s this role about?

Auvik is looking for a practical, hands-on commercial lawyer to support Sales, Customer Success, and Channel. You’ll help move B2B SaaS customer and partner deals forward by negotiating agreements, applying established playbooks, and giving clear, timely legal advice.

You’ll be an independent-minded advisor who explains risks and options clearly, helping business partners make informed commercial decisions. You’ll analyze contract terms against company policy and industry practice and provide practical recommendations. The role focuses primarily on commercial contracting and go-to-market support, with senior legal leadership and outside counsel available for specialized or higher-risk matters.

What will I be doing?

  • Support Sales and Customer Success through customer contracting for U.S. and international prospects, including reviewing exceptions to online terms and drafting, negotiating, and finalizing addenda. Deal activity increases near the end of each month, quarter and year.
  • Handle requests from prospective customers, from routine contract questions to non-standard terms and negotiations. Work with internal teams and, as appropriate, customers, partners and vendors to resolve contract issues.
  • Review and negotiate reseller, channel, and other partner agreements; develop or improve standalone agreements as needed.
  • Advise on renewals, contract interpretation, and customer disputes. Summarize non-standard positions and explain their business implications.
  • Support Marketing on non-standard promotions and contest terms, and review vendor agreements as needed.
  • Coordinate trademark registrations and alleged infringement matters with outside counsel.
  • Provide practical contract and negotiation training, and improve templates, playbooks, intake, and escalation processes so the contracting process can scale with the business.
  • You’ll use Google Workspace, Jira for legal intake and workflow, and Slack and Zoom to collaborate across teams and time zones.

What are we looking for?

  • A U.S. law degree and an active license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, in good standing.
  • Approximately 4–7 years of relevant commercial legal experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for B2B SaaS or technology agreements. Candidates with fewer years may be considered if they demonstrate strong, independent negotiation judgment.
  • Experience negotiating customer and partner contracts and advising Sales, Customer Success, or other commercial teams.
  • The ability to manage deal volume, provide timely practical advice, and communicate clearly with non-lawyers.
  • Sound legal and commercial judgment: you can apply established playbooks, explain risks and options, and identify when a matter needs escalation.
  • An organized, collaborative approach and comfort working remotely across teams and time zones.

What success looks like?

  • Sales and Customer Success receive responsive, useful legal support for customer and partner deals.
  • Routine and moderately complex agreements move efficiently within established playbooks and approval limits.
  • Business partners receive clear advice and practical options, and understand that commercial decisions remain with the business.
  • Material or unfamiliar legal risks are escalated with a clear recommendation.
  • Contract guidance is clear and consistent.

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.



About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, 401k matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

Total Target Compensation Range (Base Salary + Target Corporate Incentive)
$180,000—$234,000 USD

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Mkt Manager Revenue Cycle Inpatient Coding, you will provide strategic oversight to our inpatient coding teams, holding them fully accountable for enterprise-established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including Discharged Not Final Billed (DNFC). You will serve as a subject matter expert in ICD classification systems and reimbursement methodologies, ensuring that all coding practices align with enterprise compliance plans. By acting as a critical liaison between CDI, clinical quality, physicians, and patient financial services, you will foster collaborative relationships that ensure the absolute accuracy and integrity of the inpatient medical record across our health system.

Every day you will actively monitor DNFC and coding work queues to ensure that all operational metrics are met, while managing team workflows to hit established productivity and quality standards. You will analyze performance data to identify gaps, developing and implementing targeted action plans for sustained improvement. Furthermore, you will facilitate communication across multiple departments to resolve complex workflow bottlenecks, ensuring that the revenue cycle remains seamless and compliant with the ethical coding standards established by AHIMA and AAPC.

To be successful in this role, you will possess the ability to resolve complex technical and operational issues, including remote troubleshooting for coding software and hardware. You must demonstrate strong leadership and organizational skills, with the professional ability to deliver high-level presentations to large groups and hospital leadership. Your expertise will be essential in assisting CommonSpirit Health (CSH) executive leadership with strategic planning and the development of high-impact presentations for combined coding and CDI steering committees.

  • Manage inpatient coding teams to achieve optimal performance, productivity, and coding accuracy benchmarks.
  • Direct oversight of DNFC workflows to ensure timely billing and efficient revenue cycle operations.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for ICD coding systems, reimbursement integrity, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CDI, clinical staff, and patient financial services to optimize documentation and coding workflows.
  • Develop and execute performance improvement plans to address coding quality and productivity deficiencies.
  • Drive strategic initiatives by preparing and presenting data-driven reports for system-wide steering committees and executive leadership.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Associates Other Associate’s degree in HIM or related field and 4-6 years
  • 4-6 years 5 years of recent management of hospital-based coding teams (hospital, large multi-facility organization, etc.)
  • 4-6 years Experience in process improvement strategies and mentoring staff
  • 4-6 years Previous experience effectively managing remote teams

Preferred

  • Bachelors Other Bachelor’s degree in HIM or related field
  • 3+ years of inpatient coding experience
  • 4-6 years Experience working in a level I/II trauma center and/or teaching hospital with complex conditions and procedures (cardiovascular/interventional radiology, orthopedic, neurosurgery, and obstetrics/NICU)
  • Experience working with a CDI program
  • Registered Health Information Administrator
  • Registered Health Information Technician
  • Certified Coding Specialist

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

Persönlich. Proaktiv. Professionell.
