jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
jobs.excerpt: What we do MAIA is an AI platform for companies.  With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes.
jobs.description:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Software Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Apply with your CV here and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in semiconductor and vacuum hardware. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in semiconductor or vacuum hardware.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

Über Neolymp

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unser Ziel ist klar: 100 % Wachstum pro Jahr bei starker Profitabilität. In den nächsten drei Jahren wollen wir auf 100 Mio. € Umsatz wachsen und dafür ein starkes Marketplace-Team aufbauen, das du leitest. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unser Marktplatz-Geschäft und berichtest direkt an unseren Gründer & CEO, entscheidest sehr frei und wirst über Ziele geführt, nicht über Vorgaben.

  • Du entwickelst Amazon, Otto und Decathlon gezielt weiter und erschließt neue Marktplätze und Länder.
  • Du führst das Marketplace-Team, setzt die Prioritäten im Tagesgeschäft und baust das Team auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € aus.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Content, Design, Produktentwicklung und Logistik zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Listings, Launches und Bestände zur Strategie passen.
  • Du planst Produkt-Launches und Expansion auf den Marktplätzen mit.
  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Amazon, Otto, Decathlon, Agenturen und Dienstleister und verhandelst Konditionen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketplace-Geschäft, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in leitender Rolle.
  • Du kommst aus einem E-Commerce-Startup oder Scale-up, das bereits mindestens achtstellige Umsätze erzielt, und kannst konkret zeigen, wie du das Marktplatz-Geschäft dort entwickelt hast.
  • Tiefes Amazon-Know-how (Seller Central, Advertising, Brand Registry und Pan-EU).
  • Du kennst Otto und Decathlon als Marktplätze und hast idealerweise bereits mit ihnen gearbeitet.
  • Erfahrung mit internationaler Expansion.
  • Starkes Zahlenverständnis: Du denkst in Marge, Deckungsbeitrag und Lagerumschlag, nicht nur in Umsatz.

  • Variable Vergütung: Zusätzlich zum Fixgehalt bist du am Erfolg beteiligt.

  • Startup-Umfeld: regelmäßige Team-Events in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

jobs.description:
Overview

Shearer’s Foods, founded in 1974 and headquartered in Massillon, OH, is a leading manufacturer of salty snacks, cookies, and crackers. Specializing in private label and co-manufacturing, Shearer’s is the largest supplier of private brand salty snacks and second-largest supplier of private brand cookies and crackers.

With a strong focus on innovation, service, quality, and sustainability, Shearer’s has been awarded the food industry’s highest award for environmental sustainability, as well as multiple Supplier of the Year awards.

Operating 16 locations across North America and employing more than 5000 team members, Shearer’s is driven by its core values of People, Grow, Impact and Win. The company mission is to deliver exceptional products and services that make snacking a time to celebrate for our customers, colleagues, and community.

At Shearer’s Foods, we believe in a skills-first approach to recruitment and employment. This means focusing on what you can do and how you can grow, rather than traditional metrics alone. We are committed to adhering to anti-exclusion practices, removing barriers to access, and enhancing opportunities for all individuals based on merit and potential. Your skills, experience, and perspective are valuable—and we want to empower you to make your mark here with us. 

Responsibilities

Senior HRIS Analyst - Remote

The Senior HRIS Analyst, Talent System will serve as the functional and technical owner for iCIMS Applicant Tracking System and iCIMS Onboarding. Drive the performance and continuous improvement of recruiting and onboarding technology through effective platform configuration, release management, integrations, reporting, data integrity, security, and user support. You will also provide secondary administration and operational support across the broader HR technology portfolio, including ADP Workforce Now and SAP SuccessFactors Talent and Learning modules.

This senior individual-contributor role offers the opportunity to lead impactful recruiting and onboarding technology initiatives, partnering across HR, Talent Acquisition, and IT to drive innovation and streamline processes. Key responsibilities include:

iCIMS Platform Ownership

  • Serve as the primary functional and technical administrator for iCIMS Applicant Tracking System and iCIMS Onboarding.
  • Own configuration, workflows, forms, fields, security roles, reporting, integrations, release management, testing, system documentation, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage iCIMS system updates by reviewing release notes, determining which processes may be affected, coordinating testing with users, documenting changes before they are placed into production, and explaining relevant changes to Talent Acquisition and Plant HR.
  • Serve as the main contact for iCIMS support cases and work performed by iCIMS or outside implementation partners.
  • Ensure candidate and new-hire information transfers accurately and securely between iCIMS, ADP Workforce Now, background-screening providers, job boards, assessment tools, and identity or account-setup systems. Define field mappings and validation rules, monitor failures, coordinate issue resolution, and confirm data transfers are accurate and secure.
  • Configure secure processes within iCIMS Onboarding for collecting, routing, storing, and retaining candidate and new-hire documents. Eliminate email-based and other insecure document-handling workarounds within recruiting and onboarding.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards covering recruiting funnel performance, source effectiveness, time to fill, candidate conversion, onboarding completion, skipped or overdue process steps, and data quality. Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to define consistent metrics and validate reporting logic.
  • Evaluate configuration requests against standard iCIMS capabilities, company process standards, security requirements, and the effort required to maintain the solution over time. Recommend simpler alternatives when customization would create unnecessary complexity, inconsistent location practices, or excessive maintenance.
  • Maintain a current inventory of configurations, workflows, forms, fields, integrations, reports, security roles, vendor connections, dependencies, business purposes, and system owners.
  • Maintain and prioritize the iCIMS platform roadmap and enhancement backlog with Talent Acquisition and HR Technology leadership. Document the business problem, expected value, effort, risk, dependencies, and accountable business owner for each enhancement.
  • Monitor platform usage, system reliability, vendor support performance, support trends, and module adoption. Use this information to recommend renewals, module changes, vendor escalations, and outside consulting support. This role does not own contract negotiation or procurement.

Process Design and Candidate Experience

  • Partner with Plant HR Managers, Generalists, Coordinators, and Talent Acquisition to map current-state processes and design scalable digital workflows.
  • Design and continuously improve mobile-friendly recruiting and onboarding experiences for hourly and frontline candidates, accounting for limited computer access, varying levels of comfort with technology, multilingual needs, and time-sensitive plant hiring requirements. Monitor candidate drop-off and onboarding completion to identify and remove unnecessary friction.
  • Design system processes that work for frontline employees who may not have company email, regular computer access, or time away from the production floor during their shifts. Drive simplification and standardization across plants while accommodating legitimate local variation.

Integrations and Data Quality

  • Own the business requirements and continued reliability of iCIMS integrations. Partner with IT and vendors on technical design, monitoring, troubleshooting, and remediation.
  • Build and maintain reports that identify data errors, failed integrations, and recruiting or onboarding steps that are not being completed as designed.
  • Help ensure new-hire records use the correct employee IDs and organizational information when information moves from iCIMS into other HR systems.

Service Delivery and Knowledge Management

  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for the live iCIMS ATS and Onboarding systems. Diagnose underlying problems, resolve configuration and data issues, and coordinate with iCIMS or IT when escalation is needed. Document resolutions and identify recurring issues for permanent correction or user education.
  • Create and maintain administrator runbooks, configuration documentation, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and end-user job aids.
  • Cross-train designated HR Technology and Talent Acquisition partners to reduce key-person dependency and support continuity during absences or role transitions.
  • Train and support recruiters, Plant HR teams, and other users when new workflows or system features are introduced.

Security, Privacy, and Compliance

  • Administer and periodically review iCIMS security roles, user access, limited administrative access assigned to business users, and vendor access. Conduct reviews at least quarterly and upon material role changes; document approvals and remediation.
  • Design workflows and integrations so sensitive candidate and employee information is collected, transferred, stored, and accessed securely. Identify and remediate practices that expose sensitive information through insecure channels.
  • Maintain recruiting and onboarding configurations that support required recordkeeping, data integrity, and regulatory reporting. Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and Compliance to configure iCIMS and create reports that meet approved recordkeeping, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

How You’ll Work

  • Partner closely with the VP, HR Technology on prioritization, architecture, and roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership and recruiters to translate recruiting and onboarding needs into scalable system solutions. Talent Acquisition owns recruiting policy, recruiting and onboarding results, and user adoption; this role owns platform design, configuration, testing, system documentation, data integrity, and support.
  • Work effectively in a remote environment by maintaining reliable availability during agreed working hours, leading virtual requirements and design sessions, documenting decisions and follow-up actions, and traveling as needed for headquarters meetings, plant discovery, implementations, and major releases.
  • Future growth may include responsibility for additional HR systems, broader HR technology design work, or a leadership role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assess and document the current iCIMS ATS and Onboarding setup, resolve known defects, and establish a prioritized improvement backlog covering configurations, integrations, security roles, and process gaps.
  • Eliminate remaining paper-based onboarding workarounds at plants and establish a consistent, secure digital onboarding process.
  • Improve the accuracy of candidate and new-hire information transferred between systems through documented field mappings, validation controls, integration monitoring, and issue-resolution procedures.
  • Establish consistent practices for managing iCIMS updates, testing existing functions after changes, reviewing user access, and controlling changes to the live system.
  • Reduce recurring iCIMS support issues by fixing underlying problems, training users, and creating clear self-service documentation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of HR technology, HRIS, or closely related experience, with increasing responsibility for system administration, configuration, or implementation, including at least 3 years administering and configuring enterprise HR systems.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience administering and configuring iCIMS Applicant Tracking System, including workflows, fields, user roles, reporting, integrations, and production support.
  • Hands-on experience administering iCIMS Onboarding, including onboarding workflows, forms, document handling, and new-hire data transfer.
  • Experience leading or having direct responsibility for requirements, configuration, testing, or deployment in at least one iCIMS implementation, reimplementation, module expansion, or significant platform redesign, including requirements gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Demonstrated experience developing test plans and scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing, documenting results and defects, obtaining business approval, and managing controlled production changes.
  • Demonstrated experience administering HR or recruiting systems containing sensitive personal information, including role-based access, secure document handling, data-retention requirements, audit controls, and safe handling of live candidate and employee data during testing and troubleshooting.

jobs.excerpt: Description We’re growing and looking to hire a Senior Product Manager who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.
jobs.description:
Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Senior Product Manager who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. In healthcare, that includes the connected devices hospitals rely on for care: infusion pumps, imaging systems, patient monitors, and hospital building systems.

xDome provides visibility into these devices and supports exposure management, threat detection, network protection, secure access, and clinical operations. Claroty has been named Best in KLAS for Healthcare IoT Security for five consecutive years.

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead discovery, definition, and delivery of healthcare initiatives on xDome. You will own the healthcare roadmap and work with security, clinical engineering, and biomedical stakeholders, and with Claroty’s US field teams.

This is a remote position, with expected travel. Candidates must be located in EST time zone.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

  • Drive the Healthcare Roadmap: Set the roadmap for clinical engineering, biomedical / HTM, and security users, and align it with company priorities and engineering capacity
  • Product Adoption: Research how security and clinical engineering teams work, and define product for device context, ownership, and remediation in those workflows
  • Healthcare Data: Improve the device and clinical data in xDome. Work with medical device manufacturers on the data they provide, and guide the Data team’s priorities
  • Analyze the Market: Track how US health systems buy and run medical device security, and identify the product gaps that follow from that
  • Field Support: Partner with pre-sale and post-sale teams on US healthcare deals, and work through technical and clinical questions from large health systems
  • Customer Council: Run a healthcare customer council and use that feedback in the roadmap
  • Product GTM: Define success metrics and product messaging for exposure management, threat detection, network protection, secure access, and clinical operations
  • Enable the Field: Build playbooks and demo material for US sellers working with CISOs, clinical engineering leaders, and CIOs

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 6+ years in product management, with a record of shipping B2B products
  • Healthcare: Working knowledge of medical device security and clinical engineering. Experience at a health system, medical device company, or healthcare security company is strongly preferred
  • Stakeholders: Experience shipping product used by both security and clinical engineering teams
  • Data: Experience improving the quality of device data, including work with manufacturers or a data team
  • Technical Proficiency: Ability to work with engineering on discovery, risk, and workflow, and to write requirements another team can build
  • Analytical Rigor: Use customer input and product data to make scope and priority decisions
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, sales, and hospital executives
  • Adaptability: Experience working in Agile teams and adjusting plans based on customer feedback
  • BA/BSc or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, or a healthcare field
  • Location: Based in the United States, with travel to health-system customers

Preferred:

  • Experience selling to or building product for US health systems
  • Familiarity with CMMS, network access control, or vulnerability management in a hospital environment
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or HICP
  • Experience supporting healthcare deals through evaluation
  • Experience setting product direction with engineering teams outside your reporting line

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit claroty.com.

A Great Place to Work® certified company, Claroty is headquartered in New York City with employees across the world. The company is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, with backing from the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors, named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: IoT Security Solutions, Q3 2025, recognized by KLAS Research as Best in KLAS for Healthcare IoT Security five years in a row, and ranking on the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for multiple consecutive years.

Expected compensation for the role is between $200,000.00 - $225,000.00 USD. This is a good faith estimate but does not include equity, bonus, or other forms of payment. Pay will be determined by experience level, but those outside the salary band are welcome to apply.

Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

jobs.description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Über uns

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
  • Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
  • Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
  • Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
  • Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
  • Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
  • Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
  • Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
  • Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
  • Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich
  • Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen
  • Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine
  • Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

As a leading provider of AI-powered extended managed detection and response (MXDR) services, Ontinue is on a mission to be the most trusted, 24/7, always-on security partner that empowers customers to embrace the future by using AI to operate more strategically, at scale, and with less risk. We believe that the combination of AI and human expertise is essential for delivering effective managed security that is tailored to a customer’s unique environment, operational constraints, and risks.

Our MXDR service combines powerful proprietary AI with a one-of-a-kind collaboration model to continuously build a deep understanding of our customers’ environments, informing how we prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Our unrivaled Microsoft expertise allows customers to achieve these outcomes with the Microsoft Security tools they already own. The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. Always-on prevention Services. Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

Your mission:

At Ontinue, we’re building an environment where you can thrive. We encourage collaboration and cross-functional learning. We’re more than just a steppingstone on your resume. We’re a company where you can thrive and grow.

As a Associate Cyber Defender, you are at the forefront of our defenses, being first to react and respond to new threats. You work on the full stack for detection and response, ranging from identity over endpoint to the network, including cloud. Your curiosity drives you to constantly learn and grow from responding to a variety of attacks. Your diligence and attention to detail enable you to spot attacks accurately and deliver topmost quality.

Next to direct operations work, you contribute to projects interfacing with other internal teams as well as customers to constantly move our service forward.

Must haves:

To be successful in this role you will bring the following:

  • Detect and respond to threats in our Cyber Defense Center (SOC) by performing end-to-end investigations
  • Assist with the development and implementation of internal processes
  • Collaborate with different CDC teams to drive continuous improvement and automation
  • Remain curious and keep growing your skills and capabilities
  • Willingness to work in a Follow the Sun support model and on-call (including off-hours and bank/public holidays) as part of a Global Cyber Defense Center team

Your Qualifications:

  • University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience with security tools like EDR and SIEM
  • Reliable character, self-starter, hungry to do more, good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Knowledge of a Microsoft Security Stacks would be an asset
  • Relevant security certifications is a plus
  • Strong interest in information security. Solid understanding across the full security spectrum. In-depth knowledge in at least one of the following areas: Identity, Endpoint, Network or Cloud
  • Relevant industry certifications - Microsoft SC-200, BTL1, BTL2, CCDL1, CCDL2, GIAC etc.

What we offer:

We have been recognized as an outstanding place to work! On top of a competitive salary, we also offer an enhanced benefit package, flexible ‘me days’, annual subscription to headspace and volunteer days.

Come as you are! We search for amazing people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. Ontinue welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Next Steps:

If you have the skills and experience required and feel that Ontinue is a place you can belong, we would love to get to know you better!

Learn more: .

jobs.excerpt: Votre rôle L’Equipe : Rattaché(e) à la Direction Conseil & Audit de la région parisienne, vous pilotez un programme d'audits de cybersécurité pour nos clients multi-pays Vous garantissez la qualité, la cohérence et la maîtrise du programme, en lien avec les équipes du client, les auditeurs et les équipes internes Vos missions : Vous accompagnez le client sur l'ensemble du cycle du programme d'audit, de la planification à la remédiation, en garantissant la qualité, la cohérence et l'amélioration continue de la démarche Et vous avez la charge de réaliser les opérations suivantes : Cadrage et Gouvernance du programme : • Définir le périmètre, les objectifs, la feuille de route et les modalités de fonctionnement du programme avec le client.
jobs.description:
Votre rôle

L’Equipe :

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Conseil & Audit de la région parisienne, vous pilotez un programme d'audits de cybersécurité pour nos clients multi-pays

Vous garantissez la qualité, la cohérence et la maîtrise du programme, en lien avec les équipes du client, les auditeurs et les équipes internes

Vos missions :

Vous accompagnez le client sur l'ensemble du cycle du programme d'audit, de la planification à la remédiation, en garantissant la qualité, la cohérence et l'amélioration continue de la démarche

Et vous avez la charge de réaliser les opérations suivantes :

Cadrage et Gouvernance du programme :

  • Définir le périmètre, les objectifs, la feuille de route et les modalités de fonctionnement du programme avec le client.
  • Mettre en place et animer la gouvernance : comités de pilotage, points opérationnels, points de suivi avec les référents locaux.
  • Piloter le budget, les charges, la rentabilité et la facturation du programme.
  • Identifier, suivre et traiter les risques, les points de blocage et les dépendances.
  • Assurer la communication auprès des parties prenantes (direction, RSSI, opérationnelles, équipes locales).

Préparation des audits :

  • Élaborer le calendrier annuel des audits avec le client (pays, sites, types d'audit, besoins prévisionnels en staffing).
  • Staffer les audits et assurer l'onboarding des nouveaux auditeurs (contexte client, méthodologie d'audit, kit de livrables types, etc.).
  • Organiser les agendas, transports et hébergements et la logistique pour la réalisation des audits.

Suivi des audits :

  • Suivre l'avancement et assurer le reporting auprès du client.
  • Gérer en relais les éventuelles escalades en cours d'audit.
  • Contrôler la qualité d'exécution des audits selon la méthodologie convenue.
  • Consolider les résultats et les plans de remédiation.
  • Animer la coordination entre auditeurs pour assurer l'homogénéité des constats et des niveaux de criticité.

Pilotage de la remédiation

  • Suivre et coordonner l'avancement de la remédiation.
  • Apporter un support aux équipes concernées (priorisation, arbitrages, aide à la définition des plans d'action).
  • Assurer le reporting d'avancement de la remédiation auprès du client.
  • Préparer les synthèses et les tableaux de bord à destination de la direction

Capitalisation et amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la méthodologie et les livrables selon les audits réalisés et les retours obtenus.
  • Automatiser la réalisation des audits, leur suivi et la remédiation.
  • Définir et faire évoluer les KPI de suivi du programme d'audit.
  • Réaliser des retours d'expérience réguliers et proposer des évolutions du programme (périmètre, fréquence, maturité).
  • Contribuer à la production de livrables de référence et au développement de l'offre Audit & Conseil.

Votre rôle vous amène également à participer au développement de nos savoir-faire et de notre portefeuille d'offres, ainsi qu'au cycle de vente

Votre profil

Compétences et atouts clés pour le poste

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac +5, d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université en informatique

Vous détenez une solide expérience de 5 à 10 ans dans le domaine de la cybersécurité ou des systèmes IT, avec une bonne connaissance des enjeux de cybersécurité, de résilience et de conformité (ISO 27001, référentiels clients, etc.).

Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en pilotage de programme ou de projets complexes, idéalement dans un contexte multi-pays, incluant :

  • la gouvernance (comités de pilotage, reporting, gestion des parties prenantes)
  • le suivi budgétaire, la gestion des charges et le staffing d'équipes ;
  • la gestion des risques, des escalades et des plans de remédiation

Une expérience en audit de sécurité (réalisation, coordination ou contrôle qualité) est un atout fort

Vous disposez de solides capacités d'organisation, de coordination et de communication, et êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs variés (direction, RSSI, équipes locales, auditeurs).

Un d’Anglais opérationnel (écrit / oral) est requis, notamment pour piloter les missions de clients internationaux et communiquer avec nos équipes à l’international

Entité

Orange Cyberdefense est l’entité stratégique du Groupe Orange dédiée à la sécurité numérique. Nous accompagnons les entreprises de toutes tailles, organismes critiques, administrations et collectivités locales dans la conception de leurs stratégies de cybersécurité, leur mise en œuvre et leur gestion opérationnelle.

Nous leur apportons notre expertise afin d’assurer le meilleur niveau de protection de leurs données, de leurs équipements et des services qu’ils offrent à leurs clients ou leurs administrés.

Avec un CA de 1,3 Md€ en 2025, 7% de croissance et plus de 3.300 experts dédiés à la cybersécurité, nous nous positionnons aujourd'hui comme le Leader européen sur le marché de la cyberdéfense.

Notre vocation est de construire une société numérique plus sûre.

jobs.title: AWS Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: Description About AllCloud AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI.
jobs.description:
Description

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America.

www.allcloud.io

Job Summary

AllCloud is looking for an Account Manager. As an Account Manager at AllCloud, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth in AWS Platform services by prescribing and positioning the right solutions for customers alongside your AWS Platform counterparts. In this role, you will personally demonstrate prescriptive solution-selling expertise, including developing account strategies, interacting with and leading cross-functional resource teams, and providing leadership and hands-on participation in strategic engagements. This role requires sales experience with high-level decision-makers but with a strong focus on high-velocity prospecting and developing new opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have B2B sales experience engaging with multiple personas from end-buyers to C-suite executives. They will understand how to identify, develop, negotiate, and close small, medium, and large complex AllCloud AWS services deals. Candidates should be self-starters with a proven track record of exceeding monthly and quarterly input and output goals.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • The Account Manager position is a quota-carrying position
  • Own the entire sales cycle, from identifying expansion opportunities to building relationships with key stakeholders to negotiation and contracting
  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of AllCloud AWS solution and connect that knowledge directly to customer ROI
  • Proactively develop and identify opportunity signals and generate expansion opportunities (up-sell, add-on, cross-sell, etc.)
  • Act as an escalation point of contact for relationship and commercial issues
  • Develop strategies and coordinate cross-functional support to help customers maximize the value from AllCloud and AWS
  • Selling Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) elements through Managed Services and other AWS platform services
  • Responsible for maintaining customer relationships, preparing sales proposals, and ongoing sales activities

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of sales experience in High-tech AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud/Infrastructure / Software to market.
  • Fluency in German is essential
  • Technical background: Cloud, Internet, IT, Virtualization, hardware, network
  • Proven success with technology-orientated customers
  • Sales abilities - proven demonstrated track record to meet sales goals, negotiation skills
  • Leverage a proven sales methodology and approach to produce quarter-over-quarter target attainment
  • Personal Abilities – Customer-facing, Communication, customer-oriented, work independently, trustworthy, reliable, focused, and a team player

Advantages

  • Able to connect relationally with both technical and business executives
  • Able to perform efficiently and effectively without oversight in a fast-paced environment
  • Able to analyze problems and provide solutions
  • Experience growing accounts across a spectrum of industries with projects of all sizes
  • Experience negotiating large contracts, working through conflicts, and facilitating joint legal conversations
  • Transformation experience, including a track record of selling targeted engagements that will underpin AWS and AllCloud strategy

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development. We offer competitive salaries, bonus incentives, benefits, flexible hours, and mentoring. Apply now to become part of the team.

AllCloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

jobs.description:
Diingu – Digital Inclusion Guide

Als E-Learning-Plattform bieten wir sozialen Trägern in den Bereichen Schulbegleitung, sozialpädagogische Familienhilfe, Kita-Begleitung und Offener Ganztag wissenschaftlich fundierte Fortbildungen (E-Learnings), die von Hilfs- und Fachkräften zeit- und ortsunabhängig genutzt werden können. Mehr als 90 soziale Träger und ihre Mitarbeitenden vertrauen bereits auf unsere umfangreichen Kurse und unterstützen damit unsere Mission, gemeinsam Inklusion gelingen zu lassen.

Aufgaben

Unterstütze uns bei der Ausweitung unseres Fortbildungsangebots auf den Bereich Pflegekinderhilfe / Vollzeitpflege (§ 33 SGB VIII)

Wir haben einen festen Fahrplan und suchen nun wissenschaftliche Autor*innen, die uns mit ihrem Fachwissen bei der inhaltlichen Ausweitung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Angebote im Bereich der Pflegekinderhilfe bzw. „Vollzeitpflege in einer anderen Familie“ (nach § 33 SGB VIII) unterstützen. Gemeinsam möchten wir Mitarbeitende in diesem Arbeitsfeld dabei unterstützen, ihre anspruchsvolle und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit fachlich fundiert und praxisnah auszuüben.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen insbesondere:

  • Curriculums- und Themenentwicklung:
    Du wirkst an der gemeinsamen Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung eines Curriculums bzw. einer Themenstruktur für den Bereich Pflegekinderhilfe / Vollzeitpflege mit.

  • Fundierte Literaturrecherche:
    Du recherchierst umfassend aktuelle Fachliteratur sowie evidenzbasierte Methoden und Best Practices.

  • Erstellung praxisnaher Fortbildungsinhalte:
    Du entwickelst fachspezifische Lerninhalte für Fachkräfte der Pflegekinderhilfe auf Grundlage bestehender Konzepte oder gemeinsam erarbeiteter Strukturen.

  • Lektorat/Korrektorat:
    Du überarbeitest bestehende Texte sprachlich und fachlich.

  • Qualitätssicherung:
    Du sorgst für eine präzise und verständliche Aufbereitung der Inhalte und stellst sicher, dass die Texte sprachlich einwandfrei und fachlich korrekt sind.

  • Weiterentwicklung der Lerninhalte:
    Du trägst aktiv zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Fortbildungskurse bei, indem du branchenspezifische Trends und Best Practices identifizierst und in die Kurse integrierst.

Qualifikation

Das erwarten wir:

Wir suchen engagierte Personen, die ihre fachliche Expertise und Praxiserfahrung einbringen möchten, um Fortbildungsinhalte auf hohem fachlichem Niveau zu gestalten.

  • Fachliche Qualifikation:
    Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium Sozialer Arbeit, Sozial- oder Heilpädagogik, Kindheits- oder Sonderpädagogik, Erziehungswissenschaften, Psychologie oder einem verwandten Bereich. Eine zusätzliche Qualifikation oder vertiefte Erfahrung in den Bereichen Trauma, Bindung, psychische Belastungen im Kindesalter oder verwandten Feldern ist von Vorteil.

  • Praxiserfahrung:
    Praktische Erfahrung in der Pflegekinderhilfe (Vollzeitpflege nach § 33 SGB VIII) oder in angrenzenden Arbeitsfeldern der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.

  • Sprachkompetenz:
    Du hast eine exzellente schriftliche und mündliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit und ein gutes Gespür für eine zielgruppengerechte sowie benutzerfreundliche sprachliche Aufbereitung von Texten.

  • Qualitätsbewusstsein:
    Du arbeitest präzise und detailorientiert und stellst sicher, dass alle Inhalte höchsten fachlichen und sprachlichen Standards entsprechen.

  • Gewissenhaftigkeit:
    Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, akkurat und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten sowie Absprachen und Fristen einzuhalten.

  • Team- und Organisationsfähigkeit:
    Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produktentwicklungsteam und weiteren Team-Mitgliedern zusammen.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit mit Social Impact:
    Trage aktiv dazu bei, die fachliche Qualität in der Unterstützung von Pflegefamilien nachhaltig zu stärken.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten (remote):
    Du entscheidest, wo und wann du arbeitest.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell:
    Deine Arbeit wird fair und transparent vergütet.

  • Gründliche Einarbeitung:
    Wir nehmen uns Zeit für dich: Du erhältst eine umfassende Einführung in deine Aufgaben, die technischen Rahmenbedingungen sowie unsere Tools und Abläufe.

Lust, uns auf unserer Mission zu begleiten?

Für ein erstes Kennenlernen schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf, einem aussagekräftigen Anschreiben sowie einer Leseprobe (z. B. Abschlussarbeit oder Ähnliches).

jobs.excerpt: Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading supplier of premium glass and aluminum structures for residential and commercial projects across the USA.
jobs.description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading supplier of premium glass and aluminum structures for residential and commercial projects across the USA. Our clients include SpaceX, Nike, Starbucks, Bank of America, Yves Saint Laurent, and many others.

We are looking for a high-energy Sales Executive to crush it in the US B2C market!

If you have native-level English and love a fast pace, this is for you. We provide a massive flow of hot inbound leads and incoming calls - your job is to handle phone negotiations and close deals fast.

We offer uncapped commission, rapid graded growth, and a high-performing team culture.

Employment Type:

- Full-time 8:30 am – 5:00 pm, NY (EST).

- Remote work.

- B2B contract (sole proprietorship status or corporate entity).

Highlights:

Unlimited Earnings: No cap on your income; earn as much as you sell!

Training: Comprehensive product training for 7–10 working days.

Ramp-Up Bonus System: New hires start with a transparent deal-based bonus structure, where targets are based on closed deals rather than revenue.

Flexible Growth Path: After around 6 months, successful Sales Representatives may choose to move to an uncapped commission model or continue with the Ramp-Up Bonus System.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Close Hot Inbound Traffic: The company provides you with inbound leads dropped into your pipeline daily. No cold calling - just pure closing.
  • Crush the Phone: Expect a high volume of calls and communication with US clients: pitching, handling objections, and closing deals, backed up by quick text/email follow-ups.
  • Own the Price Negotiation: Run commercial terms and pricing within company rules, crush price objections, and push to increase the client's budget.
  • Learn the Product Inside Out: Master the technical side of our custom glass products so you can confidently answer any client question and eliminate doubts.
  • Keep HubSpot Clean & Organized: Run a spotless pipeline and treat the CRM as your single source of truth. Log every call with detailed notes, update deal stages in real time, set clear next steps and follow-up tasks, and zero out your daily tasks. CRM data is regularly reviewed, so accuracy and discipline are part of the job.
  • Close Deals and Secure Deposits: Drive high-energy communication with US buyers to lock a prepayment, close the deal, and hand the project off to the Project Management team.

Requirements

  • English: C1+ / near-native spoken English for daily calls with U.S. clients.
  • Sales Experience: 2 - 3+ years of sales experience, preferably in closing roles. Nice to have: experience in consultative sales.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely is strongly preferred.
  • U.S. Market Experience: Experience working with U.S.-based clients is a strong advantage.
  • Negotiation: Strong negotiation skills with the ability to build trust and explain product value clearly. Ability to handle client objections professionally and confidently.
  • CRM Discipline: Experience working with CRM systems; HubSpot experience is a plus.
  • Product Learning: Ability and willingness to learn a technical/custom product in detail.

Benefits

Conditions

  • Required performance metrics: during the ramp-up period, meet a clear deal-based closure plan.
  • A solid hourly base rate + structured deal-based bonuses for each closed deal during the initial period, with the opportunity to move to an uncapped commission model after approximately 6 months.
  • Structured promotion and growth system with regular review opportunities to level up your base rate, bonus structure, and earning potential.
  • Compensation in US dollars.
  • Comprehensive internal product bootcamps, sharp sales training sessions, and interactive role-play simulations to help you master our custom solutions and close faster.
  • Paid days off, paid sick leave.

Why Join Us?

  • Sell directly to homeowners and apartment owners across the U.S. in a high-demand, fast-paced B2C sector.
  • Join an industry leader and top player in the U.S. custom glass market.
  • Grow your income through a clear performance-based compensation structure, with opportunities to increase your base rate and bonus potential as you progress.
  • Work in a structured, growth-oriented remote environment alongside a global team.
  • Represent a premium brand with a strong inbound lead flow and an excellent reputation.

Ready to close? Join an industry leader in the U.S. custom glass market. Apply today, jump on our massive inbound lead flow, and take your sales career and commissions to the next level!

jobs.description:
Department: Customer Success

Reporting To: Senior Manager, Partner & Technical Support

Location: Remote, Canada

Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9AM-5PM (ideally PST)

Vacancy Type: This is an existing role we’re backfilling

Since 2010, Unbounce has empowered digital marketers to create high-converting campaigns that drive real results. It's an intuitive and powerful landing page builder with AI-powered conversion optimization features that help growing brands and agencies make smarter, data-driven decisions.

In 2024, Insightly joined the Unbounce family. Insightly provides a customizable and affordable CRM, along with marketing automation, and customer service tracking, and an integrations tool in a unified, go-to-market platform. Together, these applications have helped customers generate billions of leads, sales, and signups.

We're a results-focused, customer-obsessed team where technical expertise meets creative thinking. Here, innovative ideas are encouraged, growth is supported, and everyone has the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Please note our Talent Acquisition team will not reach out to you through channels like WhatsApp, Messenger or SMS services. All communication will be through official Unbounce email domains. Please double check the correct spelling in domains of any email communication you receive representing Unbounce.

About the Role

Our purpose in Customer Success is to help our customers grow smarter and make their experience effortless.

We're looking for committed team players who prioritize seamless customer experiences. This involves support across various channels and methods, always tailored to customer needs and company goals. Whether driving revenue or enhancing satisfaction, our focus is on customer and business success. As adaptable team members, we ensure smooth experiences at every touchpoint. As a Service Support Specialist, you'll lead in delivering exceptional support. From personalized assistance to product insights, you'll ensure customer satisfaction and team success.

Please note: The standard work schedule for this role is typically Monday to Friday; however, there may be occasional requirements to work on *weekends, holidays, or at different times from your usual shift. This flexibility is necessary to prioritize our department's primary objective of providing support to our customers as promised across various channels.

*As a remote company, we acknowledge that employees may work from locations with differing regulations and holidays that may affect their availability. We're dedicated to accommodating these differences, fostering a flexible work environment that respects individual circumstances and local laws.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer Support Excellence

  • Provide support across various channels, ensuring timely solutions and positive interactions that leave customers satisfied.
  • Empathize with customers, understanding their perspective to provide empathetic and effective support, while simplifying complex technical issues for enhanced problem-solving, and demonstrating persistence and resourcefulness in tackling new challenges to meet unique customer needs and find innovative solutions.
  • Ensure clarity and effectiveness in interactions through proficient written communication, fostering positive experiences and enhancing the customer experience.

Continuous Improvement and Teamwork

  • Contribute to team resources and documentation, ensuring accuracy and accessibility of information, and fostering a supportive team culture and growth-oriented environment through knowledge sharing, peer coaching, and shadowing.

Performance and Accountability

  • Drive positive outcomes by meeting and exceeding individual performance metrics, taking initiative, and owning your performance results and outcomes, while remaining flexible and adaptable in dynamic environments.

Doppio Group is an IT services and consulting firm helping manufacturing and distribution companies drive business transformation and improvement through the Infor product and services suite, with a focus on Infor M3 and SyteLine.

In this newly created role, the Customer Value Engineer will have a significant impact on how Doppio approaches, designs, and delivers customer engagements, connecting technology investments to measurable business outcomes.

This opportunity requires someone who is one part visionary and two parts practical: able to understand how technology can fundamentally improve business operations while ensuring solutions are appropriately scoped, affordable, achievable, and aligned with customer needs.

The role combines business and technical pre-sales, complex solution architecture and delivery, and the development of Doppio's Customer Value capabilities. Working across Sales, Delivery, Customer Success, and Doppio's technology partner ecosystem, the Customer Value Engineer will help define and design customer solutions.

As the software landscape evolves rapidly, the Customer Value Engineer will help Doppio and its clients identify and capitalize on opportunities created by AI, cloud technologies, and automation. This includes advancing Doppio's value engineering methods, frameworks, team capabilities, and solution offerings while aligning with Infor's evolving product and service strategy.

Doppio is a remote-first organization seeking someone based in the U.S. or Canada, ideally in ET or CT. Travel up to 35% is required for customer engagements, strategic workshops, and industry events.

Value Engineering & Capability Development

Equip them to identify broader customer needs, ask strategic questions, understand Doppio’s solution portfolio, and know when to engage the Customer Value Engineer.
  • Build reusable Customer Value Engineering intellectual property, including discovery frameworks, assessment tools, value models, business cases, solution playbooks, and training materials for consistent discovery, selling, and delivery.

Customer Growth & Expansion
  • Partner with Delivery Managers and consultants to identify broader opportunities within Doppio’s existing customer relationships, moving conversations beyond current projects, tickets, and historical activity toward future business priorities.
  • Help customer-facing teams identify optimization and adoption gaps, measure realized value against customer-agreed baselines, and develop multi-year customer roadmaps that support account expansion based on demonstrated customer value.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong manufacturing and distribution ERP expertise, including business processes, operating models, and areas such as product costing, production planning, inventory, supply chain, shop-floor operations, or process manufacturing.

Doppio Group is a privately held, profitable North American Infor Alliance and Delivery Partner with more than a decade of experience helping manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain organizations optimize their ERP environments. Serving industries including industrial manufacturing, food & beverage, chemicals, and packaging, Doppio provides ERP implementations, application managed services (AMS), process optimization, integrations, reporting, and ongoing support.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware

Role Type: Contract

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

Required Skills

  • Design for manufacturing

  • Vacuum systems

  • Semiconductor equipment

  • Solidworks

  • Cnc part design

What you'll do

  • Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.

  • Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.

  • Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.

  • Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.

  • Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.

  • Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in semiconductor or vacuum hardware.

  • Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.

  • Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.

  • Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.

  • Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.

  • Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

jobs.description:
Über CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group ist eine börsennotierte deutsche Holding, die vertikale Softwareunternehmen erwirbt und hält. Die Rolle

Du bist Teil des AI Core Teams im Office des CTO und arbeitest als Forward Deployed Engineer nah an den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Du betreibst unseren AI Hub, eine Open WebUI-basierte KI-Plattform, für mehr als 10 Unternehmen. Du bringst mit, was du im Feld siehst, testest neue Fähigkeiten und gestaltest die Plattform für alle 60+ Unternehmen mit.

Deutsch (C1+) und Englisch sind Pflicht.

Was du machst

  • Den AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen betreiben: Deployments, Updates, Konfiguration, SSO mit Entra ID, Monitoring, Backups und Incident Handling

  • Unternehmen und Teams onboarden: Skills, Knowledge Bases und Tools einrichten, damit jedes Unternehmen produktiv mit dem Hub arbeitet

  • Den Hub anbinden, wo ein Use Case es braucht: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, Ticketing und ERP-Systeme über Tools, MCP-Server und REST-APIs

  • Wiederkehrende Fragen in wiederverwendbare Bausteine verwandeln: Dokumentation, Vorlagen und kurze Hands-on-Sessions

  • Im AI Core Team arbeiten: Muster über Unternehmen hinweg teilen, neue Features testen und Erkenntnisse in die Plattform-Roadmap einspeisen

Das bringst du mit

Pflicht

  • Deutsch (C1 oder höher) und fließend Englisch. Du arbeitest täglich auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführern und nicht-technischen Teams. Hier machen wir keine Ausnahmen.

  • Erfahrung im Produktivbetrieb. Du hast containerisierte Anwendungen produktiv deployt und betrieben (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, eine große Cloud, Azure bevorzugt) und warst verantwortlich, wenn sie ausgefallen sind. Das heißt meist mindestens 2 Jahre in einer DevOps-, Platform-, SRE- oder Backend-Rolle.

  • Python, das du sicher lesen, debuggen und erweitern kannst

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Du nutzt sie im eigenen Arbeitsalltag ernsthaft, hast beruflich oder privat etwas damit gebaut und weißt, wo sie scheitern.

  • Du erklärst Technik so, dass Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen und danach handeln können. Du bist gern die technische Ansprechperson für Teams ohne technischen Hintergrund.

Starke Signale

  • Enterprise Identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO

  • Selbst gehostete LLM-Plattformen wie Open WebUI oder LibreChat

  • MCP, Tool Calling, Agent-Frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform)

  • Erfahrung in einer Support-, Solutions- oder kundennahen technischen Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Unternehmen, Tenants oder eine Gruppenstruktur hinweg

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du

Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein Kodierwissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR in- und auswendig, hast Fälle aus vielen Fachabteilungen kodiert, und Kolleg:innen kommen zu Dir, wenn ein Fall knifflig wird? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bist die Ansprechperson für die Kodierteams der Kliniken, die mit Valova arbeiten.

Kodierteams vertrauen nur Software, die stimmt. Wenn eine Kodierfachkraft fragt, warum Valova einen bestimmten Kode vorschlägt, braucht sie eine Antwort von jemandem, der DRG-Kodierung aus dem Alltag kennt, nicht aus dem Handbuch. Das bist Du. Und jede Frage, die Du beantwortest, macht Valova besser, weil Du das Gelernte direkt an unser Produktteam weitergibst.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in Kodierteams, die mit Valova schneller arbeiten, und in Stunden, die sie jede Woche zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgabe

  • Du bist erste fachliche Ansprechperson für Kodierfachkräfte und Medizincontrolling in unseren Kundenkliniken. Du beantwortest Kodierfragen, erklärst die Vorschläge von Valova und hilfst bei kniffligen Fällen.

  • Du begleitest neue Kliniken beim Start mit Valova, schulst Teams remote und vor Ort und baust Anleitungen und FAQs für Kodierteams auf.

  • Regeln und Testfälle aufbauen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS und DKR in klare Kodierregeln und Testfälle für unser Produktteam.

  • Auf dem Laufenden halten: Du arbeitest Katalogänderungen zum Jahreswechsel und neue Rechtsprechung ein.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der DRG-Kodierung, z. B. als Kodierfachkraft oder im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses, als freiberufliche Kodierer:in oder bei einem Kodierdienstleister, beim Medizinischen Dienst oder ärztlich

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien (DKR)

  • Geduld und Freude daran, anderen weiterzuhelfen und Dinge verständlich zu erklären, und fließendes Deutsch

Schön, aber kein Muss:

  • Kodiererfahrung in mehreren Fachabteilungen

  • Erfahrung mit MD-Prüfungen und der PrüfvV

  • Kenntnisse in Hybrid-DRG, ambulantem Operieren (AOP) oder PEPP

  • Erfahrung mit Kodiersoftware (z. B. ID DIACOS, Solventum, Orbis, iMedOne), Software-Einführungen oder Anwendersupport

  • Englisch-Lesekenntnisse

  • Interesse an Daten oder KI

Du erfüllst nicht alles? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Dein Praxiswissen in der Kodierung zählt für uns mehr als jedes Zertifikat.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin.

  • Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch.

  • Sinn mit Hebel. Statt Rückstände in einer Klinik abzuarbeiten, entlastest Du Kodierteams in vielen Kliniken gleichzeitig.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Reisen ohne Kosten für Dich. Reisekosten übernehmen wir.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

Nach Deiner Bewerbung lernen wir uns in einem ersten Gespräch kennen. Anschließend tauschen wir uns vertiefend über Deine Erfahrung und Deinen Vertriebsansatz aus.

Zum Abschluss lernst Du unser Team persönlich in Berlin oder München kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, freuen wir uns auf die Zusammenarbeit!

Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
