jobs.title: Paid Search Specialist (12 Months Contract)
jobs.excerpt: 1.  Campaign build, management and account health • Build and upload campaigns and assets across Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and App campaigns using the platform UI and Google Ads Editor.
jobs.description:
1. Campaign build, management and account health

  • Build and upload campaigns and assets across Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and App campaigns using the platform UI and Google Ads Editor.
  • Manage assigned campaigns and markets day to day, including settings, targeting, bids, budgets, optimisation goals, ad copy and asset updates.
  • Execute fast, accurate bulk builds, bulk edits and structural changes in Google Ads Editor.
  • Maintain account hygiene through naming conventions, labels, URL checks, disapproval checks, pre-launch QA, change logs and regular health reviews.
  • Identify and implement optimisation opportunities without prompting, including bid-strategy changes, bid adjustments, channel or placement exclusions and wider account-health actions.
  • Use Google Asset Studio where appropriate to create practical asset variations; ownership of full creative production remains with the creative team.

2. Search-term and keyword analysis

  • Implement scripts and AI tools integrations to review search-term data regularly to identify irrelevant traffic, emerging demand, new keyword opportunities and changes in user intent.
  • Implement scripts and AI tools integration to build and maintain negative keyword coverage at the appropriate account, campaign and ad-group level.
  • Implement scripts and AI tools integratio to expand and refine keyword portfolios using query evidence, performance and market-specific search behaviour.
  • Assess match-type performance, query quality, duplication and routing to improve relevance and control.
  • Translate findings into clear actions across keywords, ad groups, copy, landing pages, bids and campaign structure.

3. Budget pacing and forecasting

  • Monitor spend against approved market and campaign plans, maintaining an accurate pacing view.
  • Flag over- or underspend risk early, explain the cause and recommend corrective action.
  • Reallocate budget within agreed guardrails based on performance, delivery opportunity and business priority.
  • Provide short-term spend forecasts and month-end outlooks, clearly stating assumptions and delivery risks.
  • Escalate material budget, tracking or inventory constraints before they affect delivery.

PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT

4. Creative and asset performance

  • Analyse ad and asset performance by campaign, market, audience, format and funnel stage where data is available.
  • Identify winning and underperforming hooks, messages, propositions, calls to action, formats and variations.
  • Convert performance findings into clear test hypotheses and prioritised recommendations.
  • Brief the creative team on new concepts, copy directions and asset variations, including the objective, audience, insight, message, format, required versions and success metric.
  • Track new assets from briefing through launch and post-test analysis, documenting learning for future iterations.
  • Maintain sufficient asset variety and refresh cadence to support Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and App activity.

5. Landing-page performance

  • Monitor post-click performance and conversion rates using available analytics, segmented by campaign, keyword or query, audience, device, market and landing page where useful.
  • Identify likely friction points, message mismatch, weak intent alignment, broken journeys or page-performance issues that may suppress conversion.
  • Check destination URLs and campaign-to-page alignment as part of launch and ongoing QA.
  • Brief CRO, web or product teams on evidence-based landing-page test opportunities; this role supports analysis and briefing rather than owning the full CRO roadmap or page development.
  • Evaluate landing-page test results alongside media metrics to determine whether changes improve both conversion efficiency and traffic quality.

6. Competitor monitoring

  • Monitor observable competitor search presence, messaging, offers, claims and landing-page approaches in priority markets.
  • Track material changes that may affect impression share, click costs, brand defence, generic performance or user expectations.
  • Summarise findings without presenting estimated competitor activity as confirmed fact.
  • Turn competitor observations into practical recommendations for keyword coverage, copy, offers, landing pages, bidding or structured tests.

7. Structured testing

  • Maintain a prioritised test backlog across ads and assets, keywords and match types, bidding, campaign settings, audiences and landing pages.
  • Define a clear hypothesis, control and variant, primary success metric, guardrails and expected decision before launch.
  • Configure Google Ads experiments or other agreed test designs, validate setup and protect data quality during the test.
  • Interpret results with appropriate caution, distinguish directional findings from conclusive results and document limitations.
  • Record outcomes, decisions and next actions so learnings can be reused across markets.
  • Support incrementality and lift tests through configuration, QA and data collection under the direction of the PPC lead or measurement team.

DELIVERY, MEASUREMENT AND GOVERNANCE

8. Tracking and measurement

  • Maintain working knowledge of conversion tracking across front-end and server-side events.
  • Validate Google Ads tags and diagnose broken, missing, duplicated or misfiring conversions; no full GTM setup ownership is required.
  • Support implementation, validation and troubleshooting of Enhanced Conversions and Enhanced Conversions for Leads.
  • Work with analytics or MarTech partners to resolve tracking issues and confirm that optimisation signals remain fit for purpose.
  • Understand the relationship between platform conversions, downstream quality and value metrics, and flag material discrepancies.

9. Reporting and analysis

  • Run weekly analysis for assigned markets and identify the main performance drivers, blockers and risks independently.
  • Produce clear, concise reporting covering performance versus target, budget pacing, material changes, areas of focus and planned optimisations.
  • Move beyond descriptive commentary by translating analysis into prioritised recommendations, owners and next actions.
  • Use spreadsheets confidently for pivots, lookups, reconciliations and large platform exports.
  • Maintain clear documentation for tests, budget changes, structural changes and material optimisation decisions.

10. Multi-market delivery and agency QA

  • Optimise multi-language accounts with appropriate consideration of local copy, keywords, search behaviour and market nuance.
  • Coordinate translations and local validation where needed; do not rely on unreviewed machine translation for market-facing copy.
  • Turn around agreed ad hoc market requests to deadline while protecting planned priorities.
  • QA agency output in assigned markets against agreed build, tracking, compliance and reporting standards.
  • Escalate conflicts in market priority, resource or deadline risk promptly.

11. Compliance and governance

  • Monitor and resolve ad and asset disapprovals, escalating policy or legal questions through the correct internal route.
  • Maintain advertiser verification and certification status where required.
  • Follow approved claims, disclaimers, landing-page and market restrictions, and maintain an auditable record of material changes.
  • Apply disciplined pre-launch and post-launch QA, including naming, targeting, budgets, bidding, URLs, assets, conversion goals and policy status.

12. Ways of working

  • Communicate proactively with the line manager on progress, blockers, decisions and deadline risk.
  • Organise concurrent market priorities effectively and deliver to agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with creative, CRO/web, analytics, MarTech, compliance and agency partners while retaining clear ownership of PPC execution.
  • Stay current with relevant Google Ads product changes and apply new capabilities only where they support agreed objectives and controls.
  • 3+ years of hands-on paid search experience, ideally in a high-competition or complex vertical.
  • Proven delivery across Google Ads Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen, with practical exposure to asset-led campaign management.
  • Advanced working ability in Google Ads Editor, including bulk builds, bulk edits and structural changes.
  • Strong search-term and keyword-management capability, including negative keywords, match types, query-quality analysis and keyword expansion.
  • Ability to manage campaigns and identify and implement account optimisations independently.
  • Practical budget pacing and short-term forecasting skills, including early identification of over- or underspend risk.
  • Strong performance-analysis skills and the ability to produce actionable weekly reporting.
  • Ability to analyse creative and asset performance and brief new concepts or variations to a creative team.
  • Ability to assess landing-page performance and brief evidence-based improvements without requiring full CRO ownership.
  • Working knowledge of conversion tracking, Google Ads tags and GTM troubleshooting; full GTM setup is not required.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including pivots, lookups and handling large data exports.
  • Structured testing mindset: clear hypotheses, success metrics, reliable setup, careful interpretation and documented learning.
  • Clear written communication for senior reporting and partner briefs.
  • Disciplined QA, documentation and change-control habits.
  • Deeper experience across Demand Gen, YouTube and App campaigns.
  • Microsoft Advertising platform and Editor experience.
  • AppsFlyer or an equivalent mobile measurement partner, including event mapping, attribution windows and familiarity with SKAN.
  • Experience advertising financial services under Google's restricted-category requirements, including advertiser verification, certification and claims that may trigger disapprovals.
  • Multi-market and multi-language account-management experience.
  • GA4 and Looker Studio experience.
  • Experience using Google Ads experiments and interpreting inconclusive or directional results appropriately.
  • Awareness of AI-led search developments, including AI Max and account structures that support algorithmic bidding.
  • Experience using auction, market or competitive-insight tools to support observable competitor monitoring.
  • Experience working with downstream value or quality signals, mobile attribution or value-based bidding.
  • Experience with building scripts and utilization of AI tools to automate workflows.

IN SCOPE
Hands-on build and optimisation; search-term and keyword management; budget pacing; reporting; creative and landing-page analysis; briefs to specialist teams; test execution; tracking diagnosis; campaign QA; disapproval management; and multi-market delivery.

NOT THE PRIMARY OWNERChannel strategy, full creative production, the CRO roadmap, website development, full GTM implementation, legal or policy interpretation, advanced measurement design, or final cross-market budget strategy. The specialist contributes evidence and executes agreed actions in these areas.

In the fast-growing economies of the world, there's a new generation of ambitious younger people eager to gain financial independence and we’re here to make this potential a reality by empowering them with the Freedom to Succeed.

We empower them with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.

Founded in 1998 to offer online trading for retail clients, the Exinity Group is now over 25 years old and has provided leveraged trading to over 2 million customers through our global power brands, including FXTM and Nemo, giving them access to equity, commodity and FX markets across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.

Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with central offices in the UAE, Cyprus and the UK, plus a number of smaller hubs globally. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

At Nextcloud we help our users achieve a safe home for all their data. Secure, under your control and developed in an open, transparent and trustworthy way. Our Team of 170 is distributed in 30 countries worldwide. We work remotely and our work culture is shaped by mutual trust, enthusiasm and a strong belief in the principles of open source.

We are looking for a Channel Enablement Manager who will develop and manage enablement programs that strengthen the technical and commercial capabilities of our channel partner ecosystem. You will work closely with Sales Engineers, Channel Sales, Marketing, and external training partners to design and coordinate partner training, certification programs, and technical enablement initiatives. You will play a key role in ensuring our partners have the knowledge, skills, and resources to successfully position, deploy, and support Nextcloud solutions while driving partner engagement and ecosystem growth.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute partner enablement strategies aligned with business goals and ecosystem growth

  • Design, coordinate, and continuously improve partner training and certification programs

  • Manage relationships with external training providers and certification partners

  • Collaborate closely with Sales Engineers to develop technical training content, workshops, webinars, and hands-on enablement sessions

  • Create and maintain partner enablement materials, learning paths, technical documentation, and onboarding resources

  • Support product launches by ensuring channel partners are trained and ready to position new features and solutions

  • Coordinate partner onboarding and technical readiness programs for new and existing partners

  • Track training participation, certification progress, and enablement KPIs, providing recommendations for continuous improvement

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, and Engineering to ensure enablement content remains accurate and up to date

  • Foster strong relationships with channel partners to understand their enablement needs and support their continued success

Qualifikation

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, Business, or a related field

  • 3+ years of experience in partner enablement, technical marketing, channel marketing, technical training, or a related role in the IT or software industry

  • Solid technical understanding of enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, virtualization, or open source technologies

  • Experience working closely with Sales Engineers or technical sales teams

  • Understanding of open source technologies and ecosystems is highly desirable

  • Experience managing training programs, certifications, or Learning Management Systems (LMS) is a plus

  • Excellent project management, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to simplify technical concepts for diverse partner audiences

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a distributed, international team

  • English plus business proficiency in other languages such as French, Spanish, or German is a plus

  • Willingness to travel internationally

Benefits

  • A distributed, open team with a passion for working within the open-source community

  • The opportunity to promote and support a product that pushes the boundaries of technology, with a global user and contributor community

  • A competitive salary

  • Flexibility for a healthy work-life balance

  • Time for personal growth and an annual educational budget

  • Opportunities for growth and learning, even if you don’t meet all the requirements yet but have the ambition to learn and develop

jobs.title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 2+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, Fleet or general operations background a huge plus
  • Previous experience working in a Fleet Sales environment
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.)
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior TAX Specialist
jobs.excerpt: In this role, you will take ownership of indirect tax compliance across multiple European jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and alignment with local VAT regulations and internal standards.
jobs.description:
In this role, you will take ownership of indirect tax compliance across multiple European jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and alignment with local VAT regulations and internal standards. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop expertise in VAT, ESL, and Intrastat while working in a dynamic international environment and contributing to process improvements and regulatory projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation, review and submission of Indirect Tax returns (VAT, ESL, Intrastat) across assigned jurisdictions
  • Take ownership of VAT compliance and reporting processes for multiple European countries, ensuring alignment with local regulations and internal standards
  • Oversee VAT settlement process, including clearing and closing of transactions
  • Perform and review selected indirect tax postings and settlements (including JE and related payments), ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting and statutory requirements
  • Support and contribute to setup and maintenance of VAT logic and tax determination in ERP systems (e.g. SAP), working closely with Finance and IT
  • Participate in and take an active role in VAT-related projects, particularly related to implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g. e-invoicing, SAF-T, digital reporting)
  • Ensure execution of Indirect Tax control framework, including monitoring, documentation and continuous improvement of processes
  • Ensure full VAT compliance for countries under responsibility, including awareness and application of local regulatory changes
  • Identify risks, gaps and process improvement opportunities, and escalate or drive improvements where appropriate
  • Provide VAT guidance and support to internal stakeholders
  • Support internal and external audits, ensuring timely and accurate provision of documentation
  • Ensure proper documentation and retention of records in line with compliance requirements
  • Collaborate within the team and provide guidance and support to less experienced colleagues
  • Provide backup support across VAT Compliance activities
  • Perform other tasks and projects as assigned
  • Solid experience in VAT compliance and reporting, covering multiple European jurisdictions
  • Good and practical knowledge of European VAT regulations, with the ability to interpret and apply local requirements
  • Experience in SAP, including understanding of tax determination logic and data flows supporting VAT reporting
  • Motivation to be involved in VAT-related projects (e.g. e-invoicing, SAF-T, digital reporting, system implementations or enhancements); experience in this area is an advantage
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach
  • Ability to identify risks, inconsistencies and improvement areas within VAT processes and reporting
  • Good understanding of accounting principles relevant for indirect taxes (GL, postings, reconciliations, settlements)
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Finance, IT)
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain VAT topics in a clear and practical way to non-tax stakeholders
  • High level of ownership, accountability and proactiveness in managing assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  • Experience in process improvement and/or automation initiatives is an asset

Reports To Title: TAX Leader

We offer:

  • Remote work model
  • Flexible working hours
  • Private medical care including dental care
  • Life insurance
  • Multisport card
  • Social fund (e.g. vacation allowance, Christmas allowance)
  • Employee referral program

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, APEX
jobs.excerpt: Acumatica is a leading cloud ERP provider helping growing businesses thrive in a digital economy.
jobs.description:
Acumatica is a leading cloud ERP provider helping growing businesses thrive in a digital economy. Our platform brings financials, customer management, project accounting, and operations together in one connected, easy-to-use system, with unlimited users and anytime, anywhere access so every employee can participate.

APEX is an all-in-one software and services package for our General Business, Construction, Manufacturing, and Distribution editions, combining cloud ERP, implementation, and support in a single subscription. It helps companies graduate from entry-level accounting tools to a platform that can run their entire business, not just their books. As businesses grow, Acumatica grows with them, giving owners and teams the real-time insight, connected workflows, and room to scale they need to compete and win.

We're looking for a SeniorProduct Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for APEX. You'll focus on what makes a first ERP succeed: an intuitive experience, out-of-the-box reporting that answers real questions on day one, guided onboarding, and AI assistance that helps new users learn Acumatica and its workflows as they work. Your work will directly shape one of the company's most important growth opportunities over the next one to four years.

What You'll Do

Own the Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own the product vision and a multi-year strategy for first-time ERP customers across Construction, Manufacturing, Distribution, and General Business
  • Maintain an always-current short-, mid-, and long-term roadmap, with internal and external views kept aligned
  • Turn GTM and customer insight into a focused set of bets, and be clear about what the offering will not do
  • Define how the offering expands into new editions while keeping the offering simple, repeatable, and fast to deploy

Make First-Time ERP Adoption Easy

  • Own the experience that takes a customer from sign-up to confident daily use, including onboarding flows, in-product guidance, and user guides
  • Define out-of-the-box reporting and dashboards that give owners, controllers, and project and operations leaders the insight they need from day one
  • Shape AI assistance that helps users learn Acumatica, navigate workflows, and get answers in the moment
  • Partner with Design to simplify the user experience for people new to ERP

Measure What Matters

  • Define success metrics before build, including time to go-live, time to value, user adoption, feature usage, retention, and expansion
  • Ensure the work is instrumented, track results after release, and report honestly on what moved and what didn't
  • Use data to decide where to invest next, and adjust when the evidence changes

Lead Through Partnership

  • Lead your value-stream team (Designer, Business Analyst, and Technical Lead), owning the business and feature requirements (the what and why) and prioritizing what enters development
  • Work closely with Sales, Client Services, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing, the teams that sell, implement, and support the offering, to turn their field insight into product direction
  • Partner with the PMs who own Core Financials, CRM, and our industry editions, so improvements to the offering strengthen the broader platform
  • Build a trusted relationship with engineering, sharing the customer context and the why behind every priority

Work AI-First

  • Use AI every day to cluster feedback and market signal, draft personas and requirements, prototype quickly, and analyze competitors
  • Bring curiosity and judgment to how AI can shorten implementations and accelerate adoption for its customers

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear product vision and roadmap that product, GTM, and services teams rally behind
  • The offering available and succeeding across Construction, Manufacturing, Distribution, and General Business
  • Faster time to go-live and time to value, with fewer services hours per implementation
  • Measurably higher user adoption and retention among first-time ERP customers
  • Out-of-the-box reporting, guided onboarding, and AI assistance that customers actually use

Experience

  • 5+ years in product management for B2B SaaS, ideally in ERP, accounting, or business software for SMBs
  • Experience building products for customers moving from entry-level tools like QuickBooks to a more capable platform
  • A track record of improving onboarding, activation, adoption, or time to value with measurable results
  • Experience with packaged or bundled offerings that combine software and services is a plus

Product & Business Acumen

  • Strong product strategy and roadmap skills, connecting decisions to adoption and business outcomes
  • Working knowledge of accounting and financial operations; familiarity with construction, manufacturing, or distribution workflows is a plus
  • Experience with reporting, dashboards, and in-product guidance or digital adoption tools
  • Comfort with product analytics and defining measurable outcomes

AI Acumen

  • A daily personal practice of using AI tools to do product work faster and better
  • Practical understanding of what AI assistants can and can't do reliably, and how to design them for trust and accuracy

Collaboration & Influence

  • Ability to lead a cross-functional team and build strong relationships with Sales, Services, and Customer Success
  • Clear communicator who can simplify complex topics for customers, executives, and engineers alike
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-growth initiative

Why Join Us

This all-in-one offering is a proven model with real momentum and a clear mandate to scale. You'll own a product that changes the first ERP experience for growing businesses, with direct visibility to leadership and a direct line from your roadmap to company growth.

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective.

You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You’ll turn messy go-to-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You’ll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build LLM-powered agents and workflows for use cases like account research, lead and account prioritization, outbound personalization, call summarization, deal inspection, renewal risk detection, and customer health insights.
  • Focus on end user experience to optimize delivery of content, process adherence and tool utilization
  • Integrate AI systems with the GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Marketo, Slack, Zoom, data warehouse, and enrichment providers).
  • Build and maintain data pipelines that unify product usage, CRM, marketing, and support data into reliable inputs for models and agents.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps leaders to translate business problems into technical solutions, and prioritize by revenue impact and effort.
  • Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption.
  • Use LaunchDarkly’s own products, such as feature flags, AI Configs, and experimentation, to roll out, test, and iterate on GTM AI systems safely.
  • Prototype quickly, then productionize the winners with solid engineering practices (testing, observability, documentation, access controls).
  • Enable GTM teams through training, documentation, and playbooks so AI tools are adopted and trusted.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and recommend build vs. buy decisions.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or ML/AI engineering experience (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL
  • Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs (prompt design, tool use/function calling, RAG, agent frameworks, structured outputs)
  • Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs and SaaS platforms, ideally CRM and sales engagement tools
  • Familiarity with data warehouses and transformation tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar)
  • Ability to evaluate and monitor AI system quality using test sets, human review, and automated evals
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • A bias toward shipping, iterating, and measuring outcomes

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $196,600 - $270,270**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $176,900 - $243,210**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. jobs.description:
Shape the future of compensation and benefits in a global organization.

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful insights, creating fair and competitive compensation structures, and driving global HR initiatives? Would you like to contribute to the development of compensation practices across an international organization while working closely with stakeholders from different countries and cultures?

As part of the organic growth of our Global Compensation & Benefits Center of Excellence at KOSTAL, we are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking professional to join our team.

Your role and impact

As a Global Compensation & Benefits Specialist, you will play an instrumental role in shaping and implementing global compensation and benefits policies, frameworks and tools across our international organization.

Combining your analytical expertise with your stakeholder management and project management skills, you will help build competitive, equitable and sustainable compensation practices that support our business strategy.

This is an exciting opportunity to go beyond operational compensation activities, contribute to global initiatives, influence decision-making and actively shape the future of our C&B function.

What you will do

  • Drive global C&B initiatives: Contribute to the planning, development and execution of international compensation and benefits projects, from concept to implementation.

  • Shape compensation frameworks: Support the development and continuous improvement of global salary structures, job architectures and compensation guidelines.

  • Turn data into actionable insights: Manage compensation databases and tools, conduct comprehensive analyses and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic decision-making.

  • Ensure competitiveness and internal equity: Conduct market benchmarking and compensation analyses to support fair and competitive remuneration practices.

  • Be a trusted subject matter expert: Conduct job evaluations using global methodologies and empower HR professionals and business leaders to apply these frameworks effectively.

  • Drive global-to-local implementation: Coordinate the adoption of global compensation structures, policies and guidelines across local entities.

  • Build strong international partnerships: Collaborate with global, regional and local HR teams, business stakeholders and external partners.

  • Influence decision-making: Translate complex compensation data into clear, meaningful insights and prepare recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Champion continuous improvement: Stay ahead of emerging C&B trends, technologies and industry best practices, identifying opportunities to enhance our processes and tools.

  • Ensure governance and operational excellence: Support compliance with internal policies and applicable legal requirements while ensuring effective project coordination, documentation and administration.

What you bring

Professional experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Economics or a related field.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in Compensation & Benefits, HR Analytics or a related discipline.

  • Practical experience with job evaluation methodologies and market benchmarking.

  • Experience in managing or coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and confidence in working with complex datasets.

  • Affinity for HR information systems and compensation management tools.

  • Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI, and their potential applications in HR.

  • Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Your mindset and strengths

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, enabling effective collaboration across organizational levels and cultures.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Confidence in working independently and taking ownership in a dynamic, evolving international environment.

  • Adaptability, intellectual curiosity and openness to new approaches.

  • A high level of professional integrity, discretion and attention to detail.

Why this opportunity is exciting

  • Global impact: Contribute to compensation practices and initiatives that reach across countries, cultures and business units.

  • Meaningful ownership: Take responsibility for global projects and see your ideas translated into tangible outcomes.

  • Strategic exposure: Work closely with global HR stakeholders and contribute to leadership decision-making.

  • Professional growth: Further develop your expertise in global compensation, job architecture, market intelligence and HR transformation.

  • An evolving Center of Excellence: Join a growing function where your expertise, ideas and initiative can make a genuine difference.

  • International collaboration: Become part of a professional environment that values knowledge sharing, partnership and continuous learning.

If you are looking for a role where analytical expertise meets strategic thinking, international collaboration and meaningful professional impact, we would love to hear from you.

Join us and help shape the future of Compensation & Benefits at KOSTAL.

KOSTAL Group is a globally active, family-owned German company renowned for delivering innovative, market-leading solutions in the solar and automotive industries. Founded in 1912, the company has grown into a worldwide organization with around 20,000 employees across 47 locations in 22 countries.

As part of its continued expansion, KOSTAL established KOSTAL Business Services (KBS) in 2022, marking the launch of its first Business Service Centre in Hungary. This hub provides high-level support across key functions including IT, finance, procurement, master data, sales, and human resources.

Designed as a global centre of excellence, KBS focuses on delivering complex, high value-added services that strengthen and support KOSTAL’s international operations.

jobs.description:
In the time it takes you to read this job description, RapidSOS will have handled ~1,380 emergencies.

Saving lives depends on the right information reaching the right people at the right moment. RapidSOS builds the technology that makes that possible, and people around the world are joining a mission-driven, ambitious and inclusive team to do that work. Four values guide how we work: purpose over pride, trust & safety, pioneering, urgency. Together they support a culture where people innovate, collaborate, grow and, above all, make an impact.

RapidSOS is the leading public safety AI company that unlocks mission-critical intelligence for emergency response. It pairs AI with human expertise to turn data from the world’s largest Safety Network into life-saving intelligence. The network includes more than 730 million connected devices and more than 325 global technology companies. That intelligence reaches more than 23,600 federal, state and local agencies, serving 1.2 million first responders. RapidSOS has supported more than 1.1 billion emergencies in 16 countries. That experience informs RapidSOS Harmony AI, the first purpose-built AI for public safety, designed to save critical time by detecting emergencies, unifying real-time data and video, and coordinating a faster response. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com.

What this role is about:

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between product innovation and customer needs to deliver impactful solutions? At RapidSOS, we’re transforming public safety with AI-driven technology that empowers first responders and 911 telecommunicators to save lives and improve outcomes in emergencies.

As Director of Product Marketing, you will lead the product marketing function and own it hands-on for public safety and the Unite portfolio, working alongside a Senior Product Marketing Manager who owns our enterprise and B2B audience. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of product, sales, and the field to shape how we position, price, package, and launch new capabilities from Harmony AI, and to ensure our solutions resonate with the needs of the public safety community. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our products and users, set the narrative that sellers, partners, and other business units pull from, and foster cross-functional alignment to deliver clear messaging and launches. If you thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, enjoy working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions that save lives, and are excited about translating technical capabilities into real-world impact, this is the opportunity to make a tangible difference where every second matters!

What you’ll do:

  • Own go-to-market strategy for our public safety and enterprise software products, developing positioning and messaging that resonate with public safety and enterprise professionals and emphasize product value and differentiation, and aligning priorities to the revenue plan
  • Craft the platform and Harmony AI narrative and the collateral behind it, including decks, demo narratives, proof points, training materials, and messaging frameworks, so sellers, Customer Success, partners, and other business units tell one clear, consistent story about RapidSOS
  • Drive launches end to end, ensuring story, proof, and enablement are ready on launch day and setting the bar for what counts as a launch versus a release note
  • Shape pricing and packaging that customers understand and sellers can confidently explain, reviewing it against deal data and recommending changes as the market evolves
  • Track the competitive landscape and maintain a current point of view on how RapidSOS differentiates, built from win-loss evidence and feedback from the field, customers, and public safety stakeholders, and translated into positioning guidance every seller can use in a sales conversation
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, and Design to translate product functionality into field-ready language and bring customer insight, competitive intelligence, and win-loss data into roadmap and sequencing conversations, flagging when a commitment is one the market won’t reward and pushing for the proof behind what we say about the platform
  • Architect and evangelize AI-powered workflows, prompt libraries, and content templates, such as competitive intelligence and pricing agents with guardrails and human review, that expand what the broader PMM and GTM team can produce independently and reduce bottlenecks
  • Lead and develop the product marketing function by coaching and growing your Senior PMM, who owns the enterprise and B2B audience, raising the bar for what great product marketing looks like here, and shaping how the team evolves as the business grows

What we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:

  • 8+ years of marketing experience, including 5+ years in product marketing at B2B SaaS, enterprise, or B2G companies, with a track record of positioning a platform or multi-product portfolio for buying committees with multiple personas
  • A proven record of shaping pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy, using deal data and win-loss evidence to make recommendations, with a sharp sense of which numbers matter and which only look good on a slide, and the willingness to change course when the data says to
  • Experience in developing positioning and messaging that resonates with very different audiences, from front-line staff to executives to technical teams, with the range to go deep with Product and Engineering and turn technical capabilities into clear, compelling content
  • A customer-first mindset, proactively gathering qualitative and quantitative feedback from customers and the field, tracking the competitive landscape, and acting as the voice of the customer inside RapidSOS, so insight shapes positioning and product decisions
  • A builder’s mentality with bias for action and AI fluency, with a history of creating the content libraries, launch checklists, messaging systems, RFP templates, and AI workflows, skills, or agents that other people keep relying on long after you’ve moved on, plus the ability to teach others to use them and clear judgment on which calls stay with a person
  • A collaborative approach to building relationships across Product, Sales, Customer Experience, and Marketing, earning trust and creating alignment proactively so the team moves forward in the same direction
  • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who moves quickly through ambiguity and knows when to escalate
  • Prior experience managing and developing people, ideally product marketers, and setting the standard for great product marketing
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for public safety conferences, customer visits, and team offsites

Nice-to-have experience (but not required!):

  • Experience in public safety, GovTech, or B2G markets
  • Experience selling into long, committee-driven buying cycles, such as government procurement or grant-funded purchases
  • Experience standing up a product marketing function or its core processes, such as launch, win-loss, or enablement

What we offer:

  • The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally
  • Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation
  • A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Fullstack Engineer - Grafana Analytics

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business via general data analytics. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on data from across the enterprise. We build systems that help users make sense of their sea of data through AI-driven features in use cases like product analytics and sales data. These capabilities lower the barrier of domain expertise and surface meaningful signals from messy data.

The Grafana Analytics team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong software engineering background, a quick iteration mindset, and a passion for experimentation – balanced by a focus on shipping and scaling impactful features that deliver value to users. This new team works like a startup within the company: you'll wear multiple hats and won't rely on cross-functional teams that typically support other teams inside Grafana Labs engineering. You will design, develop, test, and ship AI-powered features that can manage dealing with large datasets, while also expanding the capabilities of analytics-focused AI agents to assist users with information retrieval. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build and deliver full-stack user experiences: Take ownership of developing delightful, high-performance AI features to help users discover, organize, and optimize access to large datasets.
  • Rapid experimentation and iteration: Implement a highly iterative process where you quickly prototype, test, and validate with real users, including shipping and evolving LLM- or agent-powered workflows for the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Collaborate: Work with the rest of the team to shape AI-driven product features, including the integration of agentic components with internal tools like Slack and alerting systems while engaging with internal data teams for dogfooding.
  • Utilize AI tools effectively: Use AI and automation tools to enhance both product functionality and your own development workflows.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What we're looking for:

  • Product mindset: You understand what problems users have and develop solutions to address those with proficiency and taste.
  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.

Requirements:

  • Track record of building user-facing experiences that strike the right balance between utility and delighting the user.
  • Experience with LLMs, context engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Nice to have (but not required):

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

jobs.excerpt: About OpenSesame OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You'll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern on the People Team, you'll help drive initiatives that enhance the employee experience and support OpenSesame's growth. You'll contribute to projects that blend human insight with AI-driven approaches to boost engagement, develop talent, and strengthen our culture.

Our work spans recruiting, learning and development, and people operations, giving you broad exposure to how we attract, grow, and support our people. You'll work across teams, connect with leaders, and make a tangible impact on how we work and grow together.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You'll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we'll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You'll explore how AI and data can inform people strategy, improve the employee experience, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create programs with real impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You'll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the People Team

At OpenSesame, our People Team is the heart of our company, dedicated to building an inclusive, dynamic workplace where employees can thrive and reach their full potential. From talent acquisition and employee engagement to professional development, we empower our team members to succeed and grow.

We take pride in fostering a positive, supportive culture, driving impactful initiatives, and championing the well-being of every employee. Guided by employee feedback, data, and AI-driven insights, we keep improving how we attract, grow, and support our people. Join our People Team and be part of a collaborative environment where you can make a meaningful impact on the growth, success, and happiness of our team.

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame's People Team processes and tools.
  • Get set up with our internal AI tools and learn how the team uses them day to day.
  • Begin projects like cleaning and analyzing HR data to ensure accuracy and uncover insights.
  • Support initiatives such as talent acquisition, engagement, learning & development, benefits, working with our employee resource groups (ERGs), and our internship program.

By 30 Days

  • Assist with projects like building and enhancing eLearning content to support employee development.
  • Help coordinate activities and communications related to our internship program and ERGs.
  • Manage and update content within the CourseCloud platform.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to analyze data, identify trends, and find opportunities to improve People Team programs and streamline processes.
  • Join the intern hackathon team and build a working prototype (see above).
  • Learn more about our organization-wide training program, OpenSesame Qualified.

By 60 Days

  • Establish yourself as a reliable support resource for the People Team, providing insights to enhance the employee experience.
  • Lead a project around improving a specific People Team initiative or process, such as internship engagement, ERG programming, onboarding, or internal learning programs — using data analysis and AI-driven findings to measure impact and recommend improvements.
  • Share your recommendations with stakeholders, demonstrating how your work supports our mission to unlock learning potential through technology and innovation.

Not selected for this role? You’re still in the running. We’ll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.
