Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make groundbreaking brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 200 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, privacy, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Firefox Data Science team partners with Product and Engineering to grow usage of our flagship product: Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Our work informs prioritization, investment decisions, and the long-term growth strategy across Firefox.

This Staff Data Scientist will own the analytical strategy for a major product area: identifying the right questions, defining how success is measured, and driving decisions that shape Firefox’s growth trajectory. You will be a strategic partner to product and engineering leadership: framing problems, designing measurement approaches, and translating data into clear recommendations that influence roadmap and resource allocation. You will also raise the analytical bar across the team by establishing frameworks, mentoring other data scientists, and setting standards for how we measure and learn. This role requires the judgment to know which problems matter most, the technical depth to solve them rigorously, and the influence to ensure the work drives action.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the analytical strategy for a product area: identifying the highest-leverage questions, defining the measurement framework, and ensuring data-driven decisions
  • Serve as a strategic partner to product and engineering leadership, translating ambiguous business problems into analytical approaches and clear, actionable recommendations
  • Define north-star metrics and measurement strategies to set goals, evaluate progress, and make trade-offs
  • Design and oversee experiments and causal analyses, ensuring methodological rigor and that results drive real product decisions
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of user growth dynamics: how acquisition, activation, and retention interact to drive growth, and use that understanding to diagnose metric movements, explain trends to leadership, and anticipate emerging risks or opportunities
  • Contribute and own areas of the team’s forecasting and growth modeling efforts, helping translate statistical models into actionable growth strategies
  • Mentor and elevate other data scientists through code review, methodology guidance, and establishing reusable analytical frameworks
  • Represent data science in cross-functional forums, making the case for what the data shows even when it challenges prevailing assumptions
  • Drive alignment across data science, data engineering, and product on shared priorities like data quality, metric definitions, and instrumentation

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or applied quantitative analysis, with a track record of shaping product strategy through data
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional analytical initiatives from problem framing through stakeholder alignment to decision
  • Deep expertise in experimentation (A/B testing) and causal inference, with strong judgment about when each method applies and what conclusions they support
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for analysis, modeling, and validation
  • Experience defining and owning product metrics that teams actually use to make decisions
  • Strong opinions, loosely held: you can take a position on what the data says, advocate for it clearly, and update when the evidence changes
  • Track record of mentoring or technically leading other data scientists
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to ensure that the internet is a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Sprinto is scaling its Bay Area SF motion in the US, and this role is the tip of the spear.

As an SDR, you will own the first conversation with stakeholders at target startup accounts across San Francisco. You will build and execute an outbound engine built on real cold calling volume, sharp account planning, and the ability to create urgency. You will partner closely with your Account Executive to build relationships and convert target accounts into qualified pipeline.

This is not a role for someone who wants to lean on inbound leads or events traffic. This is full cycle, self sourced outbound, built from scratch.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own the phone. Consistently drive high volume outbound calling against a defined target account list of Bay Area startups. You are comfortable picking up the phone and are not intimidated by rejection.
  • Multithread startup accounts. Go wide and deep within each account, engaging founders, CTOs, and security leads with tailored messaging across call, email, and LinkedIn.
  • Create urgency, don't wait for it. Most startup buyers are not walking in with a compliance need front of mind. You know how to surface what is blocking their next enterprise deal or audit, tie it to a timeline they already care about, and build a case for why now.
  • Convert target accounts into Sales Accepted Leads. Work a named list accounts, qualify conversations rigorously at speed, and hand off only real opportunities, not just booked meetings.
  • Partner with your AE. Work hand in glove with your Account Executive to prioritize startup accounts, plan territory coverage across the Bay Area ecosystem, and drive quota attainment together.
  • Get better every week. Track your own connect rates, meeting rates, and conversion from conversation to opportunity. High velocity means faster feedback loops. Refine your approach constantly.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • You have real experience in outbound sales, whether as an SDR, BDR, or in a directly comparable high volume, high rejection selling environment.
  • You can point to specific numbers: dials per day, connect rates, meetings booked, and you can walk someone through your last closed opportunity from first touch to conversion.
  • You have sold, or sold into, Startups across C-Suite, and understand what multithreading actually means in practice.
  • You are genuinely good on the phone. You think on your feet and build trust through curiosity, not a call script.
  • You know how to create urgency in a conversation where the buyer did not walk in looking for a solution.
  • You are commercially curious. You research accounts, understand what makes a buyer tick, and adjust your approach account by account, not template by template.
  • You thrive on coaching and feedback, and you are looking to build the foundation for a long term sales career.

How we care for our Sprinters

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve and the impact they create, not their background or personal circumstances. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Job Title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITYLead one of our highest-performing enterprise teams as it shows customers why a Predictive Revenue System is the way to run pipeline, forecast and growth.

As our Regional Vice President, Enterprise Account Management, you’ll lead 6 to 8 seasoned enterprise sellers who own our largest customer relationships. At Salesloft, we connect pipeline generation, deal progression and forecasting in one closed loop through our Predictive Revenue System, and you’ll help your team bring that story to senior revenue and technology leaders. In your first six months you will:

  • Keep a strong team on the field: assess the talent, decide where to upskill and where to add, and keep the team’s momentum through a rapidly changing market.
  • Shift the conversations your team has: engage the executives who own the revenue problem and the leaders who own the AI and go-to-market strategy, and sharpen how we win against build-it-yourself and frontier-model alternatives.
  • Grow the base: lift win rates and velocity on six- and seven-figure expansion opportunities, and open more cross-sell conversations with customers who don’t yet use us for their entire revenue lifecycle process.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE

  • Move as One: You’ll work daily with SEs, Customer Success, RevOps, Product and Marketing, and share credit for the wins. Our sellers own the renewal and the growth, so you’ll help them mobilize the whole company behind each customer.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll inspect pipeline and forecast using real buyer signals, not gut feel, and say so when the data changes your mind.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll coach in the work, stay close to key deals without taking them over, and take ownership early, with or without a title that says you should.
  • Make Your Mark: You’ll shape how we sell the Predictive Revenue System to enterprise buyers, not just run the existing playbook.

For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. jobs.excerpt: Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?
jobs.description:
Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you love solving complex problems and want your work to make a difference?

Sound like you? Keep reading.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters. 
  • Collaboration – We are in it together. 
  • Human touch – We care deeply. 

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

Why join Semble?

  • Be part of something big: join a mission-driven company transforming healthcare
  • Work with exceptional people: you’ll be surrounded by a smart, ambitious, and supportive team with a great team culture
  • Growth opportunities: join a company on an exciting growth journey, with ample opportunity for professional development.

The role

We’re hiring a mid-level OutSystems engineer to join our Technical Solutions team. You’ll build and maintain customer applications and extensions using OutSystems 11 (O11), connecting them to Semble and other systems through APIs. Solutions could include customer portals, operational applications and workflows that address specific healthcare needs.

You’ll take part in delivery from solution design through development, testing, go-live and ongoing improvement. You’ll work with Customer Success, Implementation, Product and Engineering, and collaborate with external delivery partners.

You’ll contribute to application architecture decisions, help maintain one of our existing applications, take part in code reviews and share your O11 knowledge to help upskill the Technical Solutions team. Practical experience delivering and supporting O11 applications is essential.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain responsive Reactive Web applications in Service Studio, including screens, reusable Blocks, business logic and data models. Use OutSystems UI and appropriate JavaScript, HTML and CSS to deliver accessible user experiences.
  • Follow Architecture Canvas principles to keep applications modular, separating user interfaces, business services and shared components. Help identify and improve tightly coupled modules.
  • Build and consume REST APIs to connect OutSystems with Semble and third-party systems. Handle authentication, data mapping, validation, timeouts and errors, following agreed patterns for retries and duplicate prevention.
  • Implement background processing using O11 Timers, and use Business Process Technology where a process needs it, with clear error handling and logging.
  • Model data and optimise Aggregates and SQL queries. Investigate slow screens and excessive server calls, and flag performance risks as usage grows.
  • Apply secure development practices, including server-side authorisation, record-level access checks, secure API access and careful handling of patient data. Keep sensitive information out of browser storage and diagnostic logs.
  • Test your own work, including integration testing, and support customer UAT. Prepare deployments through LifeTime together with the team, checking dependencies and configuration.
  • Use Service Center, application logs and debugging tools to investigate production issues and fix root causes.
  • Document your solutions and interfaces, take part in code reviews and share your O11 knowledge with colleagues through pairing and knowledge sessions.

What we are looking for

  • Solid hands-on OutSystems 11 experience, with at least two applications delivered to production. You can explain your design choices and what you learned from real projects.
  • Good Reactive Web development skills: screen lifecycle, Client and Server Actions, reusable Blocks, events, validation and data fetching. You understand what belongs on the client and what must be enforced on the server.
  • Working knowledge of Service Studio, LifeTime and Service Center, including debugging, versioning and deploying applications across development, test and production environments.
  • Good relational data modelling skills, with practical knowledge of Entities, Aggregates, SQL and transactions.
  • Experience consuming and exposing REST APIs, working with JSON and implementing authentication. You can investigate integration errors and handle them predictably.
  • Care for security, testing and maintainability. You take data protection seriously and can apply secure development practices in a healthcare setting.
  • Clear communication in English with customers and non-technical colleagues, and a willingness to share knowledge with the team.

Nice to haves

  • OutSystems certification relevant to O11 development, such as Associate or Professional Reactive Developer; experience with AI Mentor Studio for reviewing application quality.
  • Integration Studio and C#/.NET extensions, SOAP integrations, or O11 Mobile development.
  • Experience consuming GraphQL APIs from OutSystems. Our current applications use GraphQL, so solid REST experience is enough to get started, with existing examples in the codebase to learn from.
  • Experience writing automated tests for your own logic, for example with BDDFramework.
  • Experience with healthcare or regulated SaaS, multi-tenant applications, SSO and identity providers, or interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7.
  • Familiarity with OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC), Workato or similar integration platforms, and responsible use of AI tools to support development.
  • Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude with OutSystems 11 MCP in Service Studio, including reviewing agent changes through Compare and Merge.

What you’ll get in return

  • Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s why we hire you!
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our founders started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.

Diversity and inclusion

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including groups traditionally underrepresented in technology. We encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

🌍 Bei simpleclub sind alle willkommen. Ja, wirklich alle.

About simpleclub

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure (Cloud) Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer with a strong focus on Cloud Security Posture Management to improve the security of our foundational cloud services and production infrastructure.

You will independently solve complex security problems requiring deep technical and domain knowledge. You will develop security capabilities within your product area, establish clear paths toward company-wide adoption, and partner with engineering teams to make security an integral part of system design.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining CSPM, cloud security architecture, threat modeling, software development, identity and access management, and cloud-native infrastructure security.

Responsibilities

Cloud Security Posture Management

  • Own and evolve Cloud Security Posture Management capabilities across multiple cloud providers, with a particular focus on Wiz.
  • Use Wiz to detect, investigate, and prioritize cloud misconfigurations, excessive permissions, exposed resources, vulnerabilities, and control gaps.
  • Develop risk-based policies, custom rules, and severity models that reflect our architecture and threat landscape.
  • Define metrics for CSPM coverage, adoption, remediation performance, and measurable risk reduction.
  • Identify recurring and systemic causes of cloud misconfigurations and address them through secure defaults, preventive controls, policy as code, and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  • Partner with engineering teams to prioritize and remediate findings based on risk, exposure, business context, and potential attack paths.

Security architecture and threat modeling

  • Conduct in-depth threat modeling and security reviews for foundational services such as Identity and Access Management, Key Management Systems, and other security-sensitive platform components.
  • Assess complex features and architectures to identify threats, attack paths, trust-boundary weaknesses, and appropriate security controls.
  • Independently investigate and solve complex security problems requiring deeper domain expertise.
  • Translate security risks and trade-offs into practical solutions that strengthen system design without unnecessarily constraining engineering teams.

Security tools and integrations

  • Evaluate and compare potential solutions against technical, security, operational, and scalability requirements.
  • Integrate security tools end to end across common engineering and production scenarios.
  • Design and build scalable security solutions using Go, taking them from initial implementation to broader organizational adoption.

Cloud security architecture

  • Define scalable security controls that account for differences between cloud providers while maintaining consistent security outcomes.
  • Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to embed security controls into cloud architectures and delivery processes.
  • Support the development of preventive and detective controls across multi-cloud environments.

Linux, kubernetes and container security

  • Review the security of Kubernetes workloads, clusters, and platform components.
  • Partner with platform teams to securely deploy, operate, and maintain services in Kubernetes environments.
  • Help engineering teams to detect weaknesses and design and apply effective host-hardening, workload-isolation, and least-privilege practices.

Security partnership and collaboration

  • Influence team roadmaps to ensure important security initiatives receive appropriate priority.
  • Empower teams through clear security guidelines, practical playbooks, reusable patterns, and security-awareness activities.
  • Promote secure-by-design practices and help teams take ownership of the security of their services.
  • Communicate complex security concepts clearly to security specialists, software engineers, and other stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

Cloud Security

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cloud Security Posture Management
  • Experience configuring CSPM policies, investigating findings, prioritizing risk, integrating remediation workflows, and reporting on security posture.
  • Experience using CSPM to analyze cloud context, exposure, permissions, vulnerabilities, and potential attack paths.

Threat modeling and security reviews

  • Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for distributed systems, foundational services, and cloud infrastructure.

Software Engineering

  • Hands-on software engineering experience with Go.

K8s/Linux security

  • Practical experience deploying and maintaining services in Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, workload abstractions, and security controls.
  • Experience securing Linux systems and containerized workloads.

Security Partnership and collaboration

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence technical decisions and engineering roadmaps without direct authority.

What success looks like

  • CSPM provides broad, reliable visibility across the organization’s cloud environments.
  • Cloud security issues have clear ownership and are remediated according to their risk.
  • Recurring misconfigurations are reduced through secure defaults, preventive controls, and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  • Engineering teams make better security decisions using the guidance, patterns, and tools you provide.
  • Solutions developed within one product area have a clear path toward wider organizational adoption.

Hiring process

  • Recruiter chat (30 min)
  • Live-coding interview (60 min)
  • Security interview (60 min) : Knowledge base questions our infrastructure security (Cloud Security, Kubernetes, Linux...)
  • Security system design interview (90 min): threat modeling and review of an existing infrastructure system
  • Technical deep dive (90 min)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.description:
About JawBuddy

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

How this internship works

We offer this role in exactly two ways:

  • Mandatory internship at an EU university: you are enrolled at a university in the EU and your study regulations require an internship. You send us a document from your university that confirms this. Start as soon as possible.

  • Prácticas at a Spanish university: you are enrolled at a university in Spain, and the internship runs through your university's internship agreement (prácticas extracurriculares with a convenio), full-time or alongside your studies. Start from December 2026.

We can't offer working-student contracts, voluntary internships or freelance work.

The role

You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world. You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer.

  • About 60 % app and computer vision quality: real-world testing, releases, accessibility, performance

  • About 25 % data quality: making sure analytics data is complete and correct

  • About 15 % automation with AI: building automated tests and checks, and reviewing what they find

What you'll do

Test our computer vision in the real world

  • Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

  • Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

Own app quality

  • Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

  • Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

  • Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

  • Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

Keep our data trustworthy

  • Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

  • Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

  • Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

Automate with AI

  • Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

  • Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

  • Enrolled at an EU university with a mandatory internship in your study regulations, or at a Spanish university that signs a convenio for prácticas

  • Available 20 to 40 hours a week, remote, as your university allows

  • Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

  • Solid SQL

  • A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

  • Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

  • Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

  • Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

  • dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

  • Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Real ownership: you own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen

  • Work with AI from day one: you learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill few people have yet

  • Rare experience: computer vision, health data and quality in a health product, all in one role

  • Mentorship: a weekly 1:1 with our CTO

  • Hours that fit your studies: 20 to 40 hours a week, as your university requires

How we hire

  1. Send your CV and your university document (internship requirement, or confirmation that your university can sign a convenio).

  2. A 30-minute call with our team.

  3. A short trial task: we send you a test build of the app, and you spend about 2 hours finding and reporting what's wrong. Use any AI tools you like.

  4. A final conversation, and an offer within a week.

Details

  • Type: mandatory internship (EU university) or prácticas (Spanish university)

  • Hours: 20–40 per week, depending on your university

  • Location: remote within the EU

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Start: as soon as possible; prácticas in Spain from December 2026

jobs.excerpt: Remote (US-based, Pacific hours) · Full-time · $85,000 to $105,000 annually, DOE Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
jobs.description:
Remote (US-based, Pacific hours) · Full-time · $85,000 to $105,000 annually, DOE

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

About Red Door Collaborative

Red Door Collaborative is a creative agency serving enterprise tech organizations and SMBs with visual design, content, motion, and video work. We're a small, human-centered team: highly collaborative, quietly intense, and genuinely good at what we do. We're also evolving. AI is reshaping our industry, and we're leaning into it as a tool that enhances our work rather than replaces the people doing it.

We're rooted in SoCal and the PNW, but we're a fully remote team of creatives. We work Pacific hours and meet in person rarely. This is a real remote role, not a "remote for now" situation. This role requires someone who thrives collaborating daily within tools like Microsoft Teams, Monday.com, Figma, and Frame.io, someone who communicates proactively and can keep projects moving forward with our clients and our creatives.

About the Role

We're hiring a Creative Project Manager to lead production across our creative team: a group of 12 full-time designers, content creators, motion artists, and PMs, plus a rotating group of individual collaborators that can expand the team to 20 to 30 people depending on project load.

This is not a support role. You'll own project timelines, resource allocation, and creative quality control. You'll build workback schedules, adapt them when clients change direction (which they will), and ensure every deliverable meets our bar before it goes out the door.

You'll report directly to our Associate Creative Director and work embedded within the creative team. You'll be the person who keeps projects moving, keeps the team steady when things get chaotic, and keeps clients confident that we're delivering something worth waiting for.

We're actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone on as soon as we find the right fit.

What You'll Do

  • Project management: Build and maintain workback schedules across multiple concurrent projects. Anticipate bottlenecks. Adjust when timelines shift, and they will shift.
  • Resource management: Manage capacity and assignments across internal team members and individual collaborators. Know who's available, who's overloaded, and who's right for what.
  • Creative quality control: Review work before delivery. You're not checking boxes. You're evaluating whether the design, content, or motion work actually meets the client's intent and our quality bar. This requires a real creative eye.
  • Client communication: Translate client feedback into actionable direction. Manage expectations. Ensure our clients aren't just happy with the work, they're genuinely delighted by it. That's the bar.
  • Process stewardship: Maintain and improve how we work in Monday.com. Keep documentation current. Make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Who You Are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a project manager in a creative agency environment: not adjacent to creative work, but embedded in it.
  • You've worked as a creative yourself at some point: designer, writer, editor, something. You understand the work because you've done the work.
  • You have real experience with Monday.com (strongly preferred) or a similar tool like Asana or Wrike.
  • You've worked with enterprise clients and understand the pace, scale, and complexity that comes with large tech organizations. You don't need to know their products inside and out, but you know how to navigate their approval chains, stakeholder dynamics, and expectations.
  • You're highly detail-oriented, not as a personality descriptor, but as a practice. You catch things other people miss.
  • You're calm under pressure, not because you don't feel the stress, but because you know that if you panic, the team panics.
  • You're proactive and communicative without being a bulldozer. You speak up, follow up, and push when needed, but you do it with empathy and tact.
  • You have an open, growth mindset about AI and are excited to explore how these tools can make our creatives better. We're not looking to replace our people with AI. We're looking to expand what our team is capable of.

Before You Apply

Consider the following before applying:

  • If your project management experience is mostly outside of creative or agency environments…
  • If you're more comfortable responding to requests than anticipating needs and driving work forward…
  • If you're looking for a role where process is more important than people…
  • If fast-moving, frequently-changing client demands and priorities feel more exhausting than energizing…

Then this probably isn't the right role for you.

To Apply

In your cover letter, tell us why you're drawn to work that moves fast and changes often. We're curious what makes this kind of role energizing for you rather than exhausting. We'd rather hear your honest take than a polished answer.

During the interview process, we may ask you to walk us through a past project: the scope, the challenges, and how you navigated it. Finalists will be asked to provide references from creatives they've worked with directly. We find these conversations more revealing than almost anything else in the process.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a salaried, exempt position with an annual salary of $85,000 to $105,000, depending on experience.

We offer a full benefits package: PTO (80 hours in your first year, increasing with years of service), paid holidays (11 per year), health coverage (medical, dental, vision, plus HSA/FSA options), 401(k) with match, life and disability insurance, a charitable matching program, and stipends to support your remote setup and ongoing work-from-home costs.

Equal Opportunity

Red Door Collaborative is committed to building an inclusive team where everyone is valued and respected. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We don't just welcome diverse perspectives; we actively seek them out. People from different cultures and experiences, solving problems together, is how we do our best work.

As our Tele-Pharmacist working remotely, you’ll help our doctors and nurses safely prescribe and dispense medications to help our patients feel better and recover from their illness or injury.Every day you will meticulously review every prescription in your queue for safety, critically assessing for potential drug interactions, correct dosing, patient allergies, or any irregularities. jobs.title: Account Executive (High-Ticket Closer)
jobs.excerpt: Account Executive (High-Ticket Closer) Location: Remote Team: Limitless Agency, Sales Employment Type: Full-time, full calendar (exclusive to Limitless) Base Pay: None.
jobs.description:
Account Executive (High-Ticket Closer)

Location: Remote
Team: Limitless Agency, Sales
Employment Type: Full-time, full calendar (exclusive to Limitless)
Base Pay: None. 100% commission.
Commission: 10% of cash collected on every deal you close
Stretch Kicker: +2% (12% total) on all cash collected in any month you close 25+ deals
On-Target Earnings (OTE): For a high performer after ramp: $384,000/year at 20 deals/month. Stretch for elite top tier performance: $576,000/year at 25 deals/month. No cap.
Average Deal Size: $16,000, with higher-tier packages at $30,000+
Leads: Mostly inbound prospects from cold traffic, plus a smaller amount from organic content, pre-qualified by application form and setters.

We’re looking for the best closers in the game. You get a full calendar of high-ticket calls, a $16,000 average deal, and 10% on every dollar you collect, rising to 12% when you hit the stretch bonus.

About Limitless Agency

Limitless Agency helps digital marketing agency owners build businesses that scale and sell. Our core program, Limitless Black Card, combines one-on-one strategy with the founders, implementation support, weekly group coaching, a dedicated account team, and in-person sessions at our Tampa headquarters. We’ve worked with hundreds of agency owners and helped many reach six-figure monthly revenue.

We spend well over six figures a month on paid acquisition. We have an in-depth application form and setters qualifying the leads. Our sales team closes 25 to 50 high-ticket deals a month and we're in the process of scaling. Your job is to turn a full calendar into cash.

Website:

The Opportunity

Every deal you close pays $1,600 at our average deal size when paid in full, and up to $3,000 on a top package in a stretch month. For paid in full deals, hit 20 deals and you’re at $32,000 for the month, 25 and your rate jumps to 12% on the whole month to $48,000. For payment plans you're paid as cash is collected.

The Role

This is a pure inbound closing seat. We can fill your calendar as long as you can perform. You’ll take back-to-back calls with agency owners who found us through paid ads, and you’ll close them.

These are inbound prospects coming from cold traffic. Most had never heard of us before they saw an ad. They aren’t referrals, and they haven’t sat through a webinar that warmed them up. You build trust, find the real problem, and close a $16,000+ decision on the call. If you’ve done this with cold paid traffic, this is one of the best seats you’ll find.

What You’ll Do

  • Run back-to-back high-ticket sales calls with cold prospects from paid ads, booked by our setters.
  • Close a minimum of 15 deals a month, with a stretch goal of 25.
  • Run our sales process with precision on every call and own the outcome.
  • Follow up relentlessly on pipeline, no-shows, and open decisions to recover and close deals.
  • Work closely with the setters to keep the calendar full of qualified prospects.
  • Keep clean notes and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel so nothing slips.
  • Review your own calls, take coaching, and keep sharpening your numbers.

How Compensation Works

This is straight commission on cash collected, with no base and no cap. Some clients pay in full and some are on payment plans, so you get paid as the money comes in. Close 25 deals in a month and your rate goes from 10% to 12% on all cash collected from that month’s deals, not just the deals above 25.

Commission per deal:

  • $15,000 deal: $1,500 at 10% / $1,800 at 12% (stretch month)
  • $16,000 deal (average): $1,600 at 10% / $1,920 at 12% (stretch month)
  • $25,000 deal (higher package): $2,500 at 10% / $3,000 at 12% (stretch month)

Earning Potential

Here’s what a month looks like at different levels, using our $16,000 average deal. Bigger packages pay more. These are examples, not guarantees.

  • Ramp (first 1–2 months): 10 deals at 10% = $16,000/month ($192,000 annualized)
  • Minimum standard: 15 deals at 10% = $24,000/month ($288,000 annualized)
  • On target: 20 deals at 10% = $32,000/month ($384,000 annualized)
  • Stretch goal (12% unlocked): 25 deals at 12% = $48,000/month ($576,000 annualized)

Math at target: 20 deals × $16,000 × 10% = $32,000 a month. At stretch: 25 deals × $16,000 × 12% = $48,000 a month.

The Kicker: At 24 deals, you’ve earned $38,400. Close one more and the whole month reprices to 12%: $48,000. That’s a $9,600 raise for one deal, every month you get there.

Who Thrives Here

This seat is built for a closer at the top of their game. You’re competitive, you own your numbers, and you’d rather have uncapped commission than a base. You can walk into a call with a stranger from a Facebook ad and walk out with a $16,000 decision. You follow up without being told, and you take coaching without getting defensive.

If you need a base to lean on, or you’ve only closed warm buyers, this isn’t the seat for you.

Requirements

Non-Negotiable Requirements

We’re hiring the top closers in the market. Every finalist must meet all of these and be able to prove it.

  • 2+ years of successful high-ticket closing experience, ideally with some B2B and/or agency background
  • A proven track record closing $15,000+ deals and $150k+ months, with documentation to prove it.
  • Experience closing inbound cold prospects from cold traffic. Not just warm referrals, and not just webinar or event closes.
  • Availability for a full-time, full calendar, full commitment.

Exclusivity

This seat comes with a full calendar, and we expect your full attention. You can’t be on other offers, take sales calls for anyone else, or run a side business or side hustle. If you’re closing for someone else on the side, this isn’t the role for you.

Prove It

Saying you’re a top closer isn’t enough. Finalists will be asked to back up their numbers with items such as:

  • Commission statements, payout reports, or pay stubs showing what you earned.
  • CRM or dashboard screenshots showing deals closed, deal sizes, and close rate.
  • Recorded sales calls where you closed a $15,000+ deal with a cold prospect.
  • References from sales managers or business owners you’ve closed for.

If you can’t show it, we can’t consider you.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission: 10% of cash collected on every deal, with no ceiling on earnings.
  • Stretch accelerator: Close 25+ deals in a month and earn 12% on all cash collected from that month’s deals.
  • High-ticket deal flow: $16,000 average deal size, with packages and upsells up to $25,000.
  • Full calendar, no prospecting: Leads come from substantial paid ad spend and are pre-qualified and booked by our setters.
  • 100% remote: Close from home.
  • Coaching and call review: Elite level coaching to keep sharpening your numbers and skills.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents

  • Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost

  • A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans

CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)

AI Content & Sales Enablement

Action

We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

Reporting to our Director of Renewals, the Sr. Manager, Renewals is a critical leadership role responsible for setting the strategy and leading the team that drives commercial contract excellence and gross revenue retention (GRR) across Billtrust customers. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of renewal professionals and people leaders, and champion the use of AI tools and co-worker agents to prepare renewal strategies, analyze pricing and contract data, and surface risk early, while focusing your own expertise on renewal strategy, team performance, executive relationships, and high-stakes negotiations.

What You’ll Do:

Theme 2: Proactive Renewal Execution & Commercial Excellence

  • Own the GRR target and the team’s full contract renewal lifecycle, ensuring our standard process is initiated well in advance of expiration so renewals are on time and commercially sound.

Theme 3: Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Deal Desk, Finance/Accounting, Product, and SalesOps to ensure renewals are executed as planned and in line with company standards.
  • Enable consistent, value-anchored renewal conversations across the team with clear messaging, value articulation, and pricing rationale.

Theme 4: Reporting, Forecasting & Operational Efficiency

  • Own renewal performance reporting and forecasting, including renewal status and churn risk, and present insights to executive leadership to inform decisions and achieve retention rate goals.
  • Use AI-powered resources to identify patterns across the renewal portfolio, prioritize team focus, and continuously improve forecast accuracy.
  • Identify process gaps and drive operational improvements across the broader renewals function.

What You’ll Bring:

Required Skills:

  • 8+ years of experience in renewals or account management roles in a B2B SaaS environment, including 3+ years leading teams and/or managing people leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a large book of renewals from initiation through close, including complex pricing and term negotiations and executive stakeholder communication.
  • Track record driving AI adoption across a team or function, including building AI tools and co-worker agents into team workflows.
  • Proficient data analysis skills with experience tracking, reporting, and forecasting against renewal KPIs.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, working alongside Sales, CS, Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, and leadership to align on strategy and execution.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows or co-worker agents that improve team efficiency and forecast accuracy.
  • Experience hiring and building renewals or account management teams.
  • Background in fintech, payments, or accounts receivable software.

jobs.title: Praktikum CEO Assistenz / Founder's Associate (m/w/d) - 100% Remote - direkt mit
jobs.excerpt: Mehr als ein Praktikum.  Dein Platz neben dem Gründer.
jobs.description:
Mehr als ein Praktikum. Dein Platz neben dem Gründer.

Die meisten Praktika laufen so: Du bekommst einen Platz in einer grossen Abteilung, ein Projekt ohne echte Bedeutung und nach drei Monaten ein Zeugnis, das niemand liest. Hier ist es anders. Du arbeitest 3 bis 6 Monate jeden Tag direkt mit mir, dem Gründer und CEO von TEACHY. Du siehst, wie Entscheidungen entstehen, wie verkauft, verhandelt und geführt wird. Und du gestaltest selbst mit.

Ehrlich gefragt: Was würde in deinem Lebenslauf mehr Türen öffnen? "Praktikant in Abteilung XY" oder "Founder's Associate, direkt dem CEO zugeordnet"?

Ist das für dich?

  • Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Management oder etwas Ähnliches und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder ein freiwilliges Praktikum

  • Du willst später gründen, in die Beratung oder in eine Führungsrolle und suchst die steilste Lernkurve, die du kriegen kannst

  • Du willst Verantwortung statt Kaffeeholen und echte Ergebnisse statt Übungsaufgaben

  • Du wünschst dir einen Mentor, der dir ehrlich sagt, was schon richtig gut ist und wo du noch wachsen musst

Wenn du bei mindestens drei Punkten nickst, lies weiter. Diese Stelle könnte die wichtigste deines Studiums werden.

Was du nach dem Praktikum kannst

  • Verkaufsgespräche führen und Einwände souverän behandeln

  • Entscheidungsvorlagen schreiben, die ein Verwaltungsrat ernst nimmt

  • Projekte steuern und Dinge wirklich zu Ende bringen

  • KI Tools so einsetzen, dass sie dir jede Woche Stunden sparen

  • Personal, Finanzen und Marketing aus der Sicht eines Unternehmers verstehen

So sieht deine Woche aus

Jeden Morgen starten wir mit einem kurzen Call: Was sind heute die drei wichtigsten Dinge? Danach arbeitest du selbstständig, bist bei ausgewählten Meetings dabei und wir stimmen uns über den Tag per Chat ab. Am Freitag schauen wir zurück: Was lief gut, was hast du gelernt, was ist nächste Woche dran? Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Du packst dort an, wo du gerade am meisten bewirkst:

  • Research und Analysen zu Markt, Wettbewerb, Kund:innen und Partnern

  • Koordination von Projekten, Terminen, Pendenzen und Nachfassen

  • Sales Support: Leads recherchieren, Angebote vorbereiten, CRM pflegen

  • Marketing Support bei Kampagnen, Content und KI Tools

  • Support bei Personalthemen wie Rekrutierung, Bewerbungsgesprächen und Onboarding

  • Strategie: Du challengst Ideen, Annahmen und Entscheidungen. Auch meine

Wer ich bin

Ich bin Christian von Olnhausen. Vor rund acht Jahren habe ich TEACHY mit nichts gegründet und auf über CHF 7 Mio. kumulierten Umsatz gebracht. Ich habe einen Master in Mathematik der Universität Heidelberg, bin Verwaltungsratspräsident, Speaker, Mitglied im AI Future Council des Swiss Future Institute und bei EO Zürich. Mit TEACHY habe ich sieben Awards gewonnen, darunter den EdTech Award der EPFL.

Ich bin direkt, fordernd und ehrlich. Ich lobe, wenn es verdient ist. Und ich sage dir klar, wenn etwas noch nicht reicht. Dafür teile ich offen, was ich weiss. Und ich erkläre dir, warum ich Entscheidungen so treffe. Wenn du das als Geschenk siehst, wird das eine der wertvollsten Zeiten deines Studiums.

Über TEACHY

TEACHY ist eine der führenden Schweizer Plattformen für Nachhilfe und Lerncoaching. Mit rund 800 Tutor:innen in 55 Fächern helfen wir Kindern, Jugendlichen und Erwachsenen, über sich hinauszuwachsen. Wir sind ein kleines, schnelles Team mit grossen Zielen und einer Mission, die zählt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist während des gesamten Praktikums an einer Hochschule oder Universität immatrikuliert. Das ist Pflicht

  • Du wohnst in der Schweiz oder in Deutschland

  • Du bist hungrig, schnell und zuverlässig. Wenn du etwas zusagst, ist es erledigt

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst mit und stellst auch unbequeme Fragen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch, Englisch ist ein Plus

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und KI wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Google Workspace

Was du bekommst

  • CHF 1'500 pro Monat und damit klar über dem, was die meisten Praktika zahlen

  • Tägliches Mentoring direkt vom Gründer statt von irgendwem in der dritten Reihe

  • Einblick in das gesamte Business: Sales, Marketing, Finanzen, Personal und Strategie

  • 100% remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, egal ob aus Zürich, Berlin oder München

  • Ein aussagekräftiges Praktikumszeugnis und eine Referenz, die Türen öffnet

Eckdaten

Vergütung: CHF 1'500 pro Monat

Freiwilliges Praktikum: 3 Monate, 100%

Pflichtpraktikum: bis zu 6 Monate, Vollzeit
Arbeitsort: 100% remote aus der Schweiz oder Deutschland

Start: nach Vereinbarung

Bevor du dich bewirbst, frag dich ehrlich

  • Wie würde es sich anfühlen, in einem Jahr zurückzublicken und zu merken, dass du diese Chance hast vorbeiziehen lassen?

  • Was müsste in diesem Praktikum passieren, damit du am Ende sagst: Das war die beste Entscheidung meines Studiums?

  • Was ist dir wichtiger: ein bequemes Praktikum oder eines, das dich verändert?

So bewirbst du dich

Schick mir deinen CV und ein kurzes Anschreiben. Kein Standardtext, sondern du. Beantworte darin drei Fragen: Warum genau diese Rolle und warum jetzt? Was ist das Mutigste, das du bisher gemacht hast? Was willst du in deinen ersten 30 Tagen bewegen?

Der Prozess ist schlank: Bewerbung, Kennenlerncall mit mir, Entscheidung. Bewerbungen ohne individuelles Anschreiben werden abgelehnt. Klingt hart? Ist es auch. Aber es ist fair gegenüber allen, die sich wirklich Mühe geben. Und wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast, gehörst du wahrscheinlich dazu.

jobs.excerpt: RAW Ventures is Hiring for Fermata Fermata, one of RAW Ventures’ portfolio companies, is an AgTech innovator using computer vision and AI to detect plant diseases and pests early, helping growers reduce losses and optimize yields.
jobs.description:
RAW Ventures is Hiring for Fermata

Fermata, one of RAW Ventures’ portfolio companies, is an AgTech innovator using computer vision and AI to detect plant diseases and pests early, helping growers reduce losses and optimize yields.
Learn more at fermata.tech.

The opportunity

Fermata is hiring a senior operating leader with agtech and B2B SaaS experience to run

the company's operations and drive growth beyond its core product. Y ou will join as the

company moves from a proven product to scale, and you will shape how Fermata operates

and grows rather than maintain a finished system. Y ou will own the operating model, the

portfolio of commercial, R&D and collaboration projects, new operational directions and

customer success for the core product. The work is international, with customers and

collaborations across Europe and North America.

About Fermata

Fermata is an agtech company delivering digital scouting and agronomic decision support

to commercial growers, propagators, nurseries and seed producers. Its Croptimus

platform combines optical zoom cameras with computer vision to monitor crops daily and

detect early signs of more than 20 types of pests, diseases and other plant issues.

Fermata has customers in Canada, the Netherlands, Greece, the United Kingdom and

other markets.

Key responsibilities

Project portfolio and R&D partnerships

  • Own a portfolio of parallel projects — commercial deployments, pilots, joint R&D, research collaborations and exploratory projects — and decide with the Managing Director which to start, scale or stop.
  • Turn partner and client ideas into structured projects with clear objectives, owners, milestones, budgets and success criteria.
  • Build relationships with R&D partners — hardware, sensing and greenhouse-technology companies, research institutes and universities — and lead projects that test new data sources, crops, use cases or markets, for example where other hardware rather than fixed cameras collects crop data.
  • Discover the commercial needs behind research questions and turn successful experiments into validated business cases, together with the Product Lead and the Sales Director.

Stakeholders and roadmaps

  • Act as the senior counterpart for client and partner management: run steering meetings, shape joint technical and commercial project roadmaps and secure clear decisions.
  • Negotiate scope, responsibilities, IP and data-sharing principles of collaborations with the Managing Director.
  • Work with the Sales Director: share customer and partner insight, validate delivery assumptions and hand over opportunities that emerge from projects.

Cross-functional delivery and operations

  • Coordinate ML, Engineering and installation teams on projects: data collection and model experiments, site readiness, hardware deployment and partner equipment.
  • Align project priorities with the Product Lead's roadmap and involve the Agrotechnical Director to keep projects agronomically sound.
  • Formalise how Fermata runs projects and operations: meeting cadences, status reporting, decision logs, portfolio reviews and business processes across teams.
  • Own operational planning and budgets: hardware supply, logistics, installation capacity and supplier terms.

Customer success

  • Lead the Customer Success, support and logistics team across countries.
  • Own customer health, retention, renewals, expansion and pilot-to-scale conversion, with commercial support from the Sales Director; ensure reliable onboarding, support and hardware delivery.

How this role works with others

The Managing Director owns strategy and investment; the Product Lead owns the

product vision, roadmap and requirements; the Sales Director owns new-customer

acquisition, proposals, pricing and negotiations and supports you on renewals and

expansion; the Agrotechnical Director owns agronomic methodology; ML, Engineering

and installation teams own technical delivery.

Measures of success

  • Customers convert successfully from pilots to commercial rollout; installation and onboarding are fast, well organised and clear for both sides; existing customers are retained and grow through upscaling and upselling, with reliable logistics and support.
  • Every commercial, R&D and collaboration project has a current objective, status and next decision.
  • R&D and collaboration projects end with clear outcomes: validated results, a commercial case, or a reasoned decision to stop.
  • Partners and client management see Fermata as a reliable collaborator; joint roadmaps are agreed and followed.

Required experience and capabilities

  • Substantial experience in agtech and B2B SaaS in a senior operations, programme or partnerships leadership role.
  • Proven track record of leading R&D or collaboration projects with external partners and turning them into commercial results.
  • Experience managing parallel projects across countries; experience in the Netherlands and/or Canada is strongly preferred.
  • Confidence with senior management of client and partner companies: steering meetings and negotiation of scope, responsibilities and roadmaps.
  • Strong process design and governance skills, commercial and financial judgement, and technical literacy to work with ML, software and hardware teams.
  • Experience leading customer-facing or operational teams; fluent professional English.

Preferred: computer vision or IoT in agriculture; launching a new product line or market;

a network in Dutch and Canadian protected horticulture.

jobs.excerpt: Über uns Karriereservice. de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement.
jobs.description:
Über uns

Karriereservice.de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Wir unterstützen Menschen beim Berufseinstieg, in beruflichen Veränderungsphasen und auf dem Weg zum nächsten Karriereschritt. Zu unseren Auftraggebenden zählen Unternehmen, Hochschulen und öffentliche Institutionen.

Für unsere englischsprachigen Veranstaltungen suchen wir freiberufliche Trainer (m/w/d), die Karrierewissen verständlich vermitteln, Menschen zum Mitdenken anregen und praktische Impulse für ihre berufliche Entwicklung geben.

Für bestehende Auftraggebende suchen wir bereits konkrete Unterstützung. Gleichzeitig möchten wir unser englischsprachiges Angebot aufgrund der guten Nachfrage weiter ausbauen. Dabei freuen wir uns über Menschen, die neben ihrer Erfahrung in der Durchführung auch eigene Themen und Ideen für neue Formate einbringen möchten.

Deine Aufgaben

Du führst englischsprachige Webinare und Online-Seminaredurch. Unsere Zielgruppen sind insbesondere Studierende, Berufseinsteigende und Menschen, die sich beruflich verändern oder neu orientieren möchten.

Die Webinare dauern meist 90 Minuten, die Online-Seminare je nach Thema und Auftrag etwa zweieinhalb bis sechs Stunden. Alle Veranstaltungen finden fast ausschließlich online statt.

Mit Deiner Erfahrung unterstützt Du uns dabei:

  • Karrierewissen praxisnah vermitteln: Du leitest englischsprachige Veranstaltungen, beispielsweise zu Berufseinstieg, Bewerbungsstrategien, Vorstellungsgesprächen, beruflicher Orientierung oder Selbstpräsentation.

  • Teilnehmende aktiv einbeziehen: Du gestaltest lebendige Online-Veranstaltungen mit verständlichen Beispielen, passenden Übungen und Raum für Fragen und Austausch.

  • Inhalte zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten: Du berücksichtigst unterschiedliche berufliche Erfahrungen und internationale Hintergründe und machst Inhalte für die jeweilige Gruppe nutzbar.

  • Veranstaltungen vor- und nachbereiten: Du stimmst Inhalte und Ablauf mit unserem Team ab, bereitest Materialien vor und nutzt Rückmeldungen zur Weiterentwicklung.

  • Neue Formate mitentwickeln: Du kannst eigene Themenvorschläge einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns englischsprachige Webinare und Seminarangebote konzipieren, die wir unseren Auftraggebenden anbieten.

Das bringst Du mit

Du hast Freude daran, vor Gruppen zu sprechen, Wissen anschaulich zu vermitteln und Menschen bei ihren nächsten beruflichen Schritten zu unterstützen. Dabei verbindest Du fachliche Erfahrung mit einer offenen, zugewandten Art.

Wir wünschen uns:

  • Fließendes, souveränes Englisch: Du kannst Veranstaltungen vollständig auf Englisch leiten und auch auf spontane Fragen differenziert eingehen. Englisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau ist besonders willkommen.

  • Relevante Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Recruiting, der Personalentwicklung, der Karriereberatung oder dem Coaching mit. Du musst aber nicht alle Bereiche abdecken.

  • Erfahrung in der Wissensvermittlung: Du hast bereits Trainings, Workshops, Webinare oder Seminare eigenständig durchgeführt.

  • Didaktisches Gespür: Du strukturierst Inhalte nachvollziehbar und findest einen guten Wechsel zwischen fachlichem Input, Interaktion und praktischer Anwendung.

  • Verständnis für unsere Zielgruppen: Du kannst Dich in die Fragen und Herausforderungen von Studierenden, Berufseinsteigenden und Menschen in beruflichen Veränderungsphasen hineinversetzen.

  • Sicherheit im digitalen Raum: Du gehst souverän mit gängigen Videokonferenztools um und schaffst auch online eine angenehme Lernatmosphäre.

  • Verlässlichkeit und Eigenständigkeit: Du bereitest Deine Veranstaltungen sorgfältig vor, hältst Absprachen ein und arbeitest konstruktiv mit unserem Team zusammen.

Eine Trainings- oder Coachingausbildung sowie Erfahrung mit internationalen Zielgruppen sind von Vorteil. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass Du fachlich überzeugst und Deine Inhalte verständlich, lebendig und praxisnah vermitteln kannst.

Das bieten wir Dir

  • 100 % remote: Du führst die Veranstaltungen online durch und kannst ortsunabhängig mit uns zusammenarbeiten.

  • Konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten: Für bestehende Auftraggebende suchen wir bereits Unterstützung bei englischsprachigen Veranstaltungen.

  • Perspektive auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Wir möchten unser englischsprachiges Angebot ausbauen und freuen uns über eine kontinuierliche Zusammenarbeit.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen: Du kannst fachliche Schwerpunkte einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns neue Themen und Formate entwickeln.

  • Vielfältige Themen und Zielgruppen: Du begleitest Menschen bei wichtigen beruflichen Entscheidungen und vermittelst Wissen, das sie unmittelbar anwenden können.

  • Fachlichen Austausch und klare Abstimmung: Wir besprechen Inhalte, Termine und Rahmenbedingungen transparent und arbeiten wertschätzend auf Augenhöhe zusammen.

  • Methodischen Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst Deinen persönlichen Trainingsstil ein und gestaltest die Veranstaltungen passend zur Zielgruppe und zum Auftrag.

Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich und Deinen Trainingsansatz kennenzulernen!

Sende uns eine kurze Vorstellung mit Deinem beruflichen Hintergrund, Deiner Trainings- und gegebenenfalls Coachingerfahrung sowie den Themen, die Du auf Englisch anbieten möchtest. Gib gerne auch an, welche Erfahrung Du mit englischsprachigen Veranstaltungen mitbringst und in welchem zeitlichen Umfang Du verfügbar bist.

In einem persönlichen Gespräch schauen wir gemeinsam, welche bestehenden Aufträge zu Dir passen und welche neuen Formate wir miteinander entwickeln können.

Dein Ansprechpartner: Herr Christian Richter erwartet Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung.

Rückfragen beantwortet er Dir gerne telefonisch unter 0211 - 863 94 11.

Customer Communications Lead | Pools & Leisure

  • Make an impact on the customer experience across Auckland’s Pools & Leisure network

He angitūtanga: The opportunity

Our Pools & Leisure team plays an important role in helping Aucklanders stay active and connected with their communities. We’re looking for an experienced Customer Communications Lead to help shape how we communicate with our customers and deliver a consistent, engaging experience across our network.

In this role, you’ll lead the development and delivery of customer communications, marketing campaigns and brand initiatives across Pools & Leisure. Working closely with centre teams and internal stakeholders, you’ll ensure communications are clear, timely, accessible and consistent across customer-facing channels.

You’ll also support new products, services and initiatives, provide guidance on brand and signage requirements, and use feedback from our teams to identify opportunities for improvement. With the customer at the heart of your work, you’ll help create communications and experiences that meet the needs of Aucklanders.

He kōrero mōu: About you

You’ll bring significant experience in marketing and/or communications, with a strong track record of delivering customer communications, campaigns and brand-aligned content. Comfortable working across multiple priorities and stakeholders, you’ll know how to turn complex information into clear, engaging and customer-focused communications.

Strong relationship-building skills will be essential, along with the ability to collaborate confidently with operational teams, communications specialists, project teams, contractors and other stakeholders.

To be successful in this role, you’ll ideally bring:

  • A minimum of seven years’ experience in marketing and/or communications, with experience delivering customer communications, campaigns and brand-aligned content
  • A tertiary qualification in Marketing, Communications, Design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience working in a service-based or multi-site operational environment, with strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills

jobs.description:
Social Media Content Marketing Specialist

Location: Remote

Reports to: Director of Marketing

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Mission

Transform Paradigm’s long-form ideas, insights, and video content into a high-quality, high-velocity stream of multi-channel social media assets that strengthen brand authority, deepen audience engagement, and consistently improve the performance of our marketing ecosystem.

This role requires strong fluency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Descript, HubSpot AI, etc.) to accelerate drafting, repurposing, clipping, and content refinement.

Why Paradigm

Paradigm exists to help individuals and families move forward with financial certainty, vitality, independence, and freedom, and we are entering a pivotal moment of growth where our intellectual property, video assets, and thought leadership need to scale across every major platform. Content is central to that growth.

As our Content Marketing Specialist, you will own the systems and execution that determine how the world experiences Paradigm — making this one of the highest-leverage marketing roles in the company.

What Success Looks Like (12-Month Outcomes)

A-Players thrive on clarity and challenge. Success in this role means:

Deliver 20–25+ high-quality, platform-ready content assets per month with 95%+ on-time delivery, ensuring each piece supports a defined business goal such as:

  • Lead magnet promotion
  • Webinar/event registration
  • Nurture campaign engagement
  • Wealth Strategy awareness

Channel Performance Improvement

You will be responsible for increasing engagement rates across core platforms by 20–30% through strategic repurposing, stronger hooks and creative testing, consistent performance optimization while improving downstream action including: Link clicks, landing page traffic and email opt-ins.

Social to Lead Ownership

Own organic social lead generation by building and optimizing a multi-channel content system that produces measurable conversion into Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) through:Gated content, webinar/event signups, lead nurture sequences, and CTA-driven content journeys.

Success is defined by consistent contribution to the marketing pipeline—not just reach.

Reporting and Pipeline Visibility

Provide monthly reporting that connects content performance to: Lead volume, MQL progression, campaign attribution, top-performing content themes.

Brand Alignment & Quality

Maintain content output that is polished, on-brand, and strategically aligned, requiring fewer than 5% of assets to be revised for quality or accuracy.

Operational Efficiency

Reduce turnaround time from raw asset → publish-ready content by 25%+ through improved systems, templates, and asset organization.

Content Infrastructure

Create and maintain a searchable, scalable asset library of clips, templates, thumbnails, and reusable content building blocks.

The Work You’ll Own

1. Day-to-Day Content Execution

  • Translate strategy into daily publishing across social, email, and digital channels
  • Move content from idea → draft → polished asset independently, without micromanagement
  • Use AI tools for ideation, first-pass drafting, summarization, and content refinement

2. Social Media Ownership

You own planning, scheduling, publishing, and optimization across Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Responsibilities include:

  • Writing platform-specific captions, hooks, scripts
  • Editing short-form video clips (cutting, formatting, overlays, captions)
  • Creating simple graphics in Canva
  • Monitoring comments and supporting community engagement
  • Tracking performance and reporting insights

3. Multi-Channel Content Development & Repurposing

  • Turn long-form content (videos, webinars, interviews, articles) into short-form clips, carousels, graphics, and micro-stories
  • Use AI-assisted clipping, transcription, and drafting to accelerate production
  • Maintain a structured asset library that improves speed and consistency
  • Collaborate with marketing leadership, design, and internal experts to plan content flows and campaign themes
  • Ensure all AI-assisted content is reviewed, accurate, and on-brand

4. Marketing Campaign Execution and Support

  • Partner closely with the Marketing and Lifecycle teams to support high-performing social, content and emaill campaigns by:
  • Coordinating content updates, CTA placement, and audience-specific messaging to align with campaign goals
  • Supporting segmentation and tagging efforts to ensure the right message reaches the right audience
  • Assisting with basic workflow updates and automation adjustments
  • Performing thorough QA checks before deployment, including formatting, links, personalization, and compliance
  • Leveraging AI tools to enhance subject line testing, draft refinement, and light personalization at scale

5. AI-Assisted Content Production

  • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, Descript, HubSpot AI) to accelerate drafting, repurposing, and editing
  • Generate first-pass captions, summaries, headlines, and scripts
  • Leverage AI-powered video tools for clipping, transcription, or rough cuts
  • Maintain a simple internal AI-use log for compliance and brand governance (tool used, prompt type, human edits)

6. Cross-Channel Campaign Support

  • Ensure content execution across platforms aligns with larger marketing initiatives
  • Help create unified message flows when campaigns span multiple channels

Traits of an A-Player in This Role

  • High-volume producer capable of consistently delivering polished work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong content craftsperson who can turn long-form insights into compelling short-form assets
  • Organized and self-directed, managing deadlines without reminders
  • Proactive problem solver who brings ideas and solutions, not just execution
  • Data-informed and able to iterate content based on performance insights
  • Collaborative communicator who works smoothly across teams
  • Comfortable with video direction or basic on-set content capture
  • Fluent with HubSpot CRM
  • AI-savvy, with the ability to refine AI-generated drafts into human-quality content
  • Comfortable working with affluent, conservative, privacy-focused audiences

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of experience managing social media and content execution for a brand, agency, or creator-driven business
  • 2+ years experience in the financial services Industry or related field
  • Proven ability to produce a high volume of platform-ready short-form content tied to business goals (engagement, traffic, lead capture)
  • Strong video editing capability for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, including pacing, captions, and hook-driven structure
  • Excellent copywriting skills across formats, including: Social captions and headlines, strong hooks and CTAs, light email/lifecycle copy contributions
  • Proficiency in Canva or similar design tools to quickly create branded, scroll-stopping creative
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot, including email-building support, segmentation awareness, and CTA integration
  • Experience using AI tools to enhance content workflows (drafting, repurposing, subject line testing, creative iteration)
  • Strong understanding of how social content supports the funnel: From awareness through lead generation and MQL progression
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, able to manage deadlines, QA processes, and multi-channel coordination
  • Familiarity with Descript, Opus.pro, or AI-assisted editing tools
  • Experience supporting or managing YouTube channels
  • Ability to plan or lightly produce video shoots
  • Interest in analytics, creative testing, and experimentation

How We'll Measure Success

Consistency & Reliability:

  • % of planned social and supporting content delivered on time with minimal rework and strong production cadence.

Content Quality & Brand Alignment:

  • Creative output is polished, on-message, and strengthens Paradigm Life’s authority, trust, and brand perception across platforms.

Channel & Funnel Performance Impact:

  • Measurable improvement in key growth metrics quarter-over-quarter, including: Engagement and audience retention, link clicks and traffic to offers, lead capture and MQL contribution from social-driven campaigns

Operational Efficiency:

  • A smoother, faster, and more predictable content pipeline through strong planning, repurposing systems, and clear execution processes.

Cross-Channel Collaboration & Communication:

  • Proactive coordination with stakeholders across marketing, lifecycle/email, and sales support teams to ensure content aligns with campaign goals and lead-nurture efforts

    Come join our team!
