OFFRES EN ALTERNANCE/STAGE UNIQUEMENT

PRE-REQUIS OBLIGATOIRE : avoir une formation ou une expérience professionnelle en relation avec les marchés de l'énergie

Les marchés de l’électricité ne sont pas réservés aux grands acteurs historiques. Aidez-nous à le faire savoir.

Chez Augmented Energy, nous rendons les marchés de l’électricité accessibles. Nous sommes responsable d'équilibre & fournisseur. Nous donnons aux acteurs émergents (producteurs renouvelables, fournisseurs alternatifs, opérateurs de stockage et d’effacement, industriels) une solution clé en main pour accéder au marché. Nos solutions sont concrètes mais parfois difficile à expliquer, et c’est là que vous intervenez.

À propos de nous

Nous sommes une jeune entreprise en forte croissance, portée par des fondateurs qui ont fait leurs armes dans le trading, la tech et le commerce de l’énergie. Nous travaillons déjà avec des fournisseurs, des producteurs et des acteurs de la flexibilité. Toute l’équipe est en full remote, répartie dans 5 pays, avec une vraie culture de l'autonomie.

Le poste

Vous êtes la personne qui donne une voix à Augmented Energy. Pendant les premiers mois, vous vous consacrez entièrement au marketing et à la communication. Vous prenez ensuite progressivement une part du développement commercial, sans quitter le marketing, qui reste au coeur du poste.

Phase 1 : marketing & communication (premiers mois)

  • Construire la ligne éditoriale et rédiger des articles qui rendent le marché de l’électricité compréhensible (équilibrage, flexibilité, fourniture.)

  • Mettre en place et animer la newsletter

  • Gérer le LinkedIn de l'entreprise (≈ 2 publications par semaine)

  • Créer les supports : brochures, fiches offres, cas clients, présentations

  • Tester et utiliser l'IA au quotidien pour produire plus vite et mieux (savoir concevoir de bons prompts)

Phase 2 : marketing + appui au développement (ensuite)

  • Poursuivre l'animation de notre communication (environ la moitié de votre temps)

  • Produire les contenus qui appuient directement les ventes : cas clients, argumentaires, réponses types

  • Suivre les contacts générés par nos contenus et événements, et les qualifier avec l'équipe commerciale

  • Contribuer à la préparation et au suivi des offres de fourniture d’énergie

  • Contribuer à l'organisation du CRM commercial ( ATTIO)

  • Participer à la préparation de salons et des webinaires

Profil recherché

  • Curieux·se et débrouillard·e, à l'aise avec l'autonomie et le travail à distance

  • Bonne plume : vous savez vulgariser un sujet technique

  • À l'aise avec l'IA et les outils numériques

  • Prise d'initiative et polyvalence

Pré-requis

  • Français & Anglais courant

  • Vous connaissez le secteur de l'électricité et comprenez le fonctionnement des marchés de l’énergie

Avantages

  • 100 % télétravail

  • Un ou deux déplacements par an, pris en charge par l'entreprise

  • Rémunération selon profil

  • Démarrage dès que possible / rentrée 2026-2027

  • Alternance ou stage

The Marketing Assistant will work closely with the Sales & Marketing Coordinator to ensure marketing initiatives are executed accurately, consistently, and on time.

Preferred

This is an execution-focused support position. Marketing strategy, advertising budgets, campaign direction, sales leadership, and overall marketing performance will remain under the Sales & Marketing Coordinator and leadership team. The Marketing Assistant will be responsible for implementing approved plans and maintaining recurring marketing operations efficiently and consistently.

EXPECTATIONS FOR SUCCESS

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Consistent, timely social media scheduling and publishing.

jobs.description:
About the role

This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against.

If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you.

What you'll build

The runtime

  • Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations.

  • Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity.

Reliability

  • Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation.

  • Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown.

Tools, context, and memory

  • Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems.

  • Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation.

Evaluation and observability

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths.

  • Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results.

  • Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow.

Security

  • Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required.

Delivery and leadership

  • Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks.

  • Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering, including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work.

  • 2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain, and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved.

  • Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware.

  • Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution.

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls.

  • Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation.

  • Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture.

  • Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them.

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing.

  • Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them.

  • Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision.

jobs.title: Senior EHS Specialist - Chemical Manufacturing
jobs.excerpt: About Quaker Houghton Quaker Houghton is a global leader in industrial process and mechanical engineering applications present in 40+ countries.
jobs.description:
About Quaker Houghton

Quaker Houghton is a global leader in industrial process and mechanical engineering applications present in 40+ countries. Our engineers, chemists and industry experts partner with customers across more than 100 locations to help them run more efficiently and effectively. One of our core values is to live safe, and we continually innovate so industrial manufacturers can stay ahead in a changing world.

Your responsibilities

An excellent opportunity to join the EMEA EHS team in a senior, field-based position where you will support more than 40 sites across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

Safety is at the core of our culture. In this highly visible role, you will serve as the lead EHS technical expert across your assigned scope, partnering with employees, managers and customers to promote safe working practices, strengthen our EHS culture and drive continuous improvement.

You will work across a variety of environments, from customer sites and laboratories to commercial operations, helping to ensure compliance, reduce risk and support sustainable business performance.

This role is primarily remote-based, with regular travel throughout the UK. While home-based working is supported, occasional attendance at meetings, conferences and team events in our Manchester and Coventry offices may be required.

What will you do?

  • Act as the lead EHS technical expert for Fluidcare, Commercial Operations, Laboratories and Sales activities across the UK, driving a strong safety culture and continuous improvement.

  • Implement and enhance EHS programs, policies, procedures and risk-reduction initiatives, promoting safe behaviours and personal accountability across the business.

  • Lead and support investigations of incidents, near misses and hazard observations, ensuring robust root-cause analysis and the effective implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

  • Monitor EHS performance, trends, leading indicators and lessons learned to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Support the implementation and effective use of EHS management systems and software, ensuring compliance, action tracking and performance reporting.

  • Provide technical guidance on occupational health, industrial hygiene and workplace exposure management, partnering with HR and Operations as required.

  • Support and maintain EHS management systems, including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, helping sites demonstrate compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements.

  • Act as a key resource for EHS training and competency programs, supporting employee inductions, refresher training and ongoing awareness initiatives.

  • Provide expert guidance on risk assessments, including job task, chemical, PPE and process hazard assessments (HAZOPs), ensuring findings and actions are effectively addressed.

  • Conduct EHS audits, inspections and compliance assessments across multiple customer and company locations, identifying sustainable improvements and ensuring timely closure of actions.

  • Build strong relationships with customers, operational leaders and other stakeholders, representing Quaker Houghton during audits, meetings and customer engagements.

  • Maintain knowledge of relevant UK EHS legislation, regulations and industry best practices, ensuring changing requirements are reflected in company processes.

What you bring

  • Experience: Significant experience in Environmental, Health & Safety, ideally gained within chemical, manufacturing, industrial, engineering, or related environments.

  • Multi-Site Environment: Experience supporting multiple sites, customers or business locations rather than a single site operation.

  • Auditing & Compliance: Practical experience conducting EHS audits, inspections, incident investigations and compliance assessments.

  • Risk Assessment: Strong knowledge of risk assessment methodologies, including chemical risk assessments and workplace hazard evaluations.

  • Management Systems: Experience supporting or maintaining ISO 14001 and/or ISO 45001 management systems.

  • Industry Knowledge: Experience within the chemical industry or fluid management sector would be highly advantageous.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline preferred.

  • Professional Qualification: NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent preferred. NEBOSH Diploma or ProQual Level 6 or equivalent advance qualification would be high desirable

  • IT Skills: MS Office, MS Teams, O365 and ability to learn and utilize EHS software systems.

  • Location: Based in the United Kingdom.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling extensively throughout the UK, including regular overnight stays (typically 6-8 nights per month) and frequent visits to customer locations.

Soft Skills

  • Autonomous and proactive.

  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Confident engaging with customers and employees from diverse backgrounds and organisational levels.

  • Practical problem solver with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently while remaining a collaborative team player.

  • Passionate about safety, continuous improvement and delivering results.

Benefits

What's in it For You?

  • Flexible home-based working.

  • Company car.

  • QH University: Continuous training programs for all seniority levels.

  • 2 annual days paid volunteering leave.

  • Attractive Wellbeing, Mental Health, Women Inclusion & other DEI programs.

  • Opportunity to work closely with customers and operational teams across the UK.

  • Exposure to regional EHS initiatives and projects across EMEA.

We provide a comprehensive range of benefits to support your professional growth, well-being, and daily work:

  • Company pension plan and a private pension to support your long-term financial planning.

  • Financial wellness program to help you manage your financial health.

  • Company car, company cellphone, and company laptop equipped for your daily tasks.

  • Home office equipment and dedicated remote work provisions to set up your workspace.

  • Mental health support and paid sick leave to ensure your well-being.

  • Career training, mentoring sessions, and an internal mobility program for your professional development

  • Free parking and casual dress code for your convenience.

  • Team events and social activities to connect with colleagues.

Who are we?

We are the global leader in industrial process fluids present in 40+ countries continually improving and innovating so the world’s steel, aluminum, automotive, aircraft, machinery and industrial parts manufacturers can stay ahead in a changing world. Throughout our 100+ locations, our chemists, engineers and industry experts partner with our customers to continually improve their operations so they can run even more efficiently, even more effectively, whatever comes next.

Our values:

  • Live Safe

  • Exceed Customer Expectations

  • Drive Results

  • Embrace Diversity

  • Do Great Things Together

  • Act with integrity

Our core values embody who we are as a company, guide our decisions and inspire us. Our commitment to these values, in words and actions, builds a safer, stronger Quaker Houghton. They are the fundamental beliefs that guide our internal conduct and our relationship with the outside world.

jobs.title: Sketch Quality Control Reviewer
jobs.excerpt: The Sketch Quality Control Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the visual quality, consistency, and accuracy of sketch-based assets used in in-app videos, promotional content, and storytelling experiences.
jobs.description:
The Sketch Quality Control Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the visual quality, consistency, and accuracy of sketch-based assets used in in-app videos, promotional content, and storytelling experiences.

The role reviews sketches against approved scripts, briefs, and creative guidelines, identifies visual and continuity issues, provides clear and actionable feedback, and documents approval readiness before assets move to final production and integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review sketches used in in-app videos and promotional assets to ensure visual quality, clarity, and alignment with approved creative briefs and scripts.

  • Assess visual consistency across episodes and assets, including character design, scene continuity, composition, proportions, and storytelling flow.

  • Verify that sketches follow brand guidelines, content standards, and the approved visual direction.

  • Identify and document visual inconsistencies, missing elements, continuity gaps, and deviations from the approved script or brief.

  • Provide clear, specific, and actionable written feedback to support efficient revisions by artists and editors.

  • Coordinate with Client representatives, sketch artists, and video editors to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and follow up on corrections when needed.

  • Maintain an up-to-date QC tracker documenting review status, identified issues, recommended corrections, revision outcomes, and completion dates.

  • Confirm whether assets meet the required quality standards and are ready for approval and integration into final video assets.

  • Identify recurring quality issues and recommend improvements to QC checklists, review guidelines, and production workflows.

Required Deliverables

1. Sketch QC Report

A structured report for each asset or batch, covering visual clarity, script and brief alignment, character consistency, storytelling accuracy, identified issues, and recommended corrections.

2. Approval Summary Sheet

A consolidated summary by approved episode or batch, including the number of sketches reviewed, issue categories and frequency, revision rounds, and final QC approval status.

3. QC Tracker

An up-to-date record of review status, identified deficiencies, recommendations, revision outcomes, pending actions, and relevant completion dates.

What Success Looks Like

  • Visual issues are identified early and documented clearly, enabling artists and editors to make corrections efficiently.

  • Sketches accurately reflect the approved scripts, creative briefs, brand guidelines, and intended storytelling.

  • Character designs, scene details, and visual elements remain consistent across episodes and assets.

  • QC reports and tracking records are accurate, complete, and easy for the Client and production team to use.

  • Approved sketches consistently meet quality standards and are ready for final video production and integration.

  • Recurring issues are identified and translated into practical improvements to the QC process.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in visual quality control, creative production, or reviewing visual storytelling assets.

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling principles, storyboarding, sketch composition, and narrative clarity.

  • Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail, particularly regarding character consistency, scene continuity, composition, and visual accuracy.

  • Ability to compare visual assets against scripts, creative briefs, and established guidelines.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback.

  • Strong organizational skills and experience maintaining trackers, review logs, and structured approval documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple assets, revision rounds, and deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with artists, editors, vendors, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing storyboards, sketches, animatics, illustrations, short-form videos, or other visual storytelling assets.

  • Experience with episodic storytelling, branded content, animation, or digital media production.

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Visual Arts, Animation, Media, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar software.

  • Experience working with creative vendors, illustrators, sketch artists, or animation teams.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you’ll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will:

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems, email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. jobs.title: NetSuite Systems Engineer
jobs.excerpt: LocationAs a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on.
jobs.description:
LocationAs a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland.

Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast and Ramp coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator.

What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand.

This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales

Responsibilities

  • Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast and Ramp coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health.
  • Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds.
  • Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on.
  • Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools.
  • Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration.
  • Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including:
    • configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows;
    • core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures;
    • designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations;
    • building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs;
    • managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem.
  • A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue.
  • A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools).
  • Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data.
  • Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them.
  • Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points:

  • FloQast and/or Ramp administration experience.
  • Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment.
  • Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work.
  • Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services.

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Pressable
jobs.excerpt: Pressable (“WordPress hosting that means business”) seeks an experienced, motivated, and empathetic professional with the expertise to help us meet or exceed aggressive growth goals for our superb WordPress hosting company, part of the Automattic family.
jobs.description:
Pressable (“WordPress hosting that means business”) seeks an experienced, motivated, and empathetic professional with the expertise to help us meet or exceed aggressive growth goals for our superb WordPress hosting company, part of the Automattic family.

We’re looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our sales team. This role is essential in driving the early stages of the sales process by handling inbound leads, answering questions from prospects, creating interest in our product, and setting up meetings for senior members of the team.

The role is designed to leverage AI tools to improve speed, quality, and consistency across prospect research, discovery preparation, follow-ups, and internal documentation, while keeping human judgment and relationship-building at the center of the sales process.

As a BDR, you will play a crucial role in building relationships with potential customers by understanding their needs, introducing them to our WordPress hosting solutions, and moving them through the sales funnel. You’ll be the first point of contact for many prospects, ensuring they have a positive experience with Pressable from the start.

You’ll report to the Head of Sales & Enablement and work closely with our senior sales team to ensure seamless lead handoffs and smooth onboarding experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Inbound Lead Qualification: Manage inbound leads by responding to inquiries, identifying potential opportunities, and qualifying prospects based on their needs.
  • Prospect Engagement: Create interest and excitement around Pressable’s WordPress hosting solutions through initial discovery calls, emails, and chats.
  • Meeting Scheduling: Set up and schedule meetings for senior sales team members to further engage qualified leads.
  • Product Education: Educate prospects about Pressable’s features and benefits, ensuring they understand the value of our solutions.
  • CRM Management: Track interactions with prospects, manage lead data, and update records in our CRM to ensure accurate information and follow-ups.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the senior sales team to ensure smooth handoffs for qualified leads and help drive deals forward.
  • Customer Expansion & Retention: Engage with existing Pressable customers to identify expansion opportunities, support retention efforts, and assist with account-related sales activities, ensuring customers continue to receive sales support and value as their needs evolve.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay up to date with Pressable’s product offerings, industry trends, and evolving best practices for AI-enabled sales execution and customer engagement.
  • AI-Assisted Sales Execution: Use AI tools to support prospect research, call preparation, follow-up drafting, and deal summarization, ensuring high-quality and timely customer engagement.
  • Signal & Insight Capture: Leverage call transcripts, summaries, and AI-generated insights to identify customer needs, objections, and next steps, and reflect those clearly in the CRM.
  • Feedback Loop Participation: Contribute structured feedback surfaced through AI tools (e.g., call analysis, objection trends) to improve sales playbooks, enablement, and product feedback loops.
  • Own monthly qualified meeting and pipeline generation targets, consistently hitting or exceeding defined conversion and activity benchmarks.

Requirements:

  • Excellent Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with prospects and qualify leads.
  • Customer-Focused: A passion for understanding customer needs and offering solutions to help solve their challenges.
  • Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently and manage multiple conversations and tasks at once, ensuring timely follow-ups and outreach.
  • Curiosity & Learning Mindset: A desire to learn about Pressable’s product, the managed WordPress hosting industry, and sales techniques.
  • CRM Experience: Familiarity with CRM tools (like Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and the ability to manage leads efficiently.
  • Comfort Using AI Tools: Experience using AI tools to support research, writing, summarization, or workflow efficiency in a professional setting.
  • Strong Judgment with Automation: Ability to use AI outputs critically, knowing when to rely on them and when human judgment is required.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • Proactively identify and engage target accounts aligned with Pressable’s ICP through outbound email, LinkedIn, and phone outreach, leveraging AI for research and personalization at scale.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a BDR/JDR or similar role.
  • Familiarity with WordPress and managed hosting services.
  • Proven track record of generating leads and setting up successful sales conversations.

As a part of our fully distributed team, you can live anywhere in the world. Effectiveness in this role will mean occasionally shifting hours across weekends and odd hours to best coordinate with our global team.

Perks & Benefits of Joining Pressable!

  • Health Benefits for US-based staff (99% Paid Employee Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Matching 401(k) for US-based staff
  • Life and Disability Insurance for US-based staff (100% Paid Life, & LTD)
  • Work from home with home office setup and coworking allowances
  • Open vacation policy (no set number of days per year)
  • Hardware and software, books or conferences that promote continued learning

Salary range: $50,000 - $65,000 USD, plus 25% variable compensation. Please note that whilst salary ranges are presented here in USD, we will pay in local currency.

So, are you ready to embark on this thrilling WordPress adventure? We can’t wait to welcome you to the Pressable team and empower you to help make the web a better place. Come join us in crafting an exceptional customer experience and revolutionizing the world of WordPress hosting. Apply now and let’s build something amazing together!

About Automattic

Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place.

We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automatticians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world.

We believe in Open Source, and the vast majority of our work is available under the GPL. Automattic is a Most Loved Company, an Equal Opportunity employer, and Disability Confident Committed. We are committed to ensuring an accessible hiring process for all candidates. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups.

You can track your application status and more at MyGreenhouse.

To learn about how we handle your data, please review our Job Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice and our Privacy Policy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

LocationAs a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland.

Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator.

What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand.

This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales

Responsibilities

  • Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health.
  • Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds.
  • Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on.
  • Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools.
  • Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration.
  • Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including:
    • configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows;
    • core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures;
    • designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations;
    • building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs;
    • managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem.
  • A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue.
  • A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools).
  • Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data.
  • Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them.
  • Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points:

  • FloQast administration experience.
  • Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment.
  • Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work.
  • Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

jobs.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

Why now:

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero. We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month. Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session. What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

What you will do:

  • [35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
  • [20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
  • [20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
  • [25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

What we need from you:

In your first month, you will:

  • Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
  • Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
  • Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
  • Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
  • Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
  • Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.

By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

What you need to be great at:

  • Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
  • Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
  • Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
  • In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
  • Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
  • Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
  • Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

What we are most curious about:

  • Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
  • Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
  • What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
  • Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.

Compensation: 150,000 to 190,000 USD on-target earnings (60% base, 40% variable), with guaranteed variable during ramp.

US-based, remote, near a major hub airport.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the role Muon seeks a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and develop a high-performing technical recruiting team while personally driving critical, high-priority searches.
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and develop a high-performing technical recruiting team while personally driving critical, high-priority searches. The ideal candidate is a proven player-coach who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments, brings strong business partnership and recruiting expertise, and knows how to build and scale recruiting teams to support a scaling business.

This role may be worked remotely from an approved location.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of recruiters, providing consistent feedback, mentorship, and support to drive individual growth and overall team performance.
  • Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability around recruiting activity, pipeline development, hiring outcomes, and candidate experience.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations to support recruiter growth, engagement, and continued development.
  • Personally own and drive full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of high-priority, complex, and strategic searches, from intake through offer acceptance.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to understand business priorities, workforce needs, and evolving talent requirements.
  • Bring market intelligence, talent availability, competitive insights, and data-driven recommendations to hiring managers to influence hiring strategies and drive informed decisions.
  • Lead by example through hands-on recruiting execution, demonstrating the ownership, urgency, adaptability, and accountability expected across the team.
  • Provide visibility into team capacity, hiring forecasts, recruiting performance, risks, and resource needs to support proactive workforce planning and hiring decisions.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve recruiting processes, operational efficiency, and the scalability of the talent acquisition function as the company grows.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally within a high-growth technology, engineering, aerospace, hardware, or software environment.
  • 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading recruiters, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent, manage performance, and drive team results.
  • A proven track record of personally delivering against ambitious hiring goals while effectively balancing competing priorities and business needs.
  • Experience recruiting for technical and highly specialized roles, with the ability to develop creative and effective sourcing strategies in competitive talent markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and ambiguity is part of the job.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect recruiting strategies and priorities to broader company objectives.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence, advise, and challenge hiring managers and senior leaders when necessary.
  • A data-driven approach to recruiting, with the ability to leverage metrics to identify trends, evaluate performance, assess recruiting effectiveness, and make informed decisions.
  • Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance individual recruiting responsibilities, team performance, and people management commitments.
  • A hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves mentality. You're comfortable jumping into the details, solving problems, adapting quickly, and doing whatever is needed to help the team succeed.

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Experience recruiting within the aerospace, space, defense, satellite, or advanced technology industries.
  • Experience scaling a recruiting function within a high-growth startup, ideally through Series B, Series C, or later-stage growth.
  • Experience working with a blended recruiting model, including internal recruiters, contract recruiters, RPO partners, and external agencies
  • Experience working with modern recruiting technology and tools, including Greenhouse, ModernLoop, and Metaview.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $123,000 - $170,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.
