Job title

Senior Accountant - Financial Solutions

Reports to

Accounting Manager - Financial Solutions


Note: Candidate must reside in the U.S. in Eastern or Central Time Zones.

Job Purpose

Senior Accountants at BELAY bridge day-to-day accounting execution with technical accounting expertise and client-facing financial insight. They are responsible for ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and quality of recurring accounting services across an assigned client portfolio and serve as a key accounting escalation point for Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers.

Senior Accountants independently perform and review complex accounting activities, support month-end close, analyze financial results, and help identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and client outcomes. They provide guidance and technical support to Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers while partnering closely with Accounting Managers and Controllers to ensure consistent service delivery, appropriate client communication, and alignment with engagement scope. Senior Accountants are expected to lead through expertise, accountability, coaching, and collaboration.

.Duties & Responsibilities

As a BELAY Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Client Service & Relationship Management

  • Serve as a primary accounting escalation point for day-to-day client questions, accounting issues, and complex transactions.
  • Communicate directly with clients regarding accounting matters, financial results, and recommended actions within the scope of the engagement.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and meaningful financial reporting that helps clients understand business performance and key financial metrics.
  • Identify accounting, process, or reporting challenges and recommend practical solutions.
  • Partner with the Accounting Manager or Controller to maintain client satisfaction, address scope concerns, and ensure consistent service delivery.
  • Escalate complex technical accounting matters, significant scope concerns, or client risks to the Accounting Manager or Controller as appropriate.
  • Support a seamless client experience by partnering with internal teams and connecting clients with additional BELAY resources when appropriate.

Accounting Operations & Financial Reporting

  • Execute and oversee complex recurring accounting activities, including:
    • Month-end revenue entries and clearing account reconciliations
    • Inventory and cost of goods sold reconciliations and journal entries
    • Prepaid, accrued, and deferred revenue schedules
    • Balance sheet reconciliations
    • Financial statement preparation and review
    • Variance analysis and investigation
    • Accounts payable and accounts receivable support
    • Payroll accounting and reporting support
    • Cash flow reporting and analysis support
    • Sales tax and 1099 support, as applicable
  • Review financial statements and account reconciliations to identify unusual activity, errors, or areas requiring additional investigation.
  • Analyze financial results, gross profit margins, and key performance indicators to identify trends and potential issues.
  • Maintain accurate and well-organized accounting records within QuickBooks Online and other client systems.
  • Review work prepared by Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established accounting processes.
  • Resolve accounting issues and provide technical guidance when transactions or reconciliations require additional research or judgment.
  • Ensure accounting work is completed in accordance with applicable accounting principles, internal controls, BELAY standards, and client-specific requirements.

Staff Accountant & Bookkeeper Support

  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers.
  • Review work and provide timely, constructive feedback to improve accuracy, efficiency, and accounting knowledge.
  • Coach team members through complex reconciliations, transactions, month-end issues, and client-specific accounting questions.
  • Help Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers understand the "why" behind accounting requirements and processes rather than simply correcting work.
  • Identify recurring errors, knowledge gaps, or process challenges and communicate trends to the Accounting Manager.
  • Support onboarding and cross-training of Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers by sharing technical knowledge, best practices, and client-specific processes.
  • Reinforce standardized accounting procedures and help promote consistency across the team.
  • Serve as a resource for Bookkeepers when issues require additional accounting knowledge or escalation beyond routine bookkeeping responsibilities.

Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows, efficiency, accuracy, and automation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of accounting processes, SOPs, and best practices.
  • Partner with Accounting Managers and Controllers on accounting initiatives, client transitions, and special projects.
  • Assist with client onboarding, transitions, and other projects when technical accounting support is needed.
  • Collaborate across BELAY teams to resolve issues and improve the overall client experience.
  • Demonstrate accountability, adaptability, sound judgment, and professional maturity in all interactions.

Minimum Qualifications

This role requires a motivated and trustworthy self-starter with strong communication and technological skills who thrives both independently and as part of a team. Our ideal Senior Accountant is proactive, analytical, and client-focused, with the confidence to lead accounting discussions and support the development of others.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 4-8 years of accounting experience, preferably in client-service or outsourced accounting environments
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and month-end close processes
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and related applications (e.g., BiLL, Gusto, Shopify, Amazon, Fathom, Cin7, or comparable platforms)
  • Excellent communication skills and client service orientation
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines in a remote environment
  • High attention to detail, organization, and follow-through

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or reviewing Staff Accountants or Bookkeepers
  • Experience with inventory, e-commerce, or other complex accounting environments
  • Experience with financial analysis, KPIs, cash flow, and gross margin
  • Experience identifying process improvements and implementing accounting efficiencies

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical accounting and analytical skills
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills
  • Ability to review work, identify issues, and provide constructive feedback
  • Strong client communication and relationship management skills
  • Ability to explain accounting concepts clearly to clients and team members
  • Strong coaching, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing skills
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality
  • Sound judgment and ability to recognize when issues require escalation
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies, and processes
  • Demonstrated accountability, ownership, and professional maturity

Working conditions

BELAY Corporate offers full-time remote work, requiring a dedicated, distraction-free home office for standard Monday-Friday business hours, with occasional travel for some roles. As a full-time, exempt W-2 employee, you'll join a vibrant, award-winning company culture where you're a valued, engaged team player in a thriving organization.

Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

Ways To Stand Out from the crowd:

Data governance, security and compliance

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. jobs.title: Senior Reward Manager
jobs.excerpt: About us We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
jobs.description:
About us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?
Your new roleAs Senior Reward Manager, you will own the day-to-day delivery of total reward at Digital Science - running our salary and bonus cycles, managing benefits, overseeing reward systems and data, and keeping our job architecture and pay governance accurate, compliant and consistently applied.
This is a standalone, hands-on role. The strategic foundations of our reward framework are in place; your focus is making them work reliably and efficiently for employees and managers in every country where we operate.
You will work in close partnership with the People Partners, who represent People to their functions and advise leaders on reward decisions, and with People Operations, who support reward and benefits administration. You will provide the expertise, processes, data and guardrails that enable both teams to deliver well, reporting to the SVP of People.

Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the UK, where we have an established legal entity.
If you apply from outside of this area, your application will not be considered.

Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.
Please note that this role is primarily remote within the UK, but the successful candidate will need to be able to travel to our London office (Farringdon) occasionally.

What you’ll be doing

Reward Cycle Delivery
  • Own end-to-end delivery of the annual salary review and bonus cycles – timelines, budget modelling, guidelines, manager tools, communications, approvals, payroll hand-off and post-cycle reporting – ensuring accuracy and delivery within budget.
  • Partner with Finance on reward budgets, forecasting and accruals, and with Payroll to ensure approved changes are implemented correctly and on time.
  • Manage off-cycle pay activity (ad-hoc benchmarking, promotions, market adjustments, new-hire and internal-move offers) in line with pay ranges and governance, giving timely, consistent recommendations.
  • Equip People Partners with clear guidance, tools and data so they can advise leaders confidently on reward, acting as the escalation point for complex or exceptional cases.
Reward Systems & Data
  • Own reward configuration and data integrity in our HRIS and compensation planning tools, including pay, grade and bonus data.
  • Produce regular reward reporting – pay positioning, spend against budget, bonus outcomes and cycle analytics – that Finance and People can trust and act on.
  • Run annual pay equity analysis, identifying unexplained gaps and providing costed recommendations to feed into the salary review.
  • Identify and implement system and process improvements that reduce manual effort and error across reward operations.
Benefits Delivery
  • Manage benefits providers and brokers across our operating countries, including renewals, service levels, invoicing and annual benefits cycles.
  • Own benefits processes, policies and documentation, and equip People Operations to run day-to-day benefits administration through clear procedures, training and escalation routes.
  • Review provider performance, cost and employee uptake, recommending pragmatic improvements within budget.
Job Architecture, Benchmarking & Compliance
  • Maintain DS's job architecture, levelling roles consistently and mapping new or changed roles to career levels and job families.
  • Manage external benchmarking relationships and data (e.g. Mercer, Payscale), running annual submissions and refreshing pay ranges to keep them current.
  • Develop and analyse internal pay reporting, including gender and wider pay gap data as good practice, and keep DS prepared for emerging pay transparency requirements.
  • Maintain reward policies and guidelines, ensuring they are applied consistently and understood across the business.
Service & Stakeholder Support
  • Act as the expert point of contact for reward and benefits queries, building self-service guidance and FAQs that reduce repeat questions.
  • Work with Finance, Legal and Payroll to ensure reward processes are accurate, compliant and well controlled.
Continuous Improvement and Innovation
  • Regularly identify and implement process improvements, dedicating time to refine work and boost efficiency. Be curious and inquisitive, and committed to exploring new ideas to achieve our goals.
Curiosity and External Focus
  • Stay current with industry trends, legislation and market practice, and bring in fresh ideas from external sources where they improve delivery.
  • Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we run reward – from cycle administration to analysis and employee queries – experimenting, sharing what works and adapting how we work.
Commitment to Excellence
  • Make time for personal and professional growth, engage in cross-functional and in-team knowledge and insight sharing, and consistently foster a collaborative and innovative environment.

What you’ll bring to the role

Essential:
  • Substantial hands-on experience in a reward or compensation & benefits role, including running salary and bonus review cycles end to end in a multi-country business.
  • Experience administering reward within HRIS and compensation planning tools, with a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity.
  • Experience managing employee benefits programmes and external providers or brokers across multiple countries.
  • Working knowledge of job architecture and levelling, and of market benchmarking data and methodologies (e.g. Mercer, Payscale).
  • Experience analysing pay data to identify and explain pay gaps and inequities, with an awareness of emerging pay transparency requirements.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence working with large, sensitive datasets to produce clear, accurate reporting.
  • Effective communicator who can explain reward topics simply and work credibly with People Partners, Finance, Legal and senior leaders.
  • Practical, pragmatic and self-reliant, comfortable owning delivery against fixed deadlines as a standalone specialist.
Desirable:
  • Experience working in a global business with remote and dispersed teams.
  • Knowledge of international relocation and immigration.
  • Experience in administering LTIP and commission structures.
  • Experience in a technology, SaaS or scale-up environment.
  • CIPD or other recognised reward qualification.
We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us.

Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification, let us be the judge! Studies show that many qualified candidates from under-represented groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage you to submit your application.

Living our Values

We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.
The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are:
We are brave in the pursuit of better
We are collaborative and inclusive
We are always open-minded
We are from and for the community

At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research.

We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Beyond recruitment, we strive to cultivate an environment where inclusivity is woven into the fabric of our culture, enabling everyone to be their best self and do their best work.

jobs.description:
Job Title: R1562169 Sr.Consultant(e) en sémantique des données de santé/Senior Advisor

Job Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Sr.Consultant(e) en sémantique des données de santé

À propos d’IQVIA

IQVIA est un fournisseur mondial de solutions avancées d’analytique, de technologies et de services de recherche clinique destinés au secteur des sciences de la vie. Nous combinons les données, la technologie et l’expertise afin d’aider les organisations du secteur de la santé à prendre de meilleures décisions, à accélérer l’innovation et à améliorer les résultats pour les patients.

Au sein d’IQVIA, le Centre de sémantique des données de santé offre des services-conseils et des solutions technologiques qui aident les clients à exploiter pleinement la valeur de leurs données grâce à la sémantique et à l’interopérabilité.

Aperçu du poste

Ce poste contribue au développement et à la prestation de solutions de grande qualité dans le cadre de mandats clients, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur l’accompagnement des clients dans la mise en œuvre de technologies sémantiques, de normes d’interopérabilité et d’approches axées sur les données.

Les mandats peuvent aller de l’analyse des besoins et de la résolution de problèmes au soutien du développement de solutions plus complexes. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes de projet réparties dans différentes régions ainsi qu’avec des experts du domaine dans les secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie.

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant un vif intérêt pour les données de santé, les technologies sémantiques, l’interopérabilité, les graphes de connaissances et l’intelligence artificielle (IA), ainsi que la capacité à comprendre les besoins des clients et à les traduire en solutions concrètes.

Fonctions essentielles

  • Examiner et analyser les besoins des clients et les enjeux d’affaires, et contribuer à l’élaboration de propositions.
  • Cerner les enjeux et contribuer au développement de solutions, de stratégies de mise en œuvre et de feuilles de route appropriées.
  • Évaluer la valeur commerciale potentielle des technologies et des approches sémantiques.
  • Élaborer une documentation de projet détaillée ainsi que des exigences et des spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques.
  • Soutenir les analystes et les consultants dans l’élaboration et la structuration de présentations, de recommandations et de livrables destinés aux clients.
  • Travailler avec des données provenant des secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie en utilisant les normes, les technologies sémantiques et les approches d’interopérabilité pertinentes.
  • Soutenir, lorsque pertinent, des projets portant sur des modèles sémantiques, des graphes de connaissances et des cas d’utilisation liés à l’IA.
  • Utiliser Python, SQL ou des langages similaires de script ou de requête pour traiter et analyser les données.
  • Développer ses connaissances des services-conseils, des méthodologies ainsi que des secteurs pharmaceutique, de la santé et des sciences de la vie.
  • Dans un rôle d’analyste d’affaires, valider les livrables destinés aux clients et fournir des orientations aux équipes de projet à l’étranger.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et réparties géographiquement afin de contribuer à la réussite des projets.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat requis. Un diplôme d’études supérieures ou une formation pertinente dans un domaine informatique, médical, des sciences de la vie ou dans une discipline connexe constitue un atout important.
  • De 3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, de préférence dans les secteurs de la santé et/ou des sciences de la vie.
  • Bonne compréhension des normes relatives aux données de santé et des technologies sémantiques, notamment : FHIRSNOMEDCDISCIDMPRDF/OWLPrincipes FAIR applicables aux données
  • Une expertise de niveau spécialiste dans chacun de ces domaines n’est pas requise. Les candidats doivent posséder de solides connaissances dans certains de ces domaines, ainsi qu’une compréhension plus générale de l’écosystème de la sémantique et de l’interopérabilité.
  • Compréhension de base de l’IA et des graphes de connaissances, ainsi que de leurs applications dans les secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie, y compris une culture de base en matière d’IA.
  • Capacité à travailler avec des données à l’aide de Python, SQL ou de langages similaires de script ou de requête.
  • Solides capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Capacité à traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions claires et concrètes.
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement et en collaboration avec différents intervenants au sein de l’organisation afin d’atteindre les objectifs de l’équipe et des projets.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication écrite et verbale en anglais.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion du temps, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et de respecter les échéances.
  • Une connaissance des méthodologies, des outils et des techniques de consultation pertinents au domaine fonctionnel est souhaitée.
  • Une compréhension des tendances et des développements pertinents de l’industrie ainsi que du contexte concurrentiel est souhaitée.

Ce que vous apporterez

Vous apportez votre expertise et un vif intérêt pour la sémantique et l’interopérabilité, ainsi que le désir de contribuer à l’amélioration des secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie en aidant les organisations à mieux exploiter leurs données.

Vous avez une approche collaborative et axée sur le client, de solides capacités d’analyse et la capacité de traduire des exigences complexes liées aux affaires et aux données en solutions concrètes.

Vous êtes à l’aise de travailler au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires, de contribuer à des mandats auprès des clients et de coordonner le travail entre des équipes locales et à l’étranger. Vous vous intéressez également aux technologies émergentes, notamment l’intelligence artificielle et les graphes de connaissances, et comprenez comment celles-ci peuvent compléter des environnements de données sémantiques et interopérables.

Choix de traduction : j’ai privilégié un français professionnel naturel, adapté à une offre d’emploi au Canada, tout en conservant les termes techniques reconnus comme FHIR, SNOMED, CDISC, IDMP, RDF/OWL, Python et SQL.


Sr.Health Data Semantics Consultant

About IQVIA

IQVIA is a global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We bring together data, technology, and expertise to help healthcare organizations make better decisions, accelerate innovation, and improve patient outcomes.

Job Overview

This role contributes to the development and delivery of high-quality solutions for client engagements, with a focus on helping clients implement semantic technologies, interoperability standards, and data-driven approaches.

Assignments range from requirements analysis and problem-solving to supporting the development of more complex solutions. You will collaborate with distributed project teams and subject matter experts across the healthcare and life sciences sectors.

The role is well suited to someone with a strong interest in healthcare data, semantic technologies, interoperability, knowledge graphs, and AI, combined with the ability to understand client requirements and translate them into practical solutions.

Essential Functions

  • Review and analyze client requirements and business challenges and contribute to proposal development.
  • Identify issues and contribute to the development of appropriate solutions, implementation strategies, and roadmaps.
  • Assess the potential business value of semantic technologies and approaches.
  • Develop detailed project documentation, business and technical requirements, and specifications.
  • Support Analysts and Consultants in developing and structuring presentations, recommendations, and client deliverables.
  • Work with healthcare and life sciences data using relevant standards, semantic technologies, and interoperability approaches.
  • Support projects involving semantic models, knowledge graphs, and AI-related use cases, where applicable.
  • Use Python, SQL, or similar scripting/query languages to work with and analyze data.
  • Develop knowledge of consulting services, methodologies, and the pharmaceutical, healthcare, and life sciences industries.
  • In a Business Analyst capacity, validate client deliverables and provide direction to offshore project teams.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to support successful project delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required. An advanced degree or relevant educational background in a computational, medical, life sciences, or related discipline is highly valued.
  • 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably within healthcare and/or life sciences environments.
  • Good understanding of healthcare data standards and semantic technologies, including areas such as:
    • FHIR
    • SNOMED
    • CDISC
    • IDMP
    • RDF/OWL
    • FAIR data principles
  • Specialist-level expertise across all of these areas is not expected. Candidates should have strong knowledge in selected areas while maintaining a broader understanding of the semantics and interoperability landscape.
  • Basic understanding of AI and knowledge graphs and their application within healthcare and life sciences contexts, including basic AI literacy.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear, practical solutions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Knowledge of consulting methodologies, tools, and techniques relevant to the functional area is preferred.
  • Understanding of relevant industry trends, developments, and the competitive landscape is preferred.

What You’ll Bring

You bring expertise and a strong interest in semantics and interoperability, along with a desire to improve healthcare and life sciences by helping organizations better leverage their data.

You have a collaborative and client-focused mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate complex business and data requirements into practical solutions.

You are comfortable working across multidisciplinary teams, supporting client-facing engagements, and coordinating work across onshore and offshore teams. You also bring an interest in emerging technologies, including AI and knowledge graphs, and understand how these technologies can complement semantic and interoperable data environments.

jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

﻿Most product marketing roles start with the product and work outward. This one starts with the market and works inward. You'll own the evidence behind our go-to-market decisions: who we sell to, who we compete with, how big the opportunity is, and why we win or lose.

Your work feeds positioning, launches, sales plays, and campaign targeting. AI agent security is a young category that changes quickly, so much of the job is giving the company a clear, current picture of the market.

About Zenity﻿

Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale.We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices.

Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.

Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.

What You'll Do

Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain our market model: sizing, segmentation, and the trends shaping buyer demand.
  • Track category movement, including new entrants, acquisitions, platform vendor moves, and shifts in how buyers budget for AI security.
  • Work with analyst relations to turn analyst research and inquiry into usable insight.

Competitive

  • Run the competitive program end to end: monitoring, analysis, battlecards, and rapid response when a competitor makes a move.
  • Give sellers honest guidance on where we win, where we don't, and how to handle each case in a deal.
  • Partner with Revenue Enablement to get competitive content into the field and measure whether it's used.

ICP and buyer insight

  • Define and maintain our ideal customer profile and buying committee personas, using CRM data, call recordings, and customer conversations.
  • Work with marketing ops and field marketing so that account targeting and tiering reflect the ICP.
  • Run the win/loss program, including buyer interviews, and report patterns to product, sales, and marketing leadership.

Turning insight into decisions

  • Bring market and competitive evidence into positioning, messaging, pricing and packaging discussions, and roadmap conversations with product management.
  • Publish a regular market and competitive readout for leadership.
  • Build repeatable systems, including AI-assisted workflows, so that intelligence stays current without heroic effort.

Requirements

What You've Done

  • 5+ years in product marketing, competitive intelligence, market research, or strategy at a B2B software company.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, or the technical depth to quickly become credible with security practitioners and CISOs.
  • Comfort with both quantitative work (CRM and pipeline analysis, market sizing) and qualitative work (buyer interviews, call analysis).
  • A record of competitive or market work that changed a decision, such as a positioning shift, a sales play, or a targeting change.
  • Clear, concise writing, especially when the conclusion isn't what people hoped to hear.
  • Good judgment about evidence: you know the difference between a pattern and an anecdote, and you say which one you have.

Nice to Have

  • Background in AI security, application security, identity, or cloud security.
  • Experience running a formal win/loss program.
  • Experience building workflows with AI tools for research and analysis.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be transparent, conversational, and focused on real-world experience.

  • Recruiter Screen
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Peer Interivew
  • People Team Interview
  • VP Interview

Zenity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We enable enterprises to adopt AI agents securely and at scale, and that starts with building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work, securely, confidently, and with impact.

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $180,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for equity and performance-based incentives.

jobs.description:
Social Discovery Group(SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Senior Product CRM Manager who sees CRM not as a set of campaigns, but as part of the product: a system of user communications and in-product mechanics that drives activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
This role comes with real ownership: we give you the freedom to make decisions and act on them, and you are responsible for the results.

Your main tasks will be:

  • Own the user lifecycle strategy across key stages: onboarding, activation, engagement, monetization, retention, and reactivation.
  • Find growth opportunities through product analytics, user behavior data, CJM, funnels, and cohort analysis, and turn them into prioritized hypotheses with estimated business impact.
  • Design and run a steady stream of experiments across CRM and in-product channels: from the hypothesis and impact estimate to mockups, stakeholder approvals, and launch. Come up with new touchpoints and mechanics to engage users.
  • Own the results: evaluate experiments against control groups, measure the incremental effect on revenue, LTV, ARPPU, and conversion, and turn the findings into conclusions, recommendations and new hypotheses.
  • Work as part of cross-functional product teams together with product managers, UX/UI designers, developers, and data analysts; present your findings and recommendations to stakeholders and influence the product roadmap with CRM insights.
  • Initiate improvements to the CRM infrastructure and data: event tracking, segmentation, personalization and recommendation logic, new channels and mechanics.
  • Automate routine work and streamline team processes, using AI tools where they help.

We expect from you:

  • 4+ years of experience in CRM / lifecycle marketing or product growth, preferably in B2C digital products (mobile apps, subscription or freemium models, social/dating products are a big plus).
  • Proven track record of CRM initiatives with measurable impact on product metrics: retention, LTV, ARPPU, conversion.
  • Strong product thinking: ability to work with funnels, cohorts, CJM, and to formulate and prioritize hypotheses.
  • Solid experience with A/B testing: experiment design, control groups, statistical significance, uplift evaluation.
  • Experience writing product and experiment requirements and working with development teams in Jira / Confluence.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM/CDP systems.
  • Experience with data analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Tableau, Superset) to work with data independently.
  • Understanding of both channel metrics (OR, CTR, CTOR, unsub rate) and business metrics (revenue, ARPPU, LTV, retention, churn).
  • Strong command of both Russian and English (B2+).

How you think and work:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking: you question assumptions, double-check the data, and look for root causes rather than surface-level explanations.
  • You communicate your ideas clearly and simply to any stakeholder, from developers and analysts to senior management.
  • You know how to prioritize your work: you focus on what has the biggest impact and can explain why.
  • You build well-reasoned, data-backed arguments and defend them, but change your mind when the evidence says so.
  • You see feedback as a chance to improve, keep raising your professional bar, and collaborate well with others.
  • You take ownership, make decisions, and drive them to results without step-by-step guidance.
  • You actively use AI to automate routine tasks and work more efficiently, while staying critical of its output and checking it against the data, your own experience, and your vision.

What do we offer:

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time;
  • The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
  • 50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings;
  • Corporate discount for English lessons;
  • ​Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
  • ​Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
  • Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

jobs.description:
Senior In-House Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist

Location: Remote — Latin America
Employment Type: Full-time, independent contractor
Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours
Base Compensation: USD $2,000 – $3,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience
Performance Bonus: USD $300 per successful hire
Reports To: Founder & CEO

About the Company

Our client is a growing, seven-figure digital marketing agency that helps home-service businesses scale. The agency serves clients across the United States, Canada, and Australia through Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, web development, and other digital marketing services.

Its international remote team is expanding, and the founder is now bringing recruitment in-house.

The Opportunity

The company is looking for a proactive, results-driven recruiter and headhunter to own sourcing, screening, candidate evaluation, and hiring.

This is not a job-posting-only position. Success requires direct outreach to passive talent, excellent organization, proactive communication, and independent follow-through.

Initial hiring volume is approximately 2-3 positions per quarter, with quality prioritized over volume. You will initially focus on internal hiring, with potential future expansion into recruiting for the agency’s clients. You will also have the opportunity to shape and scale the recruiting function using modern tools and automation.

What You’ll Do

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Headhunting

  • Own searches from intake and sourcing strategy through screening, candidate presentation, and successful hire.
  • Identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, direct outreach, referrals, and other channels.
  • Build targeted talent pools and maintain consistent, thoughtful follow-up.
  • Conduct structured interviews to assess skills, experience, English communication, and culture fit.
  • Coordinate Predictive Index assessments and role-specific assignments when applicable.
  • Present qualified candidates to the founder with clear evaluations and evidence-based recommendations.

Recruiting Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate records, interview notes, pipeline stages, and next steps.
  • Build a reusable database of vetted candidates for future openings.
  • Track outreach, candidate quality, pipeline progression, and hiring outcomes.
  • Improve recruiting documentation, scorecards, workflows, and interview processes.
  • Partner with the founder and automation team to streamline recruiting using AI and automation tools.

Communication & Execution

  • Work reliably during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours, with consistent punctuality and attendance.
  • Stay actively engaged and responsive on Slack throughout the scheduled workday.
  • Provide proactive status updates, flag delays early, and communicate next steps without being chased.
  • Meet agreed deadlines and follow through on candidate communications and commitments.
  • Take ownership of problems and propose solutions independently.

Roles You Will Recruit For

Web designers and developers, AI and automation engineers, SEO specialists, Google Ads and Meta Ads specialists, client success managers, operations professionals, video editors, sales closers, and other specialized digital marketing and technical roles.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Learn the existing recruiting systems, tools, standards, and open requisitions.
  • Establish consistent, targeted sourcing and outbound outreach.
  • Build qualified candidate pipelines and maintain accurate tracking.
  • Demonstrate dependable Slack communication, organization, and proactive reporting.

First 60–90 Days

  • Complete at least one high-quality hire during the initial ramp period.
  • Present genuinely qualified candidates who meet both technical and behavioral requirements.
  • Manage recruiting activities and follow-ups independently.
  • Begin building a reusable database of vetted candidates.

Long Term

  • Consistently deliver quality hires across specialized roles.
  • Improve recruiting workflows, documentation, and automation alongside the founder and technical team.
  • Build a talent network that reduces the need to start each search from scratch.
  • Potentially support recruitment for the agency’s clients as the function expands.

Who Will Thrive Here

Someone who enjoys proactive headhunting, takes pride in precision, follows through without reminders, stays engaged with colleagues throughout the day, and consistently delivers. If you combine strong sourcing skills with exceptional attention to detail, urgency, and accountability, we would love to hear from you.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, talent acquisition, or headhunting, including proactive candidate sourcing.
  • Strong LinkedIn sourcing and outreach skills.
  • Experience conducting structured interviews and assessing candidate fit beyond résumé keywords.
  • Ability to manage recruitment pipelines, interviews, assessments, and candidate follow-up independently.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, recruitment CRMs, and candidate documentation.
  • Excellent spoken and written English for interviews and communication with U.S.-based leadership.
  • Based in Latin America and able to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Personal Attributes (Non-Negotiable)

  • High drive and initiative: You move quickly, source candidates consistently, and take action without waiting for reminders.
  • Exceptional attention to detail: You maintain accurate information, catch errors, and never lose track of critical follow-ups.
  • Accountability and reliability: You honor commitments, meet deadlines, and communicate obstacles before they become problems.
  • Slack responsiveness and schedule discipline: You stay engaged during working hours and respond promptly to time-sensitive requests.
  • Ownership and independence: You solve problems, prioritize effectively, accept direct feedback, and deliver without constant supervision.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter or Recruiter Lite.
  • Recruiting experience in digital marketing agencies, particularly across both marketing and technical/IT roles.
  • Experience in fast-paced recruiting agencies or in-house talent acquisition.
  • Experience sourcing talent across LATAM and other international remote markets.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Workable, Predictive Index, and recruiting scorecards.
  • Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, and recruiting automation or process design.
  • Experience working directly with founders or executive leadership.
    Over 4 years of professional experience in recruiting and talent acquisition.

Benefits

  • Monthly compensation of USD $2,000 – $3,000, depending on qualifications and experience.
  • Performance bonus of USD $300 for each successful hire.
  • Fully remote, LATAM-based contractor opportunity.
  • Flexible, as-needed time off, coordinated proactively and communicated clearly.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder and meaningful ownership of recruiting operations.
  • The opportunity to shape and scale the recruiting function using modern tools, AI, and automation.
  • Room to grow, with potential expansion into recruiting for the agency’s clients as the function develops.

About Red Door Collaborative

Red Door Collaborative is a creative agency serving enterprise tech organizations and SMBs with visual design, content, motion, and video work. We're a small, human-centered team: highly collaborative, quietly intense, and genuinely good at what we do. We're also evolving. AI is reshaping our industry, and we're leaning into it as a tool that enhances our work rather than replaces the people doing it.

We're rooted in SoCal and the PNW, but we're a fully remote team of creatives. We work Pacific hours and meet in person rarely. This is a real remote role, not a "remote for now" situation. This role requires someone who can take a brief and storyboard, share work in progress through Frame.io and Microsoft Teams, and turn feedback into finished animation on schedule.

About the Role

We're looking for freelance motion designers to join our bench of individual collaborators on project work for enterprise technology clients: bumpers, motion graphics and animation, explainer videos, and UI walkthroughs.

This role is motion and animation, not video editing or live-action production. Work comes in by project. Our Sr. Creative Strategist, Motion Design briefs and reviews the work, and a Creative Project Manager keeps it on schedule.

What You'll Do

  • Bumpers and motion graphics: Design and animate bumpers, intros and outros, lower thirds, and branded motion elements that hold up across a client's whole content library.
  • Explainer videos: Bring scripts and storyboards to life with 2D and 3D animation that makes complex technology products easy to understand.
  • UI walkthroughs: Animate product interfaces and workflows so viewers can follow how software actually works.
  • Revisions and delivery: Take feedback from our team and client reviewers, turn revisions quickly, and deliver final files to spec.

Who You Are

  • Experience: You have 4+ years of professional motion design experience, and a reel that shows it.
  • After Effects: You're highly proficient in Adobe After Effects.
  • Cinema 4D: Strong Cinema 4D skills are a major advantage. Much of our explainer and product work benefits from 3D.
  • Technology clients: You've animated for B2B or technology brands, and you're comfortable making complex products visually clear.
  • Independence: You manage your own schedule and deliver on agreed deadlines without needing reminders.
  • AI-forward: Red Door is an AI-forward agency. You're curious about AI-assisted tools in motion workflows and look for new ways to put them to use.

Before You Apply

Consider the following before applying:

  • If your reel is mostly live-action video editing rather than motion and animation…
  • If you're looking for steady, full-time hours rather than project-based work…
  • If animating software interfaces and product workflows sounds tedious rather than interesting…

Then this probably isn't the right role for you.

To Apply

In your cover letter, point us to one piece on your reel and tell us what problem the motion solved for the viewer. Include a link to your reel. We'd rather hear your honest take than a polished answer.

During the process, we may ask you to walk us through your reel: what you made, the decisions behind it, and what you'd change now. Finalists will be asked to provide references from creatives they've worked with directly.

Compensation

This is a freelance, project-based engagement, not employment. Each project is paid at a flat rate agreed in writing before work starts, based on the deliverables, finished length, and complexity of the work, and on your experience. Individual collaborators are not eligible for employee benefits.

Equal Opportunity

Red Door Collaborative is committed to building an inclusive team where everyone is valued and respected. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We don't just welcome diverse perspectives; we actively seek them out. People from different cultures and experiences, solving problems together, is how we do our best work.

jobs.description:
Fonction

En tant qu'UX Designer expérimenté, vous concevez des interfaces conviviales et faites évoluer l'expérience utilisateur des applications.

Vous accordez une attention particulière à la maintenance et au développement du Design System. Vous veillez à ce que ses composants, modèles et directives restent cohérents, accessibles et à jour, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans leur utilisation.

Vous participez à l'analyse des besoins et développez une bonne compréhension des utilisateurs et de leur environnement afin de définir les exigences des applications.

Vous sélectionnez et planifiez les méthodes de recherche, puis participez au recrutement des participants afin de recueillir les informations nécessaires au moyen d'entretiens, d'enquêtes, de focus groups et de tests utilisateurs.

Sur cette base, vous proposez la solution la plus adaptée et concevez des interfaces low et high fidelity selon une approche de prototypage mobile-first.

Vous accompagnez les analystes et les développeurs dans la conception des interfaces utilisateur. Vous vous assurez que les applications développées répondent aux exigences des utilisateurs et de leur environnement.

Vous veillez également au respect des normes d'accessibilité dans la conception graphique des applications.

Grâce à votre expérience dans la conception, la gestion et la maintenance des Design Systems, vous contribuez activement à leur évolution. Tout au long des projets, vous entretenez une communication régulière et efficace avec les clients et l'équipe.

Vous êtes bilingue en français et en néerlandais.

Les candidatures sans portfolio ne seront pas prises en considération.

Functie

Als ervaren UX Designer ontwerp je gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces en verbeter je voortdurend de gebruikerservaring van toepassingen en websites.

Je hebt bijzondere aandacht voor het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het Design System. Je zorgt ervoor dat componenten, patronen en richtlijnen consistent, toegankelijk en up-to-date blijven en ondersteunt teams bij het correcte gebruik ervan.

Je neemt deel aan de behoeftenanalyse en zorgt ervoor dat je de gebruikers en hun omgeving goed kent, zodat je de vereisten van de toepassingen nauwkeurig kunt bepalen.

Je bepaalt en plant de onderzoeksmethoden en helpt bij het werven van deelnemers om de nodige informatie te verzamelen via interviews, enquêtes, focusgroepen en gebruikerstests.

Je stelt de meest geschikte oplossing voor en ontwerpt low- en high-fidelityinterfaces volgens een mobile-first aanpak.

Je begeleidt analisten en ontwikkelaars bij het ontwerp van gebruikersinterfaces en ziet erop toe dat de ontwikkelde applicaties voldoen aan de vereisten van de gebruikers en hun omgeving.

Je bewaakt de naleving van toegankelijkheidsrichtlijnen en UX/UI-standaarden.

Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en onderhouden van Design Systems en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Doorheen de projecten onderhoud je een regelmatige en doeltreffende communicatie met klanten en teamleden.

Je bent tweetalig in het Nederlands en Frans.

Sollicitaties zonder portfolio worden niet in aanmerking genomen.

📝 Votre profil

Je beschikt over een bevestigde ervaring als UX Designer en over de volgende vaardigheden:

  • Ontwerptools: Figma, Sketch, Mockplus of een gelijkwaardig alternatief
  • Toegankelijkheid: WCAG 2.1
  • Prototyping: ervaring met low- en high-fidelityprototypes en een mobile-first aanpak
  • Talen: Nederlands, Engels en Frans

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. jobs.title: Markets and Trading Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Monocle Monocle Solutions is a people-centric management consulting firm specialising in banking and financial services, with offices in South Africa, the UK, and the Netherlands.
jobs.description:
About Monocle

Monocle Solutions is a people-centric management consulting firm specialising in banking and financial services, with offices in South Africa, the UK, and the Netherlands. We deliver end-to-end solutions across risk, finance, compliance, data, and technology for some of the world's leading financial institutions.

At Monocle, we believe work is more than a job. It is a chance to make a difference in the world of finance. An opportunity to fulfil your potential. To make friendships with ambitious, positive, likeminded people. To gain invaluable industry experience and learn critical skills that will make you a highly sought-after management consultant.

We understand that our greatest asset is our people and because of this, we do things a bit differently.

Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Markets and Trading Specialist to support Structured Solutions trading and Front Office technology environments. The successful candidate will combine deep cross-asset product knowledge with hands-on experience in trading and risk platforms, business and systems analysis, Front Office IT Production support, process improvement and data analysis.

This is a delivery-focused role for an individual who can work directly with traders and collaborate across Market Risk, Credit Risk, Quantitative Analytics and technology teams. The person will help resolve daily trade booking, valuation, profit-and-loss, risk and system-stability issues, while contributing to the continued development of the technology and operating capability supporting a rapidly growing/evolving Structured Solutions trading business.

Core Responsibilities

  • Provide front-line functional and analytical support to Structured Solutions traders across trade capture, valuation, profit-and-loss, risk and system-stability queries. Investigate trade bookings, the configuration and valuation of products, yield curves, market data and risk differences, determine root causes and coordinate resolution with the appropriate business and technology teams.
  • Work with traders, quantitative analysts, Market Risk, Credit Risk and developers to define, analyse, test and implement new structured products, pricing capabilities and risk engine enhancements.
  • Elicit and document business, functional, data and non-functional requirements and translate these into clear specifications, process flows, test scenarios and implementation artefacts.
  • Experience in working with the configuration, support and enhancement of trading and risk platforms and products, such as FIS Front Arena, Murex, Calypso or comparable in-house developed systems.
  • Analyse front-to-back workflows and dependencies across Front Office, Middle Office, Risk, Operations and Technology, identifying opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen controls.
  • Perform data analysis and reconciliations to explain trade, P&L, valuation and risk outcomes.
  • Plan and execute functional, regression, integration and user-acceptance testing, including defect analysis and evidence management.
  • Support implementations, upgrades, migrations and production releases, including business readiness, documentation, training, go-live and post-implementation support.
  • Produce high-quality system, process and support documentation and transfer knowledge to client teams and less experienced consultants.
  • Operate effectively in a high-pressure Front Office trading environment, prioritising critical incidents while maintaining accuracy, control and clear stakeholder communication.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Finance, Investment Management, Financial Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Professional credentials such as CFA, FRM, PRM, CQF, ACI or SAIFM qualifications are advantageous but not mandatory where the candidate has equivalent practical experience.
  • Have at least 8 years of relevant experience in Global Markets, Capital Markets, Structured Solutions, Front Office IT, trading systems or a closely related environment.
  • Demonstrate substantial hands-on experience supporting or delivering change for traders and trading-desk technology, rather than only general banking or project experience.
  • Have strong cross-asset product knowledge, including several of the following: Fixed Income, Interest Rate Derivatives, Exotic Derivatives, Counterparty Credit Risk, FX Derivatives, and Commodity Derivatives.
  • Understand derivative pricing and valuation concepts, yield curve calibration, market data, risk sensitivities, profit-and-loss and risk measures sufficiently to investigate complex Front Office issues.
  • Have practical experience with at least one enterprise trading or risk platform such as Front Arena, Murex or Calypso, or a sophisticated in-house pricing and risk engine.
  • Be able to bridge business and technology, communicate with traders and quantitative analysts, and translate complex requirements into implementable solutions.
  • Possess strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills, with the resilience and attention to detail required for production support and time-critical delivery.

Experience and Product Knowledge

  • Structured/Exotic products and cross-asset derivatives, ideally spanning Interest Rates, FX, Credit and Commodity Derivatives, XVA
  • Front Office business support and development, including trade booking, P&L and risk investigation and resolution of production issues.
  • Derivative valuation, yield curve construction/calibration, market data dependencies and model or configuration impacts.
  • Counterparty credit risk and valuation adjustments such as XVA, together with exposure, limit and risk-engine concepts.
  • Trading and risk platform implementation, configuration, upgrade, migration or production support. Strong hands-on experience in Front Arena, Murex, Calypso or a comparable cross-asset platform or bespoke risk engine.
  • Business and systems analysis: requirements elicitation, process mapping, functional specification, data mapping and acceptance criteria.
  • Testing and implementation: test design, defect investigation, regression and UAT support, release readiness, cutover and post-production support.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world’s leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We’re an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

Our Values

Customers

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

Action

We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

About the Role

The Director, Revenue is a critical leadership role responsible for owning Billtrust’s global revenue accounting function and the integrity of its revenue recognition. You will leverage AI tools and co-worker agents to automate reconciliation, exception detection, and variance reporting, focusing your expertise on technical revenue accounting, internal control design, and team development.

This role leads a global team of people managers and revenue accounting professionals, and partners across Sales, Legal, FP&A, and IT to structure compliant deals, drive process improvement, and shape the future revenue technology stack. You will be the senior technical voice on revenue accounting, defending positions with auditors and advising Accounting leadership on the most complex matters.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Accounting & Technical Compliance

  • Own the global revenue accounting function and monthly revenue close in accordance with ASC 606, U.S. GAAP, and Billtrust’s revenue recognition policies, using AI tools and co-worker agents to automate reconciliation, exception detection, and variance reporting
  • Drive the initiative to reduce month-end close time by automating manual revenue processes and transitioning toward accrual-based close methodologies
  • Review and approve accounting conclusions for standard and non-standard customer contracts, including SSP studies, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent considerations, exercising sound judgment and defending positions to stakeholders and auditors
  • Other duties as assigned.

Controls & Audit

  • Design, implement, and enhance internal controls over revenue to ensure SOX compliance and clean integrated audits
  • Oversee supporting documentation for quarterly and annual external revenue audits, including SSP studies, journal entries, and reconciliations

Cross-Functional Partnership & Technology

  • Partner with Sales and Legal on the revenue recognition implications of contract negotiations and on deal structures that comply with revenue recognition rules
  • Partner with FP&A to review monthly revenue trends and anomalies, and develop board-level materials and reporting commentary
  • Consult with Accounting Leadership on complex or non-standard revenue accounting matters, and represent Revenue in evaluations of the revenue technology stack

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop people managers and a global team of revenue accounting professionals, setting performance goals, conducting reviews, and building career paths for direct and indirect reports
  • Hire, train, and retain a skilled team of accounting professionals
  • Build team capability in AI-assisted workflows to improve accuracy and throughput across the revenue close

What You’ll Bring

Required Skills:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting and revenue recognition
  • Extensive technical accounting knowledge of ASC 606 in a SaaS environment, including contract modifications, principal vs. agent considerations, and SSP studies
  • Demonstrated experience managing people managers and building global, distributed teams
  • Experience with ERP systems (Sage Intacct or equivalent) and CRM platforms (Salesforce)
  • Track record designing and implementing SOX-compliant internal controls over revenue
  • Track record driving AI adoption across a team or function
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, with strong analytical and interpersonal skills

Preferred Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting
  • Experience at a ‘Big 4’ audit firm on public company audits
  • Prior involvement in ERP or revenue system evaluation and migration
  • Well-honed attention to detail and demonstrated ability to prioritize and delegate in a fast-paced environment
The expected base salary range for this position is $170,000 - $200,000 annually.
Compensation may vary depending on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, competencies, and geographic location. Some roles may qualify for additional incentives like equity, commissions, or other variable performance-related bonuses. Further details will be provided by our Talent Acquisition team during the interview process.

What You’ll Get

At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.

At Billtrust, we value an equitable and inclusive work environment and strive to build and foster diverse teams. Even if your work experience doesn’t align exactly with the position requirements, we’d still love to hear from you. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that celebrates and supports diversity and inclusion. We make all employment and related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Physician Assistant (PA) – Chronic Care Management & Remote Patient Monitoring

Position Summary

At TeleMate Health, we are dedicated to transforming healthcare delivery through innovative solutions. Our mission is to provide a level of monitoring and clinical intervention unique to healthcare that fills gaps in care. We deliver individualized, holistic patient care while connecting in a way that’s effective for the patient. We are seeking a compassionate and patient-focused Physician Assistant (PA) to join our growing care management team.

As a TeleMate Health PA, you will conduct initial patient assessments, develop individualized care plans, provide chronic disease and medication management education, and support patients enrolled in Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs. The position will include follow-up and as-needed visits to help patients achieve better health outcomes and successfully manage their chronic conditions.     • Medication reconciliation and review

  • Collaborate closely with care managers, nurses, providers, specialists, pharmacists, and other members of the healthcare team.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Passion for preventive care and chronic disease management.

Beginne ein neues Kapitel – werde Teil unserer Bibliothekscommunity!

Bibliotheken sind dynamische Wissenszentren und Orte der Begegnung, die einen unschätzbaren Beitrag zur Gesellschaft leisten. Wir fördern Bildung, Informationsfreiheit und lebenslanges Lernen.   • Praktikum: Du möchtest schon während der Schulzeit oder des Studiums Praxiserfahrung sammeln? Ein Praktikum bietet Dir spannende Einblicke in das vielseitige Arbeitsumfeld der Bibliotheken und hilft Dir, wertvolle Kontakte zu knüpfen.

  • Studium der Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft: Vom Bachelor bis zur Promotion erwarten Dich spannende Inhalte und Spezialisierungen in einem Berufsfeld, das auch international gefragt ist. Du erwirbst Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie Medienwissenschaft, IT, Pädagogik oder Recht und Politik.
  • Berufseinstieg & Weiterentwicklung: Mit Deiner Erfahrung kannst Du in der Bibliothekswelt durchstarten. Ob Karriereplanung, Weiterbildung, Auslandsaufenthalt oder Projekt- und Verbandsarbeit – wir bieten Dir die Chance, Deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich langfristig zu entwickeln.
  • Fachexpert:innen & Quereinstieg: Du bringst wertvolle Erfahrungen aus anderen Bereichen mit oder hast einen spezialisierten Abschluss? Unsere Bibliotheken freuen sich auf Deine Expertise und Deine frischen Ideen! Wir unterstützen Dich mit individuellen Fortbildungsangeboten für Deinen erfolgreichen Einstieg in die Bibliothekswelt.

Aufgaben

Was Dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Vielfalt und Wertschätzung: Unsere Bibliotheken stehen für Offenheit und fördern die Teilhabe aller. Hier bist Du willkommen – mit all Deinen Fähigkeiten und Talenten.
  • Eine Arbeit, die Sinn stiftet: Dein Job trägt zur Wissensvermittlung und Förderung der Medienkompetenz bei, um Menschen den Zugang zu Bildung und Informationen zu ermöglichen. Damit stärken wir gemeinsam die Grundvoraussetzung für eine lebendige Demokratie.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten: Von der Medienbeschaffung über digitale Katalogisierung bis hin zur Organisation von Veranstaltungen und Workshops – hier wird es garantiert nicht langweilig. Zudem arbeitest Du an innovativen Projekten und hilfst bei der Umsetzung neuer Services.
  • Work-Life-Balance & Sicherheit: Eine sichere Beschäftigung im öffentlichen Dienst, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und ein werteorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld geben Dir Rückhalt. Wir unterstützen Dich auch bei der Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.
  • Nachhaltigkeit & Digitalisierung: Bibliotheken setzen auf umweltbewusstes Arbeiten und digitale Innovationen, um den Anforderungen der Zukunft gerecht zu werden. Dies umfasst auch die Förderung von nachhaltigen Projekten und Initiativen.
  • Zusätzliche Benefits des öffentlichen Dienstes: In vielen Bibliotheken kannst Du von attraktiven Zusatzleistungen profitieren, die typisch für den öffentlichen Dienst sind. Hierzu zählen z. B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, gesundheitsfördernde Maßnahmen, diverse Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote, Jobticket und andere Mobilitätsangebote.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst:

  • Serviceorientierung & Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne mit vielfältigen Menschen zusammen, beantwortest Fragen geduldig und hilfst mit Freude und Respekt weiter.
  • Begeisterung für Wissen & Kultur: Bibliotheken sind der Dreh- und Angelpunkt für Bildung und Wissensvermittlung. Wenn Du für Wissen, Information und Medien brennst, bist Du hier richtig.
  • Flexibilität & Lernbereitschaft: Die digitale Transformation und sich ändernde Bedürfnisse der Bibliotheksbesuchenden erfordern Anpassungsfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen.
  • Teamgeist: Arbeiten in der Bibliothek bedeutet Zusammenhalt. Wir schätzen offene Kommunikation und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander, bei dem jeder seine Stärken einbringt.

Dein Interesse ist geweckt?

Erfahre mehr über Einstieg und Karriere im Berufsfeld Bibliothek auf unserem Webportal: meinjob-bibliothek. de. Dort erhältst Du umfassende Informationen zu Ausbildungs- und Studienmöglichkeiten, Quereinstiegen und aktuellen Stellenangeboten - deutschlandweit.

Über das verlinkte Jobportal BiblioJobs kannst Du Dich auch direkt über konkrete Ausbildungsplätze und Stellen in Bibliotheken informieren und Dich bewerben. jobs.description:
Join Points of Light and Change the World

As the world’s largest organization dedicated to increasing volunteer service, Points of Light engages more than 3.8 million volunteers across 32 countries.

Cast from the vision of one thousand points of light shared by its founder, President George H.W. Bush, in his 1989 inaugural address, Points of Light was founded in 1990 as an independent, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization to encourage and empower the spirit of service. The organization extends President Bush’s vision that “any definition of a successful life must include serving others.” Today, Points of Light continues to transcend politics and borders to inspire millions of individuals worldwide to take action.

Join Us: Be part of a movement that changes lives and communities. Please read the position description below. For more information, visit pointsoflight.org.

Salary Range:$55,000 - $60,000 Annually

Reports to:SVP, Development

Department:Development

Location: Points of Light is a remote-first organization. Any U.S. location in the Eastern or Central time zone in a market with a major airport. Washington, DC preferred.

Position Summary: The Manager, Prospect Research plays a critical role in advancing Points of Light’s fundraising efforts by leading donor intelligence, pipeline development, and data-informed prospecting strategies. This position provides comprehensive research and analysis on individuals, corporations, and foundations to enhance donor engagement and support high-capacity donor identification and qualification. Working closely with frontline fundraisers, senior leadership, and the Development Operations team, the Manager ensures a robust and dynamic prospect pipeline, supports strategic donor segmentation, and facilitates the seamless integration of research insights into Points of Light’s overall development strategy.

Position Functions and Responsibilities Include:

  • Prospect Identification: Proactively identify and qualify new individual, corporate, and foundation prospects with high capacity to give, using a combination of internal engagement data (e.g., event participation, volunteer involvement, digital interactions), subscription databases (e.g., iWave, LinkedIn, Candid, RelSci), and public data sources (e.g., news media, SEC filings, real estate records). Prioritize leads aligned with Points of Light’s mission, values, and fundraising strategies.
  • Research & Briefings: Conduct in-depth donor and prospect research using internal systems and external databases to prepare qualification summaries, briefings, profiles, and event lookbooks for the CEO, Chief Development Officer (CDO), and frontline fundraisers. Deliver concise, timely insights to support donor engagement, cultivation, and solicitation strategies.
  • Donor Intelligence & Network Monitoring: Monitor philanthropic trends, sector news, and organizational networks to surface timely opportunities and identify potential connections between Points of Light board members, senior leadership, and prospective donors.
  • Moves Management & Meeting Facilitation: Facilitate and manage regular prospect strategy and moves management meetings with frontline fundraisers and senior leadership to review pipeline progress, assess donor engagement strategies, and ensure alignment with organizational fundraising goals. Prepare meeting agendas, surface key insights, and track portfolio activity to support timely and coordinated donor movement.
  • Portfolio & Data Support: Support CRM data integrity, research tracking, and wealth screening integration by partnering with Development Operations to ensure prospect ratings, research notes, screening results, and engagement details are accurately recorded and consistently leveraged within the system.
  • Resource Library & Team Training: Train development staff on prospect research methodologies—including, but not limited to, ethics, compliance, and the effective use of subscription-based tools—to support confident, responsible, and consistent application of research practices across the team. Maintain a shared library of research templates, best practices, and training materials to strengthen internal capacity.
  • Tools & Vendor Recommendations: In collaboration with the Senior Director of Development Operations, evaluate and recommend research tools, data subscriptions, and vendors to ensure the development team has access to cost-effective, high-impact resources that support strategic fundraising.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
