jobs.excerpt: Who We Are We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.

Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.

About the Role

Personified is seeking a strategic, hands-on VP, People & Business Operations to help lead our next stage of growth.

Reporting directly to the CEO with a dotted line to the SVP of Finance, this senior leadership role will oversee our internal business operations and People function while working collaboratively with the executive team, and department leaders to improve operational performance, strengthen accountability, and build scalable infrastructure.

A core focus of this position will be developing and maintaining visibility into resource utilization, workforce capacity, staffing requirements, and operational efficiency across our managed services business. This includes owning the company's time tracking standards and using time data to inform staffing, pricing, and resourcing decisions.

The VP will partner closely with CTO and service delivery leaders to ensure our resources, processes, and organizational structure support both current client commitments and anticipated growth. While delivery leaders retain ownership of technical execution and day-to-day client service delivery, this role will establish the planning frameworks, reporting, and cross-functional processes that support effective operational decisions.

The VP will also provide strategic leadership of the People function, overseeing workforce planning, recruiting, company culture, employee development, performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness, supported by dedicated HR resources.

We're looking for someone who combines senior-level strategic thinking with a roll-up-your-sleeves approach. This person should be comfortable building structure, challenging existing processes, navigating ambiguity, and turning business priorities into measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Business Operations & Organizational Leadership
    • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of company-wide retreats, offsites, and internal events, staff meetings, internal communication and ensuring alignment with organizational goals, employee engagement, and company culture.
    • Own the company's internal meeting cadence, including weekly team meetings, manager and all-staff meetings, and the presentations and materials that support them. Lead these meetings and design agendas that drive organizational excellence, with clear priorities, follow-through on commitments, and alignment across teams.
    • Partner with the CEO and Finance to prepare board reports and investor materials, owning the People and Operational sections.
    • Act as a business partner to department leads, facilitating cross-functional alignment on workflows, shared challenges, resourcing, and decisions.
    • Interpret utilization reports and lead capacity and pod planning with delivery leaders.
    • Track progress against operational goals and ensure challenges are escalated and addressed proactively.
    • Set company-wide time tracking standards and expectations, analyze time data to surface utilization, capacity, and service profitability trends, and hold department leaders accountable for meeting those standards. Day-to-day time tracking logistics, such as timesheet reminders, approvals, and tool administration, remain with department leads and support staff.
  • People Strategy, HR Leadership & Organizational Development
    • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the People function, including management and development of HR team members.
    • Directly manage the part-time Recruiting Coordinator, who administers Breezy, runs initial candidate screens, manages the candidate pipeline and reporting, and supports hiring managers through each hiring drive.
    • Develop and execute a People strategy that supports organizational growth, employee engagement, and a high-performing, inclusive culture.
    • Oversee recruiting, onboarding and offboarding processes, employee development, performance management, and employee relations.
    • Partner with executive leadership and hiring managers to establish workforce plans, recruiting priorities, and staffing strategies aligned with business needs.
    • Lead the annual performance review and goal-setting processes, ensuring consistency, accountability, and meaningful employee development.
    • Coach and support managers on performance management, employee relations, leadership development, and team effectiveness.
    • Oversee compensation frameworks, salary bands, benefits programs, employee policies, and HR infrastructure in partnership with Finance and external advisors.
    • Ensure employee relations matters are addressed consistently, confidentially, and in accordance with company policies and applicable employment laws.
    • Serve as the senior point of contact for employees on HR policies, benefits, and workplace concerns, and maintain feedback channels such as engagement surveys and exit interviews.
    • Support organizational change management, employee communications, engagement initiatives, and culture-building programs.
    • Oversee HR administration, employee documentation, HR systems (Justworks, Culture Amp, Breezy, and Notion, including the HR Hub and company policies), compliance requirements, employee compliance training, and recurring People processes through the HR team.
    • Partner with Finance, Legal, and external providers on employment compliance, benefits administration, and HR-related risk management. Serve as backup to Finance on payroll and Justworks administration.
  • Operational Systems, Automation & Process Improvement
    • Evaluate and improve internal systems, tools, and workflows to support efficiency, accountability, and business scalability. This role owns how our people systems (Justworks, Culture Amp, Breezy, and Notion) are used in day-to-day workflows. Technical administration of Halo, Google Workspace, and other IT systems stays with the technical team, with this role consulted and kept informed.
    • Develop standardized operating procedures, process documentation, and clear ownership of recurring business activities.
    • Lead implementation and change management efforts for new operational tools, policies, and workflows.
    • Ensure operational data is reliable, accessible, and actionable for department leaders and executive leadership.
    • Build systems and processes that reduce dependency on individual knowledge and support sustainable growth.

Experience & Background

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in business operations, organizational leadership, or a related field, including experience in a senior leadership role.
  • Experience in a managed services provider (MSP), IT services, professional services, or another recurring-revenue, service-based organization strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable operational processes and leading cross-functional initiatives in a growing organization.
  • Strong experience with resource utilization, time tracking analysis, capacity planning, workforce forecasting, and operational performance management.
  • Proven ability to translate operational data into staffing recommendations, process improvements, and measurable business results.
  • Experience overseeing People Operations or HR functions, including management of HR professionals and partnership with senior leadership on workforce strategy.
  • Strong understanding of operational KPIs, labor efficiency, staffing models, and service delivery economics.
  • Experience with HRIS tools and people systems such as Justworks, Culture Amp, and Breezy, reporting dashboards, and workflow automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with senior leaders across technical, operational, financial, and People functions.
  • Experience in a remote-first, high-growth, or entrepreneurial environment is preferred.

Skills + Traits to Succeed at Personified

  • Strategic and hands-on: Able to think at the senior level while remaining willing to get into the details and drive execution.
  • Analytical and data-driven: Comfortable interpreting operational metrics and translating them into practical decisions.
  • Systems minded: Naturally identifies opportunities to build structure, streamline processes, and improve scalability.
  • People centered: Understands the relationship between organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and business performance.
  • Accountable: Takes ownership, follows through, and drives initiatives to completion.
  • Collaborative: Builds strong partnerships across departments and leads through influence as well as direct authority.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in an evolving organization where roles, priorities, and processes continue to develop.
  • Clear communicator: Able to drive alignment, navigate complex conversations, and lead organizational change.
  • Practical problem solver: Brings sound judgment, resourcefulness, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Benefits

  • Healthcare packages contributed to by Personified
  • Optional 401K matched by Personified
  • Cell phone stipend
  • Annual learning & development stipend

Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Senior Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

  • Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.
  • Maintain a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce; provide weekly pipeline reviews and revenue projections.
  • Develop targeted account strategies for key prospects in retail, manufacturing, logistics, financial services, and other enterprise verticals.
  • Identify and pursue net-new logos while deepening relationships and expanding wallet share within existing accounts.

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
  • Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
  • Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

  • Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
  • Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
  • Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.

Strongly Preferred

We're looking for a talented, versatile AI Product & Automation Engineer to help us build the next generation of AI-powered products, intelligent agents, business automation solutions, and core platform capabilities.

Our AI capabilities are still at an early stage, providing an exciting opportunity to influence our technical direction, architecture, and tooling.

While AI development will be a primary focus, this is not an AI-exclusive position. You'll be an active member of our wider engineering team, with opportunities to contribute to core product development as priorities evolve.

Job Title: Sr Statistical Programmer - CPRD

Job Location: London, Greater London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Provide advanced technical and scientific expertise in statistical programming with a focus on secondary database and real-world evidence (RWE) studies utilizing UK healthcare data sources, including CPRD. Lead the design, development, and implementation of programming solutions to support complex observational research projects for strategic clients. Serve as a subject matter expert in secondary database analytics, providing technical leadership, mentoring, and consultation to project teams while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of client commitments.


Essential Functions


  • Perform, plan, and coordinate programming activities for complex observational, epidemiological, and real-world evidence studies utilizing large healthcare databases, including CPRD and other secondary data sources.
  • Lead the programming, testing, validation, and documentation of statistical programs used for analysis datasets, statistical outputs, data quality reviews, and study deliverables.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in CPRD data structures, coding methodologies, and best practices for secondary database research.
  • Design and develop efficient programming solutions for complex longitudinal healthcare data, including patient cohort identification, data transformation, exposure and outcome derivation, and analytical dataset creation.
  • Collaborate with biostatisticians, epidemiologists, data scientists, and clients to translate study objectives into robust programming and analytical solutions.
  • Lead integration and harmonization of datasets from multiple healthcare data sources.
  • Develop, review, and maintain programming specifications, validation plans, and technical documentation for complex studies.
  • Provide advanced technical consultation to internal and external stakeholders regarding study methodology, database capabilities, and data limitations.
  • Support business development activities by contributing technical expertise to proposals, feasibility assessments, and study design discussions involving secondary databases and real-world data.
  • Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and development of reusable programming tools, macros, and standards for secondary database studies.
  • Act as Statistical Programming Lead on complex projects or portfolios, ensuring delivery quality, timelines, resource planning, and client satisfaction.
  • Support project budgeting, effort estimation, resource forecasting, and management of scope changes.
  • Mentor and train junior programmers and contribute to the growth of secondary database programming capabilities across the organization.
Required Education & Experience
  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Life Sciences, Epidemiology, Data Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience; OR
  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field with 6+ years of relevant experience; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Required Skills & Experience
  • Strong experience in statistical programming within Real-World Evidence (RWE), Observational Research, Health Outcomes Research, or Secondary Database Studies.
  • Demonstrated expertise working with CPRD and/or other large healthcare databases and electronic healthcare records.
  • Advanced proficiency in SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS Macro Language, SAS SQL, and data manipulation techniques.
  • Experience developing complex analytical datasets from longitudinal healthcare or claims databases.
  • Strong understanding of epidemiological study designs, healthcare data structures, and observational research methodologies.
  • Experience leading statistical programming activities for complex studies and interacting directly with clients.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to mentor team members and provide technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with UK healthcare datasets, including CPRD, HES, ONS, or other linked real-world data sources.
  • Knowledge of pharmacoepidemiology, drug safety, health economics, or outcomes research.
  • Experience supporting strategic client programs and large-scale secondary database portfolios.
  • Experience with additional analytical tools such as R, Python, SQL, or cloud-based data environments.

You will translate market and customer insights into strategies that attract, engage, and nurture priority corporate audiences and accounts, creating stronger pathways from market awareness and engagement to qualified opportunities and pipeline.

A critical part of this role will be developing a sophisticated understanding of how research-driven organizations operate and how trusted information supports business outcomes. You will develop expertise across key corporate markets and use cases, including Corporate Learning, Business and Finance Research, and STEM fields, identifying the distinct buyers, users, research workflows, information needs, and buying journeys within them.

You will partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and other teams to identify opportunities for growth, bring new products and capabilities to market, acquire and nurture engaged corporate accounts, and translate the depth, quality, and breadth of EBSCO’s research content into compelling business value.

What You'll Do

  • Own product marketing strategy for EBSCO’s Corporate Research Content portfolio, including segmentation, positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategies, inbound marketing approaches that drive growth and strengthen EBSCO’s position within research-driven organizations.
  • Build expertise across key corporate verticals and use cases, including Corporate Learning, Business and Finance Research, and STEM fields, understanding their distinct market dynamics, research workflows, information needs, buyers, users, buying journeys, and growth opportunities.
  • Lead market segmentation and prioritization, using market data, customer insights, business potential, engagement data, and competitive dynamics to identify and size priority industries, segments, use cases, audiences, and accounts and translate those insights into differentiated go-to-market strategies.
  • Develop differentiated positioning, value propositions, and messaging that connect EBSCO’s research content and solutions to meaningful business outcomes, from professional development to improving business decisions to accelerating scientific research and innovation.
  • Develop inbound marketing and account engagement strategies that attract and nurture priority corporate audiences and accounts, using buyer needs, content engagement, behavioral signals, and customer journey stages to create stronger pathways from awareness and engagement to qualified opportunities and Sales activity.
  • Connect content and thought leadership strategy to customer acquisition and pipeline growth, identifying the topics and translating them into content, webinars, campaigns, and other programs that generate meaningful engagement and move prospective customers toward consideration.
  • Understand and leverage artificial intelligence, monitoring how AI is reshaping corporate research, knowledge work, learning, and information discovery while using AI-powered tools to improve product marketing effectiveness.
  • Establish and track measures of go-to-market success across priority verticals and segments, using audience and account engagement, customer acquisition, pipeline contribution, campaign performance, sales feedback, adoption, and business results to continuously optimize strategy.

Your Team

You will be part of EBSCO Information Services’ Marketing organization and play a key role in shaping how EBSCO brings its research content and solutions to corporate and research-driven organizations.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and other teams to connect market and customer insights with product strategy, audience engagement, and go-to-market execution.

About You

  • 5+ years of B2B product marketing or related experience, with a demonstrated track record of developing market segmentation and go-to-market strategies, positioning complex products, engaging B2B audiences, enabling sales teams, supporting launches, and driving adoption and business growth.
  • Ability to quickly develop expertise across specialized markets and technical domains, understand differences in customers and research workflows, and translate that knowledge into actionable product marketing strategies.

  • Strong customer and market orientation and seek to deeply understand customer problems, workflows, organizational structures, buying criteria, behaviors, and information needs.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and can communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively across executive presentations, strategic briefs, customer-facing messaging, thought leadership, content, and sales enablement.
  • Confidently articulate a point of view, facilitate strategic discussions, and build trusted relationships across Product, Sales, Marketing, customers, and industry stakeholders.

What sets you apart

  • A background marketing subscription-based or enterprise information products and services within B2B markets.
  • Familiarity with one or more relevant markets, including Corporate Learning, Business and Finance, STEM, R&D, knowledge management, or corporate research. Exposure across multiple verticals is a plus, but deep expertise in every market is not expected.

Responsibilities

Noblis is working with FAA to manage large and complex telecommunications and information management programs that use state of the art technologies to deliver enterprise infrastructure services essential to the safe and efficient operation of the largest, safest, and most complex aviation system in the world. We are seeking smart, passionate, and motivated people to join our proven team in a challenging and rewarding work environment where you will be actively engaged at the intersection of technology and operations enhancing our nation’s aviation system. If you want to be involved in acquiring, implementing, and managing the communications and information solutions to achieve our nation’s aviation vision, this is the job for you!

Enterprise Information Display System (E-IDS) is a new system under development that will provide a modern auxiliary information display to Air Traffic Controllers in the National Airspace System (NAS). E-IDS will consolidate several legacy IDS systems into a common platform to provide controllers with current and consistent information needed to perform air traffic operations from both local and enterprise sources. E-IDS will use a common hardware and software platform across over 400 NAS facilities, including En Route, Terminal, Tower, and Offshore domains.Come and be a part of our dynamic team, where your contributions will not only advance the aviation industry but also contribute to a safer, more sustainable future in air travel. Apply now and take flight towards a rewarding career that promises growth, innovation, and collaboration at the forefront of aviation technology.

The primary focus of this role is designing, building, and configuring information displays for Air Traffic Controllers using the E-IDS platform.

Key Areas of Focus:

  • ATC Display Development: Build and configure customized displays for Air Traffic Control users, including selecting, assigning, and arranging widgets based on operational needs.
  • UI/UX: Apply user interface and user experience principles to develop intuitive, functional displays that support ATC operations.
  • Widget Configuration and Data Integration: Utilize the E-IDS toolset to configure widgets, connect them to appropriate datasets, and ensure accurate presentation of operational information.
  • ATC Domain Expertise: Demonstrate extensive knowledge of Air Traffic Control operations, workflows, and information requirements to understand what controllers need to see on their displays.
  • E-IDS Modernization: Support the implementation of E-IDS, which will consolidate and replace five legacy information display systems with a modern, standardized platform.

Please Note: This role is eligible for remote work. However, candidates must successfully complete both a Noblis and FAA government suitability background investigation and clearance process prior to employment. This process may require in-person appointments.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with ATC information display systems, display configuration, widget integration, and a strong understanding of ATC operational requirements.
  • Deep ATC domain knowledge is essential to successfully translating controller needs into effective display configurations.
  • U.S. Citizen or Green Card Permanent Resident who has resided in the U.S. for 3+ years 
  • Ability to obtain FAA Suitability Clearance
  • Ability to Travel up to 50%

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Information Systems or related field with 15-19 years experience.

Substitution:

  • 5 years of relevant experience may be substituted for the Bachelor's Degree.
  • Master's Degree or MBA in related field may be substituted for Bachelor's degree and 3 years experience.

Desired Qualifications

  • Legacy IDS Technical understanding, system engineering, development, system integration and test experience.
  • Experience in building legacy IDS databases.
  • Experience in troubleshooting legacy IDS operational issues.
  • Experience with UI/UX design, E-IDS or legacy IDS platforms, widget-based display development, data integration, and modernization of FAA Air Traffic Control systems.
  • Hands-on, ATC-focused display development and configuration

Overview

Noblis and our wholly owned subsidiaries, Noblis ESI and Noblis MSD, take on some of the nation’s toughest challenges, delivering advanced solutions to our customers’ most critical missions. We bring together leading scientific, engineering, and management expertise in a culture grounded in objectivity and collaboration, ensuring our work creates lasting impact across federal missions.

jobs.description:
Join Sapiens as our Lead Business Value Delivery Architect / Lead Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in taking client-facing insurance solutions from the sales cycle through delivery and into SaaS and AI platform migration, holding every engagement to a designed business outcome rather than an evolving list of requirements.

This is a role that sits between presales and delivery and stays engaged across both, spanning P&C, Life, and in future Reinsurance, with a particular focus on the non functional and operational requirements our industry consistently under-invests in. If you are deeply fluent in insurance product suites and platform roadmaps, comfortable holding both a head of claims and an engineer in the same conversation, and driven to keep clients and internal teams honest to the outcomes they signed up for - we'd love to hear from you.

What we are looking for

You have a strong track record of designing or leading solution design in complex, enterprise-scale P&C insurance implementations, ideally across both presales and delivery. Extensive, hands-on P&C experience is essential for this role.
  • Deep P&C domain expertise across policy administration, underwriting, billing and claims, covering personal, commercial and/or specialty lines. Exposure to Reinsurance or the London Market is a plus.
  • Able to speak credibly to both a Head of Claims or Underwriting and an engineer.
  • Strong on non-functional and operational requirements, not only functional design: performance, scale, availability, security, integration and operability.
  • Proven ability to keep internal teams and clients aligned to agreed business outcomes. This accountability is central to the role, so it is a required skill, not just a welcome personality trait.
  • Experience with, or strong aptitude for, migrating P&C legacy or core systems to SaaS, including policy and claims data conversion.
  • Comfortable working in a function that is still being built. Process and tooling will be defined alongside the first deals.
  • Ideally, hands-on experience with cloud-native platforms and a proven track record at Born-in-the-Cloud (BIC) companies, bringing modern SaaS delivery practices to a global enterprise environment.
  • Skilled at using AI-driven tools and platforms to design, optimise and scale enterprise solution architectures.

What you will do:

You'll own the professional and content thread of the solution end to end – across four connected areas of impact:

Value Definition – Presales solution design

  • Engage during the sales cycle, from general discovery through down select, to build product and industry context on the opportunity.
  • Frame the solution around the client's business outcomes, not a requirements checklist. Map what they are trying to achieve to what the platform actually delivers.
  • Establish a business outcome baseline with the client: what they will be able to do post go live that they cannot do today, and how both sides will measure it.
  • Own the definition of done, agreed jointly with the client.
  • Explicitly cover non functional and operational requirements: performance, scale, availability, security, integration, data migration, operability, and support, rather than leaving them to surface in build.
  • Feed into the implementation plan: the right order of implementation and the known dependencies, especially those on the client.
  • Where the platform does not meet the client's expected outcomes, own the resolution with Product and R&D. Either secure a commitment to build it into the core platform, with timelines aligned accordingly, or design it into the extension layer shipped with the core. The SA owns these conversations.
  • Act as the next layer of depth behind the presales and industry expert team. Presales surfaces the opportunity, the SA architects the solution.
  • Support the bid with clearly stated assumptions. The fixed price commercial construct itself is owned by Sales and the PD.

Delivery integrity

  • Move into rapid planning immediately after signing. Harden the solution against what the platform delivers, steering toward standard configuration over bespoke build.
  • Hand over a clear, documented solution design to the delivery team at the start of build, and safeguard the integrity of that design through delivery.
  • Hold all parties, internal teams and the client, accountable to the agreed business outcomes and how they will be achieved. This is outcome and professional accountability. The PM or PD holds delivery and the client to scope, timeline, and commitments.
  • Stay engaged through quarterly business reviews to catch outcome or value drift early.
  • Apply the definition of done. The project is complete only when the client is positioned to realise the value agreed at the outset, not simply when the system goes live.

Migration

  • For assigned clients, own migration outcomes through the analyse, dispose, bridge, and migrate framework, across the existing product portfolio and beyond.
  • Define, with each client, the specific value the migration unlocks and the KPIs that will confirm it. Migration is a value conversation, not only a technical one.

Tooling, AI, and continuous improvement

  • Serve as the first internal customer for AI in delivery, and own the tools and the standard for how they are used.
  • Set which source wins when inputs conflict: signed document over email, email over deck, deck over verbal.
  • Set what a human must verify in AI drafted work, rather than approve on sight.
  • Flag what the inputs do not say: tacit process, stakeholder disagreement, edge cases, not just what the AI summarised.
  • Work as part of the SA group to improve processes, outputs, and tools for quicker, better implementations, especially the SaaS migration factory, including a feedback loop from delivery back to discovery to recalibrate where discovery got the scope wrong.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Every signed programme has a documented, client agreed business outcome baseline, a joint definition of done, and go live success criteria.
  • Non functional and operational requirements are surfaced and designed in up front, not discovered in build.
  • Platform gaps are resolved deliberately, through a core platform commitment or an extension layer build, rather than emerging during delivery.
  • Delivery builds to the handed over design with minimal rework driven by scope or requirements ambiguity.
  • The SA group's processes, tools, and outputs measurably shorten implementations over time.

jobs.description:
Hiring Firm: Oakwell Private Wealth Management
Hiring Manager: Brian Luper -

Oakwell Private Wealth Management is hiring its first Portfolio and Trading Specialist. This position will be PERMANENTLY REMOTE. The firm’s investment strategy is institutionalized through its Investment Committee and professionally managed models; your job is the layer where strategy becomes reality for households with significant taxable assets, concentrated and legacy positions, embedded gains, trusts, executive compensation, and customized Investment Policy Statement requirements. The models and the investment strategy belong to the Investment Committee, and the firm’s outsourced Chief Investment Officer. This role owns their implementation, not their selection. Roughly fifty households are expected to qualify.

You will work at the individual tax lot level, alongside experienced advisors who own the client relationship, building and executing each household’s implementation strategy from transition through ongoing management. Technology does the broad watching: systems monitor portfolios systematically, and you review the exceptions and opportunities they surface, applying the judgment an algorithm cannot, such as an upcoming withdrawal, a charitable intention, or a family’s intention for a legacy holding. One person is accountable for implementation from beginning to end. That person is you. The week is weighted toward household implementation, with a defined block reserved for firmwide trade quality.

Salary and Benefits

  • Base salary of $90K-120K, plus a quarterly bonus plan tied to implementation quality: plans completed and kept on schedule, error and exception rates, and documentation completeness, alongside firm performance.
  • Firm pays 75 percent of health care cost for the employee, with a 401(k) and company match.
  • Twenty days of paid time off plus additional firm holidays.
  • Cross-trained backup coverage, so that time away is real and the firm’s two-week continuity standard is met.
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Permanently remote position

What You Will Own

  • Complex position strategies. Written, multi-year diversification plans for concentrated and low-basis positions, executed within each client’s capital gains budget, paired with loss harvesting. Conservative hedging under a dedicated options procedure is a later-phase capability of the Portfolio Strategist rather than a first-year responsibility.
  • Tax-aware implementation. Systematic tax loss harvesting with household-wide wash sale tracking, tax-aware rebalancing within defined bands, asset location across taxable, tax-deferred, and Roth accounts, and multi-year tax-budgeted allocation transitions.
  • Transitions and client situations. Tax-aware transition plans prepared before assets move, and implementation plans for real life: a business sale, an inheritance, retirement income, a large withdrawal.
  • Firmwide trading. Trade ticket review and reconciliation across the firm’s accounts on a cadence confirmed through capacity validation and phased in as household implementation stabilizes, error documentation and escalation, and provider coordination, one accountable owner for the details that protect every client.
  • Advisor partnership. Implementation strategy documents and plain-language education support for every qualifying household, with proactive briefings when milestones, risks, or opportunities need attention.
  • The operating documentation. The procedures, household logs, and implementation records that make this function the firm’s rather than one person’s, documented to a standard that lets a successor assume the role.
  • Priority under pressure. Daily reconciliation carries a deadline and household tax work does not. The role specification names in writing what yields first when volume spikes, and who covers it.

What You Bring

  • Seven to ten years in portfolio implementation, trading, or investment operations at a registered investment advisor, wealth manager, trust company, or asset manager.
  • Hands-on experience with rebalancing and trading platforms (Orion Eclipse, Tamarac, iRebal, or similar) and major custodial platforms; Schwab and Fidelity strongly preferred.
  • Working fluency in tax lot accounting, wash sale rules, capital gains management, and tax-aware trading mechanics.
  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, accounting, or a related field.
  • A documented-process mindset where accuracy, fairness, and efficiency take priority over speed, and the discipline to escalate rather than improvise.
  • Series 65 or investment adviser representative registration.
  • CFA, CIMA, or CFP not required but encouraged to apply.
  • Experience hedging concentrated positions with covered calls, protective puts, or collars is valued, and supports a later-phase capability rather than a first-year duty.
  • Employment is subject to the firm’s Code of Ethics, personal trading pre-clearance, outside business activity disclosure, and a background check.

What Success Looks Like

  • First ninety days. The trading SOP learned end to end, reconciliation running clean, and implementation plans drafted for the first wave of qualifying households.
  • First year. Every qualifying household on a written implementation plan, harvesting and household-wide wash sale surveillance running on the agreed cadence, and the first transition wave complete.
  • Throughout. Errors and exceptions documented and resolved, realized gains managed inside each household’s budget, and advisors briefed before they have to ask.

The role reports to Financial Planning Manager, with investment oversight from the Investment Committee. Trade authority, approval thresholds, and escalation are defined in the role specification.

The Process

Qualified candidates will start the process by having a 15- to 30-minute zoom interview conducted by our consultant (the hiring manager for this position). If there is ground to move forward, you will be asked to fill out a Career History Form and if you are selected to advance in the process, you will meet with the firm. Qualified candidates will be asked to take assessments.

Ideal Start Date: January 2027

We are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Digital Marketing & Lead Generation ManagerRemote | Construction & RemodelingGreat design gets attention.
jobs.description:
Senior Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Manager
Remote | Construction & Remodeling
Great design gets attention. Great marketing brings in the right customers. We’re looking for someone who can do both.
About the Opportunity
We’re a small construction and remodeling company with a great team and ambitious growth goals. We’re hiring an experienced, hands-on marketing professional to lead our marketing strategy, create compelling content, manage advertising, grow our online communities, and generate a consistent flow of high-quality leads.
This is more than a social media posting position. We need someone who can develop the plan, execute it, track the numbers, and explain how marketing contributes to real business opportunities.
You should be creative, analytical, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership. You enjoy working remotely, collaborating with a team, and finding better ways to reach the right customers.
Your mission: Turn our work, reputation, and marketing investment into qualified inquiries, booked consultations, and opportunities for profitable projects.
What You’ll Own
Marketing Strategy & Lead Generation
Develop and execute an integrated marketing plan across paid advertising, organic social media, community groups, local search, referral initiatives, and follow-up campaigns.
Identify the audiences, service areas, project types, and messages most likely to produce worthwhile opportunities. Bring fresh ideas, prioritize the strongest opportunities, and adjust campaigns to support our sales goals and production capacity.
We want an ambitious marketer who pursues growth with urgency—not someone who waits to be told what to post.
Google Ads & Paid Social Advertising
Hands-on Google Ads experience is required. You must be comfortable building, managing, troubleshooting, and improving campaigns—not simply reviewing reports from an outside agency.
Manage Google Ads and paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, including campaign structure, keyword research, negative keywords, geographic targeting, audiences, ad copy, creative testing, conversion tracking, and budget allocation.
Monitor ad spend, budget pacing, campaign health, analytics, and lead quality daily. Identify wasted spend and tracking problems quickly. Make purposeful, data-backed adjustments while giving tests enough time and evidence to evaluate fairly.
Operate within approved budgets and clearly explain where additional investment is—or is not—justified.
Graphic Design, Content & Social Media
Create professional, engaging graphics, advertisements, short-form videos, reels, project spotlights, and other marketing materials.
Build and manage an organized content calendar with consistent organic posts, strong messaging, and clear calls to action. Turn real project photos, before-and-after images, customer stories, and team expertise into content that builds trust.
Coordinate with our field team to obtain useful photos and video footage. Manage publishing, comments, messages, and timely handoffs of customer inquiries.
A strong design portfolio and excellent writing skills are essential.
Community Groups & Audience Growth
Manage and grow company-owned groups and expand our participation in relevant local, homeowner, neighborhood, and community groups.
Maintain an active posting and engagement plan for each group, tailored to its audience and rules. Build relationships, contribute useful information, respond to remodeling questions, and identify opportunities for genuine conversations with potential customers.
We want meaningful community engagement and qualified inquiries—not repetitive promotional posts, spam, or follower counts without business value.
Tracking, Analytics & Lead Quality
Maintain reliable tracking from the first marketing interaction through inquiry, qualification, booked appointment, and—working with sales—sold project.
Use our customer relationship management system, advertising platforms, and analytics tools to show which activities are producing real opportunities. Monitor calls, forms, and lead routing, and help identify where good inquiries are getting lost.
Provide clear weekly reporting that answers:
  • What did we spend, and what did it produce?
  • Which sources delivered qualified leads and booked appointments?
  • What are we changing next, and why?
Work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality, appointment outcomes, and lost opportunities. Do not stop at reporting clicks or form submissions.
AI-Assisted Marketing & Advertising
Use AI tools thoughtfully to support research, creative development, ad variations, video editing, reporting, and marketing automation.
Understand AI-assisted advertising features and how to evaluate their performance, set appropriate controls, and recognize when human judgment is needed.
We’re looking for practical experience—not just familiarity with AI-generated captions. Be ready to explain where you have used AI, what you personally managed, and what improved.
Review AI-assisted work for accuracy, protect customer information, and never present fabricated testimonials or AI-generated projects as our completed work.
Local Visibility, Website Conversion & Brand Standards
Manage or coordinate local search visibility, Google Business Profile activity, review-request initiatives, and improvements to approved website content, landing pages, and lead forms.
Develop appropriate follow-up and re-engagement campaigns in coordination with sales. Support referral partnerships and other promising lead-generation opportunities.
Keep messaging consistent, respect approved service territories, and follow applicable brand, franchise, platform, and company requirements. Maintain organized company-controlled accounts, creative files, tracking tools, and access records.
What You Bring
  • A proven record of generating quality leads. Experience in construction, remodeling, home services, or another high-consideration local-service business is strongly preferred.
  • Direct Google Ads and paid social experience. You have personally managed campaigns and can explain the budgets, decisions, and results.
  • Strong graphic design and content skills. You can create polished work using Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, or comparable tools, including basic short-form video editing.
  • Strong measurement skills. You are comfortable with Google Analytics 4, conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager or equivalent tools, CRM reporting, and connecting marketing activity to business outcomes.
  • Community-building experience. You know how to grow and engage relevant groups without relying on spam or empty activity.
  • Remote-work ownership. You communicate clearly, meet deadlines, organize your priorities, and collaborate well without needing constant direction.
A degree is not a substitute for demonstrated results. Show us what you have built, what you have improved, and what you personally contributed.
What Success Looks Like
We care about the right leads—not simply more leads.
For us, a qualified lead is a real homeowner or authorized decision-maker in our service area, seeking a service we offer, with a project that reasonably fits our scope, budget expectations, and timing.
Together, we will establish realistic performance targets based on our advertising budget, baseline results, service areas, and capacity. Your scorecard will emphasize qualified lead volume, cost per qualified lead, booked consultations, appointment quality, and attributable sales outcomes—not just reach, likes, or inexpensive form fills.
You will own marketing performance and work closely with sales on follow-up and conversion. We expect clear visibility into both what marketing is producing and what happens after a lead arrives.
With the right person, we will all be celebrating together! We love having talented rainmakers on our team. We have developed an incentive plan for sold leads that you generate.
Serious and qualified inquires only please!

jobs.excerpt: The bit about us We’re Hyve, a global events company that does things differently.
jobs.description:
The bit about us

We’re Hyve, a global events company that does things differently.

Our events deliver game-changing impact for people, businesses and beyond. That might mean winning a major contract, securing transformational investment, getting on the shelves of a giant retailer or hearing from thought leaders who are changing the future. The purpose of every one of our events is to bring the people who power major industries together – and open a world of potential.

At the same time, we’re using our events as platforms for progress, to drive the conversation across the world’s biggest industries on crucial topics like sustainability, diversity and ethical business.

These moments can change lives. And making those connections motivates us every single day.

But creating those human connections doesn’t just happen at our events. It’s part of everyday life when you work at Hyve. There are all sorts of socials, inclusion workshops and professional development opportunities to get your teeth into. And then there are the benefits. From gym memberships to private medical care, season ticket loans to healthy pensions, we’ve got you covered in all kinds of ways. (We’ll even give you an extra day off on your birthday!)

The bit about you

First of all, whatever your background and whatever your beliefs, there’s a culture of belonging here at Hyve and everyone is welcome. The question isn’t where you are from – it’s where you want to go.

We’re a positive bunch and if you’re a “glass half full” kind of person you’ll fit right in. Our values are brilliant work, fresh thinking, rich connections, and collective buzz. And just to be clear, these aren’t just words we put on the walls and forget about. They pull everyone together and help us all produce work that we’re proud to put our names to. If that resonates with you, great: we’re on the same page.

The bit about the division

Global Ventures is Hyve’s dedicated accelerator unit which launches new events and supercharges new ventures. This is where event launches are born and new products are accelerated, powered by obsessive customer focus, rapid experimentation, simple decision-making and entrepreneurial energy. We're small, fast and allergic to unnecessary process. We’re a fast-moving team, so a substantial part of your role will evolve beyond this job description; you’ll be trusted to take ownership, make decisions and tackle whatever your event needs to succeed.

The bit about the role

Chain of Events is behind some of the most commercially ambitious events in AI and blockchain, including RAISE Summit, MACHINA and Signal Week. Following its acquisition by Hyve Group, we’re looking for an exceptional commercial leader to build and drive MACHINA’s go-to-market engine - while acting as a connector and force multiplier across Hyve’s Global Ventures portfolio.

This is much more than a single-event role. You’ll bring teams together across sales, marketing, product and operations; turn insight into action; and transfer the playbooks, skills and commercial discipline that help new ventures scale faster.
Global Ventures is Hyve’s dedicated accelerator: the place where new event concepts are launched and high-potential businesses are supercharged. It combines the pace and ownership of a start-up with the reach and resources of a global group - powered by obsessive customer focus, rapid experimentation, simple decision-making and entrepreneurial energy.

This is a pure outbound role. You are not responsible for inbound. Your focus is building and running campaigns that convert cold contacts into conversations, using AI agent workflows, smart data, and sharp copy as your primary tools. If you are energised by seeing a sequence you built result in a meeting with a company that becomes a sponsor, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound sequences & campaign architecture
  • Build, deploy and optimise outbound campaigns - you own the sequence from first touch to booked meeting.
  • Multi-channel campaign architecture - email, LinkedIn, and any channel that converts. You decide the mix, the timing, and the message for each campaign.
  • Own the full funnel from campaign launch to booked meeting - we care about meetings generated, not sends or replies - we'll support you with the tools, data, and feedback loops to make sure the campaigns you build are converting.
  • Messaging strategy and copy direction - own the testing roadmap. Continuously iterate on what converts to meetings, not what gets opens.
  • AI agent workflows as default - use AI for research, personalisation and outreach as standard operating procedure, not as occasional add-ons. You should be building workflows that would take an SDR hours in minutes.
Data-driven outreach
  • Target list construction - source and pull target account and contact data using existing tools to build campaign-specific lists, working closely with the team to make sure targeting is sharp before any sequence goes out.
  • Enrolment logic - define and automate which contacts enter which sequences based on ICP score, data signals and funnel stage. No contact enrolled in the wrong sequence, no duplicate sends.
  • ICP scoring and segmentation - apply and adjust scoring models and segmentation logic in HubSpot to keep campaigns targeting the right accounts at the right moment.
  • Account Smart Mapping - map multiple ICP contacts per target account across seniority levels. AEs should never be working a single thread into a key account.
  • Data quality governance - maintain enrichment coverage above threshold and audit records on a regular cycle, so the team always has clean, reliable data to work from.
  • Buying committee research - surface full decision-making units per account, automated via enrichment tools where possible, manual review for the highest-priority targets.
Infrastructure & tooling
  • Domain and mailbox warm-up - you will own sender reputation and inbox placement, with full visibility into performance so you can stay ahead of any deliverability issues before they affect campaigns.
  • Day-to-day tool management - own the outreach tool stack (Lemlist, Instantly, Klenty, Alta, Artisan and equivalents). Keep it running, keep it optimised.
  • Weekly growth and deliverability report - reply rates, inbox placement, meetings booked, campaign-attributed pipeline. You will have a clear view of performance and share that with leadership each week.

Skills and expertise required

  • 2+ years’ experience in GTM engineering, growth or outbound-focused roles, ideally within events, media or B2B SaaS
  • Strong commercial acumen - you understand how GTM activity translates into qualified pipeline, revenue and long-term customer value
  • A demonstrable track record of building outbound sequences that book high-quality meetings, rather than simply generate activity
  • Hands-on experience managing outbound email infrastructure using Lemlist, Instantly, Smartlead or equivalent platforms
  • Strong working knowledge of data enrichment tools and processes, including Clay, waterfall enrichment and contact and account-data quality
  • Confident HubSpot capability - you can build workflows, refine scoring models and interpret performance reports without external support
  • An AI-native approach to outreach, using AI agents for research, personalisation and workflow automation as part of your day-to-day work
  • Excellent commercial copywriting skills, with the ability to create precise, relevant messaging that converts without relying on volume
  • A curious, experimental mindset - you test new approaches, identify what works and use data and customer feedback to improve performance quickly
  • The ability to distil new learning into clear, repeatable playbooks and teach others how to apply it across different ventures and markets
  • A natural cross-functional collaborator who can connect sales, marketing, product and operations, transferring knowledge and raising capability across Global Ventures
  • A self-directed approach - you can identify what needs to be built, take ownership and move forward confidently while remaining connected to the wider team
  • Familiarity with the AI industry and media landscape would be a strong advantage

Why this role
  • You will own the outbound engine for events that attract the most commercially active companies in AI and blockchain globally - the ICP is strong and the product sells itself to the right contacts
  • Your output is directly visible - a meeting you book today can become a six-figure sponsorship by end of quarter
  • Compensation is tied to commercial outcome, not activity - you are rewarded for what closes, not what you send
  • The tool stack is modern and you will have input into what gets added - no legacy CRM debt or spreadsheet-based prospecting

Ready to make some great experiences? Your Hyve adventure begins with one click-Apply now!

About Red Door Collaborative

Red Door Collaborative is a creative agency serving enterprise tech organizations and SMBs with visual design, content, motion, and video work. We're a small, human-centered team: highly collaborative, quietly intense, and genuinely good at what we do. We're also evolving. AI is reshaping our industry, and we're leaning into it as a tool that enhances our work rather than replaces the people doing it.

We're rooted in SoCal and the PNW, but we're a fully remote team of creatives. We work Pacific hours and meet in person rarely. This is a real remote role, not a "remote for now" situation. This role requires someone who can keep a publishing calendar moving from a distance, writing, scheduling, and gathering assets and approvals from designers, strategists, and leadership over Microsoft Teams without waiting to be chased.

About the Role

We're hiring a Social Media Writer & Content Specialist to write and manage social and content work for Red Door and for our clients. You'll write short-form social copy and manage the full slate of posts, announcements, blogs, and articles, from the calendar to the moment each piece goes live.

You'll report to our Sr. Creative Strategist, Content and Marketing, and work closely with our designers and motion artists on the visuals that go with your posts. The volume rises and falls with our internal and client project load, so you'll plan ahead and adjust the calendar as priorities shift.

What You'll Do

  • Social writing: Write short-form copy for LinkedIn, YouTube, and other major platforms: posts, captions, video titles and descriptions, and announcements. Shape one message to fit each platform and its audience.
  • Content calendar: Own the publishing calendar for Red Door and client posts, announcements, blogs, and articles. Know what's going out, when, and what each piece still needs.
  • Publishing: Schedule and publish across Red Door and client channels, and make sure every piece goes out on time, on brand, and with the right assets.
  • Coordination: Gather drafts, visuals, and approvals from strategists, designers, leadership, and client stakeholders. Keep the pipeline moving so nothing stalls waiting on a handoff.

Who You Are

  • Experience: You have 2+ years of experience writing and managing social media content for a brand, agency, or organization, and you have published work you can show us.
  • Short-form writing: You write tight, clear copy, and you can shift tone between a LinkedIn announcement and a YouTube video description without losing the message.
  • Platform knowledge: You know LinkedIn and YouTube well, including how content is formatted, scheduled, and published on each, and you're comfortable across the other major social platforms.
  • Organization: You keep a calendar current and deadlines met as a practice, and you follow up on missing assets and approvals before they hold anything up.
  • AI-forward: Red Door is an AI-forward agency. You already use AI tools in your writing and workflow, you look for new ways to make them useful, and you keep the final voice human.

Before You Apply

Consider the following before applying:

  • If your social media experience is mostly with your own personal accounts…
  • If you'd rather write occasionally than publish on a steady, recurring schedule…
  • If following up with busy people for assets and approvals feels more exhausting than energizing…
  • If you're looking for a role focused on paid social or ad buying…

Then this probably isn't the right role for you.

To Apply

In your cover letter, pick one post you wrote and tell us why you wrote it the way you did. Include links to 3 to 5 pieces of short-form work. We'd rather hear your honest take than a polished answer.

During the interview process, we may ask you to write a few short posts from a brief we provide. Finalists will be asked to provide references from people they've worked with directly.

Compensation & Benefits

This is an hourly, non-exempt position paying $31 to $40 per hour, depending on experience, and is eligible for overtime.

We offer a full benefits package: PTO (80 hours in your first year, increasing with years of service), paid holidays (11 per year), health coverage (medical, dental, vision, plus HSA/FSA options), 401(k) with match, life and disability insurance, a charitable matching program, and stipends to support your remote setup and ongoing work-from-home costs.

Equal Opportunity

Red Door Collaborative is committed to building an inclusive team where everyone is valued and respected. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We don't just welcome diverse perspectives; we actively seek them out. People from different cultures and experiences, solving problems together, is how we do our best work.

项目概述（Overview）

你是否热爱语言、写作和质量评估？我们即将启动一个全新的语言评估项目，现诚邀精通中文的专业人士加入我们的团队。

工作内容（What you will do）

识别 AI 模型在搜索相关任务中出现的真实问题，即模型未能提供准确、充分或符合要求的回答。你需要设计搜索查询（Search Queries）、进行测试、记录问题，并编写正确答案的指导说明和评估标准。

常见问题包括：

  • 本地相关性（Local Relevance）： 搜索结果是否与用户所在地区相关。

  • 信息来源质量（Source Quality）： 引用的信息来源是否可靠、权威。

  • 信息时效性（Outdated Information）： 是否使用了过时的信息。

  • 语言匹配（Language Mismatches）： 回答使用的语言是否符合用户要求。

  • 答案完整性（Incomplete Answers）： 回答是否遗漏了重要信息。

  • 地区适用性（Region-specific Inapplicability）： 信息是否真正适用于特定地区或当地实际情况。

预计需要测试多个不同的搜索查询，才能发现真正的问题。能够接受反复尝试、持续测试和迭代是这项工作的重要要求。

项目详情（Project Details）

  • 开始时间： 尽快入职（ASAP）

  • 项目周期： 长期持续项目（Ongoing Project）

  • 工作时间： 每周约 20 小时

  • 工作性质： 自由职业合同（Freelance Contract）

  • 工作地点： 澳大利亚，远程办公

  • 薪酬： 40 美元/小时

任职要求（Requirements）

1. 研究能力（Research Skills）

能够通过多个信息来源查找和核实信息，熟悉不同网站、数据库及相关文档的检索和使用。

2. 批判性思维（Critical Thinking）

能够发现不同信息来源之间的矛盾，识别过时信息，并判断某些信息是否适用于特定地区或具体场景。

3. 注重细节（Attention to Detail）

能够敏锐地捕捉语言细节、地区差异（如价格、法规和具体要求）以及各种边缘情况。

4. 解决问题的能力（Problem-solving Mindset）

能够接受反复测试和不断调整的工作方式。当测试没有达到预期效果时，能够耐心地尝试不同方法，而不会轻易失去耐心。

5. 专业领域知识（Domain Knowledge）

优先考虑具有研究、质量保证（QA）、合规审查（Compliance）或其他需要严谨核实信息、确保准确性的相关工作经验者。

6. 清晰的书面表达能力（Writing Clarity）

能够清晰地撰写操作说明、指导原则和评估标准，让其他人能够理解判断逻辑及其依据。

7. 本地化知识（Locale Knowledge）

深入了解所在地区的实际情况，包括当地法规、商业惯例和文化差异。这些知识对于识别 AI 回答中不符合当地实际情况的问题尤为重要。

Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

What will you NOT do?

At Whittle Strategic Accounting, we believe in more than just numbers. As our clients' trusted financial partners, we cultivate strong relationships built on trust, responsiveness, and excellence. Our Client Controllers play a critical role in those relationships by helping clients understand not only what their financial results are, but what those results mean for their organizations.

The Client Controller serves as the bridge between our Client Service Managers (CSMs), who support the day-to-day accounting function, and our Client CFOs, who provide higher-level strategic financial guidance. This role combines technical accounting expertise, financial analysis, and frequent client interaction. The right person enjoys digging into the numbers, identifying trends and issues, communicating directly with clients, and tackling a variety of projects beyond the monthly close.

With opportunities to expand your skills and take on leadership roles, your potential is limitless. We're committed to helping you realize more than you think is possible in your career.

  • Analyze financial results to identify trends, variances, unusual activity, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into meaningful insights for clients and Client CFOs.
  • Build strong, high-touch client relationships through frequent, proactive communication and serve as a trusted financial partner who understands each client's operations, priorities, and financial needs.
  • Review and present financial statements to clients in a clear and meaningful manner, helping clients understand their financial results and what those results mean for their organization.
  • Lead the development of detailed client budgets and forecasts and support ongoing forecasting, cash flow analysis, and financial planning.

jobs.excerpt: Why Entersekt Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks.
jobs.description:
Why Entersekt

Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.

Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior, hands‑on DevSecOps Engineer with strong experience operating and securing cloud‑native production environments in regulated settings.

They have deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code, and are comfortable owning production reliability, security monitoring, incident response and audit readiness (e.g. SOC2, PCI‑DSS). They favour automation over manual processes and take a pragmatic, security‑first approach to building and running scalable platforms.

This individual works well across engineering teams, communicates clearly in a distributed environment, and is confident mentoring others on secure infrastructure and DevSecOps best practices.

The Role

As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer at Entersekt, you are the go-to technical expert for complex infrastructure challenges. You work mostly hands-on in cloud architecture and design, leading security audits and integrating automated compliance checks in CI/CD. You own complex domains end-to-end, lead incidents, influence team standards, and translate PCI requirements into practical solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the go-to technical expert for complex infrastructure and security challenges.
  • Lead security audits and integrate automated compliance checks in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and implement cloud architecture with deep expertise in VPC, IAM, and network security.
  • Own complex domains end-to-end with minimal oversight.
  • Lead incidents and drive operational excellence initiatives.
  • Influence team standards and contribute to engineering guidelines.
  • Translate PCI requirements into practical, implementable solutions.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on security practices.
  • Drive adoption of security best practices across engineering teams.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate security risks.

Skills and Experience

Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevSecOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles.
  • Mastery of AWS, Terragrunt, and cloud-native security tooling.
  • Deep expertise in VPC design, IAM policies, and network security.
  • Experience with PCI-DSS compliance and FinTech regulatory requirements.
  • Strong track record of leading incidents and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers and influence team standards.
  • Experience driving security improvements across multiple teams.

Personality Attributes

  • Technical authority with strong credibility across teams.
  • Proactive leader who identifies and addresses risks early.
  • Excellent communicator with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strategic thinker who balances immediate needs with long-term goals.
  • Patient and effective mentor.
  • Calm and decisive under pressure during incidents.

We place a lot of value on how we treat prospective employees and appreciate the time and effort that goes into job hunting. That is why we aim to keep the hiring process as quick and seamless as possible while ensuring the best possible fit for both you and the company.

Working at Entersekt is truly a dream. You get exposed to cutting-edge technology, colleagues who are leaders in their fields, and an awesome working environment that includes flexible hours, remote work, and plenty of growth opportunities.

Apply for this position by following the "apply now" tab and or viewing our other roles at Entersekt Careers page.

Entersekt is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. For all South Africa-based roles, preference will be given to candidates from historically disadvantaged groups, in accordance with local Employment Equity objectives.
