Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Third Party Liability (TPL) Lead to support Hawaiʻi Med-QUEST’s Third Party Liability, Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA), program integrity, and Medicaid TPL initiatives. This role will lead TPL operations, including cost avoidance, recovery, lien-related processes, vendor coordination, reporting, quality assurance, and operational improvements.

The TPL Lead will oversee the TPL Subject Matter Expert (SME) and coordinate closely with the Program Integrity Lead and Policy Lead to align TPL work with program integrity, audit, policy, process, and systems priorities. This role will help ensure Medicaid acts as the payer of last resort by supporting coordination and recovery from liable third parties, including commercial insurers, Medicare, and casualty or liability carriers.

The TPL Lead will work within our project structure, with close coordination across Integrated IT, Process & Policy, Strategic Project Management, and Learning, Development & Change Management workstreams.

Work Location and Schedule Expectations: This position offers flexibility in work location, including fully onsite, hybrid, or remote arrangements. The preferred location is Kapolei, Hawaiʻi, or the U.S. West Coast. Regardless of location, the role requires availability during Hawaii Standard Time (HST) working hours. This role requires travel approximately 30%–50% of the time, including travel to Hawaiʻi for onsite client meetings, release activities, training support, go-live readiness, payment integrity workgroup sessions, and related project needs.

You Will

  • Lead TPL operations and improvements, including cost avoidance, recovery, lien-related processes, vendor coordination, reporting, and quality assurance.
  • Oversee the TPL SME’s work, including analysis, recommendations, documentation, operational support, and quality review.
  • Coordinate with the Program Integrity Lead and Policy Lead to align TPL activities with broader compliance, audit, policy, process, and systems priorities.
  • Provide guidance to project teams and stakeholders on Medicaid TPL requirements, best practices, operational considerations, and compliance expectations.
  • Support daily TPL Unit operations, including coordination with MQD units, vendors, health plans, the Civil Recoveries Division, and other partners.
  • Lead or support development, tracking, and refinement of TPL lien-related processes and documentation.
  • Facilitate meetings, manage follow-up actions, track decisions, escalate risks and blockers, and support timely issue resolution.
  • Review existing TPL processes and lead business process redesign to improve efficiency, compliance, accountability, and recovery outcomes.
  • Review TPL vendor lead files, verified policy updates, cost avoidance reports, recovery reports, and related operational data.
  • Follow project ways-of-working standards, including document management, client communication, time entry, internal review cycles, and protection of sensitive information.

You Have

Experience leading or supporting Medicaid Third Party Liability (TPL), program integrity, recovery, cost avoidance, audit, compliance, policy, or related operations.

Strong knowledge of Medicaid coordination of benefits, third-party payer data, recovery processes, lien-related processes, federal and state TPL requirements, and payer-of-last-resort principles.

  • Experience coordinating TPL-related work across program, vendor, legal, finance, policy, analytics, claims, eligibility, audit, and project management stakeholders.
  • Experience interpreting and applying federal and state Medicaid requirements.
  • Strong project leadership, facilitation, communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to analyze Medicaid claims, eligibility systems, third-party payer data, recovery opportunities, and operational improvements.
  • Experience leading or supporting business process redesign in a Medicaid, healthcare, claims, eligibility, program integrity, or TPL environment.
  • Experience overseeing or coordinating the work of subject matter experts, analysts, or project team members.
  • Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary workstreams, including strategic project management, integrated IT/process/policy, audit, operations, training, communications, and change management teams.
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience within the last five (5) years in a comparable Medicaid, healthcare, TPL, program integrity, operations, leadership, or consulting role.

Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience supporting or leading a state Medicaid agency TPL program, including cost avoidance, recovery, casualty/liability, lien-related processes, audit, compliance, coordination of benefits, or vendor coordination.
  • Experience supporting implementation activities such as process redesign, reporting, testing, training readiness, release coordination, performance monitoring, or stabilization.
  • Familiarity with Medicaid eligibility systems, claims systems, integrated eligibility systems, or vendor-managed Medicaid data environments is a plus.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $90,000-$120,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

jobs.description:
Overview

Who we are—

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With over 1,000 employees—in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles—we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defense, energy, and utilities. We fulfill this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the center of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

Here’s what Transcat has to offer—

  • Work that matters
  • A values-based culture where people care about each other and the work they do together
  • Flexibility
  • Training and development to accelerate learning and career advancement
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including paid time off, health insurance, tuition reimbursement, retirement, stock purchase plan, and MORE!
  • Pay range is $105,000 - $125,000 plus commission

The Strategic Account Manager is a senior, hunter-oriented enterprise sales professional responsible for creating net-new strategic business and expanding Transcat's position within complex, multi-site organizations. This role engages senior executives and functional leaders in business-level discussions about risk, compliance, asset performance, operational continuity, cost, and enterprise standardization, then translates those priorities into differentiated solutions across Transcat's calibration, metrology, product, asset management, reliability, validation, and related technical service portfolio.

The successful candidate combines executive presence, disciplined prospecting, strategic account planning, commercial acumen, and cross-functional leadership. This position is expected to open doors, develop opportunities where limited or no relationship exists, shape complex enterprise pursuits, and secure long-term, profitable partnerships. It is not primarily an account-service or order-management role; day-to-day program execution is coordinated with Program Management, Customer Experience, Operations, and technical resources.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Hunting and New Business Development

  • Build and execute a focused territory and target-account strategy based on ideal customer profile, market potential, competitive position, and Transcat's ability to differentiate.
  • Generate net-new enterprise opportunities through executive outreach, referrals, industry networks, strategic events, targeted campaigns, and disciplined multi-channel prospecting.
  • Create access within accounts where Transcat has limited or no relationship, and develop opportunities across multiple sites, divisions, functions, and service categories.
  • Qualify opportunities based on customer need, business impact, decision process, competitive position, solution fit, revenue potential, margin, and probability of success.
  • Maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support assigned new-business, growth, and strategic-logo objectives.

Executive Engagement and Consultative Selling

  • Establish credibility with senior executives and leaders across quality, engineering, operations, procurement, supply chain, finance, facilities, and other relevant functions.
  • Lead high-level discovery conversations that connect customer priorities to measurable business outcomes, including risk reduction, compliance, uptime, productivity, standardization, visibility, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop executive-level points of view, value hypotheses, business cases, presentations, and proposals tailored to the customer's strategic and operational environment.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder groups, identify influence and decision dynamics, and build relationships across economic buyers, executive sponsors, technical validators, procurement, and end users.
  • Lead executive briefings, capability discussions, strategic workshops, business reviews, and partnership conversations.

Strategic Account Penetration and Expansion

  • Create and maintain actionable account plans, relationship maps, whitespace analyses, competitive assessments, and pursuit strategies for assigned targets and strategic customers.
  • Expand share of wallet by identifying unmet needs and introducing Transcat capabilities across calibration, repair, product, pipette, biomedical, asset management, reliability, CMMS, validation, temperature mapping, procurement, and other emerging offerings.
  • Pursue enterprise agreements, multi-site programs, national contracts, requests for proposal, renewals, and strategic partnerships that improve customer value and create durable revenue.
  • Balance net-new logo acquisition with intentional expansion of selected strategic accounts, while avoiding displacement into routine service-management activity.

Complex Pursuit and Commercial Leadership

  • Lead complex opportunities from qualification through solution development, proposal, negotiation, contract award, and structured handoff to implementation teams.
  • Coordinate operations, technical experts, program management, marketing, finance, legal, quality, and leadership to develop feasible, differentiated, and financially sound solutions.
  • Develop commercial strategies covering scope, pricing, margin, terms, implementation risk, customer commitments, and competitive positioning.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity stages, values, close dates, next steps, risks, contacts, and forecasts in Salesforce and related systems.
  • Provide concise executive reporting on pipeline quality, pursuit strategy, customer engagement, forecast, risks, and support required.

Market Leadership and Collaboration

  • Monitor customer, industry, competitor, and market trends and convert insights into target lists, pursuit themes, and differentiated value propositions.
  • Represent Transcat professionally at customer locations, industry events, trade shows, conferences, and relevant professional networks.
  • Partner effectively with regional sales, program management, customer experience, operations, technical teams, and specialty-market leaders; clarify ownership and ensure disciplined handoffs.
  • Share repeatable practices, market intelligence, and customer insights that improve enterprise selling capability across the organization.
  • Perform other duties and lead special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated enterprise sales and business development capability with a strong record of creating opportunities, winning net-new customers, and expanding complex accounts.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate with senior leaders in concise, credible, business-oriented terms.
  • Advanced discovery, consultative selling, account planning, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to move conversations beyond individual services or price and articulate value in terms of business risk, operational performance, compliance, productivity, and financial impact.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, including pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, gross margin, contract economics, and return-on-investment concepts.
  • Ability to understand complex technical and operational environments and translate Transcat capabilities into clear enterprise value propositions.
  • Persistence, curiosity, self-direction, sound judgment, and comfort operating in ambiguity and through long, complex sales cycles.
  • Ability to lead through influence across functions, locations, and organizational levels.
  • Strong written communication, presentation development, organization, prioritization, and CRM discipline.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft 365, virtual collaboration tools, and business reporting platforms.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, science, or a related discipline required. A combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, national accounts, technical services, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success winning complex, multi-site, enterprise, or national business and engaging senior executives throughout the sales process.
  • Experience selling services, solutions, or programs into regulated, quality-driven, technical, or operationally complex environments is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in calibration, metrology, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial services, energy, manufacturing, biomedical, asset management, reliability, or compliance is preferred.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

The physical requirements described below are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to work for extended periods using a computer and standard office equipment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person and through virtual, written, and telephone channels.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and commercial transportation and to work at customer and Transcat locations as business needs require.
  • Ability to occasionally move through office, laboratory, manufacturing, and customer environments while complying with applicable safety and access requirements.

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

jobs.description:
Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) - Partner Acquisition Germany

Berlin or Frankfurt (Germany)

We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)

You'll own iwoca's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

  • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

  • Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

  • Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

  • Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

  • Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

  • A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with a ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

About Fiscal 12

Fiscal 12 is a strategic accounting and finance partner to growing manufacturing businesses in the United States. We help our clients strengthen financial operations, improve visibility into profitability and cash flow, and make better business decisions.

Our team works across multiple client engagements, providing accounting, financial reporting, inventory and cost accounting, financial planning, and advisory support. We're building a team of professionals who are curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering work that makes a meaningful difference to the businesses we support.

The role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Accounting Analyst – Manufacturing Accounting & Financial Operations to support the accounting and financial operations of our manufacturing clients.

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing reconciliations and supporting schedules, contributing to month-end close activities, and supporting accounting processes involving inventory, costing, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

You'll work closely with experienced accounting and finance professionals while gaining exposure to the financial and operational complexities of manufacturing businesses. We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete assigned tasks but takes ownership of their work, understands the numbers behind the transactions, and follows issues through to resolution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Prepare and reconcile balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, adjustments, and supporting schedules in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
  • Support monthly close activities and the preparation of accurate financial statements.
  • Maintain fixed asset schedules, including additions, disposals, depreciation, and capitalization.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and review-ready accounting workpapers.
  • Address review comments promptly and ensure assigned deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.

2. Manufacturing Accounting, Inventory & Costing

  • Support inventory reconciliations and investigate differences between accounting and operational records.
  • Assist with work-in-progress (WIP) accounting, job costing, and cost allocation.
  • Support the review of inventory valuations, cost of goods sold, and manufacturing-related accounting entries.
  • Assist in identifying inventory and costing discrepancies that may affect financial reporting or profitability.
  • Work with client teams to obtain and validate information required for accurate accounting.

3. Accounts Payable & Receivable

  • Support accounts payable processes, including invoice validation, vendor reconciliations, and payment documentation.
  • Assist with purchase order matching and invoice approval controls.
  • Monitor accounts receivable balances, aging reports, and collections-related accounting issues.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies involving customer and vendor accounts.
  • Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for financial transactions.

4. Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Follow established accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Identify accounting process gaps, recurring errors, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the documentation and implementation of accounting workflows and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate task updates, documentation, and deadlines in the company's workflow management systems.

5. Collaboration & Client Delivery

  • Work collaboratively with Client Leads and other team members across multiple client engagements.
  • Communicate outstanding issues, dependencies, and potential delays proactively.
  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities from preparation through review and completion.
  • Support client reporting and respond to accounting-related requests in a timely and professional manner.

Qualifications & Experience
Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in accounting, audit, or financial operations.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP or demonstrated ability to apply relevant accounting standards.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to analyze and reconcile financial data.
  • Experience using accounting software such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Odoo, or similar platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a remote environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting manufacturing, distribution, or other inventory-intensive businesses.
  • Familiarity with inventory accounting, WIP, job costing, or standard costing.
  • Progress toward a professional accounting qualification such as ICAN, ACCA, or CPA.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or outsourced accounting teams.
  • Exposure to ERP systems and accounting workflow management tools.

What Success Looks Like
In this role, success means:

  • Accounting reconciliations and workpapers are accurate, complete, and ready for review.
  • Month-end deliverables are completed on time, with outstanding issues communicated early.
  • Accounting discrepancies are investigated rather than simply carried forward.
  • Review feedback is addressed promptly, and work is followed through to completion.
  • Inventory, costing, and other manufacturing accounting activities are supported with reliable financial information.
  • Client Leads can confidently rely on the quality, accuracy, and completeness of your work.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to a diverse portfolio of U.S. manufacturing businesses.
  • Hands-on experience in manufacturing accounting, inventory, costing, and financial operations.
  • Opportunities to work with experienced finance professionals and develop specialized technical skills.
  • Structured learning, mentorship, and professional development.
  • A collaborative, remote-first work environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth into senior accounting, financial operations, and advisory roles.

Who Will Thrive at Fiscal 12?
You'll enjoy working with us if you are someone who:

  • Takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.
  • Is naturally curious and wants to understand why the numbers look the way they do.
  • Takes initiative rather than waiting to be reminded.
  • Communicates openly when something is unclear or at risk.
  • Enjoys solving problems and improving how work gets done.
  • Values teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and professional growth.

At Fiscal 12, we believe good accounting goes beyond recording transactions. It's about creating reliable financial information that helps businesses operate better and make smarter decisions.

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We are seeking NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation to NYC.

About This Job

We're hiring a Finance and Billing Operations Manager to own our core finance operations as we scale. This is a high impact role. You'll work closely with the founders and outside partners to keep our financial systems accurate, organized, and ready for growth.

This role needs someone who ideally has already owned billing or AR operations end to end. You'll audit what exists, find the gaps, and fix them yourself. There's no playbook, so you need to be comfortable building one. You’ll be hands on in the day to day, while learning how to build better processes, reporting, and systems over time.

In This Role You Will:

  • Own billing from invoice to cash, including invoicing, cash application, credits, collections, and reconciliation, along with day to day accounts receivable and accounts payable

  • Manage and develop our offshore billing team by setting the quality bar, reviewing work, coaching, and deciding where the team spends its time

  • Partner with Customer Success and Sales to resolve billing disputes, protect renewals, and make sure contract terms can be invoiced correctly

  • Support month end close, including reconciliations across revenue, billing, and cash, and work with our outsourced bookkeeping partners to keep our records accurate

  • Improve billing, collections, and expense workflows, using automation where it helps, and anticipate what will break as volume grows

  • Track and report key metrics such as DSO, dispute volume, invoice accuracy, and close time, and help build budgets and forecasts for leadership

  • Support audit readiness and internal controls

You Should Have:

  • 5 to 8+ years of finance or accounting experience, including hands on billing or AR work in B2B SaaS and a track record of owning invoice to cash with results you can put a number on

  • Working experience in at least one billing or ERP system, such as NetSuite, Stripe, Chargebee, or Zuora, and a working knowledge of month end close and revenue recognition

  • Experience leading people. Managing direct reports is ideal, but we will also consider candidates who have led, trained, or set standards for a team

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain finance topics in plain language to Customer Success, Sales, and Operations partners

  • Strong attention to detail, comfort working in spreadsheets and finance tools, and a willingness to own work from start to finish

What We’d Love To See:

  • A CPA or audit background

  • Experience leading an offshore or remote team across time zones

  • Experience with usage based or mixed billing models, or with selecting or migrating a billing system

  • Experience using code or automation, such as Python or SQL, to remove manual work

  • Familiarity with tools like Stripe, NetSuite, Ramp, Brex, or QuickBooks, and experience working with external accounting or bookkeeping partners

  • Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, or financial analysis

  • A proactive, curious approach and a desire to grow into a broader finance role

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation Range: $140K - $170K

  • AI and automation in Operations. Using AI to give our teams richer customer context and remove low-value work – for example, cutting the time Account Managers spend preparing for calls, or drafting the first version of routine customer communications.

  • Smarter task distribution. Rethinking how work is prioritised and split between people and automated processes – from when an Account Manager should call a customer to which customers need a personal conversation at all – so that our teams' time goes where human judgement adds the most value.

  • Stronger recoveries. Using our growing book of defaulted loans to work out which contact strategies, payment arrangements and recovery routes lead to the best outcomes – for iwoca and for the customer.

  • Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL – either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven't coded before, we'd want you to be excited to learn on the job.

The salary

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. Every customer comes to us looking for a better, easier way to handle their insurance. As an Insurance Sales Representative, your mission is to deliver an exceptional, consultative experience that turns initial interest into long-term customer trust, matching each individual with the ideal coverage from Jerry’s panel of 55+ carrier partners.

Who You Are:

  • Navigate friction thoughtfully: Listen to customer hesitation with empathy, addressing concerns directly to ensure a smooth, transparent purchasing experience.

Compensation and Perks:

  • Fully funded licensing: We pay 100% of the cost for your P&C license (expected within 2 weeks after starting).

  • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision insurance, and 401(k) match.

  • Remote-first: Work from home with all equipment provided, supported by ongoing training and active team mentorship.

  • Flexible scheduling: Choice between a 5-day, 8-hour schedule or a 4-day, 10-hour workweek.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

  • Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 2 years in tech recruitment

  • Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment

  • Global sourcing experience: You have a track record of helping attract talent from major tech hubs (USA, EU, LATAM, etc.)

Others

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

What We Offer

📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: FEDlogic: FEDlogic is a people-first benefits navigation company dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex landscape of federal and state benefits.
jobs.description:
FEDlogic:

FEDlogic is a people-first benefits navigation company dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex landscape of federal and state benefits. As the only vendor in the country providing unbiased education and advocacy on all federal and state benefits, FEDlogic stands out in its mission to ensure no one misses out on the benefits they are entitled to.

We partner with employers to help their employees and families understand and access federal and state programs. Our experts provide confidential, unbiased guidance that lowers healthcare costs, reduces financial stress, and improves well-being. By bridging the gap between government programs and workplace benefits, FEDlogic delivers meaningful impact for employees while helping employers manage risk, reduce costs, and strengthen their benefits offering.

Title: Program Operations Manager

Location: Remote; candidates in or within a 2–3 hour drive of Winston-Salem, NC (including Raleigh and Charlotte) preferred

Employment Type: Full Time

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

Position Overview:
The Program Operations Manager is a member of FEDlogic's Client Ops team, focused on partnerships, systems and program management. The role keeps FEDlogic's partner and client programs running smoothly from implementation through service and renewal, maintains the systems the Client Ops team relies on, and supports the team with proposals, contracting and stewardship reporting.

This person is the connective tissue between Client Ops, Client Success, IT, Partnerships, Connecting with Care (CWC), Marketing and Client Development. A core part of the role is managing how FEDlogic's systems work with those of our clients and partners, such as call routing between a partner's telephony platform and ours. They find operational bottlenecks and compliance gaps, put improvements in place, and contribute to the team's shared reporting.

This is not an engineering role, and a technical degree is not required. We're looking for a technically fluent operator who is comfortable getting under the hood of business systems. You learn new platforms quickly, read the documentation, and build or adjust workflows, reports and integrations yourself rather than waiting on a developer. You can sit with a partner's IT team, follow the conversation, ask precise questions and know when an answer doesn't add up, then explain the outcome in plain language to everyone else.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Operations Support

  • Support proposal development, including RFP and RFI responses, pricing inputs, service descriptions and final review with Client Development and leadership.
  • Support the Client Ops team through the contracting process for direct employer and partnership clients (captives, pools, trusts and their member groups).
  • Maintain accurate records of contract status, effective dates, renewal timelines and participating groups in HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Own the handoff from signature into implementation, making sure each new client's program and systems requirements are captured and passed cleanly to Client Success, IT, CWC and other delivery teams.

Program Management and Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Serve as the central program lead connecting Client Ops, Client Success, IT, Partnerships, CWC, Marketing and Client Development.
  • Build and manage program plans, timelines and deliverables for client launches, partner programs and internal initiatives in the team's project management tool.
  • Run recurring cross-functional operations meetings with clear owners, decisions and action items.
  • Work with IT on data, reporting needs and security requirements for client programs.
  • Partner with Marketing on client-facing materials and engagement campaigns tied to key dates such as open enrollment, Medicare Annual Enrollment and retirement planning seasons.
  • Align with Partnerships and Client Development on pipeline-to-contract handoffs, and with Client Success on post-launch service.

Partner and Client Integrations

  • Own the technical side of every new client and partner launch, mapping how their systems will connect to ours: telephony and call routing, eligibility and census files, SSO and portal access, referral workflows and data sharing.
  • Find incompatibilities early, such as a partner's phone system that can't route to ours, and drive each one to resolution across FEDlogic's IT team, the partner's IT or vendor contacts, and the client.
  • Translate between technical and non-technical teams: write clear requirements, run working sessions with outside IT teams, and confirm solutions are tested before go-live.
  • Keep an integration profile for each partner and major client, covering systems in use, technical contacts, data flows, known issues and change history.
  • Track integration milestones within the 45–60 day implementation timeline and escalate anything that threatens a launch date.
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for integration issues after launch and see root-cause fixes through.

Process Optimization and Compliance

  • Map end-to-end workflows (proposal, contract, implementation, service, renewal) and identify bottlenecks, redundancies and handoff failures.
  • Identify compliance gaps in contract terms, HIPAA and BAA obligations, data handling and documentation, and work with leadership and legal to close them.
  • Design, document and roll out standard operating procedures, templates and checklists.
  • Apply continuous-improvement methods and use automation, such as HubSpot workflows, to reduce manual work.
  • Maintain a risk and issue log for active programs and escalate items that threaten timelines, client experience or compliance.

Shared Reporting

  • Contribute to the Client Ops team's shared KPI tracking and reporting, with a focus on partnership programs and integrations.
  • Maintain the systems and data behind the team's reporting, keeping HubSpot, Salesforce and related tools accurate and consistent across Client Ops.
  • Prepare partner and client stewardship reporting, working alongside the Client Ops colleagues who lead the team's broader operational reporting.

Client Support

  • Prepare materials for and participate in stewardship meetings, including results summaries, trends, success stories and recommendations.
  • Coordinate conference and event logistics with Partnerships and Marketing, and track follow-up from contacts made at events.
  • Serve as the internal source of truth for client and program status, keeping CRM records and documentation current.

    Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in business, operations, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    • 4–6 years of experience in operations, project or program management, or service delivery, preferably in employee benefits, insurance, healthcare or B2B services.
    • Experience running technical implementations or system integrations between organizations, such as SaaS onboarding, data feeds or telephony setups.
    • A practical understanding of how business systems connect (APIs, file-based data exchanges, single sign-on, and phone and contact-center platforms). You don't need to build these, but you understand the moving parts.
    • Experience supporting proposals, contracts, renewals or client onboarding.
    • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing teams without direct authority.
    • Experience building KPI reporting and tracking budgets.
    • Proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, project management tools, Google Workspace and Excel.

    Preferred Qualifications:

    • Exposure to telephony and contact-center platforms (such as RingCentral, Five9 or Genesys) and to benefits eligibility file formats (such as 834 and census files).
    • Working knowledge of employee benefits captives, pools and trusts.
    • Familiarity with federal and state benefit programs (Medicare, Social Security, disability).
    • Experience with HIPAA, BAAs or other compliance requirements in a client services setting.
    • Experience writing or coordinating RFP responses.

    Skills and Competencies:

    • Process optimization: spots inefficiencies and builds simpler, repeatable ways of working.
    • Stakeholder communication: keeps leadership, internal teams and clients informed with clear, timely updates.
    • Reporting: keeps shared data accurate and turns it into clear, useful updates.
    • Risk management: anticipates issues, documents them and drives them to resolution.
    • Problem-solving: gets to root causes and moves quickly from analysis to action.
    • Program management: keeps multiple workstreams on schedule with strong attention to detail.
    • Technical fluency: understands how systems connect and translates clearly between technical and non-technical teams.
    • Client presence: works confidently with HR leaders, executives and partner stakeholders.

    What we Offer:

    • Flexible remote work environment
    • Paid Time Off (PTO) plus all federal holidays off
    • Comprehensive benefits package with health, dental, vision insurance group term life, short term disability, long term disability and voluntary life plans. Numerous supplemental plans to assist employees.
    • Paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave benefits.
    • Cancer Experts Now - supplemental plan
    • 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions.
    • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
    • Opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing company dedicated to making a difference in the lives of families.

    Travel:

    • Up to 15% travel per year for client meetings, stewardship meetings, company engagements, both local and occasional out-of-town and conferences.

    We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veterans status, or any other characteristic protected by law. FEDlogic participates in E-Verify to verify employment eligibility for all new hires in accordance with federal law.

    A consumer report and/or investigative consumer report may be obtained for employment purposes in connection with your application for employment.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We scaled to 50 million users in just 2 years with a lean team of 100 people. Last year, we doubled our headcount.

Now, we’re scaling again, and the next hires will shape what EverAI looks like at 100+ people. As our third Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll be central to that build, as you’re joining at a defining stage.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Alexis, and partner with leaders across the business to help assemble the team behind one of the fastest-growing AI products globally. We hire internationally and across every function of the company, with a strong focus on tech, bringing together people from leading tech hubs around the world.

You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Talent Acquisition evolves as we grow: refining our internal workflows, experimenting with new AI tools, launching employer branding initiatives, testing sourcing strategies that keep our quality bar high, and so on.

Key Mission

Identify, attract, and land top global talent, while helping build a recruitment stack that matches the scale and ambition of a company serving 50M users worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

Talent Mapping & Sourcing:

  • Global Talent Scouting: Help map and engage elite talent from Tier 1 tech hubs and companies worldwide. You’ll identify and connect with candidates who aren’t actively applying through thoughtful outreach and strong networking.

  • Smart Sourcing: Support the implementation of an AI-first recruitment stack. You’ll use tools, from AI agents to niche technical communities and unconventional channels, to help us find exceptional talent

  • Relationship Building: Maintain long-term relationships with passive talent globally to ensure we stay ahead of hiring needs as we continue scaling

Candidate Experience & Evaluation:

  • World-Class Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey from the first discovery call to the final close. Ensure every interaction with EverAI, whether candidates join us or not, is clear, respectful, and high-quality

  • Interviews and Screenings: Conduct structured interviews to assess technical aptitude and cultural alignment, and provide concise, actionable summaries for Hiring Managers and Leadership

Process Innovation & Collaboration:

  • Hiring Operations: Work closely with Founders and Team Leads to improve hiring workflows, remove friction, and strengthen how we operate as we grow past 100+ employees

  • Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Supervisor, Coding Professional Fee, you will supervise professional fee coders and support staff for assigned departments, overseeing coding, abstracting, and charge posting for physician services in both inpatient and outpatient settings. Every day you will actively manage charge lag by monitoring reports and work queue activity, monitor staff quality and productivity, and provide education as needed. You will also collaborate with clinics and providers to resolve coding issues, and participate in personnel management, scheduling, productivity, quality, and problem resolution with management. To be successful in this role, you will possess strong expertise in professional fee coding (inpatient/outpatient), proven supervisory and leadership skills, and the ability to manage staff, monitor productivity, and ensure compliance.

  • Directly supervises personnel, which includes work allocation, training, and problem resolution; evaluates performance and makes recommendations for personnel actions; motivates employees to achieve peak productivity and performance.
  • Promotes coding quality to comply with payer guidelines and regulations.
  • Conducts quality control audits of staff to verify coding quality metrics are maintained and identify opportunities for further education.
  • Manages processes within the system to verify coding completion timelines are maintained.
  • Evaluates staffing needs and optimizes resource use through crosstraining/crosscoverage to promote consistent processing of charges.
  • Trains technical and other staff on coding practices, policies and procedures, system, and payer regulations.

Along with CO, KS and NM, this position is open to remote/out of state candidates residing in only these states:

  • Alabama- Arizona- Arkansas- Colorado
  • Florida- Georgia- Idaho- Indiana
  • Iowa- Kansas - Kentucky- Louisiana
  • Missouri- Mississippi- Nebraska- New Mexico
  • North Carolina- Ohio- Oklahoma- South Carolina
  • South Dakota- Tennessee- Texas- Utah
  • Virginia- West Virginia- Wyoming

Job Requirements

Required

  • A minimum of three (3) years of experience in health care and revenue cycle experience required within a physician practice
  • Certified Professional Coder, CPC or CCSP
  • Professional coding experience
  • Must demonstrate competency of professional coding and coding guidelines
  • Experience with the electronic health record (EHR) and health care applications

Preferred

  • Associates degree or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree
  • One (1) year of supervisory experience
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor, additional coding certifications (specialty credential(s)/CPMA)

Where You’ll Work

With more than 700 care sites across the U.S. from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable and innovating how and where healing can happen both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

You will be the operational backbone of our recruiting engine, owning the logistics and making sure every candidate experiences a seamless, high-touch process end to end.

  • Manage the lifecycle of take-home assignments, maintain candidate profiles in Ashby ATS, and ensure all candidate documents are accessible to those who need them

  • You have an intense sense of urgency: You don't wait for things to happen, you make them happen. You move quickly, close loops fast, and thrive in environments where priorities shift and speed matters.

  • Your attention to detail is impeccable: You catch the small things that others miss. Your written communication is clear, polished and professional, and you keep processes tight so nothing slips.

  • You are a proactive problem solver: You’re calm under pressure, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You can handle high-stakes, time-sensitive requests from leadership without losing focus or pace.

Ideal profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree

Astrana Health builds the technology that lets physician groups deliver value-based care: the systems that enables physicians to deliver higher quality care and keeps its payers, and its partners in sync. The pace varies with the work. Some of it is fast iteration with real users. Some of it touches PHI, billing, or clinical decisions and has to be right the first time. We want engineers who can tell which kind of work is in front of them and adjust. We also expect engineers to work across the whole stack: database, backend, frontend, and the infrastructure that runs it.
As a Senior Engineer you own a product surface or a significant system end to end. We hand you problems rather than solutions.
