  • Decompose larger problems into work that several people can pick up in parallel, and adjust as you learn.
  • Design data models that survive requirements nobody has heard yet, and integrations that stay correct when the systems on the other side misbehave.
  • Work with the data directly. Answer questions about eligibility, claims, and quality data with SQL, notice when the numbers look wrong, and build the reporting and analytics that clinics and operations teams rely on.
  • Run schema and data migrations safely: expand/contract, backfills, staged cutovers, and a rollback path you have actually thought through.
  • Take systems from "works" to "runnable by someone else": meaningful logging, alerts, and runbooks.
  • Build authorization, audit trails, and PHI minimization into your designs from the start.
  • Work directly with product managers, practice managers, and clinicians. Come back from a twenty-minute conversation with a better spec than the one you were handed.
  • Handle production incidents in your area without needing someone more senior to drive.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and review code in a way that teaches.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering large, ambiguous features independently.
  • Four-year undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering. Rare exceptions for outstanding experience.
  • Full-stack experience. You are comfortable owning a feature from the database to the browser.
  • Strong TypeScript, including on the backend.
  • Strong SQL: you write and tune non-trivial queries, read query plans, and design schemas for data that will outlive the feature.
  • Data and analytics savvy. You are comfortable exploring an unfamiliar dataset, validating it, and turning it into reports or metrics that non-engineers trust.
  • Production experience with React.
  • Docker and container-based development and deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Strong proficiency with AI development tools such as coding agents and assistants. You use them to move faster on the right work, review what they produce with the same rigor as any other code and know when a task is better done without them.

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
jobs.description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

Job Description

JOB TITLE

Senior Data Developer

LEVEL/BAND

MM22

DEPARTMENT

Technology

DIRECT REPORT (JOB TITLE)

Data Development Manager

Overall Purpose of the Position

To drive and perform the activities to develop, maintain and support the Banks’ Enterprise Data Warehouse, Business Intelligence and Reporting Solutions, ensuring that the business has timely access to quality data in an efficient and effective manner and that our data stores are maintained inline with industry standards.

Operational Responsibilities

·To carry out all assigned tasks efficiently and effectively, in adherence with internal policies and procedures.

·To participate in the design and implementation of process improvements for the team.

·To participate in periodic system reviews to identify possible gaps and process inconsistencies and propose re-alignment strategies including the necessary training programmes.

Data Warehouse

·To participate in the architecture design and development of the Data Warehouse, including recoverability, resilience, data quality, data integrity and security in accordance with the Bank’s standards and industry best practices.

·To implement and maintain version control.

·To ensure proper segregation of duties within the team when it comes to implementing changes on test and production environments.

·To ensure, at all times, a current version of the documentation related to Data Warehouse architecture, data model and data dictionary is maintained.

·To monitor the state of data quality, including integrity, accuracy and consistency, within the Data Warehouse and establish goals for data quality improvements and take corrective action where necessary, including recommending updates at source with the data stewards.

·To perform the design and development activities of Data Warehouse integration with third party systems.

·To research and stay abreast of emerging Data Warehouse technologies and design methods.

Business Intelligence and Reporting

·To design and drive the development and implementation of BI solutions.

·To provide ad-hoc reports as per client/end user requirements.

·To assist our internal clients/end users in the definition of their business requirements.

·To assist/train end-users in the use of data query analysis and reporting tools.

·To promote the use of BI, BI Initiatives and Reporting tools.

Performance Management

·To establish and monitor process improvements and efficiencies to improve on the defined KPIs.

·To carry out performance benchmarking, tuning and optimisation to achieve the Bank’s desired performance results on/from the Data Warehouse.

Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

Mandatory

Skill

  • Excellent communication skills (including written and oral) - able to relate to various members of the organisation;
  • Ability to challenge the status quo and inspire others to identify opportunities and areasfor improvement;
  • Proven experience of working under pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Customer Driven with an ability to prioritise issues based on impact.
  • Excellent understanding of data administration and management functions (collection, analysis, distribution etc.)

Experience

  • Minimum of two years’ experience in Data Development/ Data Warehousing ;
  • Working knowledge of ETL and ETL techniques (technologies include Microsoft SSIS and SAP Data Services)
  • Experience in designing, developing and implementing Data Warehouse environments;
  • Hands on experience with SQL, PL/SQL and Transact SQL;
  • Knowledge of Data Reporting and KPIs.

Qualification

  • Possess a first degree level of education in IT or Engineering or equivalent specialised training in data warehousing and/or BI;.

Desirable

Skill

  • Requirements gathering;
  • Business and Process ANalysis;

Experience

  • Software Development;
  • Sprint planning.

Qualification

  • Banking/ Accounting Qualification.

Position level (1 being the highest level)

  1. Head of Department
  2. Managerial & Specialist Positions
  3. Middle Management & Specialist Positions
  4. Technical & Clerical Positions

jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!

jobs.excerpt: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Regulatory Lead

Remote, with occasional travel as required | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The role

We are looking for a Regulatory Lead to take day-to-day ownership of our regulatory framework, and of our relationship with our external compliance provider, as the business grows.

This is a broad, hands-on role covering regulatory change, compliance processes, governance and risk across the UK and US. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, our Compliance Officer and MLRO, the senior leadership team, external legal and regulatory advisers, and sophisticated institutional clients and counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take day-to-day ownership of the firm’s regulatory framework across the UK and US, prioritising work through a central plan and dashboard.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting the business, assess their impact and lead the implementation of any changes required.

  • Work with our external compliance provider to keep compliance policies, procedures and controls up to date and applied in practice, including marketing and financial promotions approvals, client categorisation and onboarding, employee compliance (such as personal account dealing, conflicts of interest and gifts and hospitality) and compliance records.

  • Oversee the compliance monitoring carried out by our external provider, act on its findings, and keep records and evidence ready for regulatory and client due-diligence review.

  • Support the MLRO and our external provider in running the firm’s financial crime framework, including anti-money laundering, sanctions and client due diligence.

  • Assess the regulatory implications of new products, jurisdictions and business initiatives, and coordinate specialist advice where needed.

  • Act as a point of contact for regulators and for clients’ and counterparties’ compliance and regulatory teams, including responding to due-diligence questionnaires.

  • Coordinate compliance training with our external provider and promote a strong compliance culture across the business.

  • Prepare regulatory and compliance reporting for the Board and senior leadership, and support corporate governance processes.

  • Manage external legal and regulatory advisers, instructions and budgets, including on contractual, data protection and other matters requiring legal input.

  • Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes through templates, automation and technology.

About you

You will have substantial experience in a regulatory or compliance role, whether gained at a fintech, crypto or digital-asset business, a trading firm, bank or broker, a regulator, an advisory or consultancy firm, or a combination of these. A legal qualification is welcome but not required.

Experience in trading, markets, payments or digital assets is desirable. A strong working knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks, sound regulatory judgement and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business processes will be essential. Exposure to US regulation would be an advantage.

You should have:

  • Experience of compliance frameworks, policies and monitoring, including working with or overseeing outsourced compliance providers.

  • Experience managing regulatory change and assessing the regulatory impact of new products or business activities.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including drafting clear policies, procedures and reports.

  • The confidence to work independently and exercise sound judgement.

  • The ability to recognise when specialist legal advice is needed, and to work effectively with external counsel.

  • A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly to colleagues across the business.

  • The ability to engage confidently with regulators, sophisticated clients, counterparties and their compliance or regulatory teams.

  • Experience managing external advisers and coordinating work across multiple jurisdictions.

  • An interest in financial markets, trading technology and regulatory developments.

The role would suit someone who wants meaningful responsibility in a growing business and enjoys building a well-organised, effective regulatory function rather than simply responding to individual queries.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

jobs.excerpt: The company Small businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

  • Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products.

  • Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics.

  • Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.

  • Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms.

  • Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself.

  • Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.

  • Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects.

  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.

  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

  • Experience working in or helping build newly formed teams.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to run hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK scales globally.

Hiring sets the pace here. How quickly we build the team decides how quickly everything else moves.

You will run multiple roles at once and close them in weeks rather than months. That only works when one person owns the full cycle, so you do: post, source, screen, assess, interview, offer. Coordinators and assessors support the individual steps. The outcome is yours.


What You’ll Do

  • Run recruitment end to end for your assigned roles.

  • Take proper briefs from hiring managers, and tell them when the profile does not match the market.

  • Source and screen directly through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards and outreach. Inbound and outbound both matter, and neither fills a role on its own.

  • Map the market and build pipelines before the role opens.

  • Keep the ATS accurate and give hiring managers a straight read on where each role stands.

  • Run interviews and scheduling so candidates get a fast, clear process.

  • Improve how we hire: screening quality, process, employer brand.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2 to 5 years in talent acquisition, in-house, agency, executive search or staffing.

  • You have run several roles in parallel against a deadline, not one at a time.

  • Real sourcing skill. You can find people who are not looking.

  • You move fast because your process is good, not because you work late.

  • Hiring experience across more than one function, corporate and tech.

  • You read candidates well and can defend a call to a skeptical hiring manager.

  • Startup, high-growth or agency experience preferred. Slow environments will not suit.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Your roles close on time, and hiring managers know where each one stands without having to ask.

  • Every role you run draws strong volume, because you treat the job post as something to be tested and improved rather than published once.

  • Shortlists hold up. Hiring managers interview the people you send and rarely ask for a different batch.

  • Candidates move through the process quickly. Nothing sits waiting on you.

  • Offers get accepted, not just issued.

  • Hiring works better a year from now than it does today, because of changes you made.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

What We're Looking For

jobs.description:
Company overview:

A leading oleochemicals manufacturer with a strong heritage in producing high-quality products from natural and renewable vegetable-based oils. The company operates a modern manufacturing facility equipped with advanced technology and produces high-quality fatty acids and glycerine for customers worldwide.

Its manufacturing capabilities allow the company to meet various customer specifications and requirements across international markets.

Job Descriptions:

Costing, Stock Valuation and Product Profitability

  • Assist the Manager in planning, organising, coordinating and monitoring the Company's
    costing systems to ensure efficient and accurate product costing, stock valuation and
    inventory reporting.
  • Prepare and review monthly stock valuation and costing for work-in-progress and finished
    goods for POC, ensuring proper cut-off, completeness and accuracy before submission
    to the Manager.
  • Assist in reviewing and maintaining cost allocation bases for material inputs, production
    costs and factory overhead absorption rates for costing purposes.
  • Prepare and analyse product profitability by product group, customer, contract and other
    relevant dimensions, and highlight negative margin contracts, unusual variances and
    areas requiring management attention.

Management Reporting, Budgeting and Business Analysis

  • Support the Manager in assessing management information needs and recommending
    improvements to reporting processes, systems and formats.
  • Prepare Profit & Loss reporting by product group, including distilled fatty acid,
    fractionation fatty acid, hydrogenation fatty acid, glycerine and other relevant product
    segments.
  • Support budget preparation, forecast review, variance analysis and cost control initiatives
    by providing timely and reliable financial information to management.
  • Monitor key cost drivers, production cost trends, inventory movements and abnormal
    variances, and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

Payments and Financial Controls

  • Review payment proposals and related documents for completeness, accuracy, proper support and compliance with approved procedures before escalation or approval by the appropriate authority.
  • Ensure relevant supporting documents, including invoices, purchase orders, supplier delivery orders, goods receiving vouchers, weight tickets and other required documents, are attached and properly verified.
  • Assist in reviewing internal control procedures, identifying control gaps or process weaknesses, and recommending improvements to strengthen governance, accountability and audit readiness.

﻿Accounting, Tax and Statutory Compliance

  • ﻿﻿Assist in overseeing accounting activities to ensure accurate recording of transactions,
    proper account classification, timely month-end closing and completeness of financial
    records.
  • Review and ensure timely preparation of accounting schedules, reconciliations, accruals,
    provisions and supporting analyses for management and audit purposes.
  • Assist in the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit schedules and responses
    to audit queries, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and company
    reporting requirements.
  • Liaise and coordinate with tax agents, auditors and relevant authorities on tax compliance
    matters, including income tax, sales and service tax, withholding tax and other applicable
    statutory submissions.
  • Review tax computations, tax estimates, deferred tax schedules and tax-related
    reconciliations to ensure accuracy, timely submission and proper documentation.
  • Monitor tax filing deadlines, statutory payment due dates and regulatory changes
    affecting the Company, and escalate key tax risks or compliance matters to Management
    where necessary.

﻿Inventory and Stock Management

  • Review stock write-off, stock adjustment and inventory movement documentation to
    ensure proper approval, completeness and compliance with company policies.
  • Highlight high stock level items, slow-moving inventory, abnormal stock balances and
    potential inventory risks to management for timely action.
  • Liaise with Operations, Procurement, Warehouse and other relevant departments to
    ensure stock records, costing data and inventory reports are complete and accurate.

Insurance, Risk Management and Compliance

  • Coordinate insurance renewal matters and ensure insurance schedules are updated and
    maintained properly.
  • Assist in reviewing insurance coverage to ensure the Company's assets, operations and
    interests are adequately covered, and follow up on policy changes, claims or renewal
    matters as required.
  • Ensure operational activities within the department comply with approved standard
    operating procedures and all other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure the department implements, establishes and maintains applicable management
    systems, including required controls, documentation and adherence to standard
    requirements.

Team Leadership and Department Administration

  • Assist the Manager in planning, coordinating and monitoring departmental activities to
    support the Company's goals, objectives, budget and reporting requirements.
  • Supervise, guide and develop team members to ensure work is performed accurately,
    efficiently and within required timelines.
  • Assign and follow up on work responsibilities, review staff output, provide guidance and
    support capability development within the department.
  • Perform any other duties or special assignments as may be assigned by Management
    from time to time.

Job Requirements:

  • ﻿﻿Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline; professional qualification such as
    ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent is preferred.
  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant working experience, including hands-on exposure to
    costing, accounting or management reporting in a manufacturing environment, preferably
    in oil refinery, oleochemicals or a related process manufacturing industry.
  • Good knowledge of product costing, stock valuation, inventory controls, management
    reporting, budgeting and financial analysis.
  • Good understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, payment controls and
    financial governance practices.
  • Good understanding of accounting standards, statutory financial reporting, audit
    processes and Malaysian tax compliance requirements, including income tax, SST and
    withholding tax.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and financial/accounting systems, with strong
    analytical, problem-solving and reporting skills.
  • Able to communicate effectively with management, team members, operations,
    procurement, warehouse and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Possesses integrity, attention to detail, accountability, leadership ability and a continuous
    improvement mindset.

Description

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within Canada.

Sargent & Lundy Consulting (SLC) works on behalf of clients to support electric power projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will help work on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, BESS, reciprocating engines, and other generating technologies with large dynamic electrical loads.

We are seeking a Controls & Grid Integration Planning Engineer to support Owner’s Engineer and design teams on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, reciprocating engines, BESS, Solar PV, with large dynamic loads. The role will provide independent technical oversight of plant control philosophies, ensuring that OEM, EPC, and system integrator designs collectively deliver stable, resilient, and compliant operation under steady-state, transient, and islanded conditions. The engineer will review and challenge dynamic studies, control narratives, plant controller strategies, and protection philosophies without directly performing detailed PSS®E or PSCAD modeling. Responsibilities include validating integration between GT controls, BESS EMS/PPC systems, SCADA, and overall coordination strategies (frequency response, voltage control, inertia management, black start, load rejection, and large motor/data center step loads).

The position requires strong cross-disciplinary leadership, risk identification capability, and the ability to translate complex control interactions into clear recommendations for owner and lender stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include engineering design reviews, technical due diligence, project development support, and conceptual design. Particular experience in electrical design of thermal power projects is desired.

You will have the opportunity to travel within North America as well as internationally.

Qualifications

    • This position requires a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
    • 10+ years’ experience in power generation controls, grid integration, or utility-scale plant systems
    • Demonstrated experience with islanded or isolated grids
    • Strong understanding of dynamic performance studies (transient stability, EMT, frequency response), even if not the primary modeler
    • Familiarity with gas turbine control systems (e.g., Mark VIe or equivalent) and BESS plant/energy management systems, power plant controllers
    • Experience reviewing EPC deliverables, grid code compliance documentation, and performance guarantees
    • Knowledge of protection coordination and system-level control architecture

      • Simple cycle gas turbines,
      • Combined cycle projects,
      • Coal fired generation, or

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering is a plus.

  • Contract development experience is a plus.
  • Reliability modeling experience is a plus.

About OpenClinica:

OpenClinica enables organizations to recruit participants and conduct clinical studies through connected solutions that simplify operations and accelerate discovery.Our platform brings together EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, randomization, analytics, and patient recruitment in a practical solution built for small to mid-size sponsors, CROs, and academic teams. About the Role and Team:

The Account Executive, eClinical is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for driving new business growth for OpenClinica’s core eClinical platform. This is a true hunting role focused primarily on new logo acquisition, with additional responsibility for expansion in accounts where our Customer Success team is not actively involved.


The role is focused on selling OpenClinica’s eClinical solutions, including EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, analytics, and EMR integrations, to small to mid-size biotech and medtech companies with lean clinical operations teams, limited internal IT resources, and time-sensitive study needs. Some academic opportunities may arise, but that is not the primary focus.


This role requires someone who can create a meaningful self-sourced pipeline through disciplined outbound prospecting, manage a full sales cycle, and close business in a way that improves predictability over time. What You Will Do:

  • Meet or exceed assigned quota

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through focused outbound prospecting, account targeting, and follow-up

  • Own the full sales cycle for new eClinical business within the assigned territory

  • Identify, qualify, and advance opportunities with small to mid-size biotech and medtech companies

  • Develop a strong working knowledge of clinical research workflows, stakeholder roles, and the broader eClinical ecosystem

  • Develop strong proficiency in OpenClinica’s eClinical solutions, including EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, analytics, and integrations, and position them effectively against customer needs

  • Understand the profile, priorities, and common pain points of ideal prospective customers

  • Map accounts, identify key stakeholders, and run a sales process that reflects customer needs and buying reality

  • Partner effectively with Sales Engineering and other internal subject matter experts to strengthen discovery, demos, strategy, and deal execution

  • Contribute to better opportunity quality, forecast accuracy, and pipeline discipline across the team

  • Stay current on product updates, roadmap developments, and relevant market dynamics

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Solutions, Marketing, and leadership to improve handoffs, share market feedback, and support account growth where appropriate

  • Represent OpenClinica credibly and professionally with prospects, customers, and at selected industry events

  • Other duties may be assigned

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in a quota-carrying SaaS sales role.

  • Direct experience in a startup environment and/or selling eClinical software highly preferred.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota and driving revenue growth.

  • Proven success generating meaningful self-sourced pipeline through outbound prospecting

  • Experience selling into small to mid-size biotech, medtech, or other clinical trial sponsor organizations

  • Strong understanding of clinical trial workflows and the broader eClinical ecosystem

  • Strong familiarity with core eClinical technologies such as EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, analytics, and related integrations

  • Ability to run a disciplined sales process, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder management, forecasting, and closing

  • Strong understanding of the needs of lean clinical operations teams working under timeline and resource constraints

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Strong relationship-building skills with both business and operational stakeholders

  • High degree of organization and CRM discipline

  • Adaptable to a fast-evolving company environment where not all systems and processes are fully established yet

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship

  • Proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales engagement tool

jobs.description:
Brief Description:

The Learning Specialist role will focus in several critical areas:

  • Designing and creating content (Facilitator Guides, Participant Workbooks, Job Aids, Exercises, Coaching Guides, blended learning solutions, and e-learning modules)
  • Designing and creating knowledge resources that are effective for front line staff utilization. This position provides consultation through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials
  • Facilitating training sessions (in classroom and virtually) from on-boarding to continued development to refresher training and pull-through of training concepts into practical everyday work. This position provides consultation through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials as well as creating client facing training curricula and schedules.

This position focus can change between these key areas to support the needs of the business and specific areas of expertise and time allocation will vary. The role is responsible for the development and delivery of learning experience across the assigned area of responsibility as well as providing consultation through the assessment, evaluation, and development of both existing and new training programs and materials. The role will also be called upon to deliver internal business unit training materials to help ensure all teams/programs have consistent foundational learnings and are operating from similar ‘Ways of Working’ principles.

Specific job duties:

  • On-boarding employees and contingent workers to ensure they have the knowledge, skills and abilities to meet customer expectations and enterprise goals.
  • Develop and deliver standardized system and process training via classroom/virtual methods. This may include travel to other UBC sites and/or to client hosted locations.
  • Consult with program participants and management to evaluate impact of training programs. Review quality and performance records to determine opportunities for review and retraining needs that may be associate specific.
  • Respond to specific training requests by leadership team or quality in a timely manner.
  • Develop, maintain and update training program and materials to reflect updated systems or processes.
  • Provide feedback and conduct periodic retraining where quality or performance issues are noted or when system or process changes require training.
  • Deliver customized program training via classroom or other methods.
  • Administer practical exercises to evaluate trainee’s comprehension. Ensure training objectives and goals are related to business objectives or client needs.
  • Responsible for ensuring all training records are documented and maintained
  • Maintains overall training documentation records including creation, revisions, reviews and archival.
  • Researching, authoring, publishing, and maintenance of Process and other related documents in compliance with established content standards using various authoring tools (KMS, MS Word, Dreamweaver, Flare, etc.).
  • Works closely with various departments and related groups, Business Owners and SMEs to document procedures and related content, including the translation of business needs into user instructions and reference content.
  • Provides support on a variety of projects including systemic improvements/enhancements to existing documentation flow and storage including contributing to training related SOP revisions.
  • Collaborates and cross-trains with Learning team to leverage organizational efficiency
  • Build and maintain effective partnerships with internal clients through needs assessments and discussions to proactively identify issues that impact training needs from both a competency and knowledge base.
  • Build and maintain effective partnerships with external clients through proactively identifying issues that impact performance and agent competency and quickly partnering to revise/retrain as needed.
  • Build and facilitate content – Facilitator Guides, Participant Workbooks, Worksheets, Job Aids, Exercises, Coaching Guides, blended learning modules, and e-learning modules to meet Program Specific Procedures, Compliance, Standard Operating Procedures, knowledge, and adherence.
  • Work collaboratively with internal clients and IT on system builds and other data points to assess needs, UAT test, coordinate, design, and develop interactive learning solutions through a variety of mediums in support of the overall strategy and goals of the business.
  • Learning interactions will focus on competencies such as presentation, negotiation, communication, conflict resolution, and procedural knowledge.
  • Play a key role across the business unit in deploying and supporting strategic initiatives and enhancements from a learning perspective.
  • Use clear communication and cross-functional process management skills to ensure timely delivery of effective training programs and sessions that add value in supporting the goals and initiatives of the business.
  • Support or participate in projects determined in conjunction with business partners, Directors and/or Managers.
  • Maintain awareness of new developments in training and instructional design and recommend modifications in our curriculum and practices.
  • Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions. Represents the organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects.
  • Develop and maintain expert knowledge of critical tools and learning requirements
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Actively participates in in-person and virtual meetings/events (internal and external)

Relevant Systems and Tools:

  • Adult Learning: ADDIE and SAM Methodologies, Technical design, Needs Analysis Skills, Objective Building, Test Creation
  • Instructional Development: Storyline, Articulate, Captivate, Photoshop – Graphical manipulation, Video Production, SharePoint/Web Development, PowerPoint, WebEx , Process Mapping/Visio, Technical Writing
  • Knowledge Management: Search Appliance/ Metadata, HTML/CSS, Web Development, Process Mapping/Visio, Technical Writing
  • LMS Administration: eQMS, SumTotal, Survey Monkey, Excel pivot tables and charts, Analytical analysis to tie evaluation data to business production

Supervisory Responsibility:

No supervisory responsibility is required although team leadership and influencing without authority as well as strong project management skills are critical to the role.

Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, training or related field or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years relevant experience or Master’s degree; operations or business environment experience
  • Certification in facilitation, adult learning, project management experience preferred
  • Ability to motivate employees, provide thought leadership and forward thinking
  • Demonstrated ability to meet multiple deadlines and manage heavy workload
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented and ability to multi-task
  • Strong focus on Patient & Client Satisfaction
  • Strong prioritization skills, able to handle multiple projects at once
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication (verbal and written) skills
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft package, particularly on Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Proven ability to develop supporting documentation
  • Understanding of adult learning principles and techniques
  • Excellent internal and external customer service skills
  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools, HTML expert, knowledge management tools preferred
  • Experience in conducting needs analysis and operations application functionality preferred
  • Ability to identify customized strategies and tactics for success in training delivery
  • Able to problem solve and think analytically

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

Are you passionate about SaaS, and ready to grow your sales career? We are looking for a driven and dynamic Account Executive to help us expand our footprint. As a key player on our Customer Acquisition team, you’ll take the lead in selling PartsBase memberships and promoting digital advertising and PBExpo, our premier annual tradeshow. With a strong product, comprehensive training, and a supportive team behind you, you’ll use consultative selling strategies to identify prospects’ needs and show them how PartsBase delivers unmatched value and results.

  • Drive Sales Growth: Proactively engage companies across the aviation, aerospace, and defense sectors via email, phone, video calls, and networking platforms.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with marketing, customer success, and product teams to align sales strategies with business goals and share market insights.

  • Continuously Learn: Stay up-to-date on industry trends, prospect feedback, and product developments to refine your approach and deepen your expertise.

Every conversation you have and every relationship you build helps aviation and defense organizations around the globe operate more efficiently and make smarter decisions.

Enjoy More of Your Weekend!

We value work-life balance, which is why our team wraps up one hour early every Friday to get a head start on the weekend.

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Get an inside look at our culture, people, and benefits--Check us out here: 👉

Our Interview Process

We believe applying for a new opportunity should be exciting, not stressful. That's why we've created a transparent, candidate-friendly hiring experience with clear expectations and timely communication every step of the way.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

What would you do with an affiliate program behind a product with 50M monthly visits?

We're operating in one of the fastest-growing AI consumer categories online, and affiliation is one of our biggest growth channels.

Now, we're looking for someone to take it further.

You'll work directly with Hugo, our Head of Partnerships & Affiliation, and run your own book, with real room to set deals, choose partners, and make decisions.

The challenge is growing volume quickly while keeping traffic quality and margins high.

You'll directly shape the next wave of growth as we scale toward 100M users.

Key Responsibilities

  • Bring in new affiliates and get them up and running quickly, from first contact to their first conversions

  • Grow your existing partners by staying in close contact, understanding what they need, and helping them scale

  • Check the data daily to catch drops, tracking issues, or low-quality traffic early, and fix them fast

  • Negotiate deals that help your partners grow and bring us high-quality new users

Your Qualifications

  • You've personally recruited and grown affiliate partners and can show it in numbers

  • You've worked where affiliates were a core growth channel (iGaming, dating or subscription apps)

  • You know data and tracking, and you spot problems early and come up with solutions

  • You negotiate CPA, RevShare, hybrid, and flat deals that work for both sides

  • You build long-term relationships with partners and communicate clearly in fluent English

  • You like to work autonomously, using AI to move faster

  • You are fully comfortable promoting products based on uncensored models and NSFW content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!
